title.zh: 2027 年魔域 WCA 世界锦标赛公布
title.en: Announcing the MoYu WCA World Championship 2027

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

WCA 大型锦标赛团队（WMCT）很高兴地公布2027 年魔域 WCA 世界锦标赛的详情：比赛将于 2027 年 7 月 22 日至 25 日在瑞典乌普萨拉举行！

这将是第 13 届世界锦标赛，也是 WCA 这项最高级别赛事自 2017 年巴黎世锦赛以来首次重返欧洲。

我们还要衷心感谢魔域，让本届世锦赛得以举办。2027 年魔域 WCA 世界锦标赛是魔域首次赞助 WCA 世界锦标赛，我们非常高兴能在这一全球舞台上与魔域合作。

WCA 世界锦标赛是一场凝聚全球社群的盛会，也是观看世界顶尖速拧选手同场竞技、见证各个官方项目世界冠军诞生的机会。瑞典魔方协会正与 WMCT 紧密合作，努力让 2027 年世锦赛充分展现我们社群的精神和才华。我们期待在明年夏天与大家相见！

完整比赛信息可在 WCA 比赛页面查看。
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

The WCA Major Championships Team (WMCT) is excited to announce the details for the MoYu WCA World Championship 2027, taking place on July 22nd - July 25th, in Uppsala, Sweden!

This is the 13th World Championship, and marks a return to Europe for the WCA’s premier event, the first time since Paris hosted the Championship in 2017.

We would also like to extend a huge thank you to MoYu for making this championship possible. The MoYu WCA World Championship 2027 marks MoYu’s first time sponsoring a WCA World Championship, and we are thrilled to be partnering with them on the global stage.

The WCA World Championship is a global gathering that unites our community as well as an opportunity to see the world’s best speedcubers compete and to crown the World Champions across all official WCA events. The Swedish Cube Association, in collaboration with the WMCT, is hard at work ensuring that the 2027 championship reflects the spirit and talent within the speedcubing community, and we are excited to see everyone next Summer!

Full competition details can be found on the WCA competition page.

title.zh: 诚信委员会简报：2026 年第三季度

html.zh:
WCA 社群，你们好：

以下是过去三个月 WIC 部分重要案件与一般动态。上季度立案 17 件、结案 10 件，作出 6 项禁赛、3 项警告，1 件未采取措施。

已发布公开报告的案件

  • WIC 与其他团队合作，结束了一项历时数月、针对某国社群问题的调查，导致多名 WCA 代表降职，一名组织者受到重大处分。详情见论坛帖子。
  • 一名选手取得高水平最少步成绩，引起部分顶尖选手怀疑。其随后向公众及通过邮件向 WIC 承认成绩作弊。比赛代表取消了相关成绩，简短调查后给予禁赛。详情见报告。
  • 一名选手在 2025 年取得突出 Skewb 成绩，包括单次洲纪录。一群顶尖选手报告疑虑后，经数月调查，WIC 认定这些成绩不可能由人类完成，涉及某种规则违反，可能是意外，也可能是故意。因此取消两项成绩，并追溯撤销一项 Skewb 洲纪录。详情见报告。

同期其他案件

本季度处理了多起提前停表事件：

  1. 一名选手被报告在比赛中故意提前停表。联系后其非常配合，还承认了代表未发现或未取消的其他情况。鉴于比赛经验相对不足且诚实，仅给予较短禁赛，并取消成绩。
  2. 另一场比赛发生类似事件。考虑年龄较小、仅涉及少量轮次，WIC 选择警告并取消相关成绩。两案相近，但年龄是后一案没有禁赛的重要因素。
  3. WIC 注意到今年已报告多起提前停表。未来引入四触点模式有望改善问题，但仍请担任裁判的读者认真警觉地观察还原，确保正确停表。
  • 有选手在场馆内将魔方还原成带仇恨含义的符号图案。联系后他们承担责任并道歉，均获警告。
  • 两名选手被发现串通，为彼此取得相对其他选手的优势，其中一人被直接观察到故意错误打乱另一人的魔方。两人均被禁赛，成绩被取消。
  • 一名选手向 WIC 报告在比赛中受到欺凌和骚扰。虽然多数行为发生在 WIC 管辖范围外，但部分行为确实在比赛中发生并被观察到。实施行为的选手获警告。
  • 一名选手因不当行为被场馆管理方请离，多人向 WIC 报告。询问多名选手和代表后，WIC 确认该行为严重，且至少在另一场比赛也发生过。因此禁止其参赛及到场。

一般动态

  • Shain Papalotl Longbehn（2020LONG05）近期卸任高级成员。衷心感谢其过去四年工作，特别感谢担任 WIC 和 WDC 负责人期间的出色贡献。
  • Lars Johan Folde（2018FOLD01）获任高级成员，祝贺并祝履职顺利。
  • 新设保护小组已开始工作，由少量专业人员处理选手保护问题，并按必要知情原则处理个案。相关引导信息即将完善。如对 WCA 认可活动中儿童及处于风险中的选手的安全、福祉有疑问或忧虑，可联系 safeguarding@worldcubeassociation.org。

如有问题，欢迎发邮件，我们的邮箱始终开放。
html.en:
Hi WCA Community,

Below you can find a summary of some of the notable cases the WCA Integrity Committee has worked on, as well as some general WIC updates from the past three months.

In the last quarter, the WCA Integrity Committee opened 17 cases and closed 10. This resulted in 6 bans and 3 warnings, while 1 case ended with no action.

Below, you can find summaries of cases we have published public reports for:

  • The WIC concluded a months-long investigation into community issues in a country, in collaboration with other teams. This resulted in the demotions of multiple WCA delegates and an organizer receiving a significant sanction. Further details can be found in this forum post, linked here.
  • A competitor was noted to have achieved high-level FMC results which arouse the suspicion of some top competitors. The competitor subsequently confessed to the public and to the WIC via email that they had cheated their results. The competitor had these results disqualified by competition delegates, and after a brief investigation received a ban. More information can be found in this report, linked here.
  • A competitor was noted to have achieved notable Skewb results, which included a continental record single, in 2025. After a group of top competitors reported these concerns to the WIC and after a months long investigation, we concluded the results were not humanly possible to achieve and involved some sort of regulation violation, whether accidental or intentional. Due to this, the WIC elected to disqualify both results, retroactively reverting a continental record in Skewb. More information can be found at this report, linked here.

Here were other cases the WIC worked on during this time:

  • The WIC dealt with multiple cases this quarter involving early timer stops:
  1. A competitor was reported to be engaging in deliberate early timer stops at a competition. When contacted, the competitor was extremely cooperative and admitted to other occurrences that were not observed/already disqualified by the competition delegates. Given their relative inexperience competing and their honesty, they were issued only a brief ban and solves were disqualified.
  2. A similar case occurred at another competition. Given their young age and the fact that this occurred only over a small amount of rounds, the WIC elected to issue a warning and disqualified the relevant solves. Although we understand that these two cases are relatively similar, the age of the competitor was a large factor into why a ban was not issued in the above case.
  3. The WIC would like to note we have already seen multiple cases with early timer stops being reported this year. While this problem will improve with the eventual introduction of 4-pad mode, we would like to ask readers who serve as competition judges to be vigilant and attentive while watching competitor’s solves to ensure they are properly stopping the timer.
  • Competitors at a competition were observed solving patterns depicting symbols with hateful connotations onto their cubes inside of the venue. The competitors, when contacted, accepted responsibility and apologized for their actions. Warnings were issued to the competitors involved.
  • Two competitors were found to be colluding with one another to give each other advantages over other competitors, including one competitor being directly observed deliberately misscrambling the other competitor’s puzzles. Both of these competitors were issued bans, with results disqualified.
  • A competitor reported to the WIC that they were experiencing bullying and harassment at a competition. Although most of this behavior occurred in areas outside of the scope of the WIC, some of this behavior was present and observed at competitions. The competitor engaging in this behavior was issued a warning.
  • A competitor was removed from a competition by venue management for inappropriate behavior, and their behavior from this competition was reported to the WIC by multiple individuals. The WIC confirmed the existence of this behavior as significant and occurring at at least one other competition after requesting comment from multiple competitors and delegates. The competitor was issued a competing and attendance ban.

General WIC updates:

  • Shain Papalotl Longbehn (2020LONG05) recently stepped down from his positions as WIC Senior Member. We are immensely grateful for all the work Shain has done over the past four years as a WIC member, and we would like to make special mention of his outstanding contribution as WIC Leader and WDC Leader.
  • Lars Johan Folde (2018FOLD01) was recently appointed as Senior Member of the WCA Integrity Committee. We congratulate him and wish him the best of luck in his new role.
  • The WIC has recently created a new subteam, the safeguarding subteam, which has commenced work. This subteam will allow for a small group of specialists to handle concerns regarding competitor safeguarding, and for these cases to be handled on a need to know basis. While signposting to this new group will be improved soon, you may contact this safeguarding group at safeguarding@worldcubeassociation.org with any questions or concerns that you may have regarding child and at-risk competitor’s safety and wellbeing at WCA-recognized events.

Do you have questions for the WCA Integrity Committee? Feel free to send us an email. Our inboxes are always open!

title.zh: WCA 质量保证委员会招募申请人（2026 年 9 月）
title.en: WCA Quality Assurance Committee Call for Applicants - (September 2026)

html.zh:
WCA 质量保证委员会志愿者岗位招募

WCA 质量保证委员会（WQAC）正在招募最多六名志愿者，填补委员会的空缺岗位。对于新加入 WCA 的志愿者，WQAC 是一个很好的起点；对于现有 WCA 志愿者，加入 WQAC 也是探索其他方式为 WCA 社区作贡献的机会。

WQAC 负责什么？

WQAC 负责开发支持 WCA 社区的教育资源，并在 WCA 志愿者未能保持岗位所需技能时提供建议。WQAC 的正式权利与职责载于 WCA 议案 10.2025.8。每位成员预计每周投入约 4—5 小时处理委员会事务。

我是否符合申请 WQAC 的条件？

申请 WQAC 的主要要求是年满 18 岁，并具备熟练的英语写作能力。我们尤其看重细致认真、解决问题和协作的能力。下列各空缺岗位还有各自的具体要求。

空缺岗位

问询团队负责人（原调查团队，1 个名额）

问询团队处理与 WCA 比赛质量、未违反《道德准则》或《行为准则》的代表行为、《WCA 打乱问责政策》（WSAP）的遵守情况，以及其他没有由别的委员会或团队直接负责的问题有关的事项。该团队正从更直接地调查问题，转向协助区域代表和高级代表，由他们开始自行直接处理所在地区的问题。该岗位直接向 WQAC 负责人汇报。如果您曾经或正在 WCA 担任志愿者，并希望帮助各地区、委员会及团队解决问题，这一岗位很适合您。

我们希望申请人：

  • 有领导小型、多元团队的经验。
  • 深入了解 WCA 代表的角色与职责。
  • 具备较强的分析与批判性思考能力，包括对认知偏差的理解。
  • 愿意为团队成员分配不同任务。
  • 能定期跟进问询事项的进展。
  • 能每天查看电子邮件和 Slack。
  • 能通过电子邮件进行专业、清晰的沟通。

学习管理系统（LMS）管理员（1—3 个名额）

学习管理系统（LMS）项目团队已发布首门培训课程，面向准备晋升为初级代表的见习代表。随着课程数量增加，为我们的 LMS 平台 Moodle 至少增设一名有经验的管理员，已变得愈加迫切。我们需要一至三名有经验的人员，协助维护现有的见习代表升初级代表课程，并帮助创建后续课程。入选者还需经常与不同团队合作，增补、改进课程内容，评估现有题库，并随着政策与实践的发展更新内容。该岗位向 LMS 项目负责人汇报。对于有在线课程开发经验的现任教育工作者或有志投身教育的人士，这一岗位非常合适。

我们希望申请人：

  • 有使用 Moodle 或其他类似 LMS 的经验。
  • 有与多个团队协作、按需更新课程内容的经验。
  • 深入了解 WCA 代表的角色（优先考虑；若具有丰富的课程或 LMS 经验，则不作硬性要求）。
  • 有课程设计经验。
  • 有 HTML/CSS/JavaScript 使用经验。

每位申请人不必满足上述所有条件，只要最终录用的团队成员合起来具备这些经验和能力即可。

WQAC 政策维护人员（1—2 个名额）

随着 LMS 上线，以及 WQAC 负责的政策即将迎来更新，我们需要专门的政策维护人员。WQAC 负责维护两项 WCA 政策：《WCA 打乱问责政策》（WSAP）及即将实施的《WCA 代表管理政策》（WDMP）。政策维护人员需经常与 WQAC 负责人及各分组负责人协作，并向 EduDocs 团队负责人汇报。他们将根据需要调整、增补 WSAP 和 WDMP 的条款。该岗位最适合希望在 WQAC 承担更多行政事务的人士。

我们希望申请人：

  • 有使用 GitHub 和 Markdown 的经验。
  • 有使用 Google Workspace 的经验，主要是 Google Docs 和 Sheets。
  • 能独立工作，也能按需协作。
  • 有编写、维护政策文件的经验。
  • 熟悉现行 WCA 文件。
  • 深入了解 WCA 代表的角色。

必要时可将该岗位分为两个：一人维护 WSAP，另一人维护 WDMP。

申请流程

有意者可通过这份 Google 表单 提交申请。所有岗位的申请材料均可持续提交，直至该 Google 表单关闭。有关申请或空缺岗位的问题，请联系 Roxana Johnson（rjohnson@worldcubeassociation.org）。

Google 表单要求申请人提供以下信息：

  1. 个人介绍： 简要介绍自己及职业背景。
  2. WCA 经历： 概述过去参与 WCA 的活动或担任过的角色。既往 WCA 经历有帮助，但不是任何这些岗位的必要条件。
  3. 可投入时间： 每周大约能投入多少小时参与 WQAC 志愿工作。
  4. 岗位： 所申请的岗位，以及自己适合这一岗位的理由。

符合条件的候选人将被选中参加面试。入选者将分批加入 WQAC。
html.en:
WCA Quality Assurance Committee Volunteer Positions Available

The WCA Quality Assurance Committee (WQAC) is seeking up to six Volunteers to fill open positions on the Committee. Joining the WQAC is a great way to get started as a new WCA Volunteer, or to explore new ways to contribute to the WCA Community if you are already a WCA Volunteer.

What does the WQAC do?

The WQAC is responsible for developing educational resources to support the WCA Community and advising in situations when WCA Volunteers are not maintaining the skills required for their positions. The official rights and duties of the WQAC are documented in WCA Motion 10.2025.8. Each member is expected to contribute approximately 4-5 hours per week to committee-related work.

Am I qualified to apply to the WQAC?

The main requirements for applying to the WQAC are that you are at least 18 years of age and are proficient in writing English. We are most interested in applicants who have strong attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and collaboration skills. Each open position below has other specific requirements applicable only to that position.

Open Positions

Inquiries (formerly Investigations) Team Leader (1 position)

The Inquiries Team handles concerns related to the quality of WCA competitions, Delegate conduct that does not violate the Code of Ethics or Code of Conduct, adherence to the WCA Scramble Accountability Policy (WSAP), and other issues not directly overseen by other Committees or Teams. This team is shifting from a more direct approach to investigating issues to assisting Regional and Senior Delegates as they begin to directly address region-specific issues on their own. This position would report directly to the WQAC Leader. This role is perfect for current or former WCA Volunteers who wish to help support various regions and WCA Committees and Teams with various issues they might encounter.

We are looking for applicants who:

  • Have experience leading a small diverse team.

  • Have strong knowledge of the role and responsibilities of a WCA Delegate.

  • Have strong analytical and critical thinking skills, including an understanding of cognitive bias.

  • Are willing to assign team members to a variety of tasks.

  • Are able to regularly check on the progress of inquiries.

  • Are able to check email and Slack daily.

  • Are able to communicate professionally and clearly through email.

LMS Administrator (1 to 3 positions)

The Learning Management System (LMS) Project team has released the first training course for Trainee Delegates ready to be promoted to Junior Delegate. As the course catalog grows, it is becoming increasingly urgent to appoint at least one additional experienced administrator for our LMS Platform, Moodle. We are in need of one to three experienced individuals to help maintain the current Trainee-to-Junior course and help create future courses. Individuals selected for this position will also be expected to routinely collaborate with various teams to add and improve course content, evaluate the current question bank, and update content as policies and practices evolve. This position will report directly to the LMS Project Leader. This role is perfect for current or aspiring educators who have experience in online course development.

We are looking for applicants who:

  • Have experience with Moodle or another similar LMS.

  • Have experience collaborating with multiple teams to update course content as needed.

  • Have strong knowledge of the WCA Delegate role (preferred, but not required if you have extensive curriculum or LMS experience).

  • Have experience in curriculum design.

  • Have experience with HTML/CSS/JavaScript.

Individual applicants do not need to have all the experience and qualities above, as long as the selected individuals collectively cover them.

WQAC Policy Maintainer (1 to 2 positions)

With the launch of the LMS and in anticipation of future updates to WQAC-maintained policies, we need a dedicated Policy Maintainer. The WQAC maintains two WCA policies: the WCA Scramble Accountability Policy (WSAP) and the soon-to-be-implemented WCA Delegate Management Policy (WDMP). The Policy Maintainer would be responsible for routinely collaborating with the WQAC Leader and the Subteam Leaders, and would report to the EduDocs Team Leader. They would adjust and add sections to the WSAP and WDMP as needed. This position is best suited for those who want a more administrative role within the WQAC.

We are looking for applicants who:

  • Have experience working with GitHub and Markdown.

  • Have experience working in Google Workspace, mainly Google Docs and Sheets.

  • Are able to work independently and collaboratively as needed.

  • Have experience writing and maintaining policy documents.

  • Have a strong knowledge of the current WCA Documents.

  • Have a strong knowledge of the WCA Delegate role.

This position can be split into two if necessary: One individual who maintains the WSAP, and another individual who maintains the WDMP.

Application Process

Interested candidates can submit applications using this Google Form The application period for candidates to submit their candidacy documents for all positions will be open until the Google Form is closed . Questions regarding the application or the open positions can be sent to Roxana Johnson (rjohnson@worldcubeassociation.org).

The Google Form will require applicants to provide the following information:

  1. Personal Introduction: A brief summary of who you are and your professional background.

  2. WCA Experience: A summary of any past activities or roles held within the WCA. While helpful, prior WCA experience is not a requirement for any of these roles.

  3. Time Commitment: The approximate number of hours per week you can commit to WQAC volunteer work.

  4. Role: The role you are applying to and the reasons you are fit for it.

Qualified candidates will be selected for interviews. Selected candidates will be added to the WQAC on a rolling basis.

title.zh: 采用 4-pad 计时模式（2026 年 8 月）

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

自 2027 年 1 月 2 日起，所有使用速拧计时器的 WCA 正式还原，都必须使用 Speed Stacks G5 StackMat™ Pro Timer 的 4-pad 模式。采用 4-pad 模式后，可以更可靠地确认正式成绩是在遵守 WCA 规则的情况下取得的，也能提高 WCA 成绩的公信力。

自 WCA 成立以来，我们一直使用具有两个感应区的速拧计时器记录成绩。这些计时器能够精确测量时间，但要使测得的时间准确反映一次速拧尝试的用时，选手必须按照 WCA 规则启动和停止计时器。

目前已经明确，双感应区速拧计时器会给规则执行带来困难，尤其是有些违规动作可能无法被现场裁判直接察觉。逐帧录像分析是一种应对方法，但这种分析耗时，而且依赖高质量录像。我们尚未找到可行的规则措辞修改或其他合适办法，能在保留现有计时器要求的前提下妥善解决这些问题。

因此，WCA 决定，改用 4-pad 是应对这些挑战的最佳方案。这项新要求将取代 WCA 认可计时器清单中的现行要求。该清单目前要求使用 2-pad 模式，并允许使用 G4 StackMat™ Pro Timer 和 G3 StackMat™ Pro Timer。

4-pad 模式需要相应修改有关启动和停止速拧计时器的规则。作为年度规则修订周期的一部分，规则修订草案将于 9 月公布，征求社区意见。

对于绝大多数选手和项目，2-pad 与 4-pad 成绩之间的时间差异可以忽略。因此，现有纪录将保持有效，直至在 4-pad 模式下被打破；4-pad 成绩也将与 2-pad 成绩共同排名。虽然我们认为没有必要重置纪录，但 WCA 排名页面将增加筛选功能，允许在二阶、魔表、金字塔和 Skewb 项目中切换查看全部成绩或仅 4-pad 成绩。

目前使用不具备 4-pad 功能计时器的所有地区，都将在这项变更生效前及时获得 Speed Stacks G5 计时器。费用由 WCA 承担，物流也由 WCA 负责。

有关这一变更背后的考量，以及 WCA 作出决定所经历的流程，请参阅 4-pad 决策过程说明文件。
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

From January 2, 2027, all official WCA attempts performed with a speedsolving timer will be required to use a Speed Stacks G5 StackMat™ Pro Timer in 4-pad mode. The adoption of 4-pad mode will provide greater certainty that official times are achieved in accordance with the WCA Regulations and will strengthen the integrity of the results recognized by the WCA.

Since our formation, the WCA has recorded times based on a speedsolving timer with two sensor pads. Although these timers are capable of precise measurement, the accuracy of this measurement in timing a speedsolving attempt requires the timer to be started and stopped in accordance with the WCA Regulations.

It has become clear that the use of speedsolving timers with two sensor pads causes difficulties in enforcing these Regulations, especially since Regulation infractions may not be visible to a judge when viewed live. Frame-by-frame video offers one route around this, but performing this analysis is time consuming and reliant on high quality video being available. No viable changes to the current Regulations wording or other suitable means have been identified that would provide a satisfactory resolution using existing timer requirements.

The WCA has therefore decided that switching to 4-pad represents the best solution to these challenges. This new requirement will replace the existing requirements in the WCA Approved Timer List, which currently requires 2-pad mode, and also allows for use of the G4 StackMat™ Pro Timer and G3 StackMat™ Pro Timer.

4-pad mode will require changes to the Regulations for starting and stopping the speedsolving timer. Draft Regulations changes will be published for community feedback in September, as part of the annual Regulations cycle.

Time differences between 2-pad results and 4-pad results are negligible for the vast majority of competitors and events. As such, existing records will stand until broken under 4-pad mode and 4-pad results will be ranked alongside 2-pad results. Although no record reset is considered necessary, the WCA Rankings page will be updated to support filtering between all results and 4-pad results for 2x2, Clock, Pyraminx, and Skewb.

All regions which are currently using timers without 4-pad capability will have Speed Stacks G5 timers provided in time for the effective date of this change. Costs will be covered and logistics will be handled by the WCA.

For more information on the factors behind this change and the process followed by the WCA to arrive at this decision, please refer to the 4-Pad Decision Process Explainer Document.

title.zh: 诚信委员会简报：2026 年第二季度

html.zh:
WCA 社群，你们好：

以下是过去三个月 WIC 部分重要案件与一般动态。上季度立案 10 件、结案 12 件，作出 2 项禁赛、4 项警告，6 件未采取措施。

  • 多次接报一名选手在比赛环境中扰乱秩序，志愿者表示，这使他们对承办该选手擅长的项目感到不安，因此展开调查。WIC 联系选手，讨论调解行为问题的办法，但认为其回应不令人满意，给予短期禁赛。
  • 因怀疑某选手盲拧表现与从眼罩下偷看相符而展开调查。依据视频及代表证词，WIC 认定正式尝试中确有偷看，并认为其说明并非完全真实。相关可疑成绩被取消，并给予正式警告。
  • 收到报告，选手以具有伤害含义的不当符号开玩笑，假装进行正式尝试，却使用摆成这些符号图案而非正式打乱的魔方。负责此事的选手道歉并获正式警告。

  • Carmen Teo Bin Jie（2012JIET01）；
  • Joran Busser（2022BUSS04）；
  • Jordan Halford（2022HALF02）；
  • Kajtek Kwiatkowski（2023KWIA01）；
  • Lars Johan Folde（2018FOLD01）；
  • Rocío Fernández Usero（2014USER01）；
  • Tyler Williams（2017WILL05）。

Cade Beck（2018BECK05）获任行为小组负责人，Amanda Schmid（2017SCHM12）获任高级成员，祝贺并祝履职顺利。

Carter Kucala（2015KUCA01）、Glib Vedmid（2016VEDM01）、Yash Budhiraja（2018BUDH01）、Yuji Yoshida（2015YOSH01）近期卸任成员，感谢他们的工作。

如有问题，欢迎给 WIC 发邮件，我们的邮箱始终开放。
html.en:
Hi WCA Community,

Below you can find a summary of some of the notable cases the WCA Integrity Committee has worked on, as well as some general WIC updates from the past three months.

In the last quarter, the WCA Integrity Committee opened 10 cases and closed 12. This resulted in 2 bans and 4 warnings, while 6 cases ended with no action. Below, you can find summaries of some notable cases:

  • An investigation was opened after repeated reports of a competitor being disruptive in competition settings, which Volunteers shared with the WIC made them uncomfortable with hosting events the competitor specialized in. The WIC reached out to the competitor and discussed means of mediating their behavioural issues but found their responses unsatisfactory. The competitor received a short ban.
  • An investigation was opened after suspicions that a competitor’s behaviour in blindfolded events was consistent with the possibility that they were looking under the blindfold. Based on video evidence and delegate testimony, the WIC concluded that peeking did indeed occur in these official attempts. The WIC also believes the competitor’s account of the situation was not entirely truthful. The solves in suspicion were disqualified and the competitor was issued a formal warning.
  • The WIC received a report detailing competitors making jokes involving inappropriate symbols with hurtful connotations. It was detailed that these competitors had pretended to conduct official attempts with puzzles showing patterns of these symbols rather than official scrambles. The competitor responsible apologized and was issued a formal warning.

General WIC updates:

After a recent application period, 8 new members have joined the WCA Integrity Committee:

  • Blake Thompson (2010THOM03)
  • Carmen Teo Bin Jie (2012JIET01)
  • Joran Busser (2022BUSS04)
  • Jordan Halford (2022HALF02)
  • Kajtek Kwiatkowski (2023KWIA01)
  • Lars Johan Folde (2018FOLD01)
  • Rocío Fernández Usero (2014USER01)
  • Tyler Williams (2017WILL05)

Cade Beck (2018BECK05) was recently appointed as Leader of the Conduct sub-team. We congratulate him and wish him the best of luck in his new role.

Amanda Schmid (2017SCHM12) was recently appointed as Senior Member of the WCA Integrity Committee. We congratulate her and wish her the best of luck in her new role.

Carter Kucala (2015KUCA01), Glib Vedmid (2016VEDM01), Yash Budhiraja (2018BUDH01), and Yuji Yoshida (2015YOSH01) recently stepped down from their positions as WIC members. Thank you so much for your work Carter, Glib and Yash, and Yuji!

Do you have questions for the WCA Integrity Committee? Feel free to send us an email. Our inboxes are always open!

title.zh: WQAC 简报：2026 年第一、第二季度

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

2026 年上半年，WCA 质量保证委员会（WQAC）一直在推进多项举措，以提升世界魔方协会的整体质量。以下是委员会自 2026 年初以来的主要进展。

概要

我们将委员会划分为三个分组，以改善工作流程，新增了 13.5 名成员，并在持续推进的各项工作中取得显著进展。我们正在编写新的《主办方手册》，学习管理系统（LMS）项目取得了进展，开展了调查，并更新了《代表报告模板》《代表手册》和《WCA 打乱问责政策》（WSAP）。

分组

WQAC 目前分为三个分组。

EduDocs

  • EduDocs 团队负责创建和维护面向 WCA 社区的教育资源，包括《选手教程》《裁判教程》《志愿者速成课程》《主办方指南》（即将改为《主办方手册》）及《代表手册》。

调查

  • 调查团队处理与 WCA 比赛质量、代表行为、《WCA 打乱问责政策》（WSAP）的遵守情况，以及其他未由别的团队或委员会直接负责的问题有关的事项。

项目

  • 项目团队牵头开展改进 WCA 志愿者培训的工作。目前最大的项目是学习管理系统（LMS）项目，其中包含一系列支持 WCA 志愿者培训的教育课程。

成员

2026 年，我们迎来了十三名新成员：

  • Abby Newlander（EduDocs）
  • Abhinav Khot（项目、EduDocs）
  • Addy Coolidge（EduDocs）
  • Amanda Schmid（调查）
  • Diogo Miguel Alves Guerreiro（项目）
  • Fatima Gulab（调查）
  • Hao Chang（调查）
  • Jiashun Wu（EduDocs）
  • Juan Nicolás Pinzón Martínez（EduDocs）
  • Mark Bennis（调查）
  • Matija Vidiček（EduDocs）
  • Shresth Shah（EduDocs）
  • Yuvraj Agarwal（EduDocs、调查）

Amanda Schmid 于 2026 年 1 月加入时，即被任命为调查团队负责人。

Sarah Strong 卸任 EduDocs 分组负责人后，Addy Coolidge 于 2026 年 5 月被任命为该分组负责人。

Sarah Strong 于 2026 年 6 月卸任 WQAC 负责人，以便将更多时间投入 LMS 项目，确保项目按当前计划推进。

我们的资深成员 Dan Smith 于 2026 年 3 月离开 WQAC，转任 WCA 的新岗位。祝贺他成为 WCA 执行董事！不过，三个月后，在我们寻找长期负责人的过程中，他重新加入 WQAC，担任临时负责人。

Roxana Johnson 于 2026 年 7 月被任命为 WQAC 下一任负责人。祝她在新的岗位上一切顺利！

《WCA 打乱问责政策》（WSAP）

我们更新了 WSAP 第 3.2 点，加入正式建议，以降低选手看到同组其他选手官方尝试的风险。

使用选手等候区时：

  1. 在还原台与选手等候区之间设置视觉遮挡。
  2. 如无法设置视觉遮挡，将选手等候区设在距离还原台至少 3 米（10 英尺）的位置。
  3. 如以上两种办法都不可行，则调整等候区布局，让选手背对还原台，例如将椅子转向。

选手留在各自还原台时：

  1. 代表应亲自或指定另一名可信任的人监督选手，确保他们不会通过其他选手的尝试获知打乱信息。

代表报告模板

我们更新了有关场地布置照片的说明，并为备注部分新增了模板。我们鼓励所有代表今后注意这些变化，尤其是在引入主责代表这一角色并修订晋升流程之后。

此前关于场地布置照片的说明如下：

您必须至少上传两张展示打乱区和比赛区的照片（也欢迎上传其他照片）。可以一次选择多个文件。只有在已上传足够多其他照片时，才能删除照片；如果要替换某张照片，需要先上传新照片，再删除旧照片。

新说明如下：

您必须至少上传两张展示本次比赛打乱区和比赛区的照片，最好是在比赛期间拍摄（也欢迎上传其他照片）。可以一次选择多个文件。只有在已上传足够多其他照片时，才能删除照片；如果要替换某张照片，需要先上传新照片，再删除旧照片。如果没有比赛区和／或打乱区在本次比赛使用期间的照片，请说明原因。

备注部分的模板原先为空，现在新增了以下文字：

备注：[出席比赛的代表应简要说明自己在本次比赛中的经历。]

报告主要撰写者：[注明本报告的主要作者。若作者是正在寻求晋升为正式代表的初级代表，这一点尤其重要。]

我们希望提醒各位代表，备注部分的目的之一，是使所有列名代表都对参与赛后工作承担责任，即使其贡献较小也应参与。

代表手册

我们对《代表手册》作出了多项改进。有关年龄政策、WRT 姓名要求及 WCA 规则的过时信息已更新，常见意外事件清单已扩充，报名名单的新结构及新选手检查功能也已加入并作出说明。此外，我们改进了有关生成打乱，以及在签到期间确保数据保护的建议。

我们正在将《代表手册》中所有有关组织比赛的信息迁移至新的《主办方手册》，让每份文件都聚焦于其目标读者。

《代表手册》的一项重要新增内容，是主责代表这一角色。在代表考察期政策工作组的支持下，手册现已对这一角色作出定义和说明。

其他团队与委员会也对《代表手册》作出了贡献。

  • WCA 规则委员会（WRC）提供了有关新规则的更新。
  • WCA 成绩团队（WRT）提供了关于管理报名数据、复查报名数据以及申请修改个人资料的更新。
  • WCA 比赛公告团队（WCAT）提供了关于修改现有比赛信息的更新。

主办方指南

在开始编写《主办方手册》之前，我们先为《主办方指南》增补了细节并作出更正，包括改进以下方面的建议：寻找场地、制定比赛日程、编制比赛预算、志愿者奖励与激励、开展新选手教程及裁判教程、发现遗漏签名，以及举行颁奖仪式。所有这些变化都会体现于新的《主办方手册》。

全新《主办方手册》

《主办方手册》将取代《主办方指南》。它将采用单一 PDF 文件，整合原先分散在十四份文件和一个网页文本中的全部内容，让主办方可以通过 CTRL-F 及类似搜索功能，更轻松地找到所需信息。《主办方手册》将与《代表手册》相似，按时间顺序组织内容，适用于各种类型的比赛，以及具有不同本地实践的地区。目前该手册仍在编写中。

学习管理系统（LMS）项目

从 2025 年 10 月至 2026 年 1 月，我们对首门 LMS 课程——见习代表升初级代表培训课程——进行了试点测试。期间共有 81 名测试者完成课程，超过了原定 52 人的目标。他们提出了 200 多条反馈，我们正逐一考虑这些意见，为今年晚些时候推出正式版本作准备。大多数反馈涉及措辞或格式问题、失效或错误的链接、过时或错误的信息、题目的错误答案，以及增删内容的建议。截至本简报发布时，我们已处理约 180 条反馈，正在解决剩余较复杂的问题。

《WCA 代表管理政策》（WDMP）

WDMP 是与首门正式 LMS 课程相配套的 WCA 政策。我们已收到高级代表及团队／委员会负责人的反馈，并召开会议讨论如何完善初稿，然后再向董事会提交提案。该政策将在首门正式 LMS 课程上线前发布。

感谢您抽出时间阅读本简报！我们将继续努力提升 WCA 的质量。

此致， WCA 质量保证委员会
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

In the first half of 2026, those of us in the WCA Quality Assurance Committee (WQAC) have been developing initiatives to improve the overall quality of the World Cube Association. Here are the main updates from our Committee since the beginning of 2026.

Summary

We organized our Committee into three subteams to improve our workflow, gained 13.5 new members, and made substantial progress on ongoing initiatives. We are in the process of developing a new Organizer Handbook, have made progress on the Learning Management System (LMS) project, conducted investigations, and updated the Delegate Reports Template, the Delegate Handbook, and the WCA Scramble Accountability Policy (WSAP). Subteams

The WQAC is now structured into three subteams.

EduDocs

  • The EduDocs Team is responsible for creating and maintaining educational resources for the WCA Community. These include the Competitor Tutorial, Judge Tutorial, Volunteer Crash Course, Organizer Guidelines (soon to be Organizer Handbook), and Delegate Handbook.

Investigations

  • The Investigations Team handles concerns related to the quality of WCA competitions, Delegate conduct, adherence to the WCA Scramble Accountability Policy (WSAP), and other issues not directly overseen by other Teams or Committees.

Projects

  • The Projects Team leads initiatives to improve the training of WCA Volunteers. The current largest project is the Learning Management System (LMS) Project, which includes a series of educational courses to support training WCA Volunteers. Members

We welcomed thirteen new members in 2026:

  • Abby Newlander (EduDocs)
  • Abhinav Khot (Projects, EduDocs)
  • Addy Coolidge (EduDocs)
  • Amanda Schmid (Investigations)
  • Diogo Miguel Alves Guerreiro (Projects)
  • Fatima Gulab (Investigations)
  • Hao Chang (Investigations)
  • Jiashun Wu (EduDocs)
  • Juan Nicolás Pinzón Martínez (EduDocs)
  • Mark Bennis (Investigations)
  • Matija Vidiček (EduDocs)
  • Shresth Shah (EduDocs)
  • Yuvraj Agarwal (EduDocs, Investigations)

Amanda Schmid was appointed the Leader of Investigations as soon as she joined in January 2026.

Addy Coolidge was appointed the Leader of EduDocs in May 2026 after Sarah Strong stepped down as the leader of this subteam.

Sarah Strong stepped down as Leader of WQAC in June 2026 to spend more time on the LMS Project and ensure we meet our current timelines.

Dan Smith, one of our long-time members, stepped down from WQAC in March 2026 to pursue a new position in the WCA. Congratulations on becoming the Executive Director of the WCA! However, he rejoined the WQAC three months later to become an interim leader while we were looking for a long-term leader.

Roxana Johnson was appointed the next Leader of WQAC in July 2026. We wish her the best in her new position!

WCA Scramble Accountability Policy (WSAP)

We have updated point 3.2 in the WSAP to include formal recommendations to reduce the risk of competitors observing official attempts by other competitors in their group.

When a Competitor Waiting Area is used:

  1. Use visual barriers between the solving stations and the Competitor Waiting Area.
  2. If visual barriers are not possible, place the Competitor Waiting Area at least 3 meters (10 feet) from the Solving Stations.
  3. If neither of the above is possible, arrange the Competitor Waiting Area so that competitors face away from the Solving Stations, such as by turning chairs around.

When competitors remain at their Solving Stations:

  1. Delegates should appoint themselves or another trusted individual to supervise competitors and ensure they do not gain information about scrambles from other competitors’ attempts.

Delegate Report Template

We have updated the text explaining setup photos and have added a new template to the Remarks section. We encourage all Delegates to be mindful of these changes going forward, especially with the introduction of the Lead Delegate role and the revised promotion procedures.

Here is the old text that explained the setup photos:

You MUST include at least 2 images which illustrate the scrambling and competition areas (other images are also welcome). You can select multiple files at once. You can delete images only when enough other images have been uploaded (if you want to replace an image, you need to upload the new one first, and then delete the old one).

And here is the new text:

You MUST include at least 2 images which illustrate the scrambling and competition areas from this current competition, preferably during the competition (other images are also welcome). You can select multiple files at once. You can delete images only when enough other images have been uploaded (if you want to replace an image, you need to upload the new one first, and then delete the old one). If you do not have current pictures of the competition area and/or the scrambling area while in use, please explain why.

The template for the Remarks section was previously blank, and we have added the following text:

Remarks: [The Delegates at the competition should include a brief remark about their experience at the competition.]

Report primarily written by: [Indicate the main author(s) of this report. This is especially important when the author is a Junior Delegate seeking promotion to Full Delegate.]

We would like to remind Delegates that one of the purposes of the Remarks section is to provide accountability towards all listed Delegates to participate in post-competition responsibilities, even if it is a minor contribution.

Delegate Handbook

We made many improvements to the Delegate Handbook. Outdated information regarding the Age Policy, WRT Name Requirements, and WCA Regulations has been updated. The list of common incidents has been expanded. The new structure of the registration lists and the newcomer checks feature have been added and explained. The suggestions for generating scrambles and ensuring data protection during check-in have been improved.

We are in the process of moving all information on organizing competitions from the Delegate Handbook to the new Organizer Handbook, so each document focuses on its intended audience.

One major addition to the Delegate Handbook is the introduction of the Lead Delegate role. With support from the Delegate Probation Policy Working Group, this role has now been defined and explained in the handbook.

Other Teams and Committees have also made contributions to the Delegate Handbook.

  • The WCA Regulations Committee (WRC) has provided updates regarding new Regulations.
  • The WCA Results Team (WRT) has provided updates on administering registration data, double-checking registration data, and requesting changes to personal data.
  • The WCA Competition Announcement Team (WCAT) has provided updates on making changes to existing competitions.

Organizer Guidelines

Before we started the Organizer Handbook, we added additional details and made corrections to the Organizer Guidelines. These include improved suggestions for finding venues, creating competition schedules, drafting competition budgets, volunteer rewards and incentives, running first-time competitor tutorials and judging tutorials, catching missing signatures, and holding awards ceremonies. All these changes will be reflected in the new Organizer Handbook.

**NEW** Organizer Handbook

The Organizer Handbook will be replacing the Organizer Guidelines. It will be a single PDF file that covers all the content that used to be distributed across the fourteen files and text on a webpage. This will allow organizers to find what they are looking for more easily by using CTRL-F and equivalent features. The Organizer Handbook will be structured in chronological order, similar to the Delegate Handbook, and applies to all types of competitions and to different regions with varying local practices. It is currently a work in progress.

Learning Management System (LMS) Project

We ran pilot testing for our first LMS course, the Trainee to Junior Delegate Training Course, from October 2025 to January 2026. There were 81 pilot testers who completed the course during this period, exceeding our goal of 52 testers. They provided over 200 pieces of feedback, all of which we are considering as we are preparing to launch the official version later this year. Most of the feedback pertained to wording or formatting issues, broken or incorrect links, outdated or incorrect information, incorrect answers to questions, and requests to add or remove content. At the time of this digest, we have addressed around 180 pieces of feedback and are working on the remaining, more complex ones.

Delegate Management Policy (WDMP)

The WDMP is the accompanying WCA policy that goes alongside the first official LMS course. We have received feedback from Senior Delegates and Team/Committee Leaders and have held meetings to discuss how to improve our first draft before sending a proposal to the Board. The policy will be published before we launch the first official LMS course.

Thank you for taking the time to read this digest! We will continue to work hard to improve the quality of the WCA.

Sincerely, The WCA Quality Assurance Committee

title.zh: WCA 官方项目列表变更（2026 年 6 月）
title.en: Changes to the WCA’s List of Official Events (June 2026)

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

经过慎重考虑，WCA 董事会决定将面转八面体（FTO）加入 WCA 官方项目列表，并移除魔表。自 2027 年 1 月 2 日起，WCA 比赛可以举办 FTO 项目。2027 年 WCA 世界锦标赛之后将不再举办魔表项目，该届世锦赛将是最后一场举办此项目的比赛。WCA 将继续探索其他项目的管理方式，尤其是在锦标赛中的安排。

我们很高兴将 FTO 列为官方项目。这是自 2014 年加入 Skewb 以来，WCA 首次增加新项目。多年来，社区一直对 FTO 保持高度兴趣，近期调查的大多数受访者也支持将其纳入。FTO 与 WCA 已认可项目的性质足够相近，能够顺利融入；同时，它与现有项目又有足够区别，能为比赛带来新意。

FTO 将采用目前大多数项目使用的“五次去头尾平均”赛制。WCA 规则委员会将制定 FTO 规则，并在 2027 年 1 月规则修订周期中公布、征求反馈。其他 WCA 志愿者也将努力完成软件和系统所需的改动，支持 FTO 于 2027 年 1 月正式上线。FTO 项目将从 2027 年 1 月 2 日起正式开赛，让世界各地选手有机会在新项目推出后的首个周末体验它。

与此同时，我们也准备向魔表告别。尽管魔表近年来受到相当多的关注，但正如 WCA 志愿者和社区成员经常指出的，它仍是一个问题较多的项目。即使 WCA 规则已多次调整，魔表依然很容易出现意外事件。在比赛中举办魔表具有挑战性：它不容易正确打乱，而且需要采用与其他速拧项目不同的流程或设备。远距离观察时，很难判断魔表是否已还原，也不容易看清选手的还原进程。这大大降低了项目的观赏性，尤其是对不了解魔表的观众而言。

这些问题源于魔表与其他项目所使用拼图之间的根本差异。魔表与这些拼图非常不同，魔表目前被 WCA 列为官方项目，有其历史原因。移除魔表将强化 WCA 作为三维几何转动拼图组织、而非其他机械拼图组织的定位。

截至 2027 年 7 月 18 日，WCA 比赛通常仍可举办魔表项目。之后，WCA 世界锦标赛将成为最后一场正式举办魔表的比赛。这样的安排为即将到来的变更提供了充分的提前通知，并让魔表在 WCA 最大的舞台上作最后告别。

近期关于 WCA 认可项目列表的志愿者及社区调查，是这些决定的参考依据之一，但只是所考虑的多项因素之一。调查结果摘要可在此处查看。我们知道本公告中的变更会令部分人失望，但认为这些重要的战略调整能够强化 WCA 的核心定位，并为未来的发展创造最佳条件。

目前不会对其他项目作出正式变更，但 WCA 将继续探索项目管理方式，尤其关注其对锦标赛的影响。六阶与七阶之间，以及四阶盲拧与五阶盲拧之间具有高度相似性，因此这些项目未来可能会有调整。不过，现有政策已允许通过更严格的参赛资格要求等措施管理这些项目的影响；《WCA 比赛要求政策》的近期变更也允许包括四阶盲拧和五阶盲拧在内的“安静”项目在单独的锦标赛中举办。
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

After careful consideration, the WCA Board has decided to add Face Turning Octahedron (FTO) to the WCA’s list of official events and remove Clock. FTO will be available for inclusion in WCA competitions from January 2, 2027. Clock will no longer be available following the WCA World Championship 2027, which will be the last competition to hold the event. The WCA will continue to explore options for how other events are managed, particularly at championship competitions.

We are excited to add FTO to our lineup. This is the first new WCA event since Skewb was added in 2014. FTO has seen a high level of sustained interest from our Community for several years and a majority of respondents to recent surveys supported its addition. FTO is both sufficiently well-aligned with the nature of other events recognized by the WCA to smoothly integrate and different enough from existing events to bring something fresh to our competitions.

FTO will be held using the same “Average of 5” format used by the majority of current events. Regulations for FTO will be developed by the WCA Regulations Committee and will be available for feedback as part of the January 2027 Regulations cycle. Other WCA Volunteers will be hard at work to make the necessary changes to our software and systems which support FTO going live in January 2027. FTO will be available from January 2, 2027, providing opportunities for competitors around the world to experience a thrilling first weekend with this new event.

At the same time, we prepare to say goodbye to Clock. Although Clock has seen significant interest in recent years, it continues to be a relatively problematic event, as frequently highlighted by WCA Volunteers and Community members. Despite multiple changes to the WCA Regulations, Clock remains highly prone to incidents. Running Clock at competitions can be challenging, as it is difficult to scramble correctly and requires the use of different procedures or equipment from other speedsolving events. Determining whether a Clock is solved and seeing a competitor progress through a solve are not easily visible at a distance and substantially reduce the spectator appeal of the event, particularly to non-specialist audiences.

These issues stem from the fundamental differences between Clock and the puzzles used for other events. Clock is highly dissimilar from these puzzles and Clock’s existing recognition by the WCA arises from historical factors. Removing Clock strengthens the WCA’s identity as being an organization for three dimensional geometrical twisty puzzles and not other mechanical puzzles.

Clock will continue to be generally available at WCA competitions until July 18, 2027. The WCA World Championship will then be the last competition to officially hold this event. This provides a substantial notice period for the pending change and gives a final send off to Clock on the WCA’s largest stage.

Recent Volunteer and Community surveys concerning the WCA’s list of recognized events formed an input into the decisions taken, although were only one of several factors considered. You can see a summary of these survey results here. We know that the changes in this announcement will be disappointing for some, but consider these to be important strategic changes that strengthen the WCA’s core identity and best set us up for future success.

No formal changes to other events are being made at this time, although the WCA will continue to explore options for how events are managed, especially considering the impact on championship competitions. High degrees of similarity between 6x6x6 Cube and 7x7x7 Cube and between 4x4x4 Blindfolded and 5x5x5 Blindfolded point to these events as potentially subject to future changes. However, existing policies already allow impacts from these events to be managed through measures such as more stringent qualification requirements and recent changes to the WCA Competition Requirements Policy allow “quiet” events, including 4x4x4 Blindfolded and 5x5x5 Blindfolded to be held at separate championship competitions.

title.zh: WCA 竞赛规则征集提案

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

规则委员会已开始筹备新一轮规则修订，计划于 2027 年 1 月 1 日生效。依据《规则修订议案》第 1.1 节，我们现向社区征集提案。如要提交提案，请在 WCA 论坛的 WCA 规则分类下发帖，并在帖子标题中包含“[January 2027 Regulations]”。

WRC 将考虑所有在 2026 年 7 月 25 日或之前提交的提案。之后，我们会开始内部讨论并起草提案。今年晚些时候，我们将公布下一轮规则修订草案，征求社区与志愿者的反馈。我们不会自动讨论此前规则修订周期中提交过的提案，因此欢迎社区成员重新提交以前讨论过的提案。

如果您对流程有任何疑问，可以在论坛公告帖中提问。
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

The Regulations Committee have started working on a new regulations cycle to take effect on January 1st 2027, and we are now requesting proposals from the community, in line with Section 1.1 of the Amendments of Regulations Motion. In order to submit a proposal, please make a forum post under the WCA Regulations category on the WCA Forum. Please include "[January 2027 Regulations]" in the title of the forum post.

The WRC will consider all proposals that are submitted on or before July 25th, 2026, at which point we will start discussing and drafting proposals internally. We will publish our drafts for the next regulations cycle later in the year, for feedback from the Community and Volunteers. We will not be discussing any proposals submitted for previous regulation cycles, so Community members are welcome to submit proposals that have been discussed previously.

If you have any questions regarding the process, you may ask in the announcement forum post.

title.zh: 《WCA 比赛要求政策》5.5 版更新（2026 年 5 月）

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

WCA 比赛公告团队（WCAT）已将《WCA 比赛要求政策》更新至 5.5 版。完整更新内容可在 GitHub PR 中查看。主要变更如下：

新增“安静锦标赛”

各国现在可以另行举办包含盲拧项目与最少步项目的锦标赛。更多信息请参阅这份说明文件。

可限定达标成绩的取得日期。

对于要求达标成绩的比赛，主办方现在可以设置一个起始日期，要求用于达标的成绩在该日期之后取得。这项变更是为了避免选手仅凭无法反映其当前水平的旧成绩获得参赛资格。

例如，三阶盲拧的资格要求可以是：在 2020 年 1 月 1 日至 2026 年 11 月 1 日之间取得优于 3 分钟的单次成绩。

其他较小的变更请参阅论坛公告。

如果您对《WCA 比赛要求政策》的变更有疑问，请联系当地代表，或使用 WCA 联系表单。
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

The WCA Competition Announcement Team (WCAT) has updated the WCA Competition Requirements Policy to Version 5.5. You can view the full details of the updates on the Github PR. A list of all major updates are available below:

The addition of a “Quiet Championship”

Countries can now have a separate championship featuring Blindfolded events and Fewest Moves. For further information, please view this explainer document.

Qualification times can have a start date.

For competitions which require qualification times, the organisers can now set a start date of which the qualification results must have been achieved. This change is made to ensure that competitors may not qualify for a competition solely from an old result which does not represent their current skill.

Example: A qualification for 3x3x3 Blindfolded can be a single time better than 3 minutes that is set between January 1st 2020 and November 1st 2026.

For further information on smaller changes, please refer to the forums announcement. 

If you have any questions regarding the changes to the WCA Competition Requirements Policy, please contact your local delegates or use the WCA Contact Form.

title.zh: WCA 高级职员变动（2026 年 5 月）

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

随着 WCA 董事会近期的人员变动，董事会重新任命了 WCA 各高级职员岗位。高级职员岗位是与 WCA 这一非营利组织的运作有关的特定法定职务。

Dan Smith 已被任命为 WCA 执行董事。Dan 此前担任 WCA 首席运营官。这一任命更准确地体现了 Dan 对全体 WCA 志愿者的领导职责，也使其岗位与 WCA 治理文件中的组织架构保持一致。Dan 的日常工作与职责没有改变。

Abdullah Gulab 已被任命为 WCA 主席。Abdullah 此前担任 WCA 财务主管及副主席。

Oliver Hexter 已被任命为 WCA 秘书。

Sachin Arvind 已被任命为 WCA 财务主管。

Glib Vedmid 和 Rubén López de Juan 已被任命为 WCA 副主席。

由于董事任期即将结束，Nick Silvestri 已卸任 WCA 主席，Blake Thompson 已卸任 WCA 秘书。董事会感谢 Nick 和 Blake 在担任董事及高级职员期间为 WCA 作出的贡献。
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

Following recent changes to the WCA’s Board of Directors, the Board has refreshed appointments to the WCA’s Officer roles. Officer positions are specific legal roles related to running the WCA non-profit organization.

Dan Smith has been appointed as WCA Executive Director. Dan had previously been acting as the WCA’s Chief Operating Officer. This appointment better reflects Dan’s leadership across all WCA Volunteers and aligns his role with the structures in the WCA’s governance documents. There is no change to Dan’s day-to-day duties and responsibilities.

Abdullah Gulab has been appointed as WCA Chair. Abdullah was previously WCA Treasurer and WCA Vice-Chair.

Oliver Hexter has been appointed as WCA Secretary.

Sachin Arvind has been appointed as WCA Treasurer.

Glib Vedmid and Rubén López de Juan have been appointed as WCA Vice-Chairs.

With their Board terms coming to an end soon, Nick Silvestri has vacated the position of WCA Chair and Blake Thompson has vacated the position of WCA Secretary. The Board wishes to thank Nick and Blake for their service to the WCA through their Director and Officer roles.

title.zh: 董事会人员变动（2026 年 5 月）
title.en: Changes in the Board of Directors (May 2026)

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

随着董事会成员 Blake Thompson 和 Nick Silvestri 的任期即将结束，WCA 于 2026 年 5 月 1 日举行了不记名选举。选举依照 WCA《董事选举议案》进行。

董事会收到了以下人员的申请：

  • Callum James Goodyear-Jørgensen
  • Glib Vedmid
  • Oliver Hexter
  • Rubén López de Juan
  • Sachin Arvind

我们很高兴宣布，Glib、Oliver、Rubén 和 Sachin 已当选为 WCA 董事会成员。

这些变动立即生效。

申请材料可在此处查看。
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

With the term of Board Members Blake Thompson and Nick Silvestri coming to an end, an anonymous election took place on May 1st, 2026. The election was conducted according to the WCA Motion: Election of Directors.

The Board received the applications of:

  • Callum James Goodyear-Jørgensen
  • Glib Vedmid
  • Oliver Hexter
  • Rubén López de Juan
  • Sachin Arvind

We are happy to announce that Glib, Oliver, Rubén, and Sachin have been elected members of the WCA Board of Directors.

These changes have become effective immediately.

The applications can be viewed here.

title.zh: 全新志愿者岗位公告栏（2026 年 4 月）

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

我们很高兴向大家介绍 WCA 志愿者岗位的新发布方式。

全新志愿者岗位公告栏

所有 WCA 团队成员岗位今后都将在统一的志愿者岗位公告栏发布，入口位于 WCA 首页的“Volunteer”栏目下。每条公告都将列明岗位详情、招募人数、申请说明及截止时间。申请人也可以在同一个页面轻松比较不同空缺岗位。点击这个链接即可查看当前空缺岗位。

目前这是一项临时方案，以满足多个团队已提出的吸引申请人的需求。永久方案将在今年晚些时候推出新版 WCA 网站时一并实施。

作为这一变化的一部分，大多数单独的志愿者岗位将不再发布在 WCA 网站或论坛上，但仍会通过我们的社交媒体渠道推广。

扩大 WCA 志愿者群体

我们正在通过多种方式吸引更多志愿者加入 WCA 社区，这项举措是其中一部分。申请岗位不要求您是速拧选手，甚至不要求您会还原魔方。您可以是选手的家人、朋友，或任何希望推动这项运动发展的人。此外，部分岗位需要专门技能，例如儿童保护、记账、人力资源、社交媒体或软件开发等。

团队负责人和高级代表的招募

团队负责人及高级代表岗位将继续只通过内部电子邮件渠道，面向现有志愿者招募，以确保申请人具备这些岗位所需的经验。

我们也将继续公开宣布所有新任命。
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

We are excited to introduce a new way to share volunteer positions across the WCA.

New Volunteer Position Board

All WCA Team Member positions will now be published on a centralized Volunteer Position Board via a link located on the WCA home page under “Volunteer”. Each listing will include role details and number of openings as well as application instructions and deadlines. Applicants can also easily compare open positions in one location. Click this link to view the current open positions.

This is a temporary solution for now to accommodate several Teams having expressed interest in attracting candidates. A permanent solution will be implemented as part of a new WCA website rollout later this year.

As part of this change, most individual volunteer positions will no longer be posted on the WCA Website or Forums. However, they will continue to be promoted via our Social Media channels.

Expanding the WCA Volunteer Base

This initiative is part of a larger effort to bring more volunteers into the WCA community. You don’t have to be a speedcuber to apply for a position or even know how to solve the Rubik’s Cube. You can be a family member, a friend, or just someone interested in growing our sport. Also, a number of positions require specialized skills such as: child safeguarding, bookkeeping, human resources, social media, software development, etc.

Recruitment for Team Leaders and Senior Delegates

Team Leader and Senior Delegate positions will continue to be recruited only through current volunteers via internal email channels. This ensures candidates have the experience required for these specialized roles.

We will also continue to publicly announce all new appointments.

title.zh: WCA 规则委员会负责人任命公告（2026 年 4 月）

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

我们很高兴宣布，Kaidyn De Luca-Mazza 已被任命为 WCA 规则委员会（WRC）的新任负责人。Kaidyn 此前已是 WRC 的成员。

WCA 董事会依据《WCA 委员会与团队议案》第 5 节，选出 Kaidyn，并通过投票批准了这一任命。任命自 2026 年 3 月 14 日生效。

我们感谢 Carter Kucala 担任负责人期间所做的工作。Carter 将继续留任 WRC 资深成员。我们也祝 Kaidyn 在新的岗位上一切顺利。

Kaidyn 是该岗位的唯一申请人，其申请材料可在此处查看。
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

We are happy to announce that Kaidyn De Luca-Mazza has been appointed as the new Leader of the WCA Regulations Committee (WRC). Kaidyn was already working as a Member of the WRC.

Kaidyn was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote, as described in Section 5 of our Motion about WCA Committees and Teams. This appointment is effective as of March 14, 2026.

We thank Carter Kucala, who will remain as a senior member of the WRC, for the work they have done as the leader, and wish Kaidyn the best of luck in his new role.

Kaidyn was the only applicant for the role, and his successful candidacy document can be found here.

title.zh: 诚信委员会简报：2026 年第一季度

html.zh:
WCA 社群，你们好：

以下是过去三个月 WIC 部分重要案件和一般工作动态。上季度立案 12 件、结案 16 件，作出 5 项禁赛、4 项警告，7 件未采取措施。

  • WIC 获悉与一名选手有关的严重疑虑，且正在采取法律行动。事件虽发生于 WCA 范围之外，程序仍在进行，但 WIC 与理事会认为有必要采取预防措施。经理事会事先批准，WIC 暂停其参赛、出席正式比赛及论坛发帖资格。WIC 将关注法律程序，并在结束后采取必要措施。
  • 因此提醒全体成员：若发现不当或违反政策的行为，请报告当地代表及 WIC：integrity@worldcubeassociation.org。我们的使命是成为社群处理纪律问题时可以信赖的对象，始终会认真对待此类事项。
  • 接报选手被抓到偷窃他人魔方并扰乱秩序，且此前已有多起性质类似的较轻事件。其被禁止参赛及到场。
  • 获悉选手在比赛中行为不当，WIC 警告后仍在其他比赛继续，因此禁止其参赛及到场。
  • WCT 向 WIC 反映，选手在论坛多次发布违反行为准则的帖子，已被标记并隐藏。其获得警告。提醒社群：包括论坛在内的所有官方管理平台均受行为准则约束，行为应与之相符。
  • 本季度大多数案件涉及不同方式的作弊，包括还原结束前用手腕停表、盲拧时从眼罩下偷看、观察期间转动。部分选手因此被禁止参赛，相关尝试成绩被取消。

一般工作动态

  • 自成立以来，WIC 持续编写和更新支持志愿者处理安全事项的文件。鉴于本简报第一案，发展小组将加大培训资源工作，保障比赛中的志愿者、选手和观众安全。近期已获得支持，期待未来几个季度与潜在合作伙伴共同开发。
  • WIC 预计很快招募各小组成员，接近月底时会提供更多信息，强烈鼓励感兴趣的社群成员届时申请。
  • Swami Srinivasan（2015SRIN02）近期获任高级成员及伦理小组负责人，祝贺并祝履职顺利。
  • Cade Beck（2018BECK05）近期获任高级成员，祝贺并祝履职顺利。
  • Glenn Koster（2022JRGL01）和 Bertie Longden（2014LONG06）近期卸任成员，感谢两人的工作。

如有问题，欢迎发邮件，我们的邮箱始终开放。
html.en:
Hi WCA Community,

Below you can find a summary of some of the notable cases the WCA Integrity Committee has worked on, as well as some general WIC updates from the past three months.
In the last quarter, the WCA Integrity Committee opened 12 cases and closed 16. This resulted in 5 bans and 4 warnings, while 7 cases ended with no action. Below, you can find summaries of some notable cases:

  • The WCA Integrity Committee was made aware of serious concerns regarding a competitor, which also involved legal action being pursued. Although these incidents happened outside the sphere of the WCA and proceedings are still ongoing, the WCA Integrity Committee and WCA Board determined that precautionary action was warranted. With the prior approval of the WCA Board, the WIC issued a suspension from competing, attending official competitions and posting on the forum. The WCA Integrity Committee will monitor the legal proceedings and take the necessary actions once they are concluded.
  • * With this in mind, the WIC would like to remind all community members that if you notice behavior that is inappropriate or violates our policies, please report such behavior to your local WCA delegates, as well as the WIC at integrity@worldcubeassociation.org. Our mission is to be able to serve as the confidant for disciplinary issues for the community, and we will always take these matters seriously. 
  • The WCA Integrity Committee was informed of a competitor who had been caught stealing puzzles from other competitors and engaging in disruptive behavior. In addition, the competitor had previously been involved in multiple minor incidents of a similar nature. The competitor was issued a ban from competing and attending official competitions.
  • The WCA Integrity Committee was made aware of a competitor who was engaging in inappropriate behavior at a WCA competition. This behavior continued at other competitions after the competitor was warned by the WIC. The competitor in question was issued a ban from participating and attending WCA competitions. 
  • The WCT noted to the WIC that a competitor had made multiple posts on the WCA Forum that violated the WCA Code of Conduct, which were flagged and removed from public view. The competitor was issued a warning for these posts. The WIC would like to remind the WCA Community that all officially managed platforms, including the WCA Forum, are under the purview of the WCA’s Code of Conduct and to make sure to conduct themselves in these spaces accordingly. 
  • The majority of our cases this quarter involved the WCA Integrity Committee handling a number of incidents in which some competitors cheated in various ways, including:
  • * Stopping the timer with their wrists before finishing the solve
  • * Peeking under their blindfolds during blindfolded events
  • * Applying moves during inspection 
  • Some competitors were banned from competing for these respective incidents, and the concerned attempts were disqualified.

General WIC updates:

  • Since its creation, the WCA Integrity Committee has been working to create and update a variety of documents aimed at supporting the WCA Volunteers in safety matters. In light of the first incident described in this digest, the WIC Development Team will step up its efforts to develop training resources for ensuring the safety of WCA Volunteers, competitors and spectators at WCA competitions. The WIC recently received support to develop such resources, and we are extremely excited and eager to develop these with potential partners over the coming quarters. 
  • The WIC anticipates opening a new call for applicants soon to fill positions across all subteams. We should have more information to share closer to the end of the month. We highly encourage any interested community members to apply when the call for applicants opens!
  • Swami Srinivasan (2015SRIN02) was recently appointed as Senior Member of the WCA Integrity Committee. He was also appointed as Leader of the Ethics sub-team. We congratulate him and wish him the best of luck in his new roles.
  • Cade Beck (2018BECK05) was recently appointed as Senior Member of the WCA Integrity Committee. We congratulate him and wish him the best of luck in his new role.
  • Glenn Koster (2022JRGL01) and Bertie Longden (2014LONG06) recently stepped down from their positions as WIC members. Thank you so much for your work Glenn and Bertie!

Do you have questions for the WCA Integrity Committee? Feel free to send us an email. Our inboxes are always open!

title.zh: WCA 一对一赛制调整（2026 年 4 月）

html.zh:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

过去几个月，我们在多场比赛中试行了新的一对一赛制，涉及三阶、三阶单手、三阶盲拧和四阶项目。结合现场观众以及 WCA YouTube 频道直播观众的大量反馈，我们作出以下调整：

  • 将三阶最少步和三阶多盲加入可采用一对一赛制的项目。
  • 对于设有一对一赛制的比赛，取消“连续赛程不得超过 16 小时，之后须至少休息 9 小时”的限制。
  • 对一对一比赛的组织方式作出小幅调整。

加入三阶最少步和三阶多盲，是希望借此机会让它们与其他三阶类项目一同参与。我们在作出决定前征询了这两个项目的世界顶尖选手。他们认同公众的反馈，认为此前没有纳入这两个项目令人费解，也希望自己主攻的项目能有机会在国际舞台上受到更多关注。

我们相信，这些调整能显著改善 WCA 一对一比赛的参赛和观赛体验。

有关调整的更多信息，请参阅公开说明文件。
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

Over the past few months, we have hosted several competitions featuring the new Head-to-Head format in the 3x3, 3x3 One-Handed, 3x3 Blindfolded and 4x4 events. Based on extensive feedback received from the community in-person and via livestreams on the WCA Youtube Channel, the following changes have been made:

  • The 3x3 Fewest Moves and 3x3 Multi-Blind events have been added to the list of Head-to-Head events.
  • The restriction on competitions not running for longer than 16 hours without a break of at least 9 hours will be removed for competitions featuring the Head-to-Head format.
  • Minor changes regarding the organisation of Head-to-Head competitions.

The decision to include 3x3 Fewest Moves and 3x3 Multi-Blind was a decision to unite them with the other 3x3-based events as part of this opportunity. This decision was made following consultations with world-class cubers in these events, who agreed with the public feedback that these events being omitted was confusing, and that they would love the opportunity for their main events to be given a spotlight on the international stage.

We are confident that these changes will substantially improve the experience for both competitors and spectators of a WCA Head-to-Head competition.

For more information regarding these changes, please read our public explainer document here.

title.zh: WCA 财务委员会成员招募（2026 年 3 月）
title.en: Call for Applicants - WCA Financial Committee Members (March 2026)

html.zh:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

**WCA 财务委员会（WFC）**正在招募新成员，欢迎申请。你不必是财务专业人士，但具备会计知识或相关背景会有帮助。如果你乐于学习、做事可靠，也愿意在幕后帮助 WCA 更好地运转，这份工作或许适合你。

WCA 财务委员会具体做什么？

简单来说，我们负责确保 WCA 妥善管理资金，用这些资金支持世界各地的魔方活动，工作包括：

  • 记录收支，完成核对和分类
  • 协助开展资助项目，包括差旅、器材和地区组织支持
  • 协助制定和监督 WCA 预算
  • 编写清晰的财务报告，供社区查阅及向监管机构申报
  • 随着 WCA 的发展，改进财务流程和管理制度

你不需要承担所有工作。委员会成员通常会根据自己的兴趣、经验和志愿服务目标，负责其中一部分。

适合哪些人？

  • 希望在本地比赛之外为社区出力的志愿者
  • 想积累非营利组织实际工作经验的学生或职场新人
  • 对国际非营利组织如何运作感兴趣的人

你会与有经验的委员会成员、WCA 首席运营官和财务主管一起工作。我们也很乐意帮助新志愿者熟悉工作。

申请人须年满 18 岁，能够用书面英语清楚沟通。有财务运营、记账、资助项目管理或会计政策制定经验更佳，但并非硬性要求。

时间投入

平均每周约需 3–5 小时，具体取决于你参与的项目。

大部分协调通过邮件和聊天异步进行，我们希望团队成员能在合理时间内回应。

申请方式

请提交一份 Word 文档或 PDF，内容包括：

  • 简短的个人介绍
  • 参与魔方社区活动的经历（如有）
  • 加入财务委员会的原因
  • 相关技能或经历，包括职业和志愿工作经历

请于 2026 年 5 月 9 日前，将申请发送至 ehollingdale@worldcubeassociation.org。收到申请后，我们会发送确认邮件，并陆续审核申请。

即使不确定自己是否完全符合要求，也欢迎申请。我们重视不同的背景、观点和经验。

如需了解更多，请参阅 WCA 动议 10.2024.6——WCA 财务委员会和 WCA 动议 11.2025.1——财务。WCA 文件页面“Finances”栏目下的年度财务报告，也有助于了解委员会的工作。

申请前如有疑问，欢迎联系我们。期待收到你的申请。
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

The WCA Financial Committee (WFC) is looking for new members, and we’d love to hear from you. You don’t need to be a finance professional - but any knowledge or background in accounting would be advantageous. If you’re curious, reliable, and want to help the WCA run better behind the scenes this might be for you.

What does the WCA Financial Committee actually do?

In simple terms, we help make sure the WCA’s money is handled responsibly and used to support cubing around the world. That includes things like:

  • Tracking income and expenses and ensuring it is reconciled and categorized
  • Supporting funding programs (travel, equipment, regional organization support)
  • Helping plan and monitor the WCA’s budget
  • Creating clear financial reports for the community and for regulatory filings
  • Improving financial processes and governance as the WCA grows

You would not be expected to do all of this — committee members usually focus on a subset of tasks based on their interests, experience, and goals as a volunteer.

Who is this a good fit for?

  • Volunteers who want to contribute beyond local competitions
  • Students or early-career professionals looking for real non-profit experience
  • Anyone interested in how an international non-profit actually operates

You’ll work alongside experienced committee members, the WCA COO, and the WCA Treasurer, and we’re happy to support newer volunteers as they learn.

You must be at least 18 years old and able to communicate clearly in written English. Although not required, any experience in financial operations, bookkeeping, grant program administration, or accounting policy development would be a great skill to bring to the team.

Time commitment On average, the commitment is about 3-5 hours per week, though this can vary depending on the projects you’re involved in.

Most coordination happens asynchronously via email and chat, and we aim to stay reasonably responsive as a team.

How to apply Please send a Word document or PDF that includes:

  • A short personal introduction
  • A summary of your involvement in the cubing community (if any)
  • Your motivation for joining the Finance Committee
  • An overview of any relevant skills or experience (professional or volunteer)

Email your application to ehollingdale@worldcubeassociation.org by 9 May 2026. You’ll receive a confirmation once we’ve received it, and applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

If you’re unsure whether you’re a “perfect fit” — apply anyway. We value different backgrounds, perspectives, and levels of experience.

If you’d like more background, please refer to WCA Motion 10.2024.6 - WCA Financial Committee and WCA Motion 11.2025.1 - Finances. The annual WCA Financial Reports, available on the WCA Documents page under "Finances", also provide useful background on the committee's operations.

If you have questions before applying, feel free to reach out. We look forward to hearing from you.

title.zh: WCA 董事会成员变动（2026 年 3 月）
title.en: Changes in the Board of Directors (March 2026)

html.zh:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

Kerrie Jarman 决定卸任 WCA 董事，自 2026 年 3 月 16 日起生效。

感谢 Kerrie 在过去两年半中担任董事、副主席和主席期间为协会所作的贡献。任职期间，她为协会提供了许多帮助，祝她今后的工作一切顺利。

接下来的几个月，董事会其他成员将整合资源、规划未来，继续做好各项工作，保障协会运转。感谢大家在此期间的耐心与理解。
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

We would like to inform you that effective March 16th 2026, Kerrie Jarman has decided to step down from her position on the WCA Board of Directors.

We would like to thank Kerrie for her contribution to the organization as a Director, Vice-Chair, and Chair over the last 2 and a half years. She has been a tremendous help to the organization during her term and we wish her the best in her other tasks.

The remainder of the Board appreciates your patience over the next few months as we consolidate our resources and plan for the future so that we can continue conducting tasks to ensure the operation of our organization.

title.zh: Dan Smith 出任世界魔方协会首席运营官
title.en: Dan Smith Appointed Chief Operating Officer of the World Cube Association

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

WCA 董事会很高兴宣布，Dan Smith 出任首席运营官！

Dan 参与 WCA 工作已有四年多，曾任董事会成员、WCA 财务主管及质量保证委员会资深成员，目前是财务团队成员和 WCA 代表。

在 WCA 之外，Dan 的职业经历主要涉及运营管理、团队建设、流程改进以及复杂技术方案的交付。他有超过 15 年的项目管理经验，带领过最多 25 人的团队，管理过最高 800 万美元的预算。他拥有科罗拉多大学工商管理硕士学位，以及马里兰大学大学学院（现名马里兰大学全球校区）的理学学士学位。

Dan 自 2018 年起活跃于速拧社区，组织或担任代表的比赛超过 50 场。2023 年，他加入 WCA 质量保证委员会，参与维护培训材料，并开发代表培训系统（LMS）。

2025 年 1 月，Dan 当选 WCA 董事，并很快在工作中发挥了作用。他与赞助商密切合作，推动新的项目，加强 WCA 管理层与各团队的联系，并与各个岗位的志愿者交流。

随着 WCA 的规模不断扩大、事务日益复杂，Dan 明白，首席运营官的职责是帮助 WCA 为未来做好准备，同时保留志愿者主导这一组织特质。

董事会认为，这个职位最适合由了解组织各层面运作的人担任。Dan 一直与全球志愿者群体密切合作，我们相信他是 WCA 首席运营官的合适人选。他已于 2026 年 3 月 5 日（星期四）卸任董事，并正式就任新职。
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

The WCA Board of Directors is excited to announce the appointment of a new Chief Operating Officer, Dan Smith!

Dan has been actively involved with the WCA for over four years. He previously served as a member of the Board of Directors, WCA Treasurer, and Senior Member of the Quality Assurance Committee, and currently serves as a member of the Finance Team and a WCA Delegate.

Dan’s professional background outside the WCA focuses on operations leadership, team development, process improvement, and delivering complex technical solutions. He has over 15 years of project management experience and has led teams of up to 25 while managing budgets up to $8 million. He holds an MBA from the University of Colorado and a BSc from the University of Maryland University College (now known as University of Maryland Global Campus).

Dan has been an active member of the speedcubing community since 2018, having organized and delegated over 50 competitions. In 2023, he joined the WCA Quality Assurance Committee, where he helped maintain educational materials and develop the Delegate training system (LMS).

In January 2025, Dan was elected to the WCA Board of Directors, where he made an immediate impact. He has worked closely with our sponsors on new initiatives, strengthened relationships between WCA leadership and teams across the organization, and engaged with volunteers at all levels.

As the WCA continues to grow in size and complexity, Dan understands that the COO role is not about changing the volunteer-driven identity that defines our organization, but about helping shape the WCA for the future.

The Board believes this role is best filled by someone who understands how the organization works at every level. Having worked closely with our global volunteer community, we believe Dan is the right person to serve as the WCA’s Chief Operating Officer. He stepped down from the Board and assumed his new role effective Thursday, March 5, 2026.

title.zh: WCA 竞赛规则：2026 年 4 月更新（错误打乱处理调整）

html.zh:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

WCA 规则委员会现公布新版 WCA 竞赛规则，适用于 2026 年 4 月 1 日及以后开始的比赛。本次修改范围有限，只涉及魔方未被正确打乱（错误打乱）时的处理方式。

主要调整如下：

  • 锦标赛决赛不再适用规则 11i1 中较严格的错误打乱处理方式，即补赛或 DNS。正确打乱仍然重要，但这一调整优先保障这些轮次的竞技公平性和观赏性。
  • 在进行打乱复核的前提下，锦标赛决赛中的纪录成绩及世界前 50 成绩也不再适用上述处理方式。这既避免了决赛仍可能受到影响的不公平情况，也鼓励赛事采取措施，确保打乱正确。
  • 对仍须按较严格标准处理错误打乱的成绩（非锦标赛决赛中的顶尖成绩），提供支持，使其能在成绩产生后及时核查，尽量避免事后改判 DNS；即使比赛结束后才发现错误打乱，也允许保留后续轮次的成绩。

具体条文可查看 GitHub 版本对比：绿色为修改或新增内容，红色为删除内容。

详细说明见这份解释文档。最终修改与 2026 年 2 月公布的草案一致，未作进一步调整。
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

The WCA Regulations Committee would like to inform you about a new version of the WCA Regulations. This version will be in effect for competitions beginning on, or after, April 1st, 2026. The changes to the Regulations in this version are limited in scope and only affect the handling of incidents in which puzzles were not correctly scrambled (misscrambles).

In summary, these changes:

  • Remove championship finals from the scope of the firmer Extra/DNS misscramble approach in Regulation 11i1. While scramble integrity remains important, this prioritizes the competitive integrity and spectacle of these rounds.
  • Also remove record/top 50 results in championship finals from this scope, as long as scramble double checking takes place. This avoids potentially unfair scenarios in which championship finals could still be affected, while encouraging measures to support correct scrambles in these contexts.
  • Provide support to ensure results still subject to stricter misscramble requirements (top results not in championship finals) can be checked once they take place, to minimise the chance of later DNS changes, and allowing subsequent round results not to be removed even if a misscramble is found after the competition.

You can review the wording changes in this comparison on GitHub, where changes and additions are marked green and removals are marked red.

You can read a detailed description of changes in this explainer document. The final changes made remain consistent with the draft changes circulated in February 2026, with no further amendments made.

title.zh: 2026 年 WCA 亚洲锦标赛最新消息（2026 年 3 月）

html.zh:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

WCA 董事会和 WCA 大型锦标赛团队（WMCT）现就 2026 年 WCA 亚洲锦标赛公布一项重要消息。

经过对目前筹备工作的全面评估，我们遗憾地宣布，本届锦标赛将不再在中国沈阳举办。在作出这一决定前，WCA 与当地组委会进行了密切合作，评估赛事在各项筹办条件上的可行性。

评估结果显示，受多项 WCA 无法直接控制的因素影响，已无法在此举办洲际级别赛事。这些因素十分复杂，涉及从整体规划到具体执行的多个方面；我们逐渐确认，无法克服这些困难。赛事日期日益临近，为给地区合作伙伴和整个社区留出足够时间调整计划，我们不得不作出这一艰难决定。

WMCT 和 WCA 董事会正在积极寻找其他方案，争取让亚洲锦标赛仍能在 2026 年举行。我们已与亚洲各地区组织直接联系，近期会向他们提供更具体的信息。选址工作完成后，我们会尽快向 WCA 社区公布消息。

衷心感谢沈阳组委会在筹备过程中付出的努力。我们与大家一样，对这一变动感到失望。我们会继续努力办好锦标赛，感谢大家的耐心。
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

The WCA Board and the WCA Major Championship Team (WMCT) wish to provide an important update regarding the 2026 WCA Asian Championship.

After an extensive review of the current planning phase, we regret to announce that the championship will no longer be held in Shenyang, China. This decision follows a period of close collaboration between the WCA and local organizers to assess the logistical feasibility of the event.

During this assessment, we have concluded that due to a number of factors outside of the WCA’s direct control, it is no longer possible to proceed with a continental-tier event in this location. These factors are complex and span a wide range of issues, from strategic to operational and everywhere in between and it became clear that we would not be able to navigate around these challenges. With the event date quickly approaching, we had to make this difficult decision to ensure our regional partners, and the community as a whole, have sufficient time to adjust their plans.

The WMCT and the WCA Board are actively exploring other possibilities to enable an Asian Championship to still take place in 2026. We are in direct contact with the Asian Regional Organizations, and will share more specific details with them shortly. We will provide an update to the WCA Community as soon as the selection process is complete.

We would like to extend our sincere gratitude to the Shenyang organization team for their hard work and dedication through the planning process. We share the community’s disappointment regarding this change and thank you for your continued patience as we work to deliver a high-quality championship experience.

title.zh: WCA 市场团队招募周边商品负责人（2026 年 2 月）
title.en: Call for Applicants - Head of Merch within the WCA Marketing Team (February 2026)

html.zh:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

WCA 正在招募一名志愿者，担任 WCA 市场团队的周边商品负责人。该岗位主要负责通过官方周边商品保持 WCA 的视觉形象，并为在官方商店购物的社区成员提供支持。

申请人预计平均每周至少投入 4 小时。该岗位不设固定任期。

主要职责

  • 商品设计：设计符合 WCA 品牌形象的新产品，提出创意方案。
  • 商店维护：管理 WCA 网店，包括上架新设计、更新商品信息（无需管理实体库存）。
  • 客户支持：回复社区成员关于订单的咨询及商品反馈。
  • 团队协作：与 WCA 各团队合作，使周边商品配合全球项目和社区的具体需求。

申请条件

  • 熟练使用平面设计工具，如 Adobe Creative Suite、Canva。
  • 英文书面表达能力良好，能够处理客户咨询。
  • 做事可靠，能够独立工作。
  • 熟悉 WCA 和魔方社区。
  • 有电商或按需印制平台经验者优先。

申请方式

申请从即日起开放，截止时间为 2026 年 3 月 12 日 23:59 UTC。有意者请将材料发送至执行助理团队（assistants@worldcubeassociation.org），并抄送 WCA 董事会（board@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：

  1. 个人介绍：简要介绍自己及个人背景。
  2. 工作设想：你对 WCA 周边商店的目标，以及初步设计想法。
  3. WCA 经历（选填）：简述过去参与的 WCA 活动或担任的职务。有相关经历会有帮助，但并非申请条件。
  4. 作品集：以往的设计或创意作品。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将面试最符合条件的申请人，通过投票选出并公布新的周边商品负责人。

感谢大家的申请与支持。
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

The WCA is seeking a volunteer to fill the position of Head of Merch within the WCA Marketing Team. This role focuses on maintaining the WCA’s visual identity through our official merchandise and providing support to community members who purchase from our store.

Candidates are expected to spend at least 4 hours per week on average to fulfill the duties of this role. There is no fixed term limit for this role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Merchandise Design: Developing new product designs and creative concepts that align with the WCA brand.

  • Store Maintenance: Managing the WCA’s storefront, including adding new designs and updating product listings (no physical inventory management is required).

  • Customer Support: Responding to community inquiries regarding store orders and product feedback.

  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Working with various WCA teams to ensure merchandise supports global initiatives and specific community needs.

Qualities Expected of Candidates

  • Proficiency in graphic design (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite, Canva).

  • Strong written communication skills in English for customer support.

  • Reliability and the ability to work independently.

  • A good understanding of the WCA and the cubing community.

  • Experience with e-commerce or print-on-demand platforms is a plus.

Application Process

The application period for candidates to submit their candidacy documents is from now until March 12, 2026, 23:59 UTC. Interested candidates can send their applications to the Executive Assistants Team (assistants@worldcubeassociation.org), CC’ing the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).

The candidacy documents must be in PDF format and must include:

  1. Personal Introduction: A brief summary of who you are and your background.
  2. Ambitions for the Role: Your goals for the WCA merch store and any initial design ideas.
  3. WCA Experience (Optional): A summary of any past activities or roles held within the WCA. While helpful, prior WCA experience is not a requirement for this role.
  4. Portfolio: Examples of previous design or creative work.

After the application period, the WCA Board will interview the most qualified applicants, make a selection by voting, and announce the new Head of Merch.

Thanks for your candidacies and support.

title.zh: 欧洲高级代表任命公告（2026 年 2 月）
