title.zh: 论坛话题精选（2023 年 10 月）

html.zh:
以下是 WCA 论坛在 2023 年第三季度的一些值得关注的话题。

将 WCA 注册为体育组织 WCA 目前正努力成为获认可的体育组织。这个帖子讨论了社区就“什么算体育运动”以及“如何让速拧成为正式认可的体育运动”提出的疑问。

Timebase 原型展示 两位美国魔友提出了一种新方案，可以不再使用传统的成绩单和签名。他们已在自己组织的几场比赛中测试 Timebase。这是一个很好的想法，也正在逐步落地。不过，根据现行规则，它目前还不能作为主要的成绩记录方式。

大型锦标赛使用统一打乱 这一讨论始于 2023 年世界锦标赛结束后。提议要求大型比赛的决赛及倒数第二轮使用同一套打乱，以公平地决出优胜者。

为首次参赛者安排试拧 首次参赛者往往不熟悉 Speed Stacks 计时器的使用，因而需要由代表安排额外还原。这个提议讨论是否应要求首次参赛者在比赛位上先试拧一次相应项目。

Cube Talk 话题小结 推出 Cube Talk，是希望围绕大家最感兴趣的问题，让魔友们在论坛上聊起来。最近以下四个话题收到了不少精彩回答：

  • 你最喜欢哪个项目？
  • 你更喜欢传魔方、当裁判、打乱还是录入成绩？
  • 你最喜欢哪位 WCA 代表？
  • 你怎么看为首次参赛者预留比赛名额？

我们希望继续这个系列，向社区提出更多问题。

如有疑问、意见或反馈，欢迎发送邮件至 advisory@worldcubeassociation.org。

感谢大家参与论坛！
html.en:
Here are some notable threads on the WCA Forum during the third quarter of 2023.

Registration of the WCA as a sports organization The WCA is currently working towards becoming a recognized sports organization. This thread discusses all doubts and queries the community raised regarding what constitutes a sport and the process of making speedcubing an officially recognized sport.

Timebase Prototype Showcase Two cubers from the USA brought a novel implementation that gets rid of the traditional scorecards and signatures. They tested out Timebase at a few competitions they are organizing. This is a great idea and in the process of becoming a reality. It is presently not allowed as the primary source of scoretaking as per the Regulations.

Uniform Scramble Sets at Major Championships The discussion set off after the World Championship 2023 concluded. The proposal was to enforce the same scramble sets for finals and penultimate rounds at large-sized competitions in order to have a fair selection of the winners.

Trial Rounds for Newcomers Newcomers have a lot of problems handling the Speed Stack timers which leads to extras being given by the Delegates. This proposal discusses if having one trial solve of that puzzle at the solving station should be a mandate for newcomers.

Cube Talk Summary The idea of starting cube talk was to get cubers conversant on the forums on most attractive questions. We have got great answers on four topics recently which are:

  • What is your favourite event?
  • Do you prefer running, judging, scrambling or scoretaking?
  • Who is your favorite WCA Delegate?
  • How do you feel about reserving competition places only for newcomers?

We hope to continue the series asking more questions to the community.

If you have any questions, comments, or feedback feel free to send an email to advisory@worldcubeassociation.org.

Thanks for being a part of the Forum!

title.zh: WCA 规则委员会工作简报（2023 年 10 月）

html.zh:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

自 WCA 规则委员会 6 月发布上一期简报以来，委员会完成了大量工作，包括制定并于 8 月发布新版规则，以及处理过去几个月里的许多意外事件。以下是几起较值得关注的事件：

  1. 不同比赛对规则 2s（涉及有特殊情况的选手）的应用有所不同，在委员会内外引发了大量讨论。其中一例为有特殊情况的选手延长了时限；另一例允许一名失明选手在三阶单手项目中，用另一只手触摸辨认魔方块件，但不得进行任何转动。WRC 提醒，采用这种安排时，WCA 代表应留意选手的动作，防止利用第二只手作弊。WRC 也计划在下一版规则中进一步明确 2s 的适用边界和允许范围。

  2. WRC 还处理了几起同一次尝试中发生多次角块扭转的事件。多数发生在五魔项目，该项目比一般项目更容易发生角块扭转。规则 5b3c 写道：“如果魔方处于不可还原的状态，而原地扭转一个角块即可使其可还原，选手可以在不拆解魔方的情况下，原地扭转该角块进行修正。”按这一条文的字面含义，由于相关尝试中不止一个角块发生扭转，这些成绩被判为 DNF。下一轮规则修订也会讨论这一条。

  3. 一场比赛中，由于打乱员的失误，金字塔第一轮某组的部分尝试使用了错误朝向打乱。代表为所有仍在赛场的选手安排补赛，这一处理是正确的。但金字塔是当天最后几个项目之一，部分选手最终没能获得补赛。WRC 决定为所有人保留原成绩，原因是金字塔属于较容易做到色中性的项目，而且错误不在选手。这样能让更多人使用相同打乱，而不是同一组出现三套不同打乱：发现错误时仍在场的人一套、次日才回到赛场的人一套，以及没有获得补赛的人使用的原错误打乱。WRC 明确说明，这不是允许错误朝向打乱的先例；其他比赛若发生类似情况，应尽快联系 WRC。

  4. 有几起事件中，观众把飞出的块件递给选手，代表因此安排了补赛。WRC 提醒大家，A5b++ 规定，这种情况下应将块件放在桌上，不得提供进一步协助。此类情况不应给予补赛，因为让选手因魔方故障获得补赛会带来优势：在补赛中取得好成绩，比在发生飞棱的尝试中取得好成绩容易。

WRC 的其他近况：

  • 近期举办了许多参赛人数众多的大型锦标赛。凡有 WRC 成员在场的比赛，委员会都能对事件即时或很快给出反馈。
  • WRC 已开始制定下一版规则，很快就会有更多消息！
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

Ever since the last digest provided by the WCA Regulations Committee in June, an enormous quantity of activities have been carried out by the committee, such as the development of a new set of regulations released in the month of August, as well as a considerable number of incidents handled by the committee during the last few months. Here you have the most notable incidents:

  1. During different competitions, there have been different applications of Regulation 2s, regarding competitors with circumstances, that resulted in a large amount of discussion inside and outside the committee. One of these cases resulted in a time limit being expanded due to a competitor with a circumstance, meanwhile in another one, a blind competitor was permitted to recognize the pieces of the puzzle in 3x3x3 One-Handed event with the other hand, without applying any moves. The WRC would like to remember that if this is to be done, the WCA Delegate should be paying attention to avoid any cheating by using the second hand. The WRC is also planning on specifying better the limits and permissions of 2s on the next set of regulations.

  2. The WRC also had a few incidents regarding several corner twists in the same attempt. Most of these cases happened on the Megaminx event, which is known for having more corner twists than normal. Applying a literal interpretation of the 5b3c regulations that states that “If the puzzle is unsolvable, and can be made solvable by rotating a single corner piece, the competitor may correct the corner piece by twisting it in place without disassembling the puzzle”, as multiple corners had been twisted in these attempts, DNF penalties have been applied. This regulation is going to be discussed in the next cycle of regulations too.

  3. In a competition, due to a scrambler’s mistake, a Pyraminx first round group had a few attempts scrambled in an incorrect orientation, the Delegates acted correctly by providing extras to everyone that was present at the competition, however, it was one of the last events in the day, so some people ended up without extra attempts. The WRC has decided that since Pyraminx is one of the easiest events to be color neutral in, and the competitors were not at fault for this mistake, the original attempts should stay for everyone, since this would result in more people having the same scrambles than three differents sets for that same group (one for the people present at the time the mistake was discovered, one for the people who were only at the competition on the next day and the incorrect one for the people that did not receive the extra attempts). The WRC would like to clarify everyone that this is not a precedent to allow puzzles scrambled in the wrong orientation, and if a similar case happens in another competition, the WRC should be contacted as soon as possible.

  4. There were several instances of popped pieces being handed by spectators to the competitors affected, where Delegates provided extras. The WRC would like to remind everyone that A5b++ states that if this happens, the piece should be placed on the table and no further assistance should be given. In cases like this, no extra attempts should be granted, since it would be advantageous for the competitor to get an extra for a puzzle defect. It is easier to get a better time on an extra attempt than on an attempt with a pop.

Another news regarding the WRC:

  • There have been a huge number of major championships with a large number of competitors, and all the times the WRC was present, the committee was able to provide live, if not very fast feedback to incidents regarding these competitions.
  • The WRC is also already working on the next set of regulations, you may expect some news very soon!

title.zh: WDC 简报：2023 年第三季度

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

过去三个月，纪律委员会努力确保选手遵守 WCA 规则，使比赛对所有人都安全、愉快。我们也启动新一轮招募，目前正在遴选。

WDC 编写了帮助代表处理常见比赛纪律问题的指导。《纪律事件指导》现为正式 WCA 文件，代表可通过官网面板查看，仅工作人员可访问。我们计划持续更新并补充案例，欢迎建议。

过去 3 个月结案 27 件，其中 6 件导致禁赛，9 件导致正式警告，包括多起试图偷窃魔方、欺凌等人际问题，以及盲拧偷看、提前停表、篡改成绩单等作弊尝试。

我们注意到提前停表案件增加，有时是意外，有时意在取得更好成绩。担任裁判时须始终关注选手，发现可疑情况就叫代表。第五代计时器停表时会闪两次；若还原尚未结束就闪灯，或结束时没有闪灯，很可能已提前停表。

最后提醒大家充分理解规则及流程，不清楚时询问代表。若认为成绩受到损害，发现可疑行为或感到不适，请立即联系最近的代表，或向 WDC 报告。

如有问题，可发邮件，或在论坛纪律板块提问。

谨致问候， Sebastiano Tronto 代表 WCA 纪律委员会
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

In the last three months the Disciplinary Committee has worked hard to make sure that every competitor complies with the WCA regulations and that competitions remain a safe and pleasant environment for everyone. We have also opened a new round of applications to select a few new members, and we are currently in the selection process.

The WDC has also worked on writing some guidelines to help WCA Delegates handle common disciplinary issues that arise during competitions. These Guidelines for Disciplinary Incidents are now an official WCA document, available to all delegates via the panel on the WCA website (link accessible to WCA Staff members only). We plan to keep this document updated and add some examples in the future, so if you have any advice for us related to this do let us know.

In the last 3 months the WDC has closed 27 investigations, including 6 that resulted in a ban and 9 that resulted in an official warning. These cases included:

  • Multiple attempted cube thefts.
  • Various interpersonal issues, e.g. bullying.
  • Multiple attempts of cheating, for example by peeking in blindfolded events, stopping the timer early or manipulating the results on the scorecard.

To expand on this last point, we have noticed more cases of competitors stopping the timer early, sometimes by accident and sometimes in an attempt to get better results. We would like to remind everyone that, when acting as a judge, you should always pay attention to the competitor and call a delegate if you notice anything suspicious. Moreover, keep in mind that gen5 timers flash twice when the competitor stops: if you notice this happening early during the solve, or if you do not notice this at the end of the attempt, this likely means that the timer was stopped early.

To conclude this Digest, we would like to remind everyone to make sure they fully understand the WCA Regulations and competition procedures. If you have any questions, or are unsure about how to do something, please do not hesitate to ask the Delegate(s) of the competition. In addition, if you ever think the competition results are being compromised in any way, or if you see suspicious behavior or feel uncomfortable at a competition, please find the nearest Delegate immediately and/or contact the WDC to report the incident.

Do you have questions for the WDC? Feel free to send us an email, or ask on the Disciplinary section of the WCA forum.

Best Regards,
Sebastiano Tronto
On behalf of the WCA Disciplinary Committee.

title.zh: 2024 年洲际锦标赛申办（2023 年 9 月）

html.zh:
董事会现征集以下地区的 2024 年洲际锦标赛申办方案：

  • 非洲
  • 亚洲
  • 大洋洲

请与本国代表商议，确定是否有意愿和能力申办。请注意，举办这一规模的比赛，无论赛前还是赛中，都需要投入大量时间和精力。

有意者请于 2023 年 10 月 31 日 23:59 UTC 前，将申请材料私下发送至 board@worldcubeassociation.org。材料须为 PDF 格式，提供两个版本：包含全部申办细节的完整版，以及删去敏感信息（如有）、可供公开的版本。

申请材料至少应包含以下信息：

计划何时举办锦标赛？

  • 1a. 可选日期。
  • 1b. 比赛天数。
  • 1c. 是否与各国学校假期重合。

计划在贵国的什么地点举办锦标赛？

  • 2a. 城市应对外国游客具有吸引力，并提供观光机会。
  • 2b. 国际、国内及市内交通的便利程度。
  • 2c. 不同价位酒店或公寓的供应情况。
  • 2d. 场馆、面积及布置（舞台、观众区、练习桌、附属房间）。
  • 2e. 可用技术设施，如网络、视频直播、灯光和音响设备。
  • 2f. 可容纳的选手与观众人数。

组织团队和工作人员如何安排？

  • 3a. 核心团队成员。
  • 3b. 核心团队的经验。
  • 3c. 其他参与方。
  • 3d. 当地志愿者的数量与能力（建议有 20% 的选手参与工作人员工作）。
  • 3e. 需要国外代表提供哪些支持。

比赛的总预算如何安排？

  • 4a. 支出：场地、场馆服务、舞台、设备、装饰、网站、证件/挂绳/礼包及奖品。
  • 4b. 收入：报名费、赞助、当地政府支持。

这份示例文件列出了大型比赛需要安排和纳入预算的部分事项，并非完整清单。关于预算部分，请注意，我们正在敲定一项赞助计划，拟由赞助商为这些锦标赛提供较大金额的支持。细节确定后，将告知获选团队。

申请期结束后，WCA 董事会将与申请方进行面谈，征求其他 WCA 工作人员的意见，并通过投票决定举办地。如有董事参与某个申办团队，该董事将在遴选过程中由其他人替代，例如高级代表或委员会/团队负责人。

我们希望这些比赛能够进一步体现大型 WCA 比赛的理念，推动组织更加专业地运作，为选手提供尽可能好的参赛体验，也向全世界呈现尽可能精彩的赛事。

感谢大家的配合，期待收到你们的申办方案！
html.en:
The Board of Directors would like to receive applications for the following regions for Continental Championships 2024:

  • Africa
  • Asia
  • Oceania

Please discuss with the Delegates in your country whether this is something you are willing and able to pursue. Bear in mind that organizing a competition of this size takes a significant amount of time and effort before and during the competition.

If you are interested, send your application documents privately to board@worldcubeassociation.org before October 31st, 2023, 23:59 UTC. Documents must be sent in PDF format in two versions: one full version with all the details for the application, and another version with sensitive details - if any - removed to make public.

Please include in your application documents at least the following information:

When would you like to hold the Championship? 1a. Possible dates 1b. Number of days of the competition. 1c. Overlap with international holiday periods of schools.

Where would you like to hold the Championship in your country? 2a. City should be interesting to visit for foreigners with opportunities for sightseeing. 2b. Ease of international, national, and local travel. 2c. Availability of hotels/apartments with different price categories. 2d. Venue, venue size, and venue setup (stage, audience, tables to practice, side rooms). 2e. Technology available like the internet, video streaming, lighting, sound equipment. 2f. Number of competitors and spectators that can be hosted.

What would the organization team and staff look like? 3a. Core team members. 3b. Experience of the core team. 3c. Involvement of other parties. 3d. Quantity and quality of local volunteers (guideline is 20% of competitors should staff). 3e. Required support by foreign Delegates.

What would be the overall budget for the competition? 4a. Cost (venue, venue services, stage, equipment, decorations, website, badges/lanyards/giftpacks, prizes). 4b. Income (registration fees, sponsoring, local government).

Here is an example document with a non-exhaustive list of topics that need to be arranged and budgeted for a large competition. Please note with regards to the budgeting section that we are currently finalizing plans for a sponsor to contribute a significant amount to these championships. When available, the details will be communicated to the selected teams.

Once the application period is over, the WCA Board of Directors will interview applicants, consult other WCA Staff members, and vote in order to decide where the Championships will take place. If any Director is involved in a team that sends in an application, they will be replaced in the selection process by another person (for example a Senior Delegate or a Committee/Team Leader).

We are looking for competitions that can reinforce our concept of large WCA competitions, boosting the professionalization of our organization and able to offer the competitors the best possible experience and the world the best possible show.

Thank you in advance for your cooperation and we look forward to viewing your applications!

title.zh: WCA 道德委员会负责人招募（2023 年 8 月）

html.en:
There will be an appointment of a new WCA Ethics Committee (WEC) Leader.

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms 24 months and to spend at least 6 hours per week on average to work for the Committee. The qualities expected of candidates are:

  • Strong leadership skills
  • Proactivity
  • Clear background
  • Trustworthiness
  • Independence
  • Accountability

The application period for candidates to submit their candidacy documents is from now until September 18th, 2023, 23:59 UTC. Interested candidates can send the application privately to the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).

The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

  • Summary of activities done for the WCA.

Thanks for your candidacies and support,

title.zh: 招募 WCA 财务委员会负责人（2023 年 8 月）

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：

  • 简短的个人介绍。

title.zh: 2024 及 2025 年 WCA 锦标赛举办地公告（2023 年 8 月）

title.zh: 招募 WDC 成员（2023 年 8 月）

html.zh:
WCA 纪律委员会（WDC）正在招募新成员！任何人均可申请，也鼓励目前不是 WCA 工作人员的社群成员申请。

WDC 做什么？

主要调查比赛中的纪律事件，如作弊尝试或不当行为，必要时发出警告或禁赛。我们也向代表提供比赛现场处理意见，并积极改进相关 WCA 动议和政策。

权利与职责详见动议 10.2022.3—纪律委员会、动议 15.2022.1—暂停资格及其他处分和行为准则。纪律日志包含以往公告、重要事件报告和定期简报，欢迎在论坛纪律板块提问。

要求

硬性要求仅为书面英语沟通能力、熟悉 WCA 比赛环境，参加过几场比赛即可。我们还重视与队友讨论推理和想法的能力、逻辑和分析能力、保密意识、沟通能力。以下有帮助但非必需：精通一个以上速拧项目；流利掌握英语以外语言；处理人际冲突或其他不愉快情境的经验。

成员多样性十分有益，尤其鼓励文化背景、国籍、年龄和性别与现有成员不同的人申请。

申请

请在 2023 年 9 月 10 日星期日 23:59 UTC 前，将 PDF 发送至 stronto@worldcubeassociation.org，包含简短自我介绍、为 WCA 及魔方社群所做活动、相关个人技能、申请动机。

全部材料须在同一个 PDF 中，预计 24 小时内确认收件。申请期后开始遴选，可能包括面试或其他评估。有问题可联系 WDC 负责人。
html.en:
The WCA Disciplinary Committee (WDC) is looking for new members! Everyone can apply, and we encourage community members who are not part of the WCA Staff to send their application.

What does the WDC do?

Most of our work consists of investigating disciplinary incidents at competitions, such as cheating attempts or inappropriate behavior. If the circumstances require it, we may issue warnings or bans. We also give feedback to WCA Delegates on how to handle certain situations during WCA competitions, and we actively work to improve the WCA Motions and policies related to these topics.

If you are interested in the details of our rights and duties, check out the Motions 10.2022.3 - Disciplinary Committee and 15.2022.1 - Suspensions and other Sanctions, as well as the Code of Conduct. The Disciplinary Log contains public announcements made by the WDC in the past, including public reports for some important incidents and periodic WDC digests. Feel free to ask questions about any of this in the Disciplinary section of the WCA Forum.

Requirements

The only strict requirements for WDC members are:

  • Ability to communicate in English (written)
  • Familiarity with the WCA competition environment (having attend a few competitions is enough)

Other qualities we look for are:

  • Ability to discuss reasoning and ideas with team members
  • Logical and analytical reasoning
  • Confidentiality
  • Communication skills

The following qualities are useful, but not necessary:

  • Expertise in one or more speedcubing events
  • Fluency in a language other than English
  • Experience in dealing with interpersonal conflict or other unpleasant situations

The committee would greatly benefit from the diversity of their members. We therefore especially encourage applications from community members with a different cultural background, nationality, age and gender from the current members.

Applications

Applicants can send their application as a PDF document to stronto@worldcubeassociation.org before Sunday, September 10, 2023, 23:59 UTC. The application document should contain:

  • A brief personal introduction
  • Summary of activities done for the WCA and for the cubing community
  • Overview of the personal skills relevant to the role
  • Motivation for applying to the WDC

Everything should be contained in a single PDF file. Applicants can expect a reply to confirm the receipt of the application within 24 hours. The selection process will start after the application period is over, and it might include an interview or other kinds of assessment.

If you have any questions feel free to contact the WDC Leader at stronto@worldcubeassociation.org.

The WCA Regulations Committee would like to inform you about the new version of the WCA Regulations and Guidelines, which are going into effect on August 1st, 2023.

You can review all changes in this comparison on GitHub. You can click on “Files changed” to see the complete files of the Regulation and Guidelines, where all changes and additions are marked green and removals are marked red.

Below is a summary of the major changes in the new version of the Regulations and the Guidelines.

  • 5b5f and additional Visual Guide (commit)

html.zh:
WCA 质量保证委员会（WQAC）正在招募新成员，一起完成委员会的工作！申请面向所有人，目前未在 WCA 担任职务的社区成员也可以申请。

WQAC 负责什么？

申请人应具备以下条件：

  • 英语流利
  • 注重细节，思考务实
  • 善于合作，能够及时回应

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，应包含：

我们会回复确认收到申请，之后可能邀请申请人面谈。如有申请方面的疑问，可联系 Daniel Vædele Egdal（degdal@worldcubeassociation.org）。

html.en:
The WCA Quality Assurance Committee (WQAC) is seeking new members to help them with their mission! Applications are open to everyone and community members not currently holding a WCA position can apply.

What does the WQAC do? The WQAC is responsible for developing and ensuring quality standards within the WCA. title.zh: WCA 关于 James Molloy 的声明

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

我们很遗憾地告知大家，近期我们获悉了一起严重事件。

近日，世界魔方协会（WCA）前财务主管、英国魔方协会（UKCA）前主席 James Molloy 承认挪用了 UKCA 资金。具体金额尚待确定，但我们要强调此事的严重性，同时向大家说明，我们已经立即采取行动。我们的首要任务是保障 WCA 资金安全，并对 WCA 财务进行初步检查。初步检查的结论是，目前没有证据表明 WCA 财务受到影响。

我们理解这一事件的影响及严重程度。UKCA 是我们最大的地区组织之一，WCA 将为其提供支持。我们很高兴地告知大家，UKCA 的财务仍然稳健，并已确认，所有即将举行的比赛都会按计划进行。

我们已立即解除 James Molloy 在 WCA 的全部职务，包括财务主管、WCA 财务委员会（WFC）负责人及代表职务。同时，在全面调查完成前，James 被禁止参加任何 WCA 比赛。UKCA 也已将 James 移出组织，并撤销其全部管理权限。

我们清楚此事的严重性，正尽力解决。WCA 与 UKCA 始终由志愿者主导、以非营利方式运作，我们将继续坚持这些原则。事件发生后，UKCA 加快了转型为新注册有限公司的计划，WCA 将支持这一工作。

WCA 董事会与 WCA 道德委员会（WEC）将对 UKCA 资产管理不当的相关事件展开彻底调查。此外，我们将对 WCA 财务进行深入审计，审计独立于所有现任 WFC 成员，以确保 WCA 财务得到妥善管理。

我们理解透明度的重要性，但必须说明，调查仍在进行，因此在调查结束前，董事会、WFC 和 WEC 无法参与进一步讨论。

WCA 董事会
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

We regret to inform you of a serious incident that has come to our attention.

Recently, the former Treasurer of the World Cube Association (WCA) and former President of the UK Cube Association (UKCA), James Molloy, admitted to misappropriating UKCA funds. Although the exact sum is yet to be determined, we want to emphasize the seriousness of this issue, whilst assuring you that immediate action has been taken. Our foremost priority has been to ensure the security of WCA funds along with conducting an initial review into the WCA’s financials. Our initial review has concluded there is no evidence that the WCA’s financials have been impacted.

We understand the impact and significance of this incident, and the WCA is here to support the UKCA, one of our largest Regional Organizations. We are glad to report that the UKCA remains financially resilient and has confirmed ALL upcoming competitions will go ahead as planned.

With immediate effect, we have removed James Molloy from all WCA positions including Treasurer, WCA Financial Committee (WFC) Leader and Delegate. James has also been banned from competing at any WCA competition until a full investigation of the situation has been conducted. UKCA has removed James from the organization and revoked all of his administrative access.

We are aware of the seriousness of this incident and are doing all we can to resolve it. Both the WCA and UKCA have always been volunteer-led organizations both operating on a non-profit basis, and we will continue to uphold these principles. We will be supporting the UKCA who have expedited plans to transition the UKCA into a newly incorporated limited company as a result of this incident.

The WCA Board and WCA Ethics Committee (WEC) will be conducting a thorough investigation into the events that occurred in the mismanagement of UKCA assets. Separately, we will conduct an in-depth audit of the WCA finances independent of any current WFC member, to ensure proper management of the WCA financials.

While we understand the significance of transparency, we must emphasize that due to the ongoing investigation, the Board, WFC and WEC cannot participate in any additional discussions until the investigation reaches its conclusion.

WCA Board of Directors

title.zh: WCA 董事会成员变动（2023 年 7 月）
title.en: Changes in the WCA Board of Directors (July 2023)

html.zh:

title.zh: WDC 简报：2023 年第二季度

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

全球比赛数量快速增加，不幸也伴随纪律案件大幅增长。过去 3 个月，WDC 新开 20 项调查，结案 17 件。部分重要案件如下：

  1. 上次简报后，我们公布了 3 项调查声明，涉及选手在线行为、反复错误打乱，以及一名代表实施性骚扰的调查，见官网纪律板块。
  2. 年初接报双方因魔方被盗发生冲突。被指控方在 WDC 联系后很快承认偷窃，似乎有悔意，被禁赛 5 个月。提醒此类情况应立即联系代表，避免直接与他人对峙。
  3. 选手被发现观察时在桌下转动，涉及两场比赛至少 8 次。其被禁赛，相关成绩被取消。之后道歉并请求重新考虑期限，WDC 考虑其年龄较小，接受了重新考虑的请求。
  4. 代表报告，两名选手互为裁判时串通记录虚假时间。显示屏与成绩单不符引起注意。两人起初称计时器故障，视频排除该说法，随后承认互相记录更快时间。因年龄较小，两人各禁赛 3 个月，互为裁判的成绩被取消。
  5. 代表发现成绩单时间被划去，换成更快成绩。裁判称原本写的是较慢时间，下一次的打乱员也称见到较慢时间。选手否认修改，但笔迹分析结合证词，认定其改了成绩，给予 9 个月禁赛。
  6. 一名组织者修改尚未公布的比赛页面，试图发布针对另一选手的冒犯性言论。修改未正式保存，但截图被传播。该选手获正式警告。调查期间，比赛代表独立决定撤去其组织者职务。

另谈社群调查结果。2022 年底，我们通过匿名问卷收到反馈，归纳如下：

  1. 社群和工作人员总体满意 WDC 工作，平均评价适度正面。我们很高兴，并将继续改进。
  2. 简报受欢迎，尤其在工作人员中。它有助于社群了解工作，将继续定期发布。
  3. 许多代表希望有文档或常见问题，帮助其不必求助 WDC 就能处理常见纪律事件。我们正在准备。
  4. 约五分之一选手称曾至少一次在比赛中被他人弄得不舒服；工作人员中接近二分之一。即使我们以友善、包容自豪，也并非人人在比赛中始终自在。请尊重身边的人，并留意他们与你相处时的感受。

最后提醒大家充分理解 WCA 规则及比赛流程。如有疑问或不清楚如何操作，请询问代表。若认为成绩受到任何损害，看到可疑行为或感到不适，请立即找最近的代表，或联系 WDC 报告。

如有问题，可发邮件，或在论坛纪律板块提问。

谨致问候， WCA 纪律委员会
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

As the number of competitions around the world continues to increase rapidly, this unfortunately has meant that there has also been a dramatic rise in the number of disciplinary cases. In the last 3 months, the WDC has opened 20 new investigations, and has closed 17. Below you can find a summary of some notable cases from this period.

  1. Since our last digest, we have published 3 public statements detailing the outcome of some investigations. These include an investigation into a competitor’s online behavior, a case of repeated misscrambling, and an investigation regarding sexual harassment from a delegate. You can view these statements on the Disciplinary section of the WCA site.
  2. Earlier in the year, the WDC was contacted regarding an altercation between two parties due to a stolen cube. After being contacted by the WDC, the party accused quickly admitted to stealing the cube, and seemed remorseful for doing so. The competitor in question was given a 5 month ban. We would also like to remind everyone that in cases like this, it is best to immediately contact the competition’s delegate, and refrain from confronting others directly.
  3. A competitor was caught making moves beneath the table during the inspection phase of their solve. This was discovered to have occurred at least 8 times across two competitions. The competitor was given a ban from WCA competitions, and the affected solves were disqualified. The competitor later requested for their ban duration to be reconsidered after providing an apology. The WDC honored this request, taking into account the competitor’s young age as part of the decision.
  4. The WDC was informed by a delegate of a case of two competitors colluding to write down false times on their scorecard when judging each other. This was caught after discrepancies were noticed between the times shown on the display and those written down. The competitors initially claimed that this was due to a timer malfunction, however after reviewing available video evidence, this was determined not to be the case. Shortly after, the competitors admitted to cheating by writing down faster times when judging each other. Due to their young age, both competitors were given 3 month bans. The solves which they had judged each other for were disqualified.
  5. A delegate contacted the WDC after noticing that a result on a scorecard was scratched out and replaced by a faster time. The judge stated that they had written the original, slower time on the scorecard, and the scrambler for the subsequent attempt also claims they saw the slower attempt written down as well. The competitor denied modifying their scorecard, however, after analyzing the handwriting of the competitor, in addition with the earlier testimonies, it was determined that the competitor had altered time on their scorecard. The competitor was issued a 9 month ban.
  6. An organizer was caught making edits to an unannounced competition page in order to post offensive remarks about another competitor. While the changes were never officially saved, screenshots of the edits were distributed. The competitor was given an official warning form the WDC. The competition’s delegates independently decided to remove the organizer from their role during the course of this investigation.

Another topic we would like to discuss is the result of the community survey. At the end of 2022, we received feedback from the WCA Community in the form of an anonymous survey. Here are some facts that we have extrapolated from the results:

  1. The community and the staff are generally satisfied with the work of the WDC and have, on average, a moderately positive opinion of us. We are happy about this, and will do our best to improve even further.
  2. The WDC digest is quite popular, especially among staff members. We find it is a nice way to keep the community informed about our work, so we will keep publishing it regularly.
  3. Many delegates have asked for us to prepare some documents or an F.A.Q. to help them handle common disciplinary incidents without our assistance. We are working on it!
  4. About 1 out of 5 competitors reported that someone else has made them feel uncomfortable at least once during a competition. This number goes up to almost 1 in 2 among our fellow staff members. This shows that, even though we take pride in being a welcoming and friendly community, not everyone always feels comfortable at WCA competitions. We would like to take this chance to remind you to always be respectful of people around you and mindful of how they feel around you.

To conclude this Digest, we would like to remind everyone to make sure they fully understand the WCA Regulations and competition procedures. If you have any questions, or are unsure about how to do something, please do not hesitate to ask the Delegate(s) of the competition. In addition, if you ever think the competition results are being compromised in any way, or if you see suspicious behavior or feel uncomfortable at a competition, please find the nearest Delegate immediately and/or contact the WDC to report the incident.

Do you have questions for the WDC? Feel free to send us an email, or ask on the Disciplinary section of the WCA forum.

Best Regards,
The WCA Disciplinary Committee

title.zh: WCA 认可地区名称的重要调整
title.en: Important Changes to the Recognition of Regions

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

为使协会采用的标准与国际体育界保持一致，我们现公布几项重要调整。经认真考虑 WCA 体育组织团队（WSOT）专项工作组的建议，我们对以下地区名称作出变更，即日起生效：

  • 中国香港（原为香港）
  • 中国澳门（原为澳门）
  • 中华台北（原为台湾）

此外，中华台北将使用 WCA 中华台北旗帜。相关变更将在未来一个月内逐步应用于 WCA 各项服务。

我们希望强调，这并非草率作出的决定，其目的仅在于与国际奥委会（IOC）的标准保持一致。专项工作组为此投入了数月时间，征询了当地社区主要相关方，以及曾参与制定 WCA 认可地区名单的成员的意见。考虑这些反馈后，WCA 董事会一致同意采纳工作组提出的调整。

如有任何疑问或顾虑，请联系 board@worldcubeassocation.org。

补充说明（2023 年 6 月 24 日）：WCA 董事会对本公告目前造成的困惑表示歉意。董事会与 WSOT 正在整理这项决定的背景和依据，预计将在未来几天内发布报告。

补充说明（2023 年 6 月 29 日）：感谢大家的耐心等待。欢迎前往 WCA 论坛，相关主题中有对此项决定更详细的说明。

此致

WCA 董事会
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

We are able to share some important updates regarding our organization's alignment with the international standards set by the sporting community. After careful consideration of recommendations made by a specialized working group within the WCA Sports Organization Team (WSOT), we have made the following changes to our regions, effective immediately:

Hong Kong, China (Formerly Hong Kong) Macau, China (Formerly Macau) Chinese Taipei (Formerly Taiwan)

Furthermore, Chinese Taipei will now operate under the WCA Chinese Taipei flag, which will be rolled out through WCA services progressively over the coming month.

We want to emphasize that this decision was not made lightly. This is purely an effort to align with the IOC’s standards. A dedicated working group has spent several months primarily focused on this matter. They have taken the time to consult with key stakeholders in the local communities and members involved in the original creation of the WCA recognized regions list. After considering the feedback from these stakeholders, the WCA Board has unanimously agreed to adopt the proposed changes put forth by the working group.

Please feel free to direct any questions or concerns to board@worldcubeassocation.org.

Note (June 24th, 2023): The WCA Board apologizes for the confusion that has arisen so far regarding this announcement. The Board and WSOT are working to consolidate the context and justifications for this decision. We expect this report to be available in the next few days.

Note (June 29th, 2023): Thank you all for your patience. Please feel free to head over to the WCA Forum, where you will find a thread with much more insight into the decision.

Kind Regards, WCA Board of Directors

title.zh: 致数据主体的数据泄露通知
title.en: Notification of Data Breach to Data Subjects

html.zh:
WCA 近日发生了一起涉及 worldcubeassociation.org 网站的数据泄露事件。根据数据保护法律，尤其是《通用数据保护条例》（GDPR），我们向所有网站用户通报本次泄露、原因概况、可能后果、后续措施及联系方式。

数据泄露概况

  • 2023 年 6 月 7 日星期三 14:43 UTC 起，约 70 分钟内，用户可能发现自己在 worldcubeassociation.org 上登录成了同一地理区域的另一位用户。
  • 原因是在通过 AWS 服务器部署内容分发网络（CDN）时，配置出现错误。
  • 受影响数据主体的确切人数尚未确定。
  • 可能遇到该情况的用户须同时满足：
    • 从相同地理位置登录 worldcubeassociation.org。
    • 其访问流量已开始经由 CDN 路由。
    • 浏览网站的时间相差不超过 1 秒。
  • worldcubeassociation.org 保存的个人数据包括出生日期和邮箱地址。

可能后果

  • 当一组罕见条件同时满足时，数据主体的个人身份信息在技术上可能泄露。
  • 我们高度确信，泄露范围已得到控制；即使存在未经授权的访问，规模也很小。
  • worldcubeassociation.org 系统只保存有限的个人身份信息，非管理员用户无法下载全部身份数据。
  • 系统管理员已确认，即使有用户意外获得管理员权限，也没有人进入数据库控制面板。
  • 目前无法排除未经授权的用户曾进入权限较高的工作人员或比赛组织者账号，从而接触个人数据的可能。
  • 恶意人员可能曾控制某个账号并查看个人信息。不过，由于持续时间短、获得访问权限的对象具有随机性，我们认为这种可能性极低。

已采取的措施

  • WCA 软件团队（WST）已进行全面调查，以了解泄露原因、时间线和影响。
  • 系统管理员仍在调查细节，确认受影响的用户。

建议采取的措施

  • 出于充分谨慎，WST 建议所有曾在 6 月 7 日星期三登录 worldcubeassociation.org 的用户：
    • 检查个人资料，确认没有意外改动。
    • 重置密码。

联系方式

如果你对个人数据保护有其他疑问或顾虑，可通过成绩团队联系 WCA 数据保护官 Jacob Ambrose：Results@worldcubeassociation.org。
html.en:
The WCA recently had an incident resulting in a data breach of the worldcubeassociation.org website. In compliance with data protection laws (namely GDPR), we are informing all users of worldcubeassociation.org of this data breach, a summary of what caused it, likely consequences, our next steps, and a point of contact.

Summary of the data breach

  • At 14:43 UTC on Wednesday 7th June 2023, for approximately 70 minutes, users may have found themselves logged in as another user (from the same geographic area) on the worldcubeassociation.org website
  • This was caused by incorrect settings during a rollout of Content Delivery Network (CDN) via our AWS servers
  • An exact number of affected data subjects is still not yet determined.
  • Users who would have experienced this behaviour are those who were logged into the worldcubeassociation.org site:
    • From the same geographic location
    • After their traffic had started being routed through the CDN
    • Browsing the website within 1 second of each other
  • Personal data records held on worldcubeassociation.org include Date of Birth and Email address.

Likely consequences

  • With a set of rare conditions being met, it was technically possible for a data subject’s personal identifying information to be compromised.
  • There is a high level of certainty that the breach was contained and that if there was any unauthorised access, it was minimal.
  • The systems of worldcubeassociation.org contain only limited personal identifying information and there is no way for a non-admin user to download all identifying data.
  • The system administrators have been able to confirm that no user, who may have found themselves with administrative privileges, gained access to the database control panel.
  • At this point in time, it is NOT possible to rule out that an unauthorised user has gained access to an account with elevated (staff or competition organiser) privileges and hence gained access to personal data.
  • A malicious actor MAY have found themselves in control of an account and may have accessed personal information, however it is believed that the likelihood is extremely low due to the short time frame and the random nature of the granted access.

Measures taken

  • The WCA Software Team (WST) has done extensive investigations to understand the cause, the timeline and impact of the breach.
  • At this point the system administrators are still investigating the details and working to understand the affected users.

Recommended actions

  • It is with an abundance of caution, WST is recommending ALL users who were logged into the worldcubeassociation.org site on Wednesday 7th June to:
    • Confirm there are no unexpected changes to their profile
    • Reset their password

Communication

If you have any further queries or concerns related to protection of your private data, the WCA’s Data Protection Officer is Jacob Ambrose, who can be contacted through the results team (Results@worldcubeassociation.org).

title.zh: WCA 规则委员会工作简报（2023 年 6 月）

html.zh:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

2023 年上半年，WCA 规则委员会完成了不少工作。比赛数量增加，相关事件也随之增多。以下是近期较值得关注的案例：

  1. 一位选手完成全部还原后，复核打乱时发现其中一次仅有一步打乱错误，且只影响还原的最后一步。WCA 代表给予补赛，WRC 随后同意：虽然错误打乱的难度相同、还原只差最后一步，但既然有补赛，就应与通常的错误打乱处理一致，采用补赛成绩。事件记录见此处。

  2. 一场比赛结束后，发现几位知名选手的多次还原使用了错误打乱。WRC 逐次调查，并根据以下标准决定是否保留：

    • 如果错误打乱给选手带来明显优势，成绩应改为 DNF。
    • 如果错误打乱与原打乱难度相近，成绩应保留。
    • 如果无法分析错误打乱，例如没有还原视频，成绩应保留。

    事件记录见此处。

  3. 一场比赛结束后，发现某些项目多次发出了错误打乱。由于数量较多，WRC 同意删除受影响轮次的成绩。事件记录见此处。

  4. 一场比赛结束后，一位选手反映，自己的几次还原混用了前一组和本组的打乱。WCA 代表也确认，自己可能同时打开了连续两组的打乱。由于打乱保密受到破坏，WRC 同意删除受影响轮次的成绩，因此决赛成绩也一并删除。事件记录见此处。

  5. 一位选手发邮件向 WRC 反映，该场比赛使用的部分遮盖物半透明，并附图证明从某些角度可以看到罩内魔方的打乱状态。WCA 代表回复称，他们已确保将半透明遮盖物叠放两层，使其足够不透明。WRC 审查公开渠道的视频证据后，同意保留成绩。事件记录见此处。

  6. 一位选手在观察期间反映计时器处于四感应区模式。后来发现，在报告计时器问题之前，选手已在观察期间触碰摄像机，违反了规则 2i2b。WCA 代表给予了临时补赛，但 WRC 认为选手在发现计时器问题前已触碰摄像机，因此应保留 DNF。事件记录见此处。

大多数影响大量成绩的事件都与打乱有关，因此 WRC 希望提醒所有 WCA 代表、组织者和选手重视这一问题。所有比赛都必须遵守 WCA 打乱责任政策，避免给选手造成不利后果。
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

The first half of 2023 was quite productive for the WCA Regulations Committee. The number of competitions, as well as the number of incidents, has increased. Here you have the most notable of the recent incidents:

  1. After a competitor finished their average, the scrambles were double checked, and it was found that one of the solves was misscrambled only by one move, affecting only the last move of the solve. The WCA Delegates provided an extra attempt, and the WRC later agreed that although the misscramble was the same in difficulty and the solve was only different by one last move, the extra attempt should be used, as always done with misscrambles when the extra is available. See the Incident Log entry here.
  2. After a competition, several attempts of high-profile competitors were found to be misscrambled. The WRC investigated each of those attempts to determine if they should stay based on the following criteria:
  • If the misscramble gives the competitor a significant advantage, the attempt should be changed to DNF.
  • If the misscramble is similar in difficulty to the original scramble, the attempt should be left as is.
  • If the misscramble cannot be analyzed (e.g. the video of the attempt is not available), the attempt should be left as is.
    See the Incident Log entry here.
  1. After a competition, several misscrambles were found to be sent out during certain events. As the number of misscrambles was significant, the WRC agreed to remove the results of the affected rounds. See the Incident Log entry here.
  2. After a competition, a competitor reported that they had both the scrambles from the previous group and from their (current) group in their average. The WCA Delegate also confirmed they could have left two consecutive scramble sets open at the same time. Since the scramble secrecy was violated, the WRC agreed that the results from the affected round should be removed (also resulting in the removal of the final round). See the Incident Log entry here.
  3. A competitor emailed the WRC reporting that some covers at this competition were translucent, attaching a picture proving that the scramble can be seen when the puzzle is under the cover under some angle. The WCA Delegates responded that they made sure translucent covers were double stacked in order to make them opaque enough. WRC reviewed the video evidence from the public resources and agreed that the results should be kept. See the Incident Log entry here.
  4. During inspection, a competitor reported that their timer was in a 4-pad mode. As later discovered, the competitor touched their camera during the inspection violating Regulation 2i2b, before reporting the timer issue. The WCA Delegates granted a provisional extra attempt, but the WRC agreed to keep a DNF since the competitor touched the camera before spotting the issue with the timer. See the Incident Log entry here.

As most of the incidents that affected a significant amount of attempts were related to scramble concerns, the WRC would like to remind everyone (WCA Delegates, organizers and competitors) about the importance of this matter. All competitions must follow the WCA Scramble Accountability Policy to avoid detrimental consequences for the competitors.

title.zh: WCA 咨询理事会招募负责人（2023 年 5 月）

html.zh:
Ekaterina Kaneva 将卸任 WCA 咨询理事会（WAC）负责人，理事会将任命新负责人。感谢 Ekaterina 在带领理事会期间所做的工作。

申请者应能完成 24 个月的任期，并平均每周投入至少 5 小时参与理事会工作。我们希望申请者具备：

  • 较强的领导能力。
  • 出色的沟通能力。
  • 熟悉 WCA 的组织架构。
  • 与 WCA 社区保持紧密联系。

申请材料提交时间为即日起至 2023 年 6 月 21 日 23:59 UTC。有意申请者可私下将材料发送至 WCA 董事会（board@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：

  1. 简短的自我介绍。
  2. 为 WCA 所做工作的概述。
  3. 担任 WAC 负责人的工作设想。

此外，请提供一份可在申请截止后公开的申请材料副本。

WAC 的权利与职责见 WCA 动议 20.2021.1。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将依据 WCA 动议 10.2022.0 第 4.2 节投票选出新负责人，并公布结果。

感谢大家的申请和支持！
html.en:
There will be an appointment of a new WCA Advisory Council Leader (WAC), as Ekaterina Kaneva is stepping down from this position. We would like to thank Ekaterina for the work she has done leading the Council.

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 5 hours per week on average to work for the Council. The qualities expected of candidates are:

  • Strong leadership skills
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Good knowledge of the WCA structure
  • A strong connection to the WCA Community

The application period for candidates to submit their candidacy documents is from now until June 21st, 2023, 23:59 UTC. Interested candidates can send the application privately to the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).

The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

  1. Brief personal introduction.
  2. Summary of activities done for the WCA.
  3. Ambitions as the WAC Leader of the WCA.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WAC can be found in WCA Motion 20.2021.1.

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, as described in Section 4.2 of WCA Motion 10.2022.0.

Thanks for your candidacies and support!

title.zh: WCA 网站计划停机维护（2023 年 6 月）

html.zh:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

WCA 软件团队（WST）将于 2023 年 6 月 5 日星期一进行支付接入方面的重要更新。WCA 网站和数据库将在 06:00–12:00 UTC 期间暂停服务。预计实际维护时间会少于预留的 6 小时。

我们正在改进 WCA 网站，感谢大家耐心等待和理解！
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

The WCA Software Team (WST) will be performing some important updates regarding payment integration on Monday 5th of June 2023. The WCA website and database will be unavailable between UTC 06:00 - 12:00. The work is expected to be completed in less than the allotted 6 hours.

Thank you for you patience and understanding as we work on making the WCA website a better platform!

title.zh: WDC 关于一宗骚扰案件的报告
title.en: WDC report on a case of harassment

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

纪律委员会近期处理完一宗选手行为不当事件。该人曾为 WCA 代表，因此我们的调查之前，伦理委员会已决定将其从正式职务降职。我们已准备公开调查报告，希望与大家分享。

报告讨论性骚扰，可能不适合所有读者。虽然话题令人不快，但社群应知道 WCA 会坚决回应此类行为。

我们支持所有遭受骚扰或其他不当行为的人。若曾在 WCA 活动中处于不舒服的境地，鼓励向当地社群代表或 WDC 讲述。

上述调查报告见此处。

谨致问候， Sebastiano Tronto 代表纪律委员会
html.en:
Dear WCA community,

The Disciplinary Committee has recently concluded an incident involving the misconduct of a competitor. Since this person used to be a WCA delegate, our investigation has been preceded by the decision of the Ethics Committee to demote them from their official position. We have prepared a public report of our investigation and we would like to share it with you.

The report discusses the topic of sexual harassment, therefore it may not be suitable for all readers. Although it is unpleasant to bring up such a topic, we think it is important for the community to know that the WCA reacts firmly to these kind of actions.

We support everyone who has been the victim of harassment or other improper behavior. If you have ever been in an uncomfortable position during a WCA event, we encourage you to talk about it with your local community representatives or with the WDC.

You can find the report of the aforementioned investigation here.

Best,
On behalf of the disciplinary committee,
Sebastiano Tronto

title.zh: WDC 对一宗错误打乱事件采取的措施
title.en: WDC action on a misscrambling incident

html.zh:
亲爱的速拧社群：

WCA 纪律委员会近期完成了 Singapore Championship 2023 一系列错误打乱的调查。鉴于事件受到高度关注，WDC 希望公开部分细节。

多名高水平选手在错误打乱上取得极好成绩后，比赛代表联系 WDC，促成调查。代表确认这些打乱出自同一人，并报告该人无视停止打乱的要求；还列出了可能受其影响的其他尝试。WDC 使用多名选手提供的视频，核查了其中若干次。

审查后，WDC 认定该人在确保打乱正确方面极度疏忽，也无视比赛期间代表的要求。WDC 未能发现其具有恶意，但无论意图如何，出现如此广泛的错误打乱都极令人担忧。

基于以上原因，WDC 对其作出 6 个月禁止参赛的处分。

提醒大家，确保每人收到正确打乱（4g1例外除外）及遵从代表要求十分重要。虽打乱等许多职责由志愿者承担，但 WCA 认为打乱准确性是保证所有比赛公平、平等条件不可或缺的一环。

谨致问候， Nicholas McKee 代表 WCA 纪律委员会
html.en:
Dear speedcubing community,

The WCA Disciplinary Committee (WDC) has recently concluded an investigation regarding a series of misscrambles which occurred at Singapore Championship 2023. Due to the high profile nature of this incident, and the public attention that it has received, the WDC would like to publish some details publicly.

The WDC opened an investigation into this matter after being contacted by the Delegates of the competition, following several high-level cubers achieving extremely good times on incorrect scrambles. The Delegates were able to match these scrambles as coming from the same individual, whom they also reported was ignoring requests to not scramble, and were able to create a list of other attempts that may have been potentially affected by this individual. After using video evidence provided by several competitors, the WDC was able to check several of these attempts.

After reviewing these attempts, the WDC has come to the conclusion that the individual responsible for these misscrambles displayed extreme negligence in regard to ensuring that the scrambles were correct, and also ignored the requests of the delegates during the competition. The WDC was not able to identify any malicious intent from this individual, but regardless of intent the WDC finds it extremely concerning that such widespread misscrambling occurred.

Due to the reasons above, the WDC has issued a 6 month ban from competing for this individual.

The WDC would like to remind everyone of the importance of ensuring that everyone receives correct scrambles (with the exceptions of 4g1) as well as following the requests of WCA Delegates at competitions. While we realize many competition duties such as scrambling are carried out by volunteers, the WCA also recognizes that scramble accuracy is an integral part of ensuring fair and equal conditions at all WCA competitions.

Best regards
Nicholas McKee
On Behalf of the WCA Disciplinary Committee

title.zh: 2025 WCA 世锦赛及 2024 年洲际锦标赛申办通知（2023 年 4 月）
title.en: Applications for WCA World Championship 2025 and Continental Championships 2024 (April 2023)

html.zh:
WCA 董事会现征集 2025 WCA 世锦赛，以及以下地区 2024 年洲际锦标赛的申办方案：

  • 非洲
  • 亚洲
  • 大洋洲
  • 南美洲

请与你所在国家的代表讨论，确认是否有意愿、有能力申办。请注意，举办这一规模的比赛，在赛前和比赛期间都需要投入大量时间与精力。

WCA 世锦赛和洲际锦标赛仅接受 WCA 认可的地区组织申办。有意申办者，请于 2023 年 7 月 25 日 23:59 UTC 前，私下将申请材料发送至 board@worldcubeassociation.org。**材料须以 PDF 格式提交两个版本：**一份包含所有申办细节的完整版，以及一份删去敏感内容（如有）、可供公开的版本。

申请材料至少应包含以下信息：

希望何时举办比赛？

1a. 可选日期。 1b. 比赛天数。 1c. 与世界各地学校假期的重合情况。

希望在本国哪个地方举办比赛？

2a. 城市对外国游客的吸引力，以及可供游览的景点。 2b. 国际、国内及本地交通的便利程度。 2c. 不同价位的酒店或公寓供应情况。 2d. 场馆、面积及布置，包括舞台、观众席、练习桌和附属房间。 2e. 可用技术设施，包括网络、视频直播、灯光和音响。 2f. 可容纳的选手与观众人数。

主办团队和工作人员如何组成？

3a. 核心团队成员。 3b. 核心团队的经验。 3c. 其他参与方。 3d. 本地志愿者的人数和能力；建议约 20% 的选手担任工作人员。 3e. 需要外国代表提供哪些支持。

比赛总预算是多少？

4a. 支出：场租、场馆服务、舞台、设备、装饰、网站、胸牌、挂绳、礼包和奖品等。 4b. 收入：报名费、赞助和地方政府支持等。

这份示例表格列出了大型比赛需要安排和编入预算的部分事项，但并非完整清单。

关于预算，请注意，我们正在敲定一项赞助安排，预计将为这些锦标赛提供可观的资金支持。细节确定后，会告知获选团队。

申请期结束后，WCA 董事会将与申办方面谈，征询其他 WCA 工作人员的意见，并通过投票决定举办地点。如有董事参与某个申办团队，该董事在选拔流程中的职责将由其他人代替，例如高级代表或委员会、团队负责人。

我们希望这些比赛能够体现 WCA 对大型赛事的理念，进一步提高协会的专业水平，为选手提供尽可能好的参赛体验，也为全世界呈现精彩的比赛。

感谢大家的配合，期待收到你们的申办材料！
html.en:
The Board of Directors would like to receive applications for the WCA World Championship 2025 and the following regions for Continental Championships 2024:

  • Africa
  • Asia
  • Oceania
  • South America

Please discuss with the Delegates in your country whether this is something you are willing and able to pursue. Bear in mind that organizing a competition of this size takes a significant amount of time and effort before and during the competition.

For the WCA World and Continental Championships, only a WCA recognized Regional Organization can apply. If you are interested, send your application documents privately to board@worldcubeassociation.org before July 25th, 2023, 23:59 UTC. Documents must be sent in PDF format in two versions: one full version with all the details for the application, and another version with sensitive details - if any - removed to make public.

Please include in your application documents at least the following information:

When would you like to hold the Championship? 1a. Possible dates 1b. Number of days of the competition. 1c. Overlap with international holiday periods of schools.

Where would you like to hold the Championship in your country? 2a. City should be interesting to visit for foreigners with opportunities for sightseeing. 2b. Ease of international, national, and local travel. 2c. Availability of hotels/apartments with different price categories. 2d. Venue, venue size, and venue setup (stage, audience, tables to practice, side rooms). 2e. Technology available like internet, video streaming, lighting, sound equipment. 2f. Number of competitors and spectators that can be hosted.

What would the organization team and staff look like? 3a. Core team members. 3b. Experience of the core team. 3c. Involvement of other parties. 3d. Quantity and quality of local volunteers (guideline is 20% of competitors should staff). 3e. Required support by foreign Delegates.

What would be the overall budget for the competition? 4a. Cost (venue, venue services, stage, equipment, decorations, website, badges/lanyards/giftpacks, prizes). 4b. Income (registration fees, sponsoring, local government).

Here is an example document with a non-exhaustive list of topics that need to be arranged and budgeted for a large competition.

Please note with regards to the budgeting section that we are currently finalizing plans for a sponsor to contribute a significant amount to these championships. When available, the details will be communicated to the selected teams.
Once the application period is over, the WCA Board of Directors will interview applicants, consult other WCA Staff members, and vote in order to decide where the Championships will take place. If any Director is involved in a team that sends in an application, they will be replaced in the selection process by another person (for example a Senior Delegate or a Committee/Team Leader).

We are looking for competitions that can reinforce our concept of large WCA competitions, boosting the professionalization of our organization and able to offer the competitors the best possible experience and the world the best possible show.

Thank you in advance for your cooperation and we look forward to viewing your applications!

title.zh: WCA 论坛简报（2023 年 4 月）

html.zh:
以下是 2023 年第一季度 WCA 论坛上值得关注的部分话题。

用专门的应用记录成绩，代替成绩单

这篇帖子提议用手机应用记录选手成绩，代替纸质成绩单，希望改善体验，并减少打印、裁切成绩单的组织工作。社区也讨论了实施这一方案可能带来的其他问题。

允许盲拧使用带标志贴纸的魔方

社区继续讨论在盲拧项目中允许使用带标志贴纸的魔方会产生哪些影响。

WCA 的发展：为组织者提供报酬

这个话题提出，为组织者举办官方比赛所付出的精力和志愿服务时间提供补偿与奖励。同时也讨论了金钱奖励带来的主要问题、可能对比赛质量产生的负面影响，以及相应解决办法。

WDC 关于三阶多盲作弊案件的报告

社区就该案的处理决定发表意见，讨论累积处罚的影响，并提出未来可能的解决办法。

世界纪录汇总

以下是过去几个月被打破、讨论较多的世界纪录：

  • Guanbo Wang 以 0.47 秒打破二阶单次世界纪录。
  • Zayn Khanani 以 1.01 秒打破二阶平均世界纪录。
  • Tommy Cherry 以 12.78 秒打破三阶盲拧单次世界纪录。
  • Elijah Brown 以 0.75 秒打破金字塔单次世界纪录。
  • Michał Krasowski 以 3.87 秒打破 Square-1 单次世界纪录。
  • Stanley Chapel 以 51.96 秒打破四阶盲拧单次世界纪录。

如有问题、意见或反馈，欢迎发邮件至 advisory@worldcubeassociation.org。

感谢大家参与论坛！
html.en:
Here are some notable threads on the WCA Forum during the first quarter of 2023.

Dedicated App for recording times instead of scorecards This thread proposes a digital approach of recording competitors' results using a mobile application rather than the use of scorecards, aiming to bring a better experience and reducing the organizational work of printing and cutting scorecards. The community discusses further issues that can arise from implementing this new approach.

Allow logo stickers in blindfolded The community continues to discuss the impact of allowing cubes with stickered logos while in Blindfolded events.

WCA Growth - Compensation of Organizers This topic proposes a method to compensate and award competition organizers for their efforts and volunteering hours spent on running official competitions. Alongside, it also discusses the solutions for major issues with monetary rewards and the negative impact it may bring to the quality of competitions.

WDC report on a case of cheating in 3x3x3 Multi-Blind The community shares their opinion on the decision of this case and discusses the effect of the accumulated punishments and suggests potential future solutions.

WR Summary Here are the most discussed World Records that were broken in the previous months:

  • Guanbo Wang breaks the 2x2x2 World Record Single with a time of 0.47 seconds.
  • Zayn Khanani breaks the 2x2x2 World Record Average with an average time of 1.01 seconds.
  • Tommy Cherry breaks the 3x3x3 Blindfolded World Record Single with a time of 12.78 seconds.
  • Elijah Brown breaks the Pyraminx World Record Single with a time of 0.75 seconds.
  • Michał Krasowski breaks the Square-1 World Record Single with a time of 3.87 seconds.
  • Stanley Chapel breaks the 4x4x4 Blindfolded World Record Single with a time of 51.96 seconds.

If you have any questions, comments, or feedback feel free to send an email to advisory@worldcubeassociation.org.

Thanks for being a part of the Forum!

title.zh: WDC 简报：2023 年 3 月

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

希望大家 2023 年开局顺利。以下是过去三个月的部分重要案件。

  1. 年初调查一名知名选手在三阶多盲中从眼罩下偷看作弊。WDC 认定其作弊，并延伸到此前数场比赛。完整公开报告已发布。
  2. 类似盲拧作弊中，选手利用裁判遮挡板位置不当偷看魔方、修正多处错误，涉及该比赛多次尝试，包括两个国家纪录平均。多次沟通后，选手承认并道歉，被禁赛 9 个月，相关还原改为 DNF。
  3. 发现选手腿上写有四阶 O 特（OLL 奇偶）公式。其很快承认没有记住公式，且不知道这样违反规则。相关成绩改为 DNF，给予正式警告，并提醒熟悉规则。
  4. 一名年轻选手取得数次异常快成绩，被怀疑观察时在桌下转动。监护人最初承认存在这一行为，但 WDC 怀疑实际是在桌下换成预先设定打乱的另一个魔方。联系选手后，其很快确认这一推断并道歉，获正式警告，相关成绩判 DNF。
  5. 近期收到多个国家的骚扰案件，部分涉及 WCA 工作人员。请尊重他人，遵守 WCA 行为准则。

也提醒裁判全神贯注履职，尤其正确举盲拧遮挡板，不要让自己或选手分心。有疑问或发现可疑行为时，应及时询问代表。

如有问题，可发邮件，或在论坛纪律板块提问。
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

We hope that the beginning of 2023 is going well for you. Below you can find a summary of some notable WDC cases from the past three months.

  1. Earlier in the year, the WDC investigated a case of a high profile competitor cheating in 3x3x3 Multi-Blind by peeking under the blindfold. The WDC concluded that the competitor had cheated, and that this cheating extends to several prior competitions as well. A full public report on this case has been made available, which can be found here.
  2. A similar case of blind cheating was caught where a competitor took advantage of their judge’s poorly placed sight blocker, in order to peek at their cube and fix several mistakes. This cheating extended to several attempts at the competition in question, including two national record averages. After several exchanges with the WDC, the competitor admitted to cheating, and apologized for their behavior. The competitor was issued a 9 month ban, and the affected solves have been changed to DNF.
  3. A competitor was caught with the 4x4 OLL parity algorithm written down on their leg. After being confronted, the competitor quickly admitted they had not memorized the algorithm, and that they didn’t know doing so was against regulations. The affected results were changed to DNF and a formal warning was given to the competitor, along with a reminder to be familiar with the WCA regulations.
  4. A young competitor who achieved several unusually fast times was suspected to be making turns to their cube underneath the table cube during inspection. The guardian of the competitor initially admitted that they had done this, however the WDC doubted that claim, instead believing that the competitor had switched the cube they were using under the table for one with a predetermined scramble. After reaching out to the competitor, they were quick to confirm the WDC’s theory and apologized for their mistakes. The competitor was issued a formal warning and the results in question were DNFed.
  5. Recently, the WDC has received a number of harassment cases from several different countries, some of which involving WCA staff. We would like to remind everyone to be respectful of others, and ensure that you are upholding the WCA Code of Conduct.

The WDC would also like to remind all judges to give their full attention to performing their duties as a judge, particularly holding the blindfolded sight blocker correctly, and not distracting themselves or the competitor. We would also like to remind all judges to not hesitate in speaking to their competition’s delegate if they have questions or notice any suspicious behavior.

Do you have questions for the WDC? Feel free to send us an email, or ask your question in the Disciplinary section of the WCA forum.

title.zh: WCA 比赛公告团队招募成员（2023 年 2 月）

html.zh:
WCA 比赛公告团队（WCAT）正在招募热心、可靠的新成员！所有人都可以申请，但须符合以下条件才会进入选拔。

WCAT 负责什么？

WCAT 成员的日常工作包括：

  • 每天准确审核和公布世界各地的比赛。
  • 处理比赛信息变更申请。
  • 经常参与团队讨论和投票。
  • WCAT 的正式权利与职责见 WCA 动议 10.2021.2。

我们希望申请者具备：

  • 主动、细心，并能着眼于解决问题。
  • 英语流利。
  • 每天能够多次查看内部消息、公布比赛。
  • 熟悉《WCA 比赛要求政策》（WCRP）。
  • 每天能投入至少 1 小时。
  • 对 WCA 规则和政策有足够了解。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：

  • 简短的自我介绍。
  • 为 WCA 所做工作的概述。
  • 具体说明自己如何符合上述要求。
  • 【可选】你认为与该岗位相关、但未在上面列出的能力和资历。

即日起至 2023 年 3 月 22 日 23:59 UTC，申请者可将材料发送给 Wilson Alvis（walvis@worldcubeassociation.org）。
html.en:
The WCA Competition Announcement Team (WCAT) is seeking new passionate and trustworthy members! The application is open to everyone. However, you must meet certain criteria to be considered for the position.

What does the WCAT do?

The daily tasks of a WCAT member include:

  • Review and announce competitions around the world on a daily basis with accuracy and correctness.
  • Handle change requests to competitions.
  • Engage in frequent discussions through voting within the Team.
  • The official rights and duties of the WCAT are documented in WCA Motion 10.2021.2.

Applicants are expected to possess the following qualities:

  • Proactive personality, detail-oriented, and solution-oriented mindset.
  • Fluency in English.
  • Ability to check internal messages and announce competitions multiple times a day.
  • Good familiarity with the WCA Competition Requirements Policy (WCRP).
  • Ability to devote at least 1 hour per day.
  • Sufficient familiarity with the WCA Regulations and WCA Policies.

Candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

  • A brief personal introduction.
  • Summary of activities done for the WCA.
  • A concrete overview on how expected qualities are to be fulfilled.
  • (Optional) Qualities and qualifications you find relevant that are not listed above.

The application period is open for applicants to submit their application document from now until March 22nd, 2023 23:59 UTC to Wilson Alvis (walvis@worldcubeassociation.org).

title.zh: Rubik’s® 连续第二年赞助世界魔方协会
title.en: Rubik’s® returns for year two of sponsorship with the World Cube Association

html.zh:
WCA Rubik’s 世锦赛将于今年 8 月在韩国举行。

作为机械益智玩具比赛的管理组织，世界魔方协会宣布，世界知名品牌 Rubik’s® 将成为 2023 年 WCA 世锦赛的官方赞助商。比赛将于 2023 年 8 月 12–15 日在韩国仁川举行。Rubik’s 于 2022 年首次成为各洲锦标赛的官方赞助商；当年共举办了创纪录的六场洲际锦标赛，来自全球 50 多个国家和地区的 1,400 多名选手参加了比赛。

2023 年 Rubik’s WCA 世锦赛预计将成为有史以来规模最大的魔方速拧锦标赛之一。世界各地的速拧选手将齐聚韩国仁川，在 17 个项目中争夺世界冠军。上一届世锦赛于 2019 年在澳大利亚墨尔本举行，德国选手 Phillip Weyer 获得冠军。

WCA 执行董事 Ethan Pride 谈到此次重要赞助时表示：“有 Rubik’s 的赞助支持，WCA 将能把锦标赛的水平和精彩程度带到前所未有的高度，为所有来到仁川的人提供最好的体验，留下难忘的回忆。2022 年，我们与 Rubik’s 一起在六大洲举办了比赛，将魔方的乐趣带到世界各地。我们相信，继续合作将让 2023 年取得更多成果。”

Spin Master 市场营销副总裁兼游戏全球业务负责人 Adam Hyman 表示：“近 50 年来，Rubik’s 一直激励着初学者，也挑战着那些已经掌握魔方的人。WCA 世锦赛回归之际，我们很高兴能够参与其中，支持这群热爱还原的魔友，并与大家一起庆祝。”

Rubik’s 官方网站：https://www.rubiks.com/ 世界魔方协会官方网站：https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/

2004 年 8 月，荷兰人 Ron van Bruchem 与美国人 Tyson Mao 创立了世界魔方协会（WCA），目的是记录成绩、制定统一规则，并帮助更多国家举办更多比赛。WCA 至今已在 143 个国家认证了超过 7,000 场比赛，累计参赛人数超过 150,000 人。自 Minh Thai 在 1982 年创下纪录以来，三阶单次世界纪录已大幅缩短，目前为中国选手杜宇生于 2018 年创造的 3.47 秒。

youtube(https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=usY4YsqzHww)
html.en:
WCA Rubik’s World Championships to take place in South Korea this August

The World Cube Association, the governing body for competitions with mechanical puzzles, announces the world famous Rubik’s® brand will be the official sponsor for the WCA World Championship 2023 taking place August 12-15, 2023 in Incheon, South Korea. Rubik’s first joined as an official sponsor for the 2022 continental championships which held a record-breaking six competitions, hosting over 1,400 participants from 50+ nationalities from around the world.

The 2023 Rubik’s WCA World Championship is set to be the one of the largest speedcubing championships ever held. Speedcubers from around the world will gather in Incheon, South Korea, where they will compete in 17 different events to determine the world champion. The last world championship, which took place in 2019, was held in Melbourne, Australia crowning German speedcuber Phillip Weyer as the champion.

The executive director of the WCA, Ethan Pride, said the following about the historic sponsorship, “With Rubik’s on board as sponsor, the WCA will be able to provide an unforgettable level of championship and excitement never achieved before to create the best experience for everyone involved in Incheon. Together with Rubik’s, in 2022 we hosted competitions in six continents, bringing the excitement of cubing across the globe. We are confident that this continued sponsorship will only bring more success in 2023.”

“Rubik’s has both inspired and challenged novice cubers, and those who have mastered its puzzle for close to 50 years,” said Adam Hyman, Spin Master’s VP of Marketing and Global Business Unit Lead for Games. “We are thrilled to come on board for the return of the WCA World Championships to support and celebrate this engaged community of solvers.”

Rubik’s Official Website: https://www.rubiks.com/ World Cube Association Official Website: https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/

In August 2004, the World Cube Association (WCA) was created by the Dutchman Ron van Bruchem and the American Tyson Mao. The goal was to track records, define a uniform set of rules, and help with the organization of more competitions in more countries. The WCA has now officiated more than 7,000 competitions in 143 countries, with more than 150,000 unique participants. Since Minh Thai’s record in 1982, the 3x3x3 Cube World Record has lowered significantly and now stands at 3.47 seconds set by the Chinese Yusheng Du in 2018.

title.zh: WCA 规则委员会工作简报：2022 年回顾

html.zh:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

2022 年，WCA 规则委员会完成了不少工作。我们希望通过这份简报，向大家介绍过去一年的工作情况。

首先，8 名新成员加入了委员会。他们的贡献给 WRC 带来了很大帮助，我们也期待委员会今后的发展。

2022 年下半年，WRC 完成了对越南比赛的调查。详情可参见这篇公告和调查报告。

除这项调查外，我们还处理了许多意外事件，可在意外事件日志中查看。以下是几起较值得关注的事件：

  1. 一次五魔尝试的观察阶段，选手无意间使魔方发生了错层，可能违反规则 A3c1。仔细审查视频后，WRC 决定不将该次尝试判为 DNF。所分析的视频画面均未显示该层转动超过允许的 36°（参见规则 10f2）。事件记录见这里。2023 年 2 月的规则更新已进一步说明观察期间的错层问题。
  2. 一名选手使用的魔表侧面贴有标志贴纸。由于当时没有规则明确禁止魔表上的标志，且选手不太可能因此获得优势，该魔表被认定可以用于比赛。事件记录见这里。2023 年 2 月的规则更新已进一步说明魔表的器材要求。
  3. 一名选手在还原结束（即停止计时器）后、该次尝试结束（即在成绩单上签名）前，表示自己受到了干扰，并要求补赛。WRC 进一步讨论后，同意保留原尝试成绩。详情见事件记录。2023 年 2 月的规则更新已进一步说明规则 11e及其指南，避免继续产生歧义。
  4. 一名选手完成还原后，在成绩尚未完整记入成绩单前，计时器被裁判重置或自行重置。视频证据拍到了显示器，但没有拍到计时器。由于视频清楚显示了显示器，且它在整个还原过程中工作正常，WRC 同意保留显示器上显示的原成绩。详情见事件记录。
  5. 一次三盲尝试中，裁判有相当长一段时间忘记放置遮挡物。WRC 决定保留补赛成绩，但之后 WCA 董事会推翻了这一决定，改为保留原尝试成绩。详情见事件记录。2023 年 2 月的规则更新已进一步说明遮挡物的相关规定。

最后，我们想提醒大家，遵守 WCA 规则、指南和政策非常重要。请确保自己正确理解这些规定，并在正式尝试中遵守。

如有 WCA 规则相关问题，欢迎通过 regulations@worldcubeassociation.org 联系我们，也可以在 WCA 论坛的 WCA 规则板块提问。
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

2022 has been a productive year for the WCA Regulations Committee, and now the WRC would like to share with you some insight on the work we have done in the recent year.

Firstly, 8 new members joined our committee. So far, their contributions have been extremely welcome for the WRC, and we look forward to seeing what the future holds for our committee.

In the second half of 2022, the WRC concluded an investigation regarding competitions in Vietnam. For more details, see this announcement and this investigation report.

Along with this investigation, we resolved many incidents, which you can find in the Incidents log, here are the most noticeable ones:

  1. During the inspection of a Megaminx attempt, the competitor caused an unintentional misalignment to the puzzle, possibly against Regulation A3c1. After careful review of the video footage, the WRC has decided not to DNF the attempt. None of the frames analyzed point to the face having moved beyond the allowed 36º (see Regulation 10f2). See this incident log. Misalignments during inspection have been clarified with the February 2023 Regulations update.
  2. A competitor used a Clock with a sticker (logo) placed on the side. The puzzle was determined to be competition-legal as there were no regulations explicitly forbidding logos for Clock puzzles and the competitor is not likely to have gained an advantage. See this incident log. Clock hardware has been clarified with the February 2023 Regulations update.
  3. A competitor claimed to be distracted after finishing the solve (i.e. stopping the timer), but before finishing the attempt (i.e. signing the score sheet), and requested an extra attempt. The WRC further discussed this incident and agreed that the original attempt should stay. For more details, see this incident log. Regulation 11e and its guidelines have been clarified with the February 2023 Regulations update to not cause any further confusion.
  4. After a competitor finished their solve, the timer was reset by either the judge or by the timer itself before the result was fully recorded on the score sheet. The video evidence showed the display but not the timer. Since the display was clearly shown in the evidence and it was working fine through the solve, WRC agreed that the original result shown on the display may stand. For more details, see this incident log.
  5. A judge forgot to hold a sight blocker for a significant amount of time in a 3BLD attempt. The decision from the WRC was to keep the extra attempt. However, in the latter, the decision was overturned by the WCA Board of Directors, thus keeping the original attempt. For more details, see this incident log. The Regulations on sight blockers have been clarified in the February 2023 Regulations update.

To conclude the digest, we would like to remind everyone about the importance of adhering to the WCA Regulations, Guidelines, and Policies. It is important to make sure you understand them properly to ensure they are followed during your official attempts.

If you have any WCA Regulations related questions, do not hesitate to contact us at regulations@worldcubeassociation.org, or to ask your questions in the WCA Regulations category on the WCA Forum.

title.zh: 招募 WCA 道德委员会成员（2023 年 2 月）

html.zh:
WCA 道德委员会（WEC）正在招募新成员，一起完成委员会的工作！所有人都可以申请，不要求申请者目前已在 WCA 任职。

WEC 负责什么？

  • 维护和更新《道德准则》。
  • 确保 WCA 工作人员遵循的各项程序符合《道德准则》。
  • 对 WCA 工作人员不遵守《道德准则》的情况开展独立调查。
  • 作为提出调查请求的注册速拧选手的可信赖联系人。
  • 若相关方不接受 WCA 纪律委员会的决定，担任上诉机构。

WEC 的正式权利与职责载于 WCA 议案 10.2022.4。

我们希望候选人具备以下条件：

  • 无不良记录。
  • 能合理安排自己的时间。
  • 能够讨论观点并说明理由。
  • 熟悉 WCA 的工作与活动。

申请期从即日起至 2023 年 3 月 3 日 23:59 UTC，请将材料发送给 Enzo Mattos（emattos@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：

  • 简短的个人介绍。
  • 曾在魔方社区开展的工作概述。
  • 申请加入 WEC 的原因。

申请者会及时收到确认收件的回复，之后可能获邀参加面试。如对申请有疑问，可联系 Enzo Mattos（emattos@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请期结束后，WEC 负责人将选出人选，在申请者接受职位后公布新成员名单。

感谢大家的申请与支持！
html.en:
The WCA Ethics Committee (WEC) is seeking new members to help them with their mission! The applications are open to everyone; it’s not a requirement to hold a current position in the WCA to be considered.

What does the WEC do?

  • Maintaining and updating the Code of Ethics.
  • Ensures that all procedures followed by WCA Staff abide by the Code of Ethics.
  • Performs independent investigations if any WCA Staff member is not compliant with said Code of Ethics.
  • Confidant for Registered Speedcubers that request investigations.
  • Functions as the board of appeal if any involved party disagrees with a decision made by the WCA Disciplinary Committee.

The official rights and duties of the WEC are documented in WCA Motion 10.2022.4..

The qualities and requirements expected of candidates are:

  • Clear background
  • Personal time management skills
  • Ability to discuss reasoning and ideas
  • Familiarity with WCA activities

The application period is open for applicants to submit their application documents from now until March 3rd, 2023, 23:59 UTC to Enzo Mattos (emattos@worldcubeassociation.org).

Candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

  • A brief personal introduction
  • Summary of activities done within the cubing community
  • Motivation for applying to join the WEC

Applicants can expect an immediate reply to confirm the receipt of the application, and may later receive a request to be interviewed. Anyone with questions about applying can contact Enzo Mattos (emattos@worldcubeassociation.org).

After the application period, the WEC Leader will make a selection and the new members will be announced once applicants have accepted the positions.

Thank you for your candidacies and support!

Dear WCA community,

We would like to inform you that effective January 25, 2023 Callum Goodyear has decided to step down from his position on the WCA Board of Directors.

We would like to thank Callum for his contribution to the organization as a Director and Secretary over the last 2 and a half years. He has been a tremendous help to the organization during his term and we wish him the best in his other tasks.

The remainder of the Board appreciates your patience over the next few months as we consolidate our resources and plan for the future so that we can continue conducting tasks to ensure the operation of our organization.
