title.zh: WCA 规则委员会调查：移除越南部分比赛成绩
title.en: WRC Investigation - Vietnamese Competitions Results Removal

html.zh:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

WCA 规则委员会（WRC）近期完成了对越南 WCA 比赛的调查，并因此移除了 2013 至 2022 年间多场比赛的大量成绩。

WRC 发现，许多比赛使用成绩单充当魔方罩，违反了规则 A2c1 和指南 A2c1+。这些小纸片无法充分遮住魔方，导致选手在还原开始前就能看到打乱后的状态。打乱保密是必须严肃对待的问题，违反保密要求的情况不能忽视。

此外，少数比赛使用了裕鑫计时器，而这类计时器不在规则 8a7 认可的计时器之列。现行规则中的对应条款为 7f1a。由于这些计时器存在不一致的问题，使用它们的比赛成绩必须移除。

这并非首次因这些问题移除成绩。这起事件以及 Hanoi Open 2022 都曾因使用成绩单作魔方罩而被移除成绩；Vancouver Island 2019 也曾因使用裕鑫计时器而被移除成绩。尽管这些问题不是选手的过错，相关成绩并非在符合 WCA 竞赛规则的条件下取得，因此必须移除。

本次调查影响了越南 19 场比赛的成绩，其中 9 场比赛已无任何有效成绩。超过 900 名选手受到影响，共移除了超过 18,000 次还原成绩；许多选手也因成绩缺失而被重新分配 WCA ID，或失去了 WCA ID。我们完全理解这会让大家感到失望，但规则经过仔细制定，就是为了防止选手获得任何不公平优势。如果不遵守规则，我们便无法保证成绩的公正可信。

这项决定当然也影响了大量原本可能有效的还原。但鉴于这些轮次中的其他还原存在诸多明确违规，我们无法有把握地认可这些成绩。

借此机会，我们再次提醒大家：理解竞赛规则十分重要。如有规则方面的疑问，请联系所在地区的 WCA 代表，或通过 regulations@worldcubeassociation.org 联系 WCA 规则委员会。

本次调查的完整报告见此处，事件日志条目见此处。
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

The WCA Regulations Committee (WRC) has recently concluded an investigation into WCA competitions in Vietnam, resulting in the removal of many results from competitions between the years of 2013 and 2022.

The WRC has found that at many of these competitions, score sheets were used as cube covers, which violates regulation A2c1 and guideline A2c1+. These small pieces of paper do not do a sufficient job covering the cube, allowing scrambled puzzles to be seen before competitors' attempts. Scramble secrecy is something that is treated very seriously and violations of it cannot be ignored.

Additionally, there is a small number of competitions that used Yuxin timers, which were not approved timers as per 8a7. Under current regulations, this is regulation 7f1a. Due to inconsistencies with these timers, the results from competitions that used them must be removed.

This is not the first time that results have been removed for these issues. Results have been removed for scoresheets being used as covers here as well as at Hanoi Open 2022. Results have been removed for using Yuxin timers at Vancouver Island 2019. While these issues are not the fault of the competitor, they were not achieved in accordance with the WCA Regulations and must be removed.

As a result of this investigation, results from 19 competitions in Vietnam were affected, including 9 competitions that no longer have any results. Over 900 competitors were affected, with more than 18,000 attempts removed in total, and many competitors had their WCA ID reassigned or lost due to their missing results. We completely empathize with the frustration that this causes, but our regulations are carefully written such that competitors can’t obtain any unfair advantages. If these aren’t followed, then we cannot guarantee the integrity of our results.

Of course, this decision impacts a significant number of solves that might be otherwise valid. However, given the number of clear violations in the rest of these rounds, we can not confidently accept these results.

We want to take this opportunity to remind everyone the importance of understanding the Regulations. If you have any questions about the Regulations, please contact either your WCA Delegate or the WCA Regulations Committee at regulations@worldcubeassociation.org.

A full report for this investigation can be found here, and the incident log entry can be found here.

title.zh: WDC 关于一宗三阶多盲作弊案件的报告
title.en: WDC report on a case of cheating in 3x3x3 Multi-Blind

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

纪律委员会刚结束一宗三阶多盲作弊调查。认定选手作弊，并确信行为也延伸至此前比赛。因此禁赛 2 年，部分成绩改为 DNF。

该选手在社群较知名，仍保持多项未受本调查影响的国家纪录。因此 WDC 决定公开报告，以解释决定理由并介绍委员会工作。

报告见此处。

谨致问候， Sebastiano Tronto 代表 WCA 纪律委员会
html.en:
Dear WCA community,

The Disciplinary Committee has just concluded an investigation on a case of cheating in 3x3x3 Multi-Blind. The competitor was found guilty and we are convinced that this behavior extends to prior competitions as well. As a result, they have been banned for 2 years and some of their results have been changed to DNF.

Since this competitor is relatively well-known in the community, still holding multiple national records (unaffected by our investigation), the WDC decided to make the report for this investigation public. The intention is to explain the reasons behind our decision and give you some insight on how the Committee works.

The report can be found here.

Best regards,
Sebastiano Tronto,
On behalf of the WCA Disciplinary Committee

title.zh: 招募 WCA 市场团队成员（2023 年 1 月）

html.zh:
WCA 市场团队正在招募新成员！所有人都可以申请，我们也鼓励尚未在 WCA 任职的人报名！

WCA 市场团队负责什么？

WMT 负责管理 WCA 与外部伙伴的关系，同时参与 WCA 品牌相关工作，包括周边商品、公众参与、市场调研及合作伙伴事务。

以下是 WMT 正在开展的一些项目：

  • 周边商品
    • 你可能已经看到上线的 WCA 周边商店。WMT 正在寻找能够帮助开发和拓展周边商品的成员。
  • 赞助
    • WMT 与 Spin Master 等现有 WCA 赞助商合作，也在全球和当地范围内寻找潜在合作机会。特别欢迎曾为自己主办的比赛争取赞助的人申请。
  • 锦标赛支持
    • WMT 希望招募能够协助推广各洲锦标赛和世锦赛的成员，重点是宣传 WCA 品牌、扩大影响范围。
  • 器材小组
    • WMT 负责处理世界各地代表提交的器材订单。有项目管理和沟通经验的人可以在这方面发挥作用。

所有人都可以申请，不要求申请者目前已在 WCA 任职。

申请条件

  • 对 WCA 品牌推广有兴趣或相关经验。
  • 每周可投入约 5–10 小时。
  • 有创意，能与团队合作。
  • 熟悉周边商品、赞助或供应商管理者优先。

申请者须提交 PDF 格式的材料，包含简短的个人介绍、参与 WCA 的经历、申请加入 WMT 的原因，以及相关经验或技能。

请于即日起至 2023 年 2 月 20 日 23:59 UTC，将申请发送至 sgrover@worldcubeassociation.org。
html.en:
The WCA Marketing Team is seeking new members! The application is open to everyone and we encourage those who do not have WCA positions to apply!

What does the WCA Marketing Team do?

The WMT is responsible for managing WCA relationships with external partners as well as working closely on the WCA Brand, including WCA merchandise, engagement, market research and working with WCA partners.

Here are some of the projects WMT is working on -

  • Merchandising
  • You may have seen the launch of the WCA Merchandise Store - WMT is seeking members who can help develop and grow the merchandising.
  • Sponsorships
  • WMT works with current WCA sponsors like Spin Master, and also works on exploring potential opportunities for the WCA (global and local scales). Candidates who have worked on getting sponsorships for competitions they have organized are strongly encouraged to apply.
  • Championship Support
  • WMT is looking for members who can help market the continental and world championships - specifically in promoting the WCA brand and growing our reach.
  • Gear team
  • WMT is responsible for fulfilling the gear orders made by delegates around the world. This is a good opportunity for someone with project management and communication experience.

The application is open to everyone. Potential applicants do not have to hold a current position to be considered.

Requirements for Applicants

  • Interest and/or experience in Marketing the WCA Brand
  • Approximate 5 - 10 Hours time commitment per week
  • Creative mind, and the ability to work within a team
  • Familiarity in dealing with merchandising/sponsorships/vendor management is a plus

Applicants should submit a PDF application including a brief personal introduction, their involvement with the WCA, their motivation for applying to the WMT, and any relevant experience or skills.

Applications should be sent to sgrover@worldcubeassociation.org from now until February 20th, 2023, 23:59 UTC to be considered.

title.zh: WCA 竞赛规则更新（2023 年 2 月）

html.zh:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

WCA 规则委员会（WRC）在此通知，新版《WCA 竞赛规则与指南》将于 2023 年 2 月 1 日生效。

所有改动可在 GitHub 版本对比中查看。点击“Files changed”即可查看规则与指南的完整文件，其中新增和修改的内容标为绿色，删除的内容标为红色。

以下是新版规则与指南主要改动的概要。

主要改动

  • 允许同时设置累计时限和单次还原时限（PR | 讨论）
  • 进一步明确 Square-1 在观察期间未对齐的处理（PR | 讨论）
  • 将第二代 Stackmat 从认可计时器名单中移除（PR）
  • 为魔表增加规则 4g2（PR）
  • 在规则中进一步明确魔表的定义（PR）
  • 在指南中进一步说明额外还原的处理（PR）
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

The WRC would like to inform you about the versions of the WCA Regulations and Guidelines, which are going into effect February 1, 2023.

You can review all changes in this comparison on GitHub. You can click on “Files changed” to see the complete files of the Regulation and Guidelines, where all changes and additions are marked green and removals are red.

Below is a summary of the major changes in the new version of the Regulations and the Guidelines.

Major Changes

  • Allow both a cumulative time limit and a time limit (per attempt) to be present at the same time (PR | discussion)
  • Make Square-1 misalignments during inspection more clear (PR | discussion)
  • Remove Gen 2 Stackmats from the list of approved timers (PR)
  • Add 4g2 for clock (PR)
  • Defining clock better in the regulations (PR)
  • More clarification on extras in the guidelines (PR)

title.zh: 2022 年年终寄语

html.zh:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

又一年过去了，感谢社区成员在 2022 年始终保持的热情！经历了两年比赛受限的时期，今年世界许多地区的魔方活动重新活跃起来，86 个国家共举办了 1,069 场比赛，迎来了超过 26,020 名首次参赛的选手。参赛需求旺盛，许多比赛很快报满，最快的一场仅用了 33 秒！一年中不断刷新纪录，也让比赛更加精彩：2022 年共诞生了 3,049 项国家纪录、216 项洲际纪录和 46 项世界纪录。我们还迎来了来自世界各地的七个新地区组织，这将帮助相关地区今后更好地筹办比赛。

感谢主办团队的细致筹备，今年的洲际锦标赛系列成功举办了六场比赛！这些赛事也离不开 RUBIK'S CUBE® 团队的帮助与赞助。希望大家有机会亲临现场，或通过直播观看精彩比赛！

在协会工作方面，许多志愿者主动担任工作人员和代表，大大改善了协会的运作。每一次岗位招募，我们都收到了大量此前未在 WCA 任职者的申请，大多数团队因此明显壮大。全年共新增 53 名委员会和团队成员，以及三名委员会和团队负责人。董事会也迎来了变动：Blake Thompson 和 Somya Srivastava 新任董事，Callum Goodyear 获得连任。代表任命和晋升同样可喜：两名高级代表、18 名代表、93 名初级代表和 132 名实习代表。正是这些志愿者让我们的工作得以开展。无论为 WCA 投入多少时间，每一位志愿者都值得我们衷心感谢！

在新成员的帮助下，各委员会和团队在 2022 年完成了许多工作！WCA 宣传团队在社交媒体发布了超过 85 条内容；WCA 咨询委员会管理了 WCA 论坛上超过 4,600 条帖子和 340 个主题；WCA 市场团队的 WCA 周边商品累计获得超过 13,000 次浏览；WCA 软件团队合并了 171 个 Pull Request，完成了 103 次翻译更新。尽管比赛数量增加，WCA 比赛公告团队仍大幅缩短了审批时间，平均降至 34.9 小时。WCA 成绩团队平均用 8.49 小时公布比赛成绩，新成员的加入也让这一效率显著提高。WCA 市场团队还处理了主办团队购买计时器和显示屏的需求，共完成 58 笔器材订单，远多于往年。WCA 规则委员会在 6 月发布了新版规则；WCA 执行助理团队则全年跟进协会内部的组织变动和公告，这也是一项繁重的工作！此外，今年还成立了两个新团队：WCA 体育组织团队和 WCA 档案团队。欢迎他们加入，分别帮助我们实现未来愿景、保存历史记录。WCA 纪律委员会、道德委员会、财务委员会、质量保证委员会及董事会每天为协会提供的重要支持，同样不可或缺。

迈入 2023 年，我们仍在寻找让协会做得更好的办法，也希望通过社区问卷听到每一位成员对既往经历的反馈。请记得在 1 月 15 日前填写问卷！我们期待今年在韩国首尔举行的又一届精彩世锦赛，也希望大家能到场参赛或在家观看。祝大家新的一年在魔方比赛和生活中都收获快乐与成功。感谢各位对 WCA 的支持，没有社区就没有这一切。祝大家 2023 年快乐！
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

Another year has passed and we are very grateful for the enthusiasm of our community throughout 2022! After two years of limited competitions, this year brought a resurgence of cubing in many areas of the world, leading to 1,069 competitions held across 86 countries. Over 26,020 new competitors competed at those events and the competitions continued to fill up quickly due to the demand, the fastest being filled in just 33 seconds! Competitions became even more exciting due to the records that were broken throughout the year with a total of 3,049 National Records, 216 Continental Records, and 46 World Records being set in 2022. We also welcomed seven new Regional Organizations from around the world which will improve the planning of competitions in those areas going forward.

We are thankful for the careful planning of the organizers for our Continental Championships series that happened this year where we had six successful competitions! The organization of these events would not have been possible without the help of the RUBIK'S CUBE® team and their sponsorship of the competitions as well. We hope you were able to attend an event or watch streams of the action live!

On the administrative side, an astounding number of volunteers stepped up to give their time to the WCA through Staff and Delegate positions which greatly improved the functions of our organization. For every call for applicants that we made for any position, we received incredible numbers of applications from people who had never held a position in the WCA before and we were able to grow most of our teams in a significant way. Overall, we welcomed 53 new Committee/Team members and three Committee/Team leaders. We also saw changes in the Board of Directors this year with the addition of two new Board members, Blake Thompson and Somya Srivastava and the re-election of Callum Goodyear. We also had fantastic numbers of Delegate promotions with the promotions of two Senior Delegates, 18 Delegates, 93 Junior Delegates, and 132 Trainee Delegates. All of these volunteers make our work possible and we cannot thank anyone who volunteers any amount of their time to the WCA enough for their contributions!

With the additional help from new members, our Committees and Teams accomplished so much in 2022! The WCA Communication Team posted over 85 times on social media, the WCA Advisory Committee oversaw over 4,600 posts and 340 topics on the WCA Forum, the WCA Marketing Team had over 13,000 views across the WCA merchandise, and the WCA Software Team had 171 merged Pull Requests and 103 translation updates. Despite the increase of competitions, the WCA Competition Announcement Team vastly decreased the time it took for them to approve competitions, dropping the average time to 34.9 hours, and the WCA Results Team posted competitions results in 8.49 hours on average, also an incredible improvement with the addition of new team members. The WCA Marketing Team also kept up with the purchasing of timer and display system requests for competition organizational teams by fulfilling 58 gear orders, which was substantially more than in previous years. The WCA Regulations Committee released updated Regulations in June and the WCA Executive Assistants Team kept track of all of the organizational changes and announcements internally throughout the year, which was a lot to manage! On top of it all, there was also an addition of two new Teams this year, the WCA Sports Organization Team and the WCA Archive Team which we are happy to welcome to the organization and will respectively help fulfill our vision for the future and keep a record of our past. Just as important is the work of the WCA Disciplinary Committee, the WCA Ethics Committee, the WCA Financial Committee, the WCA Quality Assurance Committee, and the WCA Board who support the WCA immensely everyday.

Going into 2023, we are still trying to find ways to make our organization the best it can be and we want to hear from everyone in the community about their experience so far through our Community Survey. Make sure you fill that out by January 15th! We anticipate another thrilling World Championship in Seoul, Republic of Korea this year that we hope to see you attend or watch from home. May the new year bring everyone joy and success at cubing competitions and beyond. Thank you all for your incredible support of the WCA, we could not do this without our community. Have a happy 2023!

title.zh: WDC 简报：2022 年 12 月

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

2022 年即将结束，希望大家这一年顺利，来年有更多魔方活动、纪录与乐趣！

WDC 分享过去三个月的工作。首先，完成了以下可能令人关注的调查：

  1. 一名被禁赛选手新建账号报名。代表提交成绩时发现，其成绩已删除。试图规避 WDC 决定这一行为，已计入最终禁赛期限的考量。
  2. 巧合的是，同一周末不同国家发生两起几乎相同的盲拧作弊案。看到证据后，两名选手立即承认并道歉，相关成绩被取消。鉴于年龄较小、立即承认，两案均以警告结案。我们相信其已理解错误，无需禁赛。
  3. 近月魔方偷窃案件增加，即将结束两项相关调查。提醒选手看管随身物品，不要在比赛中让魔方无人照看。

你可能已注意到委员会新成员。过去三个月，高级成员审阅 29 人申请，多数都有潜力成为优秀成员；16 人获选面试，最终 8 人加入。

新成员充满热情和活力，已开展一些调查。他们将帮助 WDC 更好地确保规则被遵守、比赛对所有人安全。

最后提醒充分理解规则和流程，有问题时询问代表；若认为成绩受到损害或看到可疑行为，请立即联系最近的代表报告。

如有问题，可发邮件或在论坛纪律板块提问。

Sebastiano Tronto WDC 负责人，代表纪律委员会
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

The end of 2022 is approaching. We hope that this was a successful year for you, and hope that the upcoming year will be full of even more cubing, records, and fun!

The WDC would like to share with you some insight on the work we have done in the last three months. Firstly, we have concluded a few investigations that could be of interest for you:

  1. A competitor signed up with a new account and registered for a competition despite being banned. This was caught by the Delegates when submitting the results of the competition, and the results of the competitor were removed. This attempt to circumvent a WDC decision has been taken into account to determine the final duration of the ban.
  2. As an unusual coincidence, we had two nearly identical cases of cheating in a blindfolded event on the same weekend, but in two different countries. When confronted with the evidence, the competitors immediately owned up to their mistakes and apologized. The affected results have been disqualified. Given the relatively young age of these competitors, and the fact that they immediately confessed, we concluded both cases with a warning. We believe that they understood their mistake and that bans were not necessary in these cases.
  3. In the past few months there has also been an increase in cases of cube stealing, and we are about to close two investigations related to this. We take this chance to remind all competitors to keep an eye on their belongings at all times and not to leave their puzzles unattended at competitions.

On a different note, you may have noticed that some new members have joined our committee. Indeed, during the past three months the senior members have gone through the applications of 29 candidates, most of whom were potentially excellent WDC members. Of these, 16 candidates were selected for an interview, and finally 8 of the interviewed candidates have been selected to join the Disciplinary Committee.

The new members have taken up their role with great enthusiasm and energy, and have already carried out a few investigations. With their help, the WDC will be better equipped to make sure that the WCA Regulations are followed, and that competitions remain a safe environment for everyone.

To conclude this Digest, we would like to remind everyone to make sure they fully understand the WCA Regulations and competition procedures. If you have any questions, or are unsure about how to do something, please do not hesitate to ask the Delegate(s) of the competition. In addition, if you ever think the competition results are being compromised in any way, or if you see suspicious behavior, please find the nearest Delegate immediately and report the incident.

Do you have questions for the WDC? Feel free to send us an email, or ask your question in the Disciplinary section of the WCA forum.

Sebastiano Tronto
WDC Leader
On behalf of the Disciplinary Committee

title.zh: 2022 年 WCA 社区问卷

html.zh:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

2022 年 WCA 社区问卷现已开放！

这份问卷让社区成员可以就不同事项提出反馈，帮助我们确定今后需要改进的方向。

每位用户都有自己的专属问卷链接。登录后，可在 WCA 官网首页找到该链接。问卷匿名填写，即使尚未参加过比赛，也欢迎参与。请不要将自己的链接分享给任何人！通过同一链接提交的所有答卷，以及通过无效链接提交的答卷，均会被删除！

请在 2023 年 1 月 15 日 23:59 UTC 前提交答卷。

如有疑问或遇到技术问题，请通过 advisory@worldcubeassociation.org 联系 WCA 咨询理事会。
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

We are glad to announce the WCA Community Survey 2022!

This survey is an instance for the community to provide feedback on different matters. Your feedback is important for us to define the different areas to develop.

Each user has their own unique link to the survey, you can find your link on the main WCA website page here (you have to be logged in to get the link). The survey is anonymous. You are welcome to participate even if you have not attended a competition yet. Please do not share your link with anyone! All the responses submitted using the same links, as well as the responses submitted via invalid links, will be deleted!

You are welcome to submit your response until January 15th 2023 23:59 UTC.

If you have any questions or technical issues, do not hesitate to contact the WCA Advisory Council at advisory@worldcubeassociation.org.

title.zh: WCA 规则委员会负责人任命公告（2022 年 12 月）

html.zh:
我们很高兴地宣布，Antonio Kam 已成为 WCA 规则委员会（WRC）的新任负责人。Antonio 此前已是 WRC 成员。

依照 WCA 委员会与团队动议第 4 节，WCA 董事会选定 Antonio，并经现任委员会负责人和高级代表投票批准。

感谢 Iván Brigidano Pérez 为 WRC 所做的工作，也祝 Antonio Kam 在新的岗位上工作顺利。

本次共有两位申请人，包括 Antonio。有兴趣的成员可在此处查看两人的申请材料。

另一位申请人为：

  • Samuel Baird
html.en:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Committee Leader. Antonio Kam is the new Leader of the WCA Regulations Committee (WRC). Antonio was already working as a member of the WRC.

Antonio was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote among the current Committee Leaders and Senior Delegates, following Section 4 of our Motion about WCA Committees and Teams.

We thank Iván Brigidano Pérez for the work he has done for the WRC, and wish Antonio Kam best of luck in fulfilling his new duties.

Antonio was among two applicants we had and both candidacy documents can be found here if you are interested in viewing them.

Other candidates who applied:

  • Samuel Baird

title.zh: WCA 体育组织团队招募成员（2022 年 11 月）
title.en: Call for Applicants - WCA Sports Organization Team (WSOT) Members (November 2022)

html.zh:
新成立的 WCA 体育组织团队（WSOT）正在招募成员！

WSOT 的目标是推动 WCA 在各国及全球范围内获得更多体育组织认可。在国家层面，团队将与地区组织紧密合作；在全球层面，则与 WCA 董事会及相关团队、委员会共同推进。加入 WSOT，你将有机会参与 WCA 运作方式的改变！

WSOT 的正式权利与职责见 WCA 10.2022.13 号议案。

我们希望申请人具备：

  • 积极主动、注重细节，善于解决问题。
  • 能细致审阅和撰写篇幅较长、内容复杂的文档。
  • 热爱速拧，希望看到它在世界体育舞台上取得成绩。
  • 较熟悉 WCA 的政策、章程和竞赛规则。
  • （加分项）以运动员或工作人员身份参与高水平体育赛事的经历。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，包含：

  • 简短的个人介绍。
  • 为 WCA 所做工作的概述。
  • 具体说明自己如何满足申请条件及上述要求。
  • （选填）其他你认为与岗位有关的素质和资历。

申请从即日起开放，请于 2022 年 12 月 20 日 23:59 UTC 前将材料发送给 Ethan Pride（epride@worldcubeassociation.org）。如有疑问，欢迎在申请截止前联系！
html.en:
The new WCA Sports Organization Team (WSOT) is seeking members!

The WSOT is a newly created team with the goal of seeking further recognition of the WCA as a sporting organization both nationally and globally. The WSOT will be working closely with regional organizations on national recognition and the WCA Board/relevant teams and committees on global recognition. The WSOT is a great chance to be a part of change in how the organization operates!

The official rights and duties of the WSOT are documented in WCA Motion 10.2022.13.

The expected qualities of applicants include:

  • Proactive personality, sense of detail, and solution-oriented thinking.
  • Eye for detail in reviewing and writing lengthy complicated documents
  • A passion for speedcubing with a desire to see it's success on the world sporting stage
  • Sufficient familiarity with the WCA Policies, Bylaws and Regulations.
  • (Desirable) Involvement in high level sports as a participant or official

Candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

  • A brief personal introduction.
  • A summary of activities done for the WCA
  • A concrete overview on how you fulfil the requirements, and the expected qualities.
  • (Optional) Qualities and qualifications you find relevant that are not listed above.

The application period is open for applicants to submit their application document from now until December 20th 2022 23:59 UTC to Ethan Pride (epride@worldcubeassociation.org). Any applicants with questions are encouraged to reach out before the end of the application deadline!

title.zh: WCA 论坛精选（2022 年 11 月）

html.zh:
以下是 2022 年下半年 WCA 论坛上值得关注的几个话题。

WCA 竞赛规则简明版

该帖建议为整套规则制作简明版，让新选手和年纪较小的选手更容易了解比赛要求，提高大家对规则的熟悉程度。WCA 的教学资源就是用浅显方式说明规则的一个例子。

鼓励举办系列赛

系列赛可以缓解参赛需求过旺的问题。该帖讨论如何在魔友密集的地区举办系列赛，而不是继续增加大型比赛，以满足当地魔友的参赛需求。

WCA 非官方语言版块公告

论坛新增了阿拉伯语、德语、俄语、西班牙语和瑞典语五个语言子版块，希望让英语非母语的成员更容易参与论坛，分享反馈和想法。

允许选手选择不公开报名信息

该帖建议修改报名流程，不再强制公开已报名选手的姓名，而是显示名额和报名状态，让选手自行选择是否展示姓名。

用 3D 打印 Square-1 魔方罩防止错位

该帖介绍了一种 3D 打印的 Square-1 魔方罩，可防止打乱后的魔方在送往还原桌途中错位。这是一种方便的办法，已有部分主办方采用，以减少比赛中可能出现的争议和困惑。

如有问题、意见或反馈，欢迎发送邮件至 advisory@worldcubeassociation.org。

感谢大家参与论坛！
html.en:
Here are some notable threads on the WCA Forum in the second half of 2022.

Summarized Version of the WCA Regulations This thread proposes a summarized version of the entire regulations to make it easy for newer and/or young competitors to stay informed at competitions and to increase literacy with the regulations. The education resources on the WCA is one example of conveying regulations in an easy way.

Incentives for organizing series competitions Series competitions are a solution to excessive competition demand. This thread goes into finding suggestions and ideas of having series competitions in dense cubing areas as opposed to more big competitions to cater to the local cubing community.

Unofficial WCA Languages announcement There are new subcategories for 5 languages, which are Arabic, German, Russian, Spanish and Swedish. The aim of this is for non-native English speakers to get introduced to the forums and pitch their feedback and ideas.

Allow competitors to opt-out of having their competition registration made public This thread proposes a change to the registration process by not publicly showing registered competitors name.The goal of this change is to display competitors limits/status and their name optionally shown.

3D Printed Square-1 Cover to prevent misalignments This thread shows a solution of using 3D Printed Square-1 Cover to prevent misalignments after scrambling while it is brought to the solving station. It is a convenient solution and some organizers have started using it to save potential confusion at competitions.

If you have any questions, comments, or feedback feel free to send an email to advisory@worldcubeassociation.org.

Thanks for being a part of the Forum!

title.zh: WCA 体育组织团队负责人任命公告（2022 年 11 月）

html.zh:
我们很高兴地宣布，Ethan Pride 将担任 WCA 体育组织团队（WSOT）的新负责人。

按照关于 WCA 委员会和团队的议案第 4 节，WCA 董事会选定 Ethan，并经现任委员会负责人和高级代表投票批准。

WSOT 是新成立的团队，祝 Ethan Pride 履新顺利。

如有兴趣，可在此处查看 Ethan 的申请材料。
html.en:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Team Leader. Ethan Pride will become the new Leader of the WCA Sports Organization Team (WSOT).

Ethan was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote among the current Committee Leaders and Senior Delegates, following Section 4 of our Motion about WCA Committees and Teams.

WSOT is a new team and we wish Ethan Pride best of luck in fulfilling his new duties.

Ethan’s candidacy document can be found here if you are interested in viewing it.

title.zh: WCA 道德委员会负责人任命公告（2022 年 10 月）

html.zh:
我们很高兴地宣布，Enzo Mattos 将担任 WCA 道德委员会（WEC）的新负责人。Enzo 此前已是 WEC 成员。

按照关于 WCA 委员会和团队的议案第 4 节，WCA 董事会选定 Enzo，并经现任委员会负责人和高级代表投票批准。

感谢 Blake Thompson 为 WEC 所做的工作，祝 Enzo 履新顺利。

本次共有两位申请人，Enzo 是其中之一。如有兴趣，可在此处查看他的申请材料。

董事会还收到了以下申请人的材料：

感谢 Shamika 参与申请。
html.en:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Committee Leader. Enzo Mattos will become the new Leader of the WCA Ethics Committee (WEC). Enzo was already working as a member of the WEC.

Enzo was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote among the current Committee Leaders and Senior Delegates, following Section 4 of our Motion about WCA Committees and Teams.

We thank Blake Thompson for the work he has done for the WEC, and wish Enzo the best of luck in fulfilling his new duties.

Enzo was among two applicants we had and his candidacy document can be found here if you are interested in viewing it.

The Board received applications from the following applicants:

  • Shamika Dalvi

We would like to thank Shamika for applying.

title.zh: WCA 档案团队成员招募（2022 年 10 月）

html.zh:
WCA 档案团队（WAT）正在招募积极、可靠的新成员！所有人均可申请，无须已在 WCA 任职。

你是否对魔方圈过去的故事感兴趣，也愿意把它们讲给别人？你是否喜欢了解魔方史上的纪录、大型锦标赛和重要人物？你是否习惯收藏以往 WCA 比赛的物品？你是否喜欢写速拧相关的文章？如果是，你可能很适合加入 WAT！

WAT 的工作是什么？

  • 收集和整理与 WCA 过去、现在和未来有关的信息及媒体资料。
  • 撰写、制作和整理文字及视觉内容，用连贯的叙述介绍纪录页面、大型锦标赛及 WCA 的整体历史。
  • 与其他团队合作制作 WCA 宣传资料。
  • 在条件允许时报道 WCA 大型锦标赛。
  • 维护 WCA 的历史时间线，确保各项内容及时更新。

WCA 决议中对 WAT 正式权利和职责的规定见此处。

我们希望成员具备：

  • 良好的英语写作能力。
  • 每周能投入 3–5 小时。
  • 良好的人际交往与沟通能力。
  • 熟悉 WCA 的活动。

以下能力有帮助，但不是硬性要求：

  • 流利使用另一种或多种语言。
  • 有任何形式的新闻报道或写作经验。
  • 良好的沟通和采访能力。
  • 熟悉 Google G-Suite，并有使用经验。

如有意加入 WCA 档案团队，请将申请发送给 WAT 负责人 William Gan（wgan@worldcubeassociation.org）。如有疑问，欢迎在提交申请前先联系我们。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，包含：

  • 简短的自我介绍。
  • 参与 WCA 和魔方社区的经历总结。
  • 申请加入 WAT 的原因。
  • 其他与 WAT 工作相关的经验或个人技能。

申请人将在 24 小时内收到确认收件的回复。申请截止时间为 2022 年 11 月 19 日 23:59 UTC。现任 WAT 成员将审核和讨论申请，并在截止后约 2–3 周作出决定。

感谢你有意加入 WAT，期待收到你的申请！
html.en:
The WCA Archive Team (WAT) is seeking motivated and trustworthy members! This call for applicants is open to everyone; it's not a requirement to hold a current position in the WCA to be considered.

Are you interested in cubing stories of the past and retelling them? Do you enjoy learning about records, major championships and key figures in cubing history? Do you have a habit of collecting objects from past WCA competitions? Do you enjoy writing about speedcubing? If yes, then you may be a great fit for the WAT!

What does the WAT do?

  • Gather and organize information and media relevant to the WCA's past, present and future.
  • Create and compile written/visual content to provide a narrative structure to the Records page, major championships and the WCA in general.
  • Collaborate with other teams in producing WCA promotional material.
  • Provide coverage of major WCA championships where feasible.
  • Keep track of the WCA's historical timeline and ensure all content is up-to-date.

The official rights and duties of the WAT as described in the Motions of the WCA can be found here.

Members are expected to have:

  • Good written English.
  • Time commitment of 3-5 hours per week.
  • Interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Familiarity with WCA activities.

Other qualities which are useful to have but are not required include:

  • Fluency in another language(s).
  • Experience in any form of journalism or writing.
  • Good communication and interviewing skills.
  • Experience and familiarity with Google G-Suite.

If you are interested in joining the WCA Archive Team, please send an application to WAT Leader, William Gan (wgan@worldcubeassociation.org). If you have any questions, please do not hesitate in reaching out first before sending your application.

The application document must be in PDF format, and should include:

  • A brief personal introduction
  • A summary of your involvement with the WCA and cubing community
  • Your motivation to join the WAT
  • Any additional experience or personal skills relevant to the WAT

Applicants can expect a reply to confirm the receipt of their application within 24 hours. The application deadline is November 19th 2022 23:59 UTC. Applications will be reviewed and discussed among the current WAT members and a decision will be made about 2-3 weeks after the deadline.

Thank you for your interest in joining the WAT, we look forward to receiving your applications!

title.zh: WCA 沟通团队招募成员（2022 年 10 月）
title.en: Call for Applicants - WCA Communication Team (WCT) Members (October 2022)

html.zh:
WCA 沟通团队（WCT）正在招募成员，协助管理和制作 WCA 社交媒体内容，并参与其他项目！

所有 WCA 成员均可申请，无需目前在 WCA 任职。

WCT 负责什么？

  • 回复通过邮件及 WCA 网站联系页面收到的日常咨询。
  • 管理 WCA 官方社交媒体，定期发布有吸引力的内容。
  • 与 WCA 其他负责人合作，改进网站及面向社区的沟通。

WCT 的正式权利与职责见 10.2021.1 号议案：沟通团队。

工作安排

  • 我们争取在 24 小时内回复所有邮件和私信。增加成员有助于 WCT 更及时地回应。
  • 社交媒体内容至少提前 2 天安排，在成员有空时发布。
  • 关于 WCT 其他项目的内部邮件须在 48 小时内回复；这些项目还可能带来其他工作，所需时间各不相同。
  • 每周预计投入 2–5 小时。

我们希望你具备

  • 社交媒体知识：熟悉多种平台及其基本功能。即使你自己没有使用过，也将需要代表 WCA 发帖，因此应了解各平台适合什么内容。
  • 流利的英语：我们在大多数社交平台上用英语发帖，也用英语回复大部分邮件。不过，我们会收到多种语言的来信，若能用发件人的母语回复当然更好。因此，也欢迎除英语外还精通其他语言的申请人。
  • 沟通能力：能够用专业、简洁的邮件回答选手问题，熟悉并准确介绍 WCA 为选手提供的资源。你也将负责撰写得体、能够传达 WCA 宗旨的社交媒体内容。
  • 耐心：反复回答同样的问题时仍保持专业并不容易，却是日常工作的一部分。邮件和社交媒体互动都应友善。
  • 创意：我们一直需要新的社交媒体系列选题，以及拓展其他平台的不同做法。希望你思考这些问题，并在有想法时提出建议。

申请方式

请从即日起至 2022 年 11 月 2 日星期三 23:59 UTC，将 PDF 格式的申请材料发送至 rreis@worldcubeassociation.org。

申请请包含：

  • 简短的个人介绍。
  • 你参与 WCA 事务的经历。
  • 申请加入 WCT 的动机。
  • 除英语外熟练掌握的语言。
  • 对各社交媒体平台的熟悉程度，以及一条可用于 WCA 发帖的创意。
html.en:
The WCA Communication Team (WCT) is seeking members to help with managing and creating WCA social media posts and other projects!

The application is open to all WCA members. You do not have to hold a current position to be considered.

What does the WCT do?

  • Answers daily inquiries to the WCA through emails and the contact page on the WCA website.
  • Manages official WCA social media platforms through frequent and engaging posts
  • Works with other WCA leaders to improve the WCA website and communications to the community

The official rights and duties of the WCT are documented in Motion 10.2021.1 - Communication Team.

Workflow Outline

  • We try to reply to all emails and DMs within a 24 hour period and having more members gives the WCT more opportunities to be reactive.
  • Social media posts are planned at least 2 days in advance and are posted when members are available.
  • Internal emails regarding other WCT projects are answered within 48 hours and other work may come from those projects that take various amounts of time.
  • Time commitment per week is between 2-5 hours.

Characteristics we are looking for

  • Social media knowledge: You should be familiar with many social media platforms and their basic functions. While you may not have used them personally, you will have to post to them as the WCA and should know what type of content goes on each.
  • Fluent English: Our posts on most social media platforms are in English and we answer most emails in English. We do, however, receive emails in many different languages and having people responding in the sender’s native language is always appreciated. For this, we do welcome those that are fluent in other languages alongside English.
  • Communication skills: You should be able to write a professional, concise email to answer competitor questions and to convey a thorough knowledge of the WCA resources for competitors. You will be responsible for writing social media posts that are appropriate and convey the mission of the WCA.
  • Patience: Always maintaining professionalism when answering the same question many times is hard, but necessary for our day-to-day communications. You should keep friendly communications within our email and social media interactions.
  • Creativity: We always need ideas of new social media series or unique ways to expand to other platforms. You will be required to think about this and suggest ideas when you can.

Applications

Please send the application in PDF format to rreis@worldcubeassociation.org from now until Wednesday, November 2, 2022, 23:59 UTC to be considered.

To apply, please include:

  • A brief personal introduction
  • Your involvement with the WCA
  • Your motivation for applying to the WCT
  • Fluency in other languages than English
  • Your familiarity with social media platforms and an idea of a potential WCA post

title.zh: 《WCA 会费制度政策》更新（2022 年 10 月）
title.en: Updates to the WCA Dues System Policy (October 2022)

html.zh:
WCA 财务委员会（WFC）已更新《WCA 会费制度政策》，适用于 2022 年 10 月 25 日及之后公布的全部比赛。本次调整提高了各场 WCA 比赛按每位选手报名费计算的会费比例，也提高了第 4、5 档国家每位选手的会费基准金额。

这一调整将为 WCA 的发展提供更多资金，并支持启动目前尚在筹备中的项目。短期内，资金将用于改善 WCA 软件。

完整改动列表见 GitHub 上的这份拉取请求和这份拉取请求。

更新后的会费政策全文见此处。

如有疑问，请联系 WFC（finance@worldcubeassociation.org）。
html.en:
The WCA Financial Committee (WFC) has issued an update to the WCA Dues System Policy that will be applicable to all competitions announced on and after October 25, 2022. The changes include an increase in the percentage of the registration fee per competitor that is owed as a due from each WCA competition and increases the base level of dues per competitor for countries that fall in Bands 4 and 5.

This change will provide significant funding for the growth of the WCA, and to start working on projects that are currently in the planning stages. For the short term, funding will be going towards improvements to WCA Software.

A full list of changes can be found on the GitHub pull request here and here.

The full updated Dues document can be found here.

Please contact the WFC (finance@worldcubeassociation.org) with any questions.

title.zh: WCA 规则委员会招募负责人（2022 年 10 月）

html.zh:
Iván Brigidano Pérez 的 WCA 规则委员会（WRC）负责人任期即将结束，委员会将任命新负责人。感谢 Iván 在带领委员会期间所做的工作。

申请者应能完成 24 个月的任期，并平均每周投入至少 5 小时参与委员会工作。我们希望申请者具备：

  • 较强的领导能力。
  • 细心的工作态度。
  • 深入掌握规则。
  • 分析思考能力。
  • 出色的沟通能力。

申请材料提交时间为即日起至 2022 年 10 月 23 日 23:59 UTC。有意申请者可私下将材料发送至 WCA 董事会（board@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：

  • 简短的自我介绍。
  • 为 WCA 所做工作的概述。
  • 担任 WRC 负责人的工作设想。

此外，请提供一份可在申请截止后公开的申请材料副本。

WRC 的权利与职责见 WCA 动议 10.2021.9。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将投票选定人选，并依据 WCA 动议 10.2022.0 第 4 节，由高级代表及现任委员会、团队负责人投票确认后，公布新负责人。

感谢大家的申请和支持。
html.en:
There will be an appointment of a new WCA Regulations Leader, as Iván Brigidano Pérez’s term is ending as the Leader of the WCA Regulations Committee. We would like to thank Iván for the work he has done leading the committee.

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 5 hours per week on average to work for the committee. The qualities expected of candidates are:

  • Strong leadership skills
  • Attention to detail
  • Expert knowledge of Regulations
  • Analytical thinking
  • Excellent communication skills

The application period for candidates to submit their candidacy documents is from now until October 23rd, 2022, 23:59 UTC. Interested candidates can send the application privately to the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).

The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

  • Brief personal introduction.
  • Summary of activities done for the WCA.
  • Ambitions as the WRC Leader of the WCA.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WRC can be found in WCA Motion 10.2021.9.

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of WCA Motion 10.2022.0.

Thank you for your candidacies and support.

title.zh: 欧洲及非洲高级代表任命公告（2022 年 10 月）
title.en: Announcement of new Senior Delegate - Europe and Africa (October 2022)

html.zh:
我们很高兴地宣布，Simone Cantarelli 将出任欧洲地区的新任高级代表。董事会没有收到非洲高级代表职位的申请，因此现阶段将由董事会承担这一职责。

感谢 Laura Ohrndorf 担任欧洲高级代表期间的工作，也感谢 Brent Boswell 担任非洲高级代表期间的工作。

WCA 董事会依照《关于高级代表的议案》第 4 节，经董事投票选出 Simone。

祝 Simone Cantarelli 在新的岗位上一切顺利。他的高级代表任期自 2022 年 10 月 1 日开始。

我们共收到两份申请，Simone 是其中一位申请人。如有兴趣，两份申请材料均可在这里查看。

除 Simone 外，欧洲职位的另一位申请人是：

  • Sam Spendla
html.en:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Senior Delegate for Europe - Simone Cantarelli. The Board did not receive any applications for the Senior Delegate for Africa, and as such the Board will take on that role at this time.

We would like to thank Laura Ohrndorf for her service as Senior Delegate for Europe, and Brent Boswell for his service as Senior Delegate for Africa.

Simone was selected by the WCA Board by voting among them, following Section 4 of our Motion about Senior Delegates.

We wish Simone Cantarelli the best of luck in fulfilling his new duties. His term as Senior Delegate began on October 1, 2022.

Simone was among two applicants we had and both candidacy documents can be found here if you are interested in viewing them.

Other than Simone, the following applicant for Europe was:

  • Sam Spendla

title.zh: 2024 年 WCA 洲际锦标赛承办申请（2022 年 10 月）

html.zh:
WCA 董事会现征集以下锦标赛的举办城市申请：

  • 2024 年 WCA 非洲锦标赛
  • 2024 年 WCA 亚洲锦标赛
  • 2024 年 WCA 大洋洲锦标赛
  • 2024 年 WCA 南美洲锦标赛

请与所在国家的代表讨论是否有意愿和能力承办。举办这一规模的比赛，需要在赛前和比赛期间投入大量时间与精力。请注意，洲际锦标赛的申请须获得 WCA 认可的地区组织支持。

如有意承办，请在 2022 年 11 月 30 日 23:59 UTC 前，将申请材料私下发送至 board@worldcubeassociation.org。

材料须以 PDF 格式提交两个版本：一份包含所有申请细节的完整版；另一份为公开版，如有敏感信息，应将其删除。

申请材料至少须包含以下信息：

  1. 计划何时举办 2024 年洲际锦标赛？
    1. 可选日期
    2. 比赛天数
    3. 与各国学校假期的重合情况
  2. 计划在本国何处举办 2024 年洲际锦标赛？
    1. 城市应对外国游客有吸引力，有观光机会
    2. 国际、国内及市内交通的便利程度
    3. 不同价位酒店、公寓的供应情况
    4. 场馆、面积及布置，包括舞台、观众区、练习桌和附属房间
    5. 网络、视频直播、灯光及音响等技术条件
    6. 可容纳的选手和观众人数
  3. 主办团队和工作人员如何组成？
    1. 核心团队成员
    2. 核心团队的经验
    3. 其他参与方
    4. 当地志愿者的数量和能力，建议约 20% 的选手参与工作人员工作
    5. 需要外国代表提供哪些支持
  4. 比赛的总体预算是多少？
    1. 支出：场馆、场馆服务、舞台、器材、装饰、网站、证件及挂绳和礼品包、奖品
    2. 收入：报名费、赞助、地方政府支持

此处有一份示例文档，列出大型比赛需要安排并纳入预算的部分事项，清单并非详尽无遗。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将与申请方面谈，征询其他 WCA 工作人员的意见，并投票决定各项 2024 年洲际锦标赛的举办地。如有董事参与某个申办团队，将由其他人员（例如高级代表或委员会、团队负责人）代替其参与遴选。

我们希望这场比赛能够进一步实践 WCA 大型赛事的理念，让协会的工作更加专业，为选手提供尽可能好的参赛体验，也向世界呈现尽可能精彩的比赛。

如果某项锦标赛未收到申办申请，将在 2023 年开放第二轮申请。

提前感谢大家的配合！
html.en:
The Board of Directors would like to receive applications for host cities for the following Championships:

  • WCA African Championship 2024
  • WCA Asian Championship 2024
  • WCA Oceanic Championship 2024
  • WCA South American Championship 2024

Please discuss with the Delegates in your country whether this is something you are willing and able to pursue. Bear in mind that organizing a competition of this size takes a significant amount of time and effort before and during the competition. Please note that applications for continental championships must be endorsed by a WCA Recognized Regional Organization.

If you are interested, send your application documents privately to board@worldcubeassociation.org before November 30th, 2022, 23:59 UTC.

Documents must be sent in PDF format in two versions: one full version with all the details for the application, and another version with sensitive details - if any - removed to make public.

Please include in your application documents at least the following information:

  1. When would you like to hold your Continental Championship 2024?
    1. Possible dates
    2. Number of days of the competition.
    3. Overlap with international holiday periods of schools.
  2. Where would you like to hold your Continental Championship 2024 in your country?
    1. City should be interesting to visit for foreigners with opportunities for sightseeing.
    2. Ease of international, national, and local travel.
    3. Availability of hotels/apartments with different price categories.
    4. Venue, venue size, and venue setup (stage, audience, tables to practice, side rooms).
    5. Technology available like internet, video streaming, lighting, sound equipment.
    6. Number of competitors and spectators that can be hosted.
  3. What would the organization team and staff look like?
    1. Core team members.
    2. Experience of the core team.
    3. Involvement of other parties.
    4. Quantity and quality of local volunteers (guideline is 20% of competitors should staff).
    5. Required support by foreign Delegates.
  4. What would be the overall budget for the competition?
    1. Cost (venue, venue services, stage, equipment, decorations, website, badges/lanyards/giftpacks, prizes).
    2. Income (registration fees, sponsoring, local government).

Here is an example document with a non-exhaustive list of topics that need to be arranged and budgeted for a large competition.

Once the application period is over, the WCA Board of Directors will interview applicants, consult other WCA Staff members, and vote in order to decide where each 2024 Continental Championship will take place. If any Director will be involved in a team that sends in an application, they will be replaced in the selection process by another person (for example a Senior Delegate or a Committee/Team Leader).

We are looking for a competition that can reinforce our concept of large WCA competitions, boosting the professionalization of our organization and being able to offer the competitors the best possible experience and the world the best possible show.

If no bids for a championship are received a secondary application period will be made available in 2023

Thank you for your cooperation in advance!

title.zh: WDC 简报：2022 年 9 月

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

经历数年疫情导致 WCA 活动稀少后，全球多数地区比赛终于逐步恢复！这令人振奋，希望情况持续改善，让各地有更多比赛和乐趣。

不幸的是，随比赛恢复，欺诈、作弊及其他不当行为也增加。纪律委员会决定就今年部分调查发布简短匿名报告，帮助大家了解幕后工作：

  1. 今年早些时候一场比赛，三名年轻选手无视代表禁止，进入场馆限制区域。在本应锁住的房间内，两人打开水龙头后未关闭便返回比赛。数日后才被发现，积水已严重损坏建筑。监控确认了三人身份。面对证据，他们承认，家长赔偿损失。鉴于行为及后果严重，三人均因进入限制区域被禁赛，其中造成水灾的两人期限更长。
  2. 一人用假名、假邮箱报名，并在备注中留下冒犯性言论。成绩团队 Sam Spendla 协助查明其为已注册选手，而且不是第一次。面对询问，其立即承认并道歉，获正式警告。使用 WCA 官方资源戏弄代表和主办方以自娱，并不可接受。
  3. 选手称其某次时间因把 1 看成 7 而在 WCA Live 录得更慢，并向当地社群分享编辑过的成绩单图片。详细调查认定首次录入正确，选手试图欺骗我们和代表，以得到更快时间，本案中也是国家纪录。因此给予禁赛。
  4. 一名选手报告遭受其所称的骚扰：另一选手通过 WCA 官方社交媒体的社群投稿分享了其个人信息。后者明确无悔意，承认故意拖延回复以免在国内重大比赛前被禁赛。调查还发现其针对举报者持续欺凌、骚扰和嘲弄，因此禁赛。我们对欺凌，以及故意造成他人精神或身体伤害的行为零容忍。
  5. 最后是一则积极消息：一名有过错的选手弥补了错误。2014 年，Carlos Miguel Pérez（2014）以出售魔方为由收取多名选手钱款，却不交货，原公开公告见此处。近 8 年后，Carlos 证明已联系被骗选手、退款或交付魔方。诈骗和盗窃案件通常永久禁赛，除非归还全部财物。因此本案解除其禁赛，他可再次参加 WCA 比赛。

最后提醒充分理解规则及流程，不清楚时询问代表。若认为成绩受到损害或看到可疑行为，请立即找最近的代表报告。

如有问题，可发邮件，或在论坛纪律板块提问。

Sebastiano Tronto WDC 负责人，代表纪律委员会
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

After a couple of years of little WCA activity due to the COVID-19 pandemic, we are finally seeing a gradual return of competitions in most regions around the world! This is exciting, and we hope that things continue to improve so that we can have more competitions and more fun all around the world.

Unfortunately, as competitions are returning, we have also seen an increase in the number of attempts of fraud, cheating and other kinds of misbehavior. The Disciplinary Committee has decided to publish a short and anonymized report for some of the cases that we have investigated this year. We hope that this can give you an insight into the work that the WDC carries out behind the scenes:

  1. At a competition earlier this year, three young competitors entered restricted areas of the building where the competition was hosted, despite being told not to by the delegates. Whilst in a room that was meant to be locked, two of them turned the taps on and left them on as they returned to the competition. This was not discovered until a few days later, when the water had already caused significant damage to the building. The competitors were caught and identified thanks to the surveillance cameras. When confronted with the evidence, they confessed, and their parents paid for the damage done to the building. Given the severity of these actions and their consequences, we gave all three competitors a ban for entering restricted areas, and the two of them responsible for the flooding received a longer ban.
  2. A person signed up for a competition with a fake name, a fake email address and left offensive remarks in the registration comments. With the help of Sam Spendla from the Results Team we were able to identify this person as a registered speedcuber, and we noticed that it was not the first time they did this. When we confronted this person they immediately confessed and apologized. We gave this competitor a formal warning. We would like to take this chance to remind everyone that using official WCA resources to make fun of delegates and organizers for your own amusement is not acceptable behavior.
  3. A competitor claimed that one of the times they obtained was faster than what was entered on WCA live, due to a 1 being mistaken for a 7. To support this claim, they shared an edited picture of the scorecard with the local community. After a detailed investigation we determined that the time had been entered correctly the first time, and that this competitor was trying to deceive us and the delegates in order to obtain a faster time, and in this case a national record result. The competitor was issued a ban.
  4. A competitor reported being the victim of what they described as harassment: some personal information was shared by another competitor as a community contribution via official WCA social media. The competitor made it clear that they had no remorse for their actions and admitted to delaying his response in order to avoid being banned before a major competition in their country. In our investigation we have also discovered a pattern of bullying, harassment and mockery against the competitor who reported the case to us. With all of this in mind, after our investigation we decided to issue a ban. We would like to take this chance to remind competitors that we have a zero tolerance stance on bullying and any actions that are taken in a deliberate effort to cause others emotional or physical harm.
  5. Ending with a positive note, we have a guilty competitor who redeemed himself. Back in 2014, Carlos Miguel Pérez (2014) defrauded multiple fellow speedcubers by promising to sell them cubes, taking their money and never delivering the cubes. You can read the original public announcement here. After almost 8 years Carlos was able to prove to us that he had contacted the defrauded competitors and returned their money or given them their cubes. As is standard in cases of fraud and theft, bans remain permanent unless the competitor responsible returns all stolen property and/or funds, so in this case we have lifted Carlos’ ban and he is once again able to compete in WCA competitions.

To conclude this Digest, we would like to remind everyone to make sure they fully understand the WCA Regulations and competition procedures. If you have any questions or are unsure about how to do something, please do not hesitate to ask the Delegate(s) of the competition. In addition, if you think the competition results are being compromised in any way or if you see suspicious behavior, find the nearest Delegate immediately and report the incident.

Do you have questions for the WDC? Feel free to send us an email, or ask your question in the Disciplinary section of the WCA forum.

Sebastiano Tronto
WDC Leader
On behalf of the Disciplinary Committee

title.zh: 招募 WCA 纪律委员会（WDC）成员（2022 年 9 月）
title.en: Call for Applicants - WCA Disciplinary Committee (WDC) Members (September 2022)

html.zh:
WCA 纪律委员会正在招募新成员！任何人都可申请，也鼓励目前不属于 WCA 工作人员的社群成员申请。

WDC 做什么？

主要工作是调查比赛中的纪律事件，例如作弊尝试或不当行为。必要时，我们可能发出警告或禁赛，也向 WCA 代表提供比赛现场处理特定情况的意见。

权利与职责详见动议 10.2022.3—纪律委员会、15.2022.1—暂停资格及其他处分及行为准则。纪律日志载有以往公开公告。欢迎在 WCA 论坛纪律板块提问。

要求

硬性要求仅有：能以书面英语沟通；熟悉 WCA 比赛环境，参加过几场比赛即可。其他重视的素质包括：能与队友讨论推理及想法；逻辑和分析能力；保密意识；沟通能力。精通一个或多个速拧项目、熟练掌握英语以外语言有帮助，但并非必需。

成员多样性将使委员会受益，因此尤其鼓励文化背景、国籍、年龄、性别与现有成员不同的社群成员申请。

申请

请于 2022 年 10 月 14 日星期五 23:59 UTC 前，将 PDF 申请发送至 stronto@worldcubeassociation.org，包括简短自我介绍、为 WCA 和魔方社群所做活动、相关个人技能、加入 WDC 的动机。

全部材料应在同一个 PDF 中。申请人预计将在 24 小时内收到确认收件回复。申请期结束后开始遴选，可能包括面试或其他评估。如有问题，可联系 WDC 负责人 stronto@worldcubeassociation.org。
html.en:
The WCA Disciplinary Committee (WDC) is looking for new members! Everyone can apply, and we encourage community members who are not part of the WCA staff to send their application.

What does the WDC do?

Most of our work consists of investigating disciplinary incidents at competitions, such as cheating attempts or inappropriate behavior. If the circumstances require it, we may issue warnings or bans. We also give feedback to WCA delegates on how to handle certain situations during WCA competitions.

If you are interested in the details of our rights and duties, check out the motions 10.2022.3 - Disciplinary Committee and 15.2022.1 - Suspensions and other Sanctions, as well as the Code of Conduct. The Disciplinary Log contains public announcements made by the WDC in the past. Feel free to ask questions about any of this in the Disciplinary section of the WCA forum.

Requirements

The only strict requirements for WDC members are:

  • Ability to communicate in English (written)
  • Familiarity with the WCA competition environment (having attend a few competitions is enough)

Other qualities we look for are:

  • Ability to discuss reasoning and ideas with team members
  • Logical and analytical reasoning
  • Confidentiality
  • Communication skills

The following qualities are useful, but not necessary:

  • Expertise in one or more speedcubing events
  • Fluency in a language other than English

The committee would greatly benefit from the diversity of their members. We therefore especially encourage applications from community members with a different cultural background, nationality, age and gender from the current members.

Applications

Applicants can send their application as a PDF document to stronto@worldcubeassociation.org before Friday, October 14, 2022, 23:59 UTC. The application document should contain:

  • A brief personal introduction
  • Summary of activities done for the WCA and for the cubing community
  • Overview of the personal skills relevant to the role
  • Motivation for applying to the WDC

Everything should be contained in a single PDF file. Applicants can expect a reply to confirm the receipt of the application within 24 hours. The selection process will start after the application period is over, and it might include an interview or other kinds of assessment.

If you have any questions feel free to contact the WDC leader at stronto@worldcubeassociation.org.

title.zh: 招募 WCA 财务委员会成员（2022 年 9 月）

html.zh:
WCA 财务委员会（WFC）计划招募几位新成员。所有人都可以申请，不要求申请者目前已在 WCA 任职。

WFC 负责什么？

  • 使用 Xero 处理日常记账，管理 WCA 的财务与现金流。
  • 制定 WCA 年度预算及财务预测，包括参赛人数的分析和预测。
  • 管理会费制度，包括开具账单及应收款管理。
  • 代表 WCA 完成税务和其他监管合规表格。
  • 依据《器材资助政策》和《差旅报销政策》审核资助申请。
  • 完成 WCA 董事会要求的，或议案规定的其他财务工作。

WFC 的正式权利与职责载于 WCA 议案 10.2021.6。

我们希望候选人具备以下条件：

  • 良好的数学或数据分析能力。
  • 良好的英语书面表达能力。
  • 每周可投入 2–5 小时。
  • 能及时查看和回复委员会邮件。

以下经验并非必需，但会对 WFC 的工作有所帮助：

  • 财务、税务或会计经验。
  • 使用电子表格的经验，并熟悉 Google G-Suite。
  • 非营利组织或企业财务方面的知识和经验。
  • 了解美国税务及美国国税局（IRS）相关事务。

申请材料须包含：

  • 简短的申请信和个人介绍，包括申请加入 WFC 的原因。
  • 一份 WCA 经历简历，列出截至目前参与魔方社区的情况。
  • 职业简历，尤其是数学、会计或财务相关经历。

我们会及时回复，确认材料是否完整，也可能邀请你与 WFC 负责人面试。

请于 2022 年 10 月 11 日星期二 23:59 UTC 前，将申请提交给 WCA 财务主管兼财务委员会负责人 James Molloy（jmolloy@worldcubeassociation.org）。申请将由 WFC 负责人及高级成员审核。如有疑问，欢迎在提交申请前先联系我们。

感谢你愿意加入 WFC，期待收到你的申请！
html.en:
The WCA Financial Committee (WFC) is looking for a few new members to add to its team. The applications are open to everyone; it is not a requirement to hold a current position in the WCA to be considered.

What does the WFC do?

  • Day-to-day bookkeeping using Xero, managing the finances and cash flow of the WCA.
  • Determine the annual budget for the WCA and forecasting, including analysis and projections of competitor counts.
  • Manage the Dues system including invoicing and credit control.
  • Complete tax and other regulatory compliance forms on behalf of the WCA.
  • Review applications for funding in accordance with the Equipment Funding and Travel Reimbursement policies.
  • Other financial tasks requested by the WCA Board or in accordance with our Motions.

The official rights and duties of the WFC are documented in WCA Motion 10.2021.6.

The qualities and requirements expected of candidates are:

  • Good math or data analytics skills.
  • Good written English.
  • Time commitment of 2-5 hours per week.
  • Prompt review and response to committee emails.

The following are not required, but it would be useful for new WFC members to have experience with any of the following:

  • Experience in finance, tax, or accounting.
  • Experience using spreadsheets and familiarity with Google G-Suite.
  • Knowledge and experience in non-profit or corporate finances.
  • US tax and IRS knowledge.

Candidacy documents must include:

  • A brief cover letter and personal introduction, including your motivation for applying to the WFC.
  • A WCA resume listing your involvement with the cubing community so far.
  • Your professional resume (especially if math/accounting/finance related).

You can expect an immediate reply to confirm whether your application is complete, and may receive a request for an interview with the WFC Leader.

Please submit your application by Tuesday, 11 October, 2022 at 23:59 UTC to the WCA Treasurer and Leader of the WCA Financial Committee, James Molloy (jmolloy@worldcubeassociation.org). Applications will be reviewed by the WFC Leader and Senior Members. If you have any questions, please do not hesitate in reaching out first before sending your application.

Thank you for your interest in joining the WFC, and we look forward to receiving your applications!

title.zh: WCA 董事会成员变动（2022 年 9 月）
title.en: Changes in the Board of Directors (September 2022)

html.zh:
Callum Goodyear 和 Saransh Grover 的董事任期即将结束，WCA 于 2022 年 8 月 31 日举行了不记名选举，选出新一届成员。此次选举依据动议 5.2021.1——董事选举进行。

我们很高兴地宣布，选举顺利完成，Callum 成功连任 WCA 董事！祝他履职顺利。感谢 Calvin 提交申请，以及他对 WCA 的持续投入。也感谢 Saransh 在董事任期内所做的工作。

html.en:

The Board received applications from:

Callum Goodyear Calvin Nielson

We are happy to announce that the election was successful and that Callum was elected to renew his term on the WCA Board of Directors! We wish him the best of luck with his duties! We thank Calvin for his application and his continued commitment to the WCA. We would also like to thank Saransh for his work on the WCA Board during his term.

Applications from both candidates can be viewed here.

title.zh: WCA 成绩团队成员招募（2022 年 8 月）
title.en: Call for Applicants - WCA Results Team (WRT) Members (August 2022)

html.zh:
WCA 成绩团队（WRT）正在招募认真投入、值得信赖的新成员！

你喜欢数字吗？你是否总能很快发现餐厅菜单上别人没注意到的错字或前后不一致之处？数据不准确会不会让你难以忍受？如果是，你可能很适合 WRT！

WRT 成员应具备以下条件：

  • 回应及时，愿意经常处理 WRT 工作。
  • 注重细节，能够准确、审慎地处理数据。
  • 是 WCA 社区中值得信赖、做事可靠的成员，能够负责任地使用 WCA 数据库访问权限。已在 WCA 任职或有 WCA 工作人员推荐者更佳。
  • 至少基本了解什么是关系型数据库或 SQL 数据库。
  • 有 SQL（MySQL）经验更佳，但并非硬性要求。

WRT 成员的日常工作包括：

  • 核验、上传和公布比赛成绩。
  • 处理成绩或个人资料的修改请求。
  • 协助 WCA 代表及委员会处理数据相关问题和需求。
  • 调查 WCA 数据库中不一致的数据。
  • 分析 WCA 数据，为其他 WCA 工作人员提供参考。
  • 管理并落实 WCA 的数据保护政策。
  • 处理注册速拧选手和 WCA 工作人员提出的数据保护相关请求。

WRT 成员平均每周需投入约 5–6 小时。尤其需要准备好至少每隔两三天拿出 30–60 分钟，处理有时效要求的日常工作，例如提交比赛成绩。

在此过程中，你可以更深入地了解 WCA 的组织结构和数据库，并直接参与维护 WCA 比赛成绩的准确可信。WCA 动议中规定的 WRT 正式权利与职责见此处。

有意加入 WCA 成绩团队者，请将申请发送给 WRT 负责人 Sébastien Auroux（sauroux@worldcubeassociation.org）。申请至少应包括详细的个人介绍，说明自己为什么适合 WRT，以及加入团队的动机和目标。

申请截止时间为 2022 年 8 月 31 日 23:59 UTC。此后，现任 WRT 成员会审阅和讨论申请，并在约 3–5 周后作出决定。

期待收到你的申请！
html.en:
The WCA Results Team (WRT) is looking for devoted and trustworthy team members!

Do you like numbers? Are you the type of person quickly spotting typos or inconsistencies in restaurant menus that others miss? Does it drive you crazy when data lacks precision? If yes, then you might be a very good fit for the WRT!

The qualities that you should bring to become a WRT member include:

  • You are very responsive and willing to work on WRT tasks regularly.
  • You have a good sense of detail and you are able to handle data precisely and consciously.
  • You are a highly trusted and reliable member of the WCA community and can responsibly handle access to the WCA database. Ideally, you are already a WCA employee or have a recommendation from one.
  • You have at least a basic understanding of what a (relational / SQL) database is.
  • Existing experience with SQL (MySQL) is beneficial, but not strictly mandatory.

As a WRT member you will work on the following regular tasks:

  • Verifying, uploading and publishing competition results.
  • Handling change requests to results or personal data.
  • Supporting WCA Delegates and WCA committees with data-related problems and requests.
  • Investigating inconsistencies in the WCA database.
  • Analyzing the WCA’s data to provide insights for other WCA staff members.
  • Managing and enforcing WCA’s Data Protection policies.
  • Handling requests from Registered Speedcubers and WCA Staff on Data Protection matters.

On average, the membership in the WRT requires approximately 5-6 hours per week. In particular, you should be ready to spend 30-60 minutes at least every second/third day on handling time-critical regular WRT work (e.g. result submissions).

In return, you gain a deeper insight into the structure of the WCA and the WCA database, and you will actively contribute to ensuring the integrity of the WCA's competition results. The official rights and duties of the WRT as described in the Motions of the WCA can be found here.

If you are interested in joining the WCA Results Team, please send an application to WRT leader Sébastien Auroux (sauroux@worldcubeassociation.org). The application should at least include a comprehensive description of yourself, showing why you would be a good addition to the WRT, and your motivation and goals for becoming a WRT member.

The application deadline is August 31st 2022 23:59 UTC. Following that date, the applications will be reviewed and discussed among the current WRT members and a decision will be made about 3-5 weeks after.

We are looking forward to your application!

title.zh: 2024 年洲际锦标赛举办地公布：欧洲及北美洲

title.zh: WCA 档案团队负责人任命公告（2022 年 7 月）

html.zh:

title.zh: WCA 论坛摘要（2022 年 6 月）

html.zh:
以下是 2022 年上半年 WCA 论坛上部分值得关注的话题。

新选手应获得额外报名时间 社区成员分享了热门比赛名额很快报满、没有额外报名时间的经历，并提出其他报名方式，例如优先接纳首次参赛者，或通过增加系列赛来满足需求。

WCA 名人堂提案 有人提议向成绩卓著、贡献突出的魔友颁发证书，列出其全部成就。帖子讨论了是否应将仍在活跃参赛的魔友纳入其中。

用排名总和决定比赛总冠军 帖子提出采用类似记忆运动的成绩评定方式，将在多个项目中取得最快成绩的选手评为比赛总冠军。

将团队盲拧加入 WCA 正式项目 帖子讨论了增设团队盲拧项目的组织问题。如果通过，它将成为 WCA 首个团队项目。主要顾虑是如何防作弊，以及如何安排选手配对和排名。

2022 年 6 月 1 日生效的规则修改 规则修改后，比赛不再必须设置选手候场区。同时，删除新冠疫情临时规则的 Y 章，也放宽了比赛中的相关安全限制。

2022 年世界纪录汇总 2022 年上半年共打破 20 次世界纪录，其中 Max Park 一人贡献了 9 次！目前仍保持的有 13 项。祝贺 Max Park、Patrick Ponce、Zayn Khanani、Max Siauw、Sameer Agarwal、David Epstein、Jasper Murray、Simon Kellum、Juan Pablo Huanqui 和 Tommy Cherry。

如有疑问、意见或反馈，欢迎发邮件至 advisory@worldcubeassociation.org。

感谢大家参与论坛！
html.en:
Here are some notable threads on the WCA forum in the first half of 2022.

New Competitors should have extra time to register The community explains their experience regarding registering for competitions that fill up fast due to high demand and do not have extra time provision. Community members promote alternative ideas for registration, including allowing first time competitors priority or addressing the demand with more series competitions.

WCA Hall of Fame proposal This is a proposed idea for having diplomas handed out to eminent and well accomplished cubers which include the cuber’s full list of achievements. This thread discusses whether currently active cubers should be included.

Sum of Ranks to win a competition This thread proposes memory sports like result declaration where the competitor who gets the fastest results in many events, should be declared the overall winner of the competition.

Adding Team BLD as a WCA event This thread discusses the logistical issues with adding team BLD as an event. It would be the first team event in the WCA. The main concerns are how to ensure anti-cheating protocols and competitor pairing/ranking.

Regulation changes effective from 1st June 2022 The regulation change now implies that competitions do not need to have a mandatory Competitors Waiting Area. The safety rules restrictions at the competitions have also been relaxed by dropping article Y about temporary COVID regulations.

2022 WR Summary A total of 20 World Records were broken in the first half of 2022, with Max Park breaking 9 of those! A total of 13 World Records stand currently. Congrats to Max Park, Patrick Ponce, Zayn Khanani, Max Siauw, Sameer Agarwal, David Epstein, Jasper Murray, Simon Kellum, Juan Pablo Huanqui and Tommy Cherry.

If you have any questions, comments, or feedback feel free to send an email to advisory@worldcubeassociation.org.

Thanks for being a part of the Forum!

title.zh: WCA 比赛公示团队成员招募（2022 年 6 月）

html.zh:
WCA 比赛公示团队（WCAT）正在招募新成员！

申请者须符合以下要求：

  • 能流利使用英语。
  • 曾以组织者或核心工作人员的身份参与至少五场比赛。

WCAT 的正式权利与职责载于 WCA 动议 10.2021.2。

WCAT 成员的日常工作包括：

  • 审核提交的比赛申请，确保信息准确无误后公示比赛。
  • 处理比赛信息变更申请。
  • 与团队其他成员讨论并投票。

我们希望申请者具备以下条件：

  • 积极主动、注重细节，善于思考解决办法。
  • 每天能多次查看团队消息，并灵活处理紧急请求。
  • 熟悉 WCA 比赛要求政策（WCRP）。
  • 对 WCA 竞赛规则及各项政策有足够了解。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包括：

  • 简短的个人介绍。
  • 具体说明自己如何符合上述要求和期望。
  • （可选）其他自认为与本职务有关、但上述未列出的能力和资历。

申请自即日起开放，截止时间为 2022 年 6 月 21 日 23:59 UTC。请将材料发送给 Wilson Alvis（walvis@worldcubeassociation.org）及 Daniel Vædele Egdal（degdal@worldcubeassociation.org）。
html.en:
The WCA Competition Announcement Team (WCAT) is seeking new members!

Applicants must meet the following requirements for applying:

  • Fluency in English.
  • Have been involved in at least five competitions as an organizer or key staff member.

The official rights and duties of the WCAT are documented in WCA Motion 10.2021.2.

The daily tasks of a WCAT member include:

  • Reviewing and announcing competition submissions with accuracy and correctness.
  • Handling change requests to competitions.
  • Debating and voting with the rest of the Team.

The expected qualities of applicants include:

  • Proactive personality, sense of detail, and solution-oriented thinking.
  • Ability to check messages from the team several times a day and flexibility in handling urgent requests.
  • Good familiarity with the WCA Competition Requirements Policy (WCRP).
  • Sufficient familiarity with the WCA Regulations and WCA Policies.

Candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

  • A brief personal introduction.
  • A concrete overview on how you fulfil the requirements, and the expected qualities.
  • (Optional) Qualities and qualifications you find relevant that are not listed above.

The application period is open for applicants to submit their application document from now until June 21st 2022 23:59 UTC to Wilson Alvis (walvis@worldcubeassociation.org) and Daniel Vædele Egdal (degdal@worldcubeassociation.org).

title.zh: WCA 规则更新：2022 年 6 月

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

WRC 在此介绍将于 2022 年 6 月 1 日生效的新版《WCA 规则与指南》。

全部改动可通过 GitHub 上的对比查看。点击“Files changed”即可查看《规则》和《指南》的完整文件；修改和新增内容标为绿色，删除内容标为红色。

新版《规则与指南》的改动摘要如下：

  • 删除 Y 章及对该章的引用。
  • 增加规则 2a4，允许采取 WCA 代表认为必要的安全措施。
  • 允许比赛不设置选手等候区（规则 7h）。
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

The WRC would like to inform you about the versions of the WCA Regulations and Guidelines, which are going into effect June 1, 2022.

You can review all changes in this comparison on GitHub. You can click on “Files changed” to see the complete files of the Regulation and Guidelines, where all changes and additions are marked green and removals are red.

Here is a summary of the changes in the new version of the Regulations and the Guidelines:

  • Removing Article Y and its references.
  • Adding Regulation 2a4 to allow for safety measures deemed necessary by the WCA Delegate.
  • Allowing competitions not to have Competitors Waiting Area (Regulation 7h).

title.zh: WCA 规则委员会招募成员（2022 年 5 月）

html.zh:
WCA 规则委员会（WRC）计划招募最多 5 名新成员，欢迎不同背景的社区成员申请。申请面向所有人开放，不要求目前在 WCA 任职。

WRC 负责什么？

  • 更新和完善 WCA 规则；可参阅公开的 GitHub 仓库和 WCA 论坛版块。
  • 阅读比赛报告，处理比赛中的意外事件。
  • 与 WCA 社区交流，收集对规则的反馈。
  • 处理与规则有关的问题和咨询。

WRC 的正式权利与职责见 WCA 动议 10.2021.9。

申请者应符合以下要求：

  • 经常查收并回复邮件，每天约 5–10 封。
  • 客观地按照 WCA 规则的条文及其精神处理问题。
  • 讨论事件处理方式时，能够体谅当事人，并提出建设性意见。
  • 每周能够投入 5–10 小时。

以下经验并非必需，但会对 WRC 的工作有所帮助：

  • 能用流畅、清楚的英语与不同语言背景的人沟通。
  • 参与过线上或线下魔方社区讨论。
  • 了解 WCA 规则的历史。
  • 使用 GitHub 或编写代码，尤其是 Python、Java、Ruby on Rails。
  • 项目管理、领导工作、处理组织激励问题、倡议工作或法律工作。

优先申请期为即日起至 2022 年 6 月 3 日 23:59 UTC，请私下将申请材料发送给 Iván Brigidano（iperez@worldcubeassociation.org）。材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：

  • 简短的自我介绍。
  • 能够证明自己符合要求的经历或成果。
  • 你为什么想加入 WRC？
  • 你是否有特别希望帮助 WRC 改进的议题或问题？
  • 【可选】其他与 WRC 工作有关的经验。

你会很快收到确认材料是否齐全的回复，也可能受邀与 WRC 负责人面谈。

如有疑问，欢迎联系 Iván Brigidano（iperez@worldcubeassociation.org）。

感谢你愿意为 WRC 和 WCA 出力！
html.en:
The WCA Regulations Committee (WRC) is looking for up to 5 new members. Interested community members of all backgrounds are encouraged to apply. The applications are open to everyone; it’s not a requirement to hold a current position in the WCA to be considered.

What does the WRC do?

  • Update and improve the WCA Regulations. (See our public GitHub repository and the WCA Forum page.)
  • Read competition reports and respond to incidents.
  • Engage with the WCA community for feedback about the Regulations.
  • Address any issues and inquiries related to the Regulations.

The official rights and duties of the WRC are documented in WCA Motion 10.2021.9.

The qualities and requirements expected of candidates are:

  • Regularly check and respond to email (5-10 emails/day).
  • Objectively apply the letter and spirit of the WCA Regulations.
  • Compassionately and constructively discuss how to address incidents.
  • Time commitment of 5-10 hours per week.

The following are not required, but it would be useful for new WRC members to have additional experience with any of the following:

  • Writing fluent, clear English while communicating across language differences.
  • Cubing community discussions, online or offline.
  • The history of the WCA Regulations.
  • Using GitHub and/or writing code (especially Python, Java, Ruby on Rails).
  • Project management, leadership, addressing organisational incentives, advocacy, and/or legal work.

The priority application period is open for candidates to submit their candidacy document from now until June 3th, 2022, 23:59 UTC privately to Iván Brigidano (iperez@worldcubeassociation.org). Candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

  • A brief personal introduction.
  • A summary of experiences/accomplishments to demonstrate that you can meet the requirements.
  • What motivates you to join the WRC?
  • Do you have any topics/issues that you are passionate about helping the WRC improve?
  • Optionally, any additional experience that is relevant to WRC work.

You can expect an immediate reply to confirm whether your application is complete, and may receive a request for an interview with the WRC Leader.

If you have any questions please do not hesitate in reaching out to Iván Brigidano (iperez@worldcubeassociation.org).

Thank you for your interest in assisting the WRC and the WCA!

  • 扎实的专业技术能力。
  • 良好的沟通能力。
  • 能够理解篇幅长、英文表达复杂的文档。
  • 注重细节。
  • 项目管理经验。

申请截止时间为 2022 年 5 月 19 日 23:59 UTC。有意者请私下将材料发送至 WCA 董事会（board@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，包含：

  1. 简短的个人介绍。
  2. 为 WCA 所做工作的概述。
  3. 担任 WCA 体育组织团队负责人的工作设想。

另请提供一份可在申请截止后公开的申请材料副本。

WSOT 的权利与职责见 WCA 议案 10.2022.13。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将通过投票选出新负责人，并按照 WCA 议案 10.2022.0 第 4 节，经高级代表及现任委员会、团队负责人投票确认后公布。

感谢大家的申请与支持。
html.en:
There will be an appointment of a new WCA Sports Organization Team (WSOT) Leader.

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 4 - 6 hours per week on average to work for the Team. The qualities expected of candidates are:

  • Strong technical expertise
  • Good communication
  • Ability to digest long documents in complex English
  • Detail-oriented
  • Project management experience

The application period is open for candidates to submit their candidacy documents until May 19th, 2022, 23:59 UTC. Interested candidates can send the application privately to the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).

The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

  1. Brief personal introduction.
  2. Summary of activities done for the WCA.
  3. Ambitions as the WSOT Leader of the WCA.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WSOT can be found in WCA Motion 10.2022.13.

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of WCA Motion 10.2022.0.

Thank you for your candidacies and support.

title.zh: 招募 WCA 执行助理团队成员（2022 年 4 月）

html.zh:
WCA 执行助理团队正在招募新成员！

  • 较强的组织能力。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：

请于即日起至 2022 年 5 月 16 日 23:59 UTC，将申请发送至 board@worldcubeassociation.org。

title.zh: 拉丁美洲高级代表任命公告（2022 年 3 月）

html.en:
