title.zh: 开放申办 2024 年 WCA 各洲锦标赛

html.zh:
各位 WCA 工作人员及地区组织成员：

董事会现征集以下地区的 2024 年 WCA 洲际锦标赛申办材料：

  • 亚洲
  • 欧洲
  • 北美洲
  • 南美洲

请与本国代表讨论，你们是否有意愿和能力承办。请注意，举办这一规模的比赛，在赛前和比赛期间都需要投入大量时间和精力。各洲锦标赛的申办必须得到 WCA 认可的地区组织支持。

如有意申办，请于 2022 年 5 月 31 日 23:59 UTC 前，将申请材料私下发送至 board@worldcubeassociation.org。材料须为 PDF 格式，并提供两个版本：一份包含所有申办细节的完整版；另一份去除敏感信息（如有），用于公开。

申办材料至少应包含以下信息：

  1. 你们希望何时举办 2024 年洲际锦标赛？
    1. 可选日期。
    2. 比赛天数。
    3. 与各国学校假期的重合情况。
  2. 你们希望在本国的哪个地点举办？
    1. 城市应对海外访客有吸引力，并有观光游览的机会。
    2. 国际、国内及市内交通的便利程度。
    3. 是否有不同价位的酒店或公寓可供选择。
    4. 场地、面积及布置，包括赛台、观众区、练习桌和附属房间。
    5. 可用的技术设施，如网络、视频直播、灯光及音响设备。
    6. 可容纳的选手和观众人数。
  3. 主办团队和工作人员如何安排？
    1. 核心团队成员。
    2. 核心团队的经验。
    3. 其他合作方的参与情况。
    4. 当地志愿者的数量与能力；建议工作人员人数达到参赛人数的 20%。
    5. 需要海外代表提供哪些支持。
  4. 比赛总体预算是多少？
    1. 支出：场地、场地服务、赛台、器材、装饰、网站、证件/挂绳/礼包、奖品等。
    2. 收入：报名费、赞助、地方政府支持等。

以下示例表格列出了大型比赛需要安排和编列预算的部分事项，并非完整清单：https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1w6uxOHrr40of1R4-NjU1vy7fVJXRHiRZBn53Hc-IOk8

申办期结束后，WCA 董事会将与申请方面谈，咨询其他 WCA 工作人员，并投票决定各场 2024 年洲际锦标赛的举办地。如果某位董事参与了申办团队，该董事在遴选流程中的职责将由他人代替，例如高级代表或委员会、团队负责人。

我们期待通过这些比赛进一步完善大型 WCA 赛事的办赛理念，让协会工作更专业，为选手提供尽可能好的参赛体验，也向全世界呈现尽可能精彩的比赛。

提前感谢大家的配合！

注：非洲和大洋洲锦标赛将在今年晚些时候开放申办。
html.en:
Dear WCA Staff & Regional Organizations,

The Board of Directors would like to receive applications for WCA Continental Championships 2024 for the following regions:

  • Asia
  • Europe
  • North America
  • South America

Please discuss with the Delegates in your country whether this is something you are willing and able to pursue. Bear in mind that organizing a competition of this size takes a significant amount of time and effort before and during the competition. Please note that applications for continental championships must be endorsed by WCA Recognized Regional Organizations.

If you are interested, send your application documents privately to board@worldcubeassociation.org before May 31st, 2022, 23:59UTC. Documents must be sent in PDF format in two versions: one full version with all the details for the application, and another version with sensitive details - if any - removed to make public.

Please include in your application documents at least the following information:

  1. When would you like to hold your Continental Championship 2024?
    1. Possible dates
    2. Number of days of the competition.
    3. Overlap with international holiday periods of schools.
  2. Where would you like to hold your Continental Championship 2024 in your country?
    1. City should be interesting to visit for foreigners with opportunities for sightseeing.
    2. Ease of international, national, and local travel.
    3. Availability of hotels/apartments with different price categories.
    4. Venue, venue size, and venue setup (stage, audience, tables to practice, side rooms).
    5. Technology available like the internet, video streaming, lighting, sound equipment.
    6. Number of competitors and spectators that can be hosted.
  3. What would the organization team and staff look like?
    1. Core team members.
    2. Experience of the core team.
    3. Involvement of other parties.
    4. Quantity and quality of local volunteers (guideline is 20% of competitors should staff).
    5. Required support by foreign Delegates.
  4. What would be the overall budget for the competition?
    1. Cost (venue, venue services, stage, equipment, decorations, website, badges/lanyards/gift packs, prizes).
    2. Income (registration fees, sponsoring, local government).

Here is an example document with a non-exhaustive list of topics that need to be arranged and budgeted for a large competition: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1w6uxOHrr40of1R4-NjU1vy7fVJXRHiRZBn53Hc-IOk8

Once the application period is over, the WCA Board of Directors will interview applicants, consult other WCA Staff members, and vote in order to decide where each 2024 Continental Championship will take place. If any Director will be involved in a team that sends in an application, they will be replaced in the selection process by another person (for example a Senior Delegate or a Committee/Team Leader).

We are looking for a competition that can reinforce our concept of large WCA competitions, boosting the professionalization of our organization and being able to offer the competitors the best possible experience and the world the best possible show.

Thank you for your cooperation in advance!

Note: Applications for Africa & Oceania will open later in the year.

title.zh: WCA 就乌克兰局势采取的措施（2022 年 3 月）
title.en: WCA action regarding situation in Ukraine (March 2022)

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

我们一直关注乌克兰近期的事态发展，并对此感到震惊。WCA 董事会与社区其他成员一样，希望当前局势能尽快以和平方式解决。我们也衷心希望，那些无辜卷入冲突的 WCA 社区成员能够平安。

过去几天，WCA 董事会讨论了该地区近期赛事能否举行的问题，并批准采取以下措施：

WCA 将不认可白俄罗斯和俄罗斯所有即将举行及今后的赛事，包括目前已安排于 3 月在俄罗斯举行的两场赛事。此外，在另行通知前，不再公布白俄罗斯或俄罗斯的新赛事。

WCA 董事会强调，这一决定经过了慎重考虑。我们选择遵循国际奥林匹克委员会执行委员会于 2022 年 2 月 25 日提出的建议。
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

We have been following the recent developments in Ukraine with shock. The WCA Board along with the rest of our community are hoping for a swift and peaceful resolution to the current situation. We additionally wish for the safety of members of the WCA community who have been unknowingly caught in this conflict.

Over the past few days the WCA Board has had discussions on the feasibility of upcoming events in the region and has approved the following action:

All upcoming and future events in Belarus and Russia will not be recognised by the WCA. This includes the two currently scheduled events to be held in Russia in March. Additionally no further events will be announced in Belarus or Russia until further notice.

The WCA Board would like to stress this decision has not been made lightly. In this decision we are choosing to follow recommendations set forth by the International Olympic Committee Executive Board on February 25, 2022.

title.zh: WCA 市场推广团队成员招募（2022 年 2 月）

html.zh:
WCA 市场推广团队（WMT）正在招募新成员！

WCA 市场推广团队做什么？

WMT 负责维护 WCA 与外部合作伙伴的关系，并参与 WCA 品牌相关工作，包括周边商品、社交媒体互动、市场调研和大型赛事推广。

以下是 WMT 正在开展的几个重点项目：

  • 周边商品：
    • 你可能已经看到 WCA 周边商店上线了。WMT 希望招募能够帮助开发和拓展周边商品业务的成员。如果你热衷于通过周边商品推广 WCA 品牌、扩大其影响，这是一个很好的机会。
  • 赞助与合同：
    • WMT 与 Spin Master 等现有 WCA 赞助商合作，也在为 WCA 寻找全球及地方层面的潜在合作机会。我们特别欢迎曾为自己组织的比赛或所在地区组织争取赞助的人申请，一同参与 WCA 的未来发展。
  • 锦标赛支持：
    • 与上一项密切相关，WMT 希望招募能够帮助推广洲际锦标赛和世界锦标赛的成员，重点是宣传 WCA 品牌、扩大影响，吸引尽可能多的选手以及现场和线上观众。

所有 WCA 成员均可申请，申请者不必目前在 WCA 担任职务。

申请要求

  • 对推广 WCA 品牌有兴趣及／或相关经验。
  • 每周能投入约 5 至 10 小时。
  • 有创意，能与团队合作。
  • 熟悉周边商品、赞助或供应商管理者优先。

申请者须提交 PDF 格式的申请材料，包括简短的个人介绍、参与 WCA 的经历、申请加入 WMT 的原因，以及相关经验或技能。

申请自即日起开放，请于 2022 年 3 月 16 日 23:59 UTC 前发送至 sgrover@worldcubeassociation.org。
html.en:
The WCA Marketing Team (WMT) is seeking new members!

What does the WCA Marketing Team do?

The WMT is responsible for managing WCA relationships with external partners as well as working closely on the WCA Brand, including WCA merchandise, social media engagement and market research and promotion of large events.

Here are some of the key projects the WMT is working on -

  • Merchandising:
  • You may have seen the launch of the WCA Merchandise Store - the WMT is seeking members who can help develop and grow the merchandising, this is a great opportunity for someone who’s passionate about growing the WCA brand and reach through merchandising.
  • Sponsorships & Contracts
  • WMT works with current WCA sponsors like Spin Master, and also works on exploring potential opportunities for the WCA (global and local scales). Candidates who have worked on getting sponsorships for competitions they have organized, or regional organizations they have been part of are strongly encouraged to apply and shape the future of the WCA.
  • Championship Support
  • Closely related to the last point, WMT is looking for members who can help market the continental championships, as well as the world championships - specifically in promoting the WCA brand and growing our reach in order to gain as many competitors and spectators as possible, both in person and online.

The application is open to all WCA members. Potential applicants do not have to hold a current position to be considered.

Requirements for Applicants

  • Interest and/or experience in marketing the WCA Brand
  • Approximate 5 - 10 Hours time commitment per week
  • Creative mind, and the ability to work within a team
  • Familiarity in dealing with merchandising/sponsorships/vendor management is a plus

Applicants should submit a PDF application including a brief personal introduction, their involvement with the WCA, their motivation for applying to the WMT, and any relevant experience or skills.

Applications should be sent to sgrover@worldcubeassociation.org from now until March 16th, 2022, 23:59 UTC to be considered.

title.zh: WCA 顾问委员会社区及工作人员代表招募（2022 年 1 月）
title.en: Call for Applicants - WAC Community and Staff Representatives (January 2022)

html.zh:
**WCA 顾问委员会（WAC）**正在从社区和工作人员中招募新成员，协助委员会开展工作。

所有 WCA 成员均可申请。

WAC 是什么？负责什么工作？

WAC 最重要的职责是充当社区与 WCA 工作人员之间的桥梁：让社区在重要议题的讨论中发声，并建立稳定的双向沟通渠道。社区代表与工作人员代表都是其中不可或缺的一部分。有关 WAC 主要职能的更多信息，见 WCA 动议 20.2021.01。

委员会下设两个小组：社区代表组及 WCA 代表组。本次同时招募社区代表与工作人员代表，因此包括 WCA 工作人员在内的任何社区成员都可申请。如果你从未在 WCA 担任正式职务，这是一次为 WCA 的改进出力的好机会！

委员会目前的重点项目包括 WCA 论坛的版务与管理，以及开发不同渠道，收集对 WCA 有帮助的社区意见。

我们希望候选人具备以下条件：

  • 沟通能力：内部沟通使用英语，因此需要中等水平的英语能力。
  • 工作态度：成员应定期参与工作，不能连续多天不理会消息。预计每周需投入 2 至 3 小时处理委员会事务。
  • 改进意识：我们会花不少时间讨论工作方式，并收集值得关注的议题。如果你认为 WCA 已经完美无缺，可能就不太适合这项工作！
  • 兴趣：乐于与社区成员讨论 WCA 事务。
  • 成熟稳重：线上讨论需要启发思考并有所收获。反馈社区意见时，你代表的是社区，而非自己的个人观点。
  • 熟悉的领域：团队希望尽可能覆盖社区中的不同群体，因此成员可以将部分精力放在自己熟悉且关心的领域。这可以是某个地理区域，也可以是某类魔友，例如顶尖／速度较慢的魔友、较年轻／年长的魔友。

两个小组都欢迎有线上社区管理经验、熟悉相关工作，并长期参与速拧社区的申请者！

申请自即日起开放，截止时间为 2022 年 2 月 14 日 23:59 UTC。请将材料发送给 Zachary Miller（zjmiller2004@gmail.com）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包括：

  • 姓名。
  • 简短的个人介绍。
  • 参与 WCA 的经历概述。
  • 说明自己如何符合所需条件。
  • 成为 WCA 顾问委员会成员后的工作设想。

提前感谢大家的申请与支持！
html.en:
The WCA Advisory Council (WAC) is seeking new members from both the community and staff to assist the council in its duties.

The application is open to all WCA members.

What is the WAC and what do they do?

The biggest task of the WAC is to be an intermediary between the community and the WCA Staff - to give the community a voice when important topics are being discussed, along with establishing consistent and bilateral communication lines between the community and the WCA Staff. The Community Representatives, along with Staff Representatives are a vital part of that process. More information about the main functions of the WAC can be found here: WCA Motion 20.2021.01.

The council has 2 sub-teams - Community Representatives and WCA Representatives. This announcement is for both Community and Staff representatives, which means that anyone in the community, including WCA Staff, is able to apply for this position. If you have never held a formal position in the WCA before, this an exciting opportunity to contribute towards making the WCA even better!

Current key projects of the council involve moderation and management of the WCA Forum and developing different channels to gather community feedback useful for the WCA.

The qualities expected of candidates are:

  • Communication: Internal communication is done in English, so an intermediate standard of English is required.
  • Work Ethic: Members will be expected to contribute regularly and not ignore messages for many days. The expected time commitment is 2-3 hours per week on tasks for the council.
  • Innovation: There will be significant time spent discussing our methods of working and doing a lot of idea gathering of topics to focus on. If you think that the WCA is currently perfect then you probably aren’t the person for this!
  • Interest: An enjoyment to discuss WCA matters among the community is ideal.
  • Maturity: Online discussions will need to be thought-provoking and productive. When providing community feedback you'll be representing the community and not your own views.
  • Specializations: The goal of the team is to cover a wide spectrum of the community and therefore members can partly focus on certain areas that they are knowledgeable and passionate about. This could be a geographical area, or any sort of “category” of cuber (e.g. elite/slower cubers, younger/older cubers).

Having prior experience and familiarity managing online communities along with long term engagement with the speedcubing community is a plus for both subteams!

The application period is open for candidates to submit their candidacy document from now until February 14, 2022, 23:59 UTC to Zachary Miller (zjmiller2004@gmail.com)

The candidacy documents must be submitted in PDF format, and should include the following:

  • Your Name
  • A brief personal summary
  • A summary of involvement in the WCA
  • An explanation of how you fit the qualities required
  • Aspirations as a member of the WCA Advisory Council

Thank you in advance for your candidacies and support!

title.zh: WCA 宣传团队负责人任命公告（2022 年 1 月）

我们很高兴地宣布，Rui Reis 将担任 WCA 宣传团队（WCT）的新任负责人。Rui 此前已在 WCT 担任高级成员。

Rui was selected by the WCA Board, following Section 4 of our Motion about WCA Committees and Teams.

The Board also received an application from the following applicant:

  • Chandler Scheurkogel

We thank Chandler for applying and both applications can be found here.

title.zh: 2021 年年终寄语

html.zh:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

2021 年即将结束，我们又一次回望了对各地魔友而言充满挑战的一年。尽管环境艰难，WCA 仍取得了许多值得庆祝的成果，也让我们对来年充满期待。

更多地区得以恢复举办比赛：起初依据比赛公示规定，随后遵循比赛安全政策中新的安全措施。这些比赛的名额以创纪录的速度报满，最快的一场仅用了 44 秒，足见各地对比赛回归的热切期待。全年共有 49 个国家举办了 242 场比赛，每月的比赛数量也显著增加。在家练习的时间多了，各级纪录也不断被刷新。恭喜各位出色的魔友在 2021 年打破了 584 项国家纪录、69 项洲际纪录和 21 项世界纪录！

各委员会与团队虽然大多在幕后工作，但他们的成绩同样不容忽视。即使比赛不如以往活跃，他们仍在努力改进 WCA。为持续改善参赛体验，董事会、WCA 质量保证委员会和 WCA 规则委员会制定或修订了比赛要求政策、打乱问责政策、竞赛规则以及获准使用的计时器名单。这些政策为比赛确立了重要标准，目前已顺利应用于比赛。WCA 比赛公示团队平均用时 63.9 小时批准新的比赛公示。考虑到新安全政策要求高级代表审核并批准所有比赛，这一成绩十分可贵。比赛结束后，WCA 成绩团队平均约用 12.8 小时发布成绩，同样付出了不少努力。我们也要感谢 WCA 纪律委员会、WCA 道德委员会和 WCA 财务委员会。他们的许多工作不直接面向公众，却对 WCA 负责任地正常运作至关重要。

希望你已经在社交媒体上看到了 WCA 沟通团队的工作成果：他们共发布了 70 条帖文，其中不少机构公告最初由 WCA 执行助理团队起草。执行助理团队还每月发送内部简报，让 WCA 工作人员了解协会动态。今年新任命了 4 位高级代表、5 位委员会／团队负责人、25 位见习代表和 6 位初级代表，另有 11 位代表晋升，需要跟进的事务着实不少！在论坛方面，WCA 顾问委员会管理了超过 2,700 条帖子（包含超过 300 个新话题），并定期发布热门讨论摘要。WCA 软件团队努力推出了新版 TNoodle 1.1.0，并进一步更新至当前的 1.1.2 版本，为打乱程序带来了许多重要修复和功能。今年最令人兴奋的成果之一，是 WCA 市场推广团队扩充并推出了面向世界各地魔友的 WCA 周边商品。上线以来，已售出超过 240 件商品，网站浏览量超过 4,000 次！

我们一如既往地认真筹备新一年的工作。2022 年的洲际锦标赛将在安全条件允许的地方举行。我们期待这些比赛取得成功，特别是所有赛事均获得了 Rubik’s 的赞助。2021 年世界锦标赛的取消让我们遗憾，但我们也期待在 2022 年推进于韩国首尔举办的 2023 年世界锦标赛的筹备。请放心，这些赛事的规划会把社区的安全放在心上。等到时机对大家都合适时，魔友们一定能够再次相聚。

志愿者每天为社区投入时间与资源，没有他们的付出，就没有我们这一年的成绩。希望新的一年能给大家带来值得庆祝的时刻，也期待在 2022 年再次相聚。祝大家新年平安快乐！
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

Here at the end of 2021, we once again find ourselves reflecting on a challenging year for cubers everywhere. Despite the circumstances, there were many accomplishments within the WCA that are reason to celebrate and look forward to the year ahead.

Many more areas were able to begin holding competitions again using the Competition Announcement Rules at first and later meeting new safety measures outlined in the Competition Safety Policy. These competitions filled their registration limits in record time, the quickest one filling in just 44 seconds, so we can tell that the demand is high for competitions to return to many areas. Over the year, 242 competitions were held in 49 different countries, with the number of competitions held each month increasing significantly. With so much time to practice at home, we also saw many records broken again at all levels. Congratulations to the amazing cubers who were able to break 584 National Records, 69 Continental Records, and 21 World Records in 2021!

Although much of their work is behind the scenes, we cannot overlook the accomplishments of our Committees and Teams, who work hard to continually improve the WCA even if competitions are not as active. In our efforts to continually improve the competition experience, the Competition Requirements Policy, Scramble Accountability Policy, Regulations, and list of approved timers were introduced and modified by the Board, WCA Quality Assurance Committee, and WCA Regulations Committee. These policies help set important standards for our competitions and have already been applied to competitions without issue. The WCA Competition Announcement Team approved new competition announcements in an average of 63.9 hours which is a great accomplishment considering the new policies that required Senior Delegates to review and approve all competitions due to the Safety measures put in place. Once the competitions were complete, the WCA Results Team posted results in about 12.8 hours on average, which takes quite a bit of effort. We also want to acknowledge the great efforts of the WCA Disciplinary Committee, WCA Ethics Committee, and WCA Financial Committee that do much of their work without public appearance but are crucial to keep the WCA accountable and functional.

Hopefully you saw the efforts of the WCA Communication Team on social media where there were 70 posts, many of which were organizational announcements originally drafted by the WCA Executive Assistants Team, who also sent out monthly internal digests to keep WCA Staff informed of happenings around the organization. With four new Senior Delegates, five new Committee/Team Leaders, 25 new Trainee Delegates, six new Junior Delegates and 11 Delegate promotions, there was a lot to keep track of! On the Forum, the WCA Advisory Council oversaw over 2,700 posts (and over 300 new topics) and posted periodic digests of the most popular conversations. The WCA Software Team worked hard on a new release of TNoodle 1.1.0 (and further updates to the current version 1.1.2) which introduced many crucial fixes and functions to the scrambling program. One of the most exciting achievements of the year was the launch of expanded WCA Merchandise by the WCA Marketing Team that can be enjoyed by cubers around the world. Since launch, there have been over 240 items sold and over 4,000 website views!

As always, we are carefully preparing for the year ahead which will hold the 2022 Continental Championships, where it is safe to do so. We are hopeful that these competitions will be successful, especially with the sponsorship by Rubik’s for all of the events. Although we were saddened about the cancellation of the World Championship 2021, we look forward to the organization of the World Championship 2023 in Seoul, Republic of Korea throughout 2022. Rest assured, these events will be planned with the safety of our community in mind and know that bringing cubers together again will happen when the time is right for everyone.

As always, we would not have had a successful year without the efforts of our volunteers who dedicate their time and resources to the community everyday. We hope the new year brings moments of celebration to all and we look forward to meeting together again in 2022! Have a safe and happy New Year!

title.zh: 2022 年 1 月版 WCA 规则已生效
title.en: WCA Regulations — January 2022: Now in Effect

html.zh: 新版 WCA 规则和指南已于 2022 年 1 月 1 日生效。详情请参阅此前的公告。
html.en: New WCA Regulations and Guidelines are in effect as of January 1, 2022. Please see the original announcement for details.

title.zh: WCA 竞赛规则更新（2022 年 1 月）

html.zh:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

WCA 规则委员会（WRC）在此通知，新版《WCA 竞赛规则与指南》将于 2022 年 1 月 1 日生效。

所有改动可在 GitHub 版本对比中查看。点击“Files changed”即可查看规则与指南的完整文件，其中新增和修改的内容标为绿色，删除的内容标为红色。

新版规则与指南的改动概要如下：

  • 认可 Speed Stacks 第五代 Stackmat 计时器。（提交记录 | 讨论）
  • 明确取消资格对成绩的影响。（提交记录 | 讨论）
  • 明确设有累计时限的轮次中选手迟到的处理。（提交记录 | 提交记录 | 讨论）
  • 明确魔表硬件的要求，由 WCA 代表酌情判断是否认可。（提交记录 | 提交记录 | 讨论）
  • 允许魔方含有透明部件，前提是这些部件不提供额外信息。（提交记录 | 讨论）
  • 强烈建议选手关闭通知和来电。（提交记录 | 讨论）
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

The WRC would like to inform you about the versions of the WCA Regulations and Guidelines, which are going into effect January 1, 2022.

You can review all changes in this comparison on GitHub. You can click on “Files changed” to see the complete files of the Regulation and Guidelines, where all changes and additions are marked green and removals are red.

Here is a summary of the changes in the new version of the Regulations and the Guidelines:

  • Approving Speed Stacks Stackmat timer Generation 5. (commit | discussion)
  • Clarification on how disqualifications affect results. (commit | discussion)
  • Clarification on late competitors to rounds with cumulative time limits. (commit | commit | discussion)
  • Clarification on Clock hardware, which is approved at WCA Delegate discretion. (commit | commit | discussion)
  • Puzzles are allowed to have transparent parts as long as they do not provide additional information. (commit | discussion)
  • Strongly recommend competitors to turn off notifications and calls. (commit | discussion)

title.zh: Rubik’s Cube® 将赞助 2022 年 WCA 洲际锦标赛
title.en: Rubik's Cube® to sponsor the 2022 World Cube Association Continental Championships

html.zh:
全球知名儿童娱乐公司 Spin Master 旗下的 RUBIK'S CUBE® 宣布与世界魔方协会（WCA）达成一项前所未有的赞助合作。自 20 世纪 70 年代末上市以来，匈牙利发明家 Ernő Rubik 教授创造的魔方吸引了全球数百万人。复杂的结构和缤纷的图案让魔方广受欢迎，也成为流行文化的一部分。随着更高效的解法出现，大家自然开始渴望竞技。首次国际比赛于 1982 年在布达佩斯举行，美国选手 Minh Thai夺冠，并以 22.95 秒创造了首个官方世界纪录。

间隔二十多年后，随着网络论坛兴起，一群热爱魔方的人决定重拾魔方竞技，在加拿大多伦多举办了 2003 年世锦赛。比赛大获成功，随后欧洲和美国陆续举办了多场较小规模的比赛。2004 年 8 月，荷兰人 Ron van Bruchem 和美国人 Tyson Mao 创建了世界魔方协会（WCA），目的是记录成绩、制定统一规则，并帮助更多国家举办更多比赛。如今，WCA 已在 143 个国家认证了超过 7,000 场比赛，参赛人数超过 150,000 人。自 Minh Thai 于 1982 年创造纪录以来，三阶世界纪录已大幅缩短，目前为中国选手杜宇生在 2018 年创造的 3.47 秒。

此次赞助将支持以下六场 2022 年 Rubik’s WCA 洲际锦标赛：

  • Rubik’s WCA 2022 非洲锦标赛——南非开普敦，日期待定。
  • Rubik’s WCA 2022 亚洲锦标赛——待定。
  • Rubik’s WCA 2022 欧洲锦标赛——丹麦哥本哈根，2022 年 7 月 14–17 日。
  • Rubik’s WCA 2022 北美锦标赛——加拿大多伦多，2022 年 7 月 7–10 日。
  • Rubik’s WCA 2022 大洋洲锦标赛——澳大利亚墨尔本，2022 年 12 月 15–18 日。
  • Rubik’s WCA 2022 南美锦标赛——巴西巴西利亚，2022 年 7 月 22–24 日。

RUBIK'S CUBE® 与 WCA 有着共同的目标：让热爱解谜的人们相聚，提供有趣、公平、专业的最佳参赛体验。
html.en:
RUBIK'S CUBE®, owned by Spin Master, a leading global children's entertainment company, has announced an unprecedented sponsorship with the World Cube Association (WCA). Since its release in the late '70s, the Rubik's Cube - from its Hungarian inventor Professor Ernő Rubik - has fascinated millions of people around the world. The complexity coupled with the colorful patterns led to the Rubik's Cube's immense popularity and presence in pop culture. Naturally, with the development of methods to solve the puzzle more efficiently, came a strong desire for competition. The first international gathering took place in 1982 in Budapest in which the American Minh Thai took the victory and set the first ever official World Record with a result of 22.95 seconds.

After a break of more than 20 years and the advent of internet forums, a passionate group of Cubers decided to revive the competitive spirit of the puzzle and organized the 2003 World Championship in Toronto, Canada. This competition was a massive success and prompted multiple smaller scale competitions to be organized in Europe and the USA. In August 2004, the World Cube Association (WCA) was created by the Dutchman Ron van Bruchem and the American Tyson Mao. The goal was to track records, define a uniform set of rules, and help with the organization of more competitions in more countries. The WCA has now officiated more than 7,000 competitions in 143 countries, with more than 150,000 unique participants. Since Minh Thai's record in 1982, the 3x3 Cube World Record has lowered significantly and now stands at 3.47 seconds set by the Chinese Yusheng Du in 2018.

The sponsorship will deliver the following six Rubik's WCA Continental Championships in 2022:

  • Rubik's WCA African Championship 2022 - Cape Town, South Africa - Dates TBC
  • Rubik's WCA Asian Championship 2022 - TBC
  • Rubik's WCA European Championship 2022 - Copenhagen, Denmark - 14th - 17th July, 2022
  • Rubik's WCA North American Championship 2022 - Toronto, Canada - 7th - 10th July, 2022
  • Rubik's WCA Oceanic Championship 2022 - Melbourne, Australia - 15th - 18th December, 2022
  • Rubik's WCA South American Championship 2022 - Brasília, Brazil - 22nd - 24th July, 2022

RUBIK'S CUBE® and the WCA have a shared goal of bringing together communities of problem-solvers and the best experience for fun, fair and professional competitions.

title.zh: WCA 论坛精选（2021 年 12 月）

html.zh:
以下是过去几个月 WCA 论坛上值得关注的几个话题。

移除第五代计时器的四触点模式

Speed Stacks 新推出的第五代计时器在社区中褒贬不一。活跃的速拧选手 Callum 介绍了如何简单改装计时器，使其像原来的双触点计时器一样工作。

2022 年 WCA 竞赛规则意见征集

WCA 规则委员会就明年计划实施的《WCA 竞赛规则与指南》改动征求社区意见。下个月，我们将看到 2022 年最终确定的全部改动。

明拧项目的累计时限

按现行规则，只有在项目不设单次还原时限时，才可使用累计时限。累计时限最常用于盲拧项目，让选手在预计的总时长内完成整轮比赛。Kit 建议为明拧项目引入可同时设置单次时限的累计时限制度，以改善赛程安排，更好地管理每位选手完成全部还原所需的时间。

Max Park 一天打破四项世界纪录

Max Park 在美国蒙大拿州米苏拉的一场比赛中，一天内四次打破世界纪录。他两次刷新三阶平均世界纪录，将其降至 5.32 秒；以 20.94 秒刷新四阶平均世界纪录；最后又以 9.34 秒刷新单手平均世界纪录。祝贺 Max！

Zayn Khanani 三次刷新二阶世界纪录

过去几周，Zayn Khanani 状态火热，在不同比赛中两次打破二阶世界纪录。他先将二阶平均世界纪录降至 1.13 秒，随后是 1.06 秒，最后是 1.05 秒。他目前仍在参加美国及世界各地的比赛，很有可能很快再次打破世界纪录。

如有问题、意见或反馈，请发送邮件至 advisory@worldcubeassociation.org，也欢迎直接参与相关帖子的讨论！

感谢大家分享重要反馈、认真参与讨论，一起建设论坛。
html.en:
Here are some notable threads on the WCA Forum from the previous few months.

Removing 4-pad mode functionality in Gen5 timers The new Gen5 timers released from the Speed Stacks company had mixed reviews from the community. An active speedcuber, Callum, discusses how to apply a simple modification to the timer to make it work like the original 2-pad touch timers.

2022 WCA Regulations feedback The WCA Regulations Committee asked for community feedback on the changes that they are implementing next year to the WCA Regulations and Guidelines. We will be hearing about all the finalized changes for 2022 next month.

Cumulative time limits in sighted events In the current Regulations, cumulative time limits can only be used if individual solve time limits are not used for the event. Most commonly, these are used for blindsolving events which allows competitors to complete the entire round of an event within an estimated overall time. Kit proposes that we have the system of cumulative time limits for sighted events that allows for individual solve time limits to be applied as well, as it will improve competition schedules and overall management of the time taken by each competitor to complete their attempts.

Four World Records from Max Park in a single day Max Park broke four world records in one day at a competition in the US in Missoula, Montana. He broke the 3x3 World Record twice, reducing it to a 5.32 second average, the 4x4 Record, resulting in a 20.94 second average, and finally the One-Handed Record with a 9.34 second average. Congratulations to Max!

Three World Records from Zayn Khanani in the 2x2 event Zayn Khanani, over the course of the last few weeks, went on a spree and broke the 2x2 World Record twice at different competitions. He reduced the 2x2 Average Record to 1.13 seconds, then 1.06 seconds, and finally 1.05 seconds. He is currently attending more competitions across the USA and the world, and there is a high chance that we will see another World Record from him soon.

If you have any questions, comments, or feedback, please send an email to advisory@worldcubeassociation.org or participate in the discussions on the threads yourself!

Thanks to everyone for being a part of the Forum by sharing important feedback and adding value to the discussions.

title.zh: 美国及加拿大高级代表任命公告（2021 年 11 月）

html.zh:
我们很高兴地宣布，Matthew Dickman 将担任美国及加拿大地区的新任高级代表。感谢 Kit Clement 此前担任该地区高级代表期间的付出。

WCA 董事会依照高级代表动议第 4 节的规定，通过内部投票选定了 Matthew。

祝 Matthew 顺利履行新的职责。他的高级代表任期自 2021 年 11 月 18 日开始。

James Hildreth 也申请了这一职位。感谢两位申请者愿意在现有工作之外，进一步帮助 WCA 和速拧社区。两人的申请材料可在此处查看。
html.en:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Senior Delegate for USA & Canada - Matthew Dickman. We would like to thank Kit Clement for his service as Senior Delegate for the region previously.

Matthew was selected by the WCA Board by voting among them, following Section 4 of our Motion about Senior Delegates.

We wish Matthew the best of luck in fulfilling his new duties. His term as Senior Delegate began on November 18, 2021.

An application was also received from James Hildreth for the position. We want to thank both applicants for their willingness in helping the WCA and the Speedcubing Community even more than they currently do. You can view both of their candidacy documents here.

title.zh: WCA 董事会成员变动（2021 年 11 月）
title.en: Changes in the Board of Directors (November 2021)

html.zh:
随着董事 Bob Burton 和 Henrik Buus Aagaard 的任期即将结束，WCA 开放了董事职位申请。遗憾的是，我们没有收到任何申请，董事会选举程序因此停止。

Bob 和 Henrik 的任期已于 2021 年 11 月 8 日 23:59 UTC 结束。自此，董事会由其余三位成员组成。

感谢 Bob 和 Henrik 在任期间取得的各项成果，以及他们对 WCA 的投入。祝愿他们今后一切顺利！
html.en:
With the terms of Board Members Bob Burton and Henrik Buus Aagaard coming to an end, applications were opened for the Board of Directors. Unfortunately, no applications were received for the position(s) which has stopped the Board election process.

The terms of Bob and Henrik ended at 23:59 UTC on November 8, 2021. From this point the Board has been reduced to the remaining three members.

We want to thank both Bob and Henrik for all the accomplishments they have had in their positions and for their dedication to the WCA. We wish them all the best for whatever is up next!

title.zh: WCA 沟通团队招募负责人（2021 年 10 月）

html.zh:
Lauren Clement 的 WCA 沟通团队（WCT）负责人任期已结束，团队将任命新负责人。感谢 Lauren 任职以来所做的工作。

申请者应能完成 24 个月的任期，并平均每周投入至少 5 小时参与团队工作。我们希望申请者具备：

  • 较强的领导能力。
  • 细心的工作态度。
  • 良好的沟通能力。

申请材料提交时间为即日起至 2021 年 11 月 18 日 23:59 UTC。有意申请者可私下将材料发送至 WCA 董事会（board@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：

  • 简短的自我介绍。
  • 为 WCA 所做工作的概述。
  • 担任 WCT 负责人的工作设想。

此外，请提供一份可在申请截止后公开的申请材料副本。

WCT 的权利与职责见 WCA 动议 10.2021.1。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将投票选定人选，并依据 WCA 动议 10.2021.0 第 4 节，由高级代表及现任委员会、团队负责人投票确认后，公布新负责人。

感谢大家的申请和支持。
html.en:
There will be an appointment of a new WCA Communication Team (WCT) Leader, as Lauren Clement’s term has expired in her position as the Leader of the Team. We would like to thank Lauren for the work she has done in this position so far.

Candidates are expected to fulfill their term (24 months) and to spend at least 5 hours per week on average to work for the committee. The qualities expected of candidates are:

  • Strong leadership skills
  • Attention to detail
  • Communication skills

The application period for candidates to submit their candidacy documents is from now until November 18th, 2021, 23:59 UTC. Interested candidates can send the application privately to the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).

The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

  • Brief personal introduction.
  • Summary of activities done for the WCA.
  • Ambitions as the WCT Leader of the WCA.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WCT can be found in WCA Motion 10.2021.1.

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of WCA Motion 10.2021.0.

Thank you for your candidacies and support.

title.zh: 高级代表任命公告：西亚和南亚（2021 年 10 月）
title.en: Senior Delegate Announcement - Asia West and South (October 2021)

html.zh:
我们很高兴地宣布，西亚和南亚地区的高级代表为 Akash Rupela。

Akash 的任期此前已获延长，但根据 WCA 动议 09.2021.1中关于 WCA 高级代表权利与职责的规定，此时须重新进行任命。本次没有其他人申请该职位。

祝 Akash Rupela 继续顺利履行该地区的职责。

他的申请材料可在此处查看。
html.en:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Senior Delegate in Asia West and South: Akash Rupela.

Akash’s term had been extended previously but as noted on the rights and duties of WCA Senior Delegates available in WCA Motion 09.2021.1, a new appointment had to be made at this time. There were no other candidates who applied for the position.

We wish Akash Rupela the best of luck in continuing to fulfill his duties in the region.

You can find his candidacy document here.

title.zh: WCA 成绩团队负责人任命（2021 年 10 月）

html.zh:
我们很高兴宣布，Sébastien Auroux 获任 WCA 成绩团队（WRT）负责人。Sébastien 的任期此前已延长过，但根据 WCA 决议 10.2021.0中关于委员会与团队权利和职责的规定，须重新进行任命。

根据关于 WCA 委员会与团队的决议第 4 节，WCA 董事会选定 Sébastien，并经现任委员会负责人及高级代表投票通过。

除 Sébastien 外，以下人员也提交了申请：

  • Brandon Reichman

两人的申请材料可在此处查看。感谢 Brandon 提交申请，也祝 Sébastien 继续带领团队顺利开展工作。
html.en:
We are happy to announce that we have a new WCA Results Team (WRT) Leader, Sébastien Auroux. Sébastien’s term had already been extended previously but as noted on the rights and duties of WCA Committees & Teams available in WCA Motion 10.2021.0, a new appointment had to be made.

Sébastien was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote among the current Committee Leaders and Senior Delegates, following Section 4 of our Motion about WCA Committees and Teams.

Other than Sébastien, the following individuals also applied:

  • Brandon Reichman

You can find both of their candidacy documents here. We thank Brandon for the application and wish Sébastien luck with his continued work with the team.

title.zh: 官方认可计时器名单更新（2021 年 10 月）
title.en: Updating the Official List of Approved Timers (October 2021)

html.zh:
经过数月征求意见和评估，WCA 规则委员会（WRC）与 WCA 董事会决定更新官方认可的计时器型号名单，参见规则 7f1a。具体调整如下：

  • Speed Stacks 第五代 Stackmat 计时器将随 2022 年规则生效而获准使用。
  • Speed Stacks 第二代 Stackmat 计时器将随 2023 年规则生效而不再获准使用。

取消对第二代计时器的认可，是为了解决部分 Stackmat 计时器故障方面的顾虑。仍在使用这些计时器的社区将有一年以上的过渡期，以安排更换。

同时，认可名单的更新也将为组织者和 WCA 代表提供更多选择。
html.en:
After a few months of feedback and review, the WCA Regulations Committee (WRC) and the WCA Board have decided to update the official list of approved timer versions (see Regulation 7f1a). The following changes will take effect:

  • Speed Stacks Stackmat timer Generation 5 will be approved alongside 2022 Regulations.
  • Speed Stacks Stackmat timer Generation 2 will no longer be an approved timer alongside 2023 Regulations.

The Generation 2 Timers have to be removed to address some concerns about Stackmat timer malfunctions. A grace period of over one year will be granted to allow the communities that still use these timers to make the arrangements to replace them.

At the same time, this update on the list of approved timers will bring more opportunities to organizers and WCA Delegates.

title.zh: 年度会员大会通知（2021 年 9 月）

html.zh:
根据章程第 2.12 条，董事会现通知：WCA 年度会员大会将于 10 月 17 日 18:00 UTC 举行。会员可以通过 WCA Twitch 频道观看直播。此文件夹中提供了年度大会资料包，包含会上将讨论的全部相关文件。

期待你参加本次年度会员大会。
html.en:
The Board is providing notice as required by Bylaw 2.12 of the Annual Meeting of WCA members which will be held on October 17 at 18:00 UTC. Members will be able to tune into this meeting via a livestream hosted on the WCA Twitch. In this folder you will find the information packet related to the annual meeting which contains all relevant documentation that will be discussed at the meeting.

We look forward to your participation in the upcoming annual meeting.

title.zh: WCA 比赛要求政策和会费政策更新（2021 年 9 月）
title.en: Updates on WCA Competition Requirements Policy & WCA Dues Policy (September 2021)

html.zh:
WCA 董事会近日批准了以下政策的更新：

  • WCA 比赛要求政策：新增对系列赛的介绍，扩大其适用范围，并对原有章节作出多项调整。完整改动列表见此处。
  • WCA 会费政策：改动将于 2022 年 1 月 1 日生效，具体内容见此处。
html.en:
The WCA Board has recently approved the updates to the following policies:

  • WCA Competition Requirements Policy - Includes an introduction and increased scope of series competitions and a variety of adjustments to previously created sections. The full list of changes can be found here.
  • WCA Dues Policy - These changes will take effect starting January 1, 2022 and can be viewed here.

title.zh: 招募 WCA 道德委员会成员（2021 年 9 月）

html.zh:
WCA 道德委员会（WEC）正在招募新成员，一起完成委员会的工作！所有人都可以申请，不要求申请者目前已在 WCA 任职。

WEC 负责什么？

  • 维护和更新《道德准则》。
  • 确保 WCA 工作人员遵循的各项程序符合《道德准则》。
  • 对 WCA 工作人员不遵守《道德准则》的情况开展独立调查。
  • 作为提出调查请求的注册速拧选手的可信赖联系人。
  • 若相关方不接受 WCA 纪律委员会的决定，担任上诉机构。

WEC 的正式权利与职责载于 WCA 议案 10.2021.4。

我们希望候选人具备以下条件：

  • 无不良记录。
  • 能合理安排自己的时间。
  • 能够讨论观点并说明理由。
  • 熟悉 WCA 的工作与活动。

申请期从即日起至 2021 年 10 月 3 日 23:59 UTC，请将材料发送给 Blake Thompson（bthompson@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：

  • 简短的个人介绍。
  • 曾在魔方社区开展的工作概述。
  • 申请加入 WEC 的原因。

申请者会及时收到确认收件的回复，之后可能获邀参加面试。如对申请有疑问，可联系 Blake Thompson（bthompson@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请期结束后，WEC 负责人将选出人选，在申请者接受职位后公布新成员名单。

感谢大家的申请与支持！
html.en:
The WCA Ethics Committee (WEC) is seeking new members to help them with their mission! The applications are open to everyone; it’s not a requirement to hold a current position in the WCA to be considered.

What does the WEC do?

  • Maintaining and updating the Code of Ethics.
  • Ensures that all procedures followed by WCA Staff abide by the Code of Ethics.
  • Performs independent investigations if any WCA Staff member is not compliant with said Code of Ethics.
  • Confidant for Registered Speedcubers that request investigations.
  • Functions as the board of appeal if any involved party disagrees with a decision made by the WCA Disciplinary Committee.

The official rights and duties of the WEC are documented in WCA Motion 10.2021.4.

The qualities and requirements expected of candidates are:

  • Clear background
  • Personal time management skills
  • Ability to discuss reasoning and ideas
  • Familiarity with WCA activities

The application period is open for applicants to submit their application documents from now until October 3rd, 2021, 23:59 UTC to Blake Thompson (bthompson@worldcubeassociation.org).

Candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

  • A brief personal introduction
  • Summary of activities done within the cubing community
  • Motivation for applying to join the WEC

Applicants can expect an immediate reply to confirm the receipt of the application, and may later receive a request to be interviewed. Anyone with questions about applying can contact Blake Thompson (bthompson@worldcubeassociation.org).

After the application period, the WEC Leader will make a selection and the new members will be announced once applicants have accepted the positions.

Thank you for your candidacies and support!

title.zh: 《比赛安全政策》调整（2021 年 9 月）

html.zh:
过去几个月，WCA 董事会与高级代表进行了长时间讨论，并听取了更多工作人员的意见。董事会现决定对《比赛安全政策》（WCSP）作出以下调整：

  1. 比赛能否公告，将依据当地要求和法律规定判断，不再以病例数为依据。WCA 认可比赛的主办方、代表和选手必须遵守相关的当地要求和法律。
  2. 无需施加限制的门槛仍为每百万人口 1 例（7 日滚动平均）。
  3. 比赛仍应遵守 WCSP。任何偏离 WCSP 的做法或豁免，都必须由比赛代表通过安全报审程序提交，并获得高级代表或地区代表批准。

部分地区的情况正逐步改善，已足以举办比赛。请大家耐心等待，让当地代表和主办方弄清安全办赛需要遵循哪些新流程。即使条件允许，比赛也未必会立即恢复；恢复后，安排方式也可能与新冠疫情前不同。过渡期间，需要社区成员共同适应。

感谢大家一直以来的理解，希望未来能在比赛中再次见到你们！
html.en:
After many hours of discussions amongst the WCA Board, Senior Delegates, and hearing wider Staff feedback over the past months, the Board will be changing the Competition Safety Policy (WCSP) in the following ways:

  1. Local requirements and legislation will take the place of case counts in announcement determination. Relevant local requirements and legislations must be followed by organizers, Delegates, and competitors of WCA-recognized competitions.
  2. 1 case per million population (7-day rolling average) will still remain as the restrictionless limit.
  3. Competitions are still expected to follow the WCSP. For any deviations or exemptions from the WCSP, the Senior Delegate or Regional Delegate must approve these via the safety submission by the Delegate of the competition.

As conditions are starting to improve in areas well enough to hold a competition, we ask for your patience as local Delegates and organizers understand what new procedures will need to be followed to run a competition safely. Competitions may not return immediately once they are able and when they do, they may not be set up in the way competitions were run before COVID-19 was prevalent, so the community’s adaptability will be needed in this time of transition.

We thank you for your understanding so far and we hope to see you at our competitions again in the future!

title.zh: 《打乱责任政策》发布（2021 年 8 月）

html.zh:
WCA 质量保证委员会与 WCA 规则委员会（WRC）讨论合作，并征求董事会、高级代表及委员会/团队负责人的意见后，现已实施《打乱责任政策》。

这份政策规定了 WCA 官方打乱必须遵循的管理标准，由 WRC 负责执行。政策面向 WCA 代表和比赛组织团队，通过打乱公式、打乱操作及场地布置的标准，说明如何保障打乱的公正与保密。

欢迎通过 WCA 论坛发帖，或发邮件至 quality@worldcubeassociation.org，提出意见和问题。
html.en:
The WCA Quality Assurance Committee has implemented the Scramble Accountability Policy through discussion and collaboration with the WCA Regulations Committee (WRC) and feedback from the Board, Senior Delegates, and Committee/Team Leaders.

The purpose of this policy is to define standards of how official WCA Scrambles must be treated and will be enforced by the WRC. The policy is targeted towards WCA Delegates and competition organization teams for giving instructions on how they ensure scramble integrity through the standards of scrambles and scrambling, and venue setup standards.

We welcome your thoughts and questions through a post on the WCA Forum or an email to quality@worldcubeassociation.org.

title.zh: WCA 成绩团队招募负责人（2021 年 8 月）

html.zh:
Sébastien Auroux 担任 WCA 成绩团队负责人的任期已满，WCA 将任命新的 WCA 成绩团队（WRT）负责人。感谢 Sébastien 至今在这一岗位上所做的工作。

所有 WCA 成员均可申请，无需目前在 WCA 任职。

申请人应能完成 24 个月任期，并平均每周至少投入 5 小时处理团队事务。我们希望申请人具备：

  • 出色的领导能力。
  • 注重细节。
  • 分析思考能力。
  • SQL（MySQL）及编程经验会有帮助，但并非硬性要求。

申请从即日起开放，截止时间为 2021 年 9 月 1 日 23:59 UTC。有意者请私下将材料发送至 WCA 董事会（board@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，包含：

  • 简短的个人介绍。
  • 为 WCA 所做工作的概述。
  • 担任 WCA 成绩团队负责人的工作设想。

另请提供一份可在申请截止后公开的申请材料副本。

WRT 的权利与职责见 WCA 议案 01.2021.10。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将通过投票选出新负责人，并按照 WCA 议案 10.2021.0 第 4 节，经高级代表及现任委员会、团队负责人投票确认后公布。

感谢大家的申请与支持。
html.en:
There will be an appointment of a new WCA Results Team (WRT) Leader, as Sébastien Auroux's term has expired in his position as the Leader of the Team. We would like to thank Sébastien for the work he has done in this position so far.

The application is open to all WCA members. Potential applicants do not have to hold a current position to be considered.

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 5 hours per week on average to work for the committee. The qualities expected of candidates are:

  • Strong leadership skills
  • Attention to detail
  • Analytical thinking
  • Experience with SQL (MySQL) and programming are beneficial, but not strictly mandatory

The application period for candidates to submit their candidacy documents is from now until September 1st, 2021, 23:59 UTC. Interested candidates can send the application privately to the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).

The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

  • Brief personal introduction.
  • Summary of activities done for the WCA.
  • Ambitions as the WRT Leader of the WCA.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WRT can be found in WCA Motion 01.2021.10.

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of WCA Motion 10.2021.0.

Thank you for your candidacies and support.

title.zh: 比赛公示规定（2021 年 8 月）

html.zh:
WCA 董事会决定，比赛审批须遵循以下指引：

参考数据：https://ourworldindata.org/coronavirus

所在国家每百万人病例数低于 1：

  • 高级代表可批准比赛不受相关限制举办，即组织者不必遵循 WCA 比赛安全政策中“比赛举办”一节的要求。
  • 高级代表在批准不受限制的比赛前，应考虑感染更普遍地区的人员前来参赛的可能性。

所在国家每百万人病例数低于 50：

  • 高级代表可批准比赛。
  • 应审查比赛安全方案，确认其已考虑 WCA 比赛安全政策中“比赛举办”一节的要求。
  • 获批人数上限最多为每 2 平方米 1 名到场人员（每 4 平方米 1 名选手）。
  • 如果每百万人病例数升至 50 以上但未超过 100，除确认安全方案足以应对病例增加外，无须采取其他行动。

所在国家每百万人病例数低于 100：

  • 比赛由董事会负责审批。
  • 比赛安全方案将通过我们的 Google 表单链接提交审查，方案应完整涵盖 WCA 比赛安全政策中“比赛举办”一节的要求。
  • 获批人数上限最多为每 3 平方米 1 名到场人员（每 6 平方米 1 名选手）。
  • 如果在赛前两周至赛前 7 天这段时间内，每百万人病例数升至 100 以上，比赛将被取消，符合下一节条件的情况除外。

所在国家每百万人病例数低于 200：

  • 如果所在国家每百万人病例数超过 100，将不再公示新的比赛。
  • 已公示的比赛，须同时符合以下 3 项要求方可继续举办：
    • 超过 50% 的人口已接种第一剂新冠疫苗。
    • 所有到场人员均须在比赛前至少 14 天完成最后一剂新冠疫苗接种，或出示比赛开始前不超过 96 小时内的新冠检测阴性证明。组织者／代表必须在每名到场人员进入场馆前核验相关证明。
    • 比赛全程严格遵守 WCA 比赛安全政策的所有要求。
  • 如果在赛前两周至赛前 7 天这段时间内，每百万人病例数升至 200 以上，比赛一律取消。
html.en:
The WCA Board has decided on the following guidelines in order for a competition to be approved:

Reference: https://ourworldindata.org/coronavirus

Country case counts less than 1 per million:

  • Senior Delegate may approve the competition restrictionless meaning the organizers do not need to follow the ‘holding of competitions’ section of the WCA Competition Safety Policy
  • Senior Delegates should consider the ability to travel from areas of more prevalent infection before approving a competition as restrictionless.

Country case counts less than 50 per million:

  • Senior Delegate may approve the competition
  • Competition safety plan should be reviewed showing consideration for the ‘holding of competitions’ section of the WCA Competition Safety Policy
  • A competitor limit may be approved to a maximum of 1 attendee per 2 square meters (1 competitor per 4 square meters)
  • No action is required if case numbers rise above 50 per million (unless case counts exceed 100 per million) except checking that the safety plan is suitable for the increased number

Country case counts less than 100 per million:

  • Board will be in charge of competition approvals
  • Competition safety plan will be reviewed through our google form link and the plan should completely cover the ‘holding of competitions’ section of the WCA competition safety policy
  • Competitions will be approved up to a maximum of 1 attendee per 3 square meters (1 competitor per 6 square meters)
  • If case numbers rise above 100 per million in the period of 2 weeks to 7 days before the competition then it will be cancelled except for when the following section applies.

Country case counts less than 200 per million:

  • No new competitions will be announced if the country is above 100 per million cases.

  • Already announced competitions may proceed provided they meet the following 3 requirements:

    • Greater than 50% of the population has received the first dose of a COVID-19 vaccine.
    • All attendees are required to have received the final dose of a COVID-19 vaccine at least 14 days before the competition or show a negative COVID-19 test from no more than 96 hours before the start of the competition. The organizer/Delegates must verify proof of this from all attendees before they enter the venue
    • All points in the WCA Competition Safety Policy are to be strictly adhered to throughout the duration of the competition.

  • If case numbers rise above 200 per million in the period of 2 weeks to 7 days before the competition then it will be cancelled without exception.

title.zh: 2021 年 WCA 世锦赛取消

html.zh:
各位社区成员：

我们十分遗憾地通知大家，今年将不再举办 WCA 世锦赛。

本周，核心团队和 WCA 董事会作出了一个不得不作出的决定：取消本届世锦赛。让一直期待这场比赛的大家失望了，我们非常抱歉。

此前很长一段时间，我们都相信延期后的阿尔梅勒世锦赛能够如期举行。但最近的情况表明，这已不再现实。

WCA 世锦赛的目标之一，是吸引尽可能多的国家的选手参加。许多选手通常会长途旅行，往往还会与家人一同前来。因此，我们认为，选手一旦报名并预订行程，就应尽可能确信比赛能够举行。

遗憾的是，距离原定比赛日期已不足五个月，我们仍无法给出这种把握。荷兰政府对大型活动的规定依然不确定，几乎每周都在变动；新增阳性人数一旦上升，已经放宽的措施又会重新收紧。通常，取消人员密集的活动是最先采取、也是最后解除的措施。

此外，国际旅行仍受到很大限制和严格管理。即使已完成疫苗接种，往往也需要检测。许多国家不建议出行，或要求旅行者隔离。已有几位顶尖魔友告诉我们，由于这些限制，他们不会参加世锦赛。我们无法左右这些措施，世锦赛也不会获得例外待遇。

即使到了 12 月一切看起来有所好转，只要新增阳性人数上升，或部分国家不建议前往荷兰，我们仍可能不得不取消比赛。比赛具体条件也很不确定：我们可能需要每天为选手和观众进行检测，还必须面对选手或工作人员在世锦赛期间感染、无法继续参赛或履行工作职责的风险。

这意味着，我们目前在荷兰举办大型锦标赛的计划正式结束。明年，各洲锦标赛将在哥本哈根、墨尔本、巴西利亚、开普敦、塞梅和多伦多举行。下一届世锦赛将在韩国首尔举行。祝各主办团队筹备顺利。

我们一心想办出有史以来最好的世锦赛，带给大家精彩的体验。作为主办团队，我们当然非常失望，但遗憾的是，现实如此。感谢所有为本届世锦赛付出的人，大家一起投入了大量心血。衷心感谢，能与你们共事是我们的荣幸。
html.en:
Dear community,

It is with the deepest regret that we inform you that there will be no WCA World Championship this year.

This week, the core team and the WCA Board came to the inevitable conclusion that we must cancel the championship. We are very sorry that we have to disappoint everyone who was looking forward to this event.

For a long time we were confident that the (postponed) championship in Almere could go ahead. However, the recent developments show us that this is no longer a realistic scenario.

One of the goals of the WCA World Championships is to have participants from as many countries as possible. Traditionally many of these participants travel a long distance, often with their families, to attend the event. Therefore we think that we should give the participants maximum confidence that the competition will take place, once they have registered and booked their trips.

Unfortunately now with less than five months before the planned dates of the World Championship we cannot give that confidence. We have to deal with ongoing uncertainty surrounding government regulations for major events in The Netherlands. Regulations are changing by the week and measures that have been relieved are again taken once the number of new positive tests is increasing. Usually the first measure to be taken is to cancel events with many attendants and such a measure is the last to be relieved again.

In addition to that, international travelling is still very limited and highly regulated. Even people who are fully vaccinated often need to be tested. Many countries have negative travel advice or require quarantaine when travelling. We know from several top cubers that they were not going to attend the World Championship because of these limitations. We have no control over these measures and no exceptions will be made for our World Championship.

Even if in December everything is looking better, there will still be a real risk that we have to cancel the competition if the number of new positive tests is increasing or if some countries give negative travel advice for The Netherlands. The conditions for the competition are also quite uncertain: we may be required to do daily testing for competitors and visitors. We have to deal with the risk of competitors and/or staff getting infected during the championship and not being able to participate or do their staff duties.

This definitively puts an end to our current plans for a large championship in The Netherlands. Next year there will be the continental championships in Copenhagen, Melbourne, Brasilia, Cape Town, Semey and Toronto. The next World Championship will be in Seoul, Korea. We wish the organizing teams the best of luck.

We wanted nothing more than to organize the best World Championship ever and give you a fantastic experience. As the organizing team, we are of course very disappointed. But it is what it is, unfortunately. We thank everyone who contributed to this championship. Together we put an enormous amount of effort into this. Many thanks, it was a pleasure to work with you.

title.zh: WCA 论坛精选（2021 年 7 月）

html.zh:
WCA 论坛于去年启用，旨在让社区成员就 WCA 的工作发表意见。至今已有超过 10,000 名成员，发布了 4,000 多篇不同帖子，讨论新提案和现有政策。在这期双月简报中，我们整理了过去几个月里一些有意思的话题，欢迎大家有空时阅读。

许瑞航的三阶平均 5.48 秒 许瑞航今年接连打破多项纪录，最终从 Feliks Zemdegs 手中拿下三阶平均世界纪录，引起了世界魔方圈的关注。这是首个低于 5.50 秒的平均成绩，对中国魔方社区乃至整个速拧运动都有重要意义。

2020 年对魔方社区的影响 受新冠疫情影响，2020 年和 2021 年的 WCA 比赛数量大幅下降。这篇帖子讨论了经常参赛的魔友在没有比赛的日子里如何度过。

2023 年 WCA 世锦赛举办地公告 遴选委员会选定韩国首尔举办 2023 年 WCA 世锦赛。时隔 12 年，世锦赛终于将重返亚洲。再过一个月，计划在荷兰阿尔梅勒举行的 2021 年世锦赛也将开放报名，请留意相关消息！

2021 年规则修改 WCA 规则委员会完成了年度规则更新。委员会从这篇 WCA 论坛帖子中收集反馈和建议，供修订时参考。具体修改可在 WCA GitHub 上查看。

美国恢复魔方比赛 魔方比赛规模最大的国家终于恢复举办 WCA 比赛。新冠疫情导致赛事停摆一年多后，美国开始重新组织比赛。

如有问题、意见或建议，请发送邮件至 advisory@worldcubeassociation.org，或直接参与帖子讨论！

感谢每一位论坛参与者，感谢大家分享重要反馈、为讨论补充有价值的意见。
html.en:
Starting last year, the WCA Forum was designed for community members to give their insight on actions within the WCA. We have had over 10,000 members and more than 4,000 unique posts since which covered discussions on new WCA proposals and existing WCA policies. In this bi-monthly digest, we have summarized some interesting topics on the Forum in the last couple of months. Feel free to view the threads below at your leisure.

Ruihang Xu’s 5.48 3x3 Average Ruihang Xu swept the world by breaking an incredible amount of records this year and finally grabbing the 3x3 average world record from Feliks Zemdegs. This is a monumental achievement for the Chinese community and speedcubing as a whole, being the first average under 5.50 seconds.

Impact of the year 2020 on the cubing community The years 2020 and 2021 saw a big slump in the number of WCA competitions due to the COVID-19 pandemic. This thread saw discussions on how regular WCA competitors are coping when there are no competitions to attend.

WCA Championship 2023 Hosts Announcement The city of Seoul in the Republic of Korea was selected by a selection committee to host WCA World Championship 2023. After 12 years, Worlds will finally return to Asia. In a month's time, the registration for World Championship 2021 will open up which will take place in Almere, Netherlands. Keep an eye out for that news as well!

Changes in 2021 Regulations The yearly WCA regulations update was done by the WCA Regulations Committee. Feedback and suggestions are taken from this WCA Forum thread for consideration by the committee. More details of the changes can be viewed on the WCA Github here.

Return of Cubing Competitions in the US The biggest country for cubing is finally resuming WCA competitions. After the COVID-19 pandemic caused a break for over a year, the US is starting to organize competitions again.

If you have any questions, comments, or feedback, please send an email to advisory@worldcubeassociation.org or participate in the discussions on the threads yourself!

Thanks to everyone for being a part of the Forum by sharing important feedback and adding value to the discussions.

title.zh: WCA 档案团队招募成员（2021 年 7 月）

html.zh:
WCA 正在整理和保存组织创立以来的历史，以及一路走来各个重要节点的记录。为此，我们向大家介绍专门负责这项工作的 WCA 档案团队（WAT）！团队正在招募成员参与相关项目，希望各地区都有人加入，提高工作的效率。所有人均可申请，无需目前在 WCA 任职。

你是否好奇早期魔友的经历？想挖掘过去的魔方故事，从新的角度讲述它们？想进一步了解 WCA 的过去与未来？如果答案是肯定的，你可能很适合加入 WAT！

WAT 负责什么？

  • 收集并归档与 WCA 过去及未来有关的信息和影音资料，例如纪录与重要节点、大型锦标赛及活动、地区组织等。
  • 利用档案制作文字和视觉内容，用于 WCA 网站、其他平台和大型魔方活动，让不同受众更好地了解 WCA 与魔方。
  • 持续更新档案，与组织者及其他团队合作开展社区项目，保存 WCA 的历史。

WAT 目前是根据 WCA 章程第 5.3 节成立的顾问委员会。不会另在议案或委员会／团队页面为该团队建立更多文件。

我们希望成员具备：

  • 细心，回复及时。
  • 良好的人际沟通能力，并愿意学习。
  • 较好的英语水平。
  • 熟悉 WCA 活动。

以下能力会有帮助，但并非必需：

  • 熟练掌握其他语言。
  • 叙事写作、创意写作或任何形式的新闻工作经验。

预计每周投入约 4–6 小时。

申请从即日起开放，请于 2021 年 8 月 1 日 23:59 UTC 前将材料发送给 William Gan（wgan@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，包含：

  • 简短的个人介绍。
  • 参与 WCA／魔方社区的经历。
  • 加入 WAT 的动机。
  • （选填）其他与 WAT 工作有关的经验。

收到申请后，我们会回复确认。在申请期间及截止后的两周内，入围者可能受邀参加面试。如对 WAT 或申请流程有疑问，请联系 William Gan（wgan@worldcubeassociation.org）。

感谢大家的申请与支持！
html.en:
The WCA is making efforts to preserve the history of how our organization began and the important milestones we have reached along the way to where we are today. As a part of this mission, we would like to introduce the WCA Archive Team (WAT) which will be the team of people focused on this work! Currently, the team is seeking new members to help work on their projects. They hope to have members that can represent each region to make their work more efficient. The application is open to everyone; it's not a requirement to hold a current position in the WCA to be considered.

Curious about the experiences of cubers back then? Interested in uncovering past cubing stories and retelling them in a new light? Want to discover more of the WCA's past and future? If you said yes, then you may be a great fit for the WAT!

What does the WAT do?

  • Gather and archive information and media relevant to the WCA past and future e.g., records/milestones, major championships/events, regional organizations, etc.
  • Create textual and visual content using the archive to be implemented on the WCA website, other platforms, and at major cubing events to better engage all audiences on the topic of the WCA and cubing.
  • Update the archive and work with organizers and other teams in community projects to preserve the WCA's legacy.

The WAT is currently an Advisory Committee created under Section 5.3 of the WCA Bylaws. There won't be any further documentation created regarding this team in the Motions or on the Committees/Teams page.

Members are expected to have:

  • Great attention to detail and responsiveness
  • Interpersonal skills and desire to learn
  • Decent level of proficiency in English
  • Familiarity with WCA activities

Other qualities which are useful to have but are not required include:

  • Proficiency in another language(s)
  • Experience in narrative/creative writing or any form of journalism

The expected workload is around 4-6 hours per week.

The application period is open for applicants to submit their application document from now until August 1st 2021 23:59 UTC to William Gan (wgan@worldcubeassociation.org).

The application document must be in PDF format, and should include:

  • A brief personal introduction
  • A summary of your involvement with the WCA/cubing community
  • Your motivation to join the WAT
  • (Optional) Any additional experience relevant to WAT work

Applicants can expect a reply to confirm the receipt of their application. During and up until two weeks after the application period, shortlisted applicants may be invited for an interview. If you have any questions about the WAT or the application process, please contact William Gan (wgan@worldcubeassociation.org).

Thank you in advance for your applications and support!

title.zh: TNoodle 发布 macOS 问题修复版本

html.zh:
TNoodle 刚刚发布了一个问题修复版本。随着比赛逐步恢复，多位代表反馈：TNoodle 1.1.0 在 macOS Big Sur 及更高版本中会在启动后立即崩溃。

我们在 TNoodle 1.1.1 中修复了这一问题，同时修正了最少步裁切纸张的一处细小不一致。新版本还加入了世界语翻译。完整更新说明请见 GitHub。

为了让受影响的代表能够为比赛生成打乱，TNoodle 1.1.1 已立即获准使用。不过，打乱算法并未改变，因此已用 TNoodle 1.1.0 生成的打乱仍然有效。

旧版将有约两周的过渡期。截至 7 月 25 日星期日（含当日），仍可使用 TNoodle 1.1.0。所有在此日期之后结束的比赛，均须使用 TNoodle 1.1.1 生成打乱。

请记得，最新版打乱程序的下载地址始终为 https://worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/.

请大家注意安全。

Gregor，代表 WST
html.en:
There has just been a new bugfix release for TNoodle. With competitions slowly returning, several Delegates reported issues with TNoodle 1.1.0 crashing directly after launch on macOS versions "Big Sur" and later. We fixed this bug in TNoodle 1.1.1, along with a minor inconsistency in FMC cutout sheets. There is also a brand new Esperanto translation; please refer to GitHub for the full release notes.

In order to enable the affected Delegates to generate scrambles for their competitions, TNoodle 1.1.1 has been promoted immediately. However, please note that the scrambling routines have not changed, which means that scrambles which have already been generated with TNoodle 1.1.0 remain valid.

There will be a phase-out of roughly two weeks. You may continue to use TNoodle 1.1.0 up to and including Sunday, July 25. All scrambles for competitions ending after that date must be generated with TNoodle 1.1.1.

Please remember that the latest version of the scramble program is always available at https://worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/.

Stay safe,

  • Gregor on behalf of the WST

title.zh: WCA 市场推广团队成员招募（2021 年 5 月）

html.zh:
WCA 市场推广团队正在招募新成员！

WCA 市场推广团队做什么？

WMT 负责维护 WCA 与外部合作伙伴的关系，并参与 WCA 品牌相关工作，包括周边商品、社交媒体互动和市场调研。

根据动议 10.2021.7.1，WCA 市场推广团队负责发展和管理 WCA 品牌、寻找赞助、协助分发 WCA 比赛器材，以及推广 WCA 周边商品。

本次重点招募以下三个方向的成员：

  • WCA 器材组（仅限美国居民）：
    • WCA 器材组负责分发通过 Speed Stacks 提供的 WCA 比赛器材。你的主要职责是将世界各地代表的订单提交给 Speed Stacks，并确保器材送到代表手中。由于 Speed Stacks 仅在美国境内发货，非美国代表下单时，需要你代为收货和转寄。
  • 市场调研与周边商品：
    • WCA 和 WMT 正在加紧建设 WCA 品牌商品销售平台。我们希望招募有周边商品设计或网店搭建经验的成员。这是平面设计师为 WCA 品牌出力的好机会，你将与 WCA 沟通团队中的其他平面设计师密切合作，推出新的设计。
  • 赞助与合同：
    • 我们希望招募有相关经验或有兴趣为 WCA 寻找全球及地方赞助机会的成员。特别欢迎曾为自己组织的比赛或所在地区组织争取赞助的人申请，一同参与 WCA 的未来发展。

你可以针对上述某个方向申请，也可以表示愿意参与其中一个或多个方向；这三项工作并不互斥。

所有 WCA 成员均可申请，申请者不必目前在 WCA 担任职务。

申请要求

  • 对推广 WCA 品牌有兴趣及／或相关经验。
  • 每周能投入约 5 至 10 小时。
  • 有创意，能与团队合作。
  • 熟悉周边商品、赞助或供应商管理者优先。

申请者须提交 PDF 格式的申请材料，包括简短的个人介绍、参与 WCA 或 WCA 地区组织的经历、申请加入 WMT 的原因，以及希望在 WMT 内参与的具体小组。

申请自即日起开放，请于 2020 年 6 月 26 日 23:59 UTC 前发送至 sgrover@worldcubeassociation.org。
html.en:
The WCA Marketing Team is seeking new members!

What does the WCA Marketing Team Do?

The WMT is responsible for managing WCA relationships with external partners as well as working closely on the WCA Brand, including WCA merchandise, social media engagement and market research.

According to Motion 10.2021.7.1, The WCA Marketing Team is responsible for developing and managing the WCA Brand, seeking sponsorships, supporting the distribution of WCA Competition Gear, and marketing WCA Merchandise.

We are seeking members for three specific fields:

  • WCA Gear Team (US Residents only)
  • The WCA Gear Team is responsible for managing the distribution of WCA Tournament equipment, available from Speedstacks. Your primary responsibility would be to place orders made by Delegates around the world to Speed Stacks, and ensure that they are delivered back to the delegates. In cases where international (non-US) delegates are placing orders, you will have to receive and forward them due to the limitation of Speed Stacks shipping within the US.
  • Market Research & Merchandising:
  • The WCA and WMT are rapidly approaching the creation of a merchandising platform for WCA branded products. We are looking for members who have experience in either Designing Merchandise, or creating online Merchandise stores. This is a great opportunity for graphic designers to contribute to the WCA brand. You will work closely with other WCA Graphic Designers in the WCA Communications team to develop fresh designs.
  • Sponsorships & Contracts
  • We are looking for members who have experience, or interest in exploring potential opportunities for sponsorships for the WCA (global and local scales). Candidates who have worked on getting sponsorships for competitions they have organized, or regional organizations they have been part of are strongly encouraged to apply and shape the future of the WCA.

Please note that your application can be tailored to one of these 3 fields, or you could instead express interest in one or more of the three (they are not exclusive).

The application is open to all WCA members. Potential applicants do not have to hold a current position to be considered.

Requirements for Applicants

  • Interest and/or experience in Marketing the WCA Brand
  • Approximate 5 - 10 Hours time commitment per week
  • Creative mind, and the ability to work within a team
  • Familiarity in dealing with merchandising/sponsorships/vendor management is a plus

Applicants should submit a PDF application including a brief personal introduction, their involvement with the WCA or WCA regional organizations, their motivation for applying to the WMT and the specific team(s) they would like to work in within the WMT.

Applications should be sent to sgrover@worldcubeassociation.org from now until June 26th, 2020, 23:59 UTC to be considered.

title.zh: WCA 软件团队负责人招募（2021 年 5 月）

html.zh:
WCA 将任命一位新的软件团队（WST）负责人。申请面向所有 WCA 成员开放，无须目前已在组织中任职。

申请人应能完成 24 个月的任期，并平均每周为团队工作至少 10 小时。我们希望申请人具备以下条件：

  • 扎实的专业技术能力。
  • 良好的沟通能力。
  • 解决问题的能力。
  • 能围绕目标开展工作。
  • 项目管理经验。

申请材料提交截止时间为 2021 年 6 月 1 日 23:59 UTC。有意者请将申请私下发送给 WCA 董事会（board@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，包含：

  • 简短的自我介绍。
  • 为 WCA 所做工作的总结。
  • 担任 WCA 软件团队负责人的工作设想。

此外，请提供一份可在申请期结束后公开的申请材料。

WST 的权利和职责见 WCA 决议 10.2021.11。

申请期结束后，WCA 董事会将投票选定人选，经高级代表和现任委员会/团队负责人投票确认后公布。流程见 WCA 决议 10.2021.0第 4 节。

感谢大家的申请与支持。
html.en:
There will be an appointment of a new WCA Software Team (WST) Leader. The application is open to all WCA members. Potential applicants do not have to hold a current position to be considered.

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 10 hours per week on average to work for the Team. The qualities expected of candidates are:

  • Strong technical expertise
  • Good communication
  • Problem solving skills
  • Goal-oriented
  • Project management experience

The application period is open for candidates to submit their candidacy documents until June 1st, 2021, 23:59 UTC. Interested candidates can send the application privately to the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).

The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

  • Brief personal introduction.
  • Summary of activities done for the WCA.
  • Ambitions as the WST Leader of the WCA.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WST can be found in WCA Motion 10.2021.11.

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of WCA Motion 10.2021.0.

Thanks for your candidacies and support.

title.zh: TNoodle 1.1.0 发布

html.zh:
TNoodle-WCA-1.1.0 现已发布，可在 https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles 获取。

相较于 TNoodle-WCA-1.0.1，主要可见改动如下：

  • 修复打开翻译时会触发打乱生成的问题
  • 修复最少步翻译取消选择后仍会打印的问题
  • 为各项目增加进度条
  • 修复生成包含非 ASCII 字符的 PDF 时可能出现的问题
  • 修复影响 TNoodle 发布的问题（因此本次没有一周的过渡期；近期比赛的负责代表已提前收到通知）
  • 令牌过期后退出登录
  • 生成打乱期间禁用用户操作（shzcuber 的首次贡献）
  • 增加可折叠侧栏（JonEsparaz 的首次贡献）
  • 赛程有误时跳过按顺序整理的打乱，而不是让整个流程失败
  • 修正部分提示中的空格
  • 含最少步项目的比赛只生成 1 张空白纸，而不是每轮生成 1 张，避免重复
  • 修复部分亚洲语言的最少步纸张翻译错误（此前未被报告的问题）

完整改动列表见此处。

请注意，正式比赛必须使用当前版本的官方打乱程序。最新版始终可在 https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles 获取。
html.en:
TNoodle-WCA-1.1.0 is now available from https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles

Main visible changes that have been made since TNoodle-WCA-1.0.1:

  • Fixed bug that triggered scrambles when opening translations
  • Fixed bug that would print deselected FMC translations
  • Add progress bar to each event
  • Fixed bug that could occur while generating PDFs with non ASCII characters
  • Fixed bug affecting TNoodle releases (this bug was responsible for we having no week phase out this time; delegates responsible for the nearest competitions were told about this in advance)
  • Logout after token expiration
  • Freeze human interaction while generating scrambles (first contribution by shzcuber)
  • Add collapsing sidebar (first contribution by JonEsparaz)
  • Skip ordered scrambles if schedule is broken instead of failing the whole process
  • Fix spaces in some messages
  • Generate only 1 empty sheet for competitions with FMC (as opposed to 1 per round, which was redundant)
  • Fix (unreported bug) that would translate incorrectly FMC sheets for some Asian languages

A complete list of all changes can be found here.

Please remember that official competitions must use the current version of the official scramble program. This is always available from: https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles

title.zh: WCA 规则更新：2021 年 5 月

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

WRC 在此介绍将于 2021 年 5 月 1 日生效的新版《WCA 规则与指南》。

全部改动可通过 GitHub 上的对比. 点击“Files changed”即可查看《规则》和《指南》的完整文件；修改和新增内容标为绿色，删除内容标为红色。

简化条文

  • 删除已包含在《WCA 比赛要求政策》中的指南 2c1+ 和 2c1++。 (提交 | 讨论)
  • 删除指南 7d+。 (提交 | 讨论)
  • 将“选手区”更名为“选手等候区”。 (提交 | 讨论)

明确责任

  • 在盲拧项目中，选手开始还原尝试时，身体不得接触魔方罩。 (提交 | 讨论)
  • 修改 A2b1 和 F2a，不再严格要求口头告知。 (提交 | 讨论)
  • 要求选手必须在自己签字完成后才可复位计时器，而不只是等裁判签完字。 (提交 | 提交 | 讨论)
  • 允许选手在盲拧项目中对齐各面。 (提交 | 讨论)
  • 明确指南 A7c4+ 的适用方式。 (提交 | 讨论)

其他调整

  • 删除《指南》第 6 章。 (提交 | 讨论)
  • 允许选手在三阶多盲中自行选择使用自备的垫面。 (提交 | 讨论)
  • 允许选手在最少步比赛中使用涂改用品。 (提交 | 讨论)
  • 明确比赛要求。 (提交 | 提交 | 讨论)
  • 明确选手将智能手机放在口袋中的相关规定。 (提交 | 讨论)
  • 删除规则 Y7e1。 (提交)

意外事件裁定

  • 在三阶多盲记忆阶段，如果选手转动魔方，对涉及的魔方单独处罚。 (提交 | 提交 | 讨论 | 意外事件日志)
  • 修订规则 A6e)。 (提交 | 提交 | 讨论 | 意外事件日志)
  • 明确晋级条件。 (提交 | 提交 | 提交 | 讨论 | 意外事件日志)
  • 明确被取消资格的成绩应如何处理。 (提交 | 意外事件日志)
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

The WRC would like to inform you about the versions of the WCA Regulations and Guidelines, which are going into effect May 1, 2021.

You can review all changes in this comparison on GitHub. You can click on “Files changed” to see the complete files of the Regulation and Guidelines, where all changes and additions are marked green and removals are red.

Simplifications

  • Remove Guidelines 2c1+ and 2c1++ which are already in the WCRP. (commit | discussion)
  • Remove Guideline 7d+ from the Guidelines. (commit | discussion)
  • Renaming "Competitors Area" to “Competitor Waiting Area”. (commit | discussion)

Accountability

  • The competitor must have no physical contact with the puzzle cover while starting the attempt on Blindfolded events. (commit | discussion)
  • Modify A2b1 and F2a to not strictly require an announcement. (commit | discussion)
  • Require the competitor to finish signing (not just for the judge to finish signing) before the competitor may reset the timer. (commit | commit | discussion)
  • The competitor may align the faces in Blindfolded events. (commit | discussion)
  • Clarification regarding Guideline A7c4+ use. (commit | discussion)

Miscellaneous

  • Remove Article 6 from the Guidelines. (commit | discussion)
  • Allow for competitors to optionally use a self-supplied “surface” in Multi Blind. (commit | discussion)
  • The competitor may use correction materials for Fewest Moves. (commit | discussion)
  • Clarification regarding competitions requirements. (commit | commit | discussion)
  • Clarification regarding competitors wearing a smartphone on their pockets. (commit | discussion)
  • Removing the Regulation Y7e1. (commit)

Incidents Rulings

  • Multi Blind puzzles are individually penalized if the competitor applies a move during the memorization phase. (commit | commit | discussion | incident log)
  • Regulation A6e) revisement. (commit | commit | discussion | incident log)
  • Clarification regarding advancement conditions. (commit | commit | commit | discussion | incident log)
  • Clarification regarding how disqualifications results should be handled. (commit | incident log)

title.zh: WCA 软件团队招募成员（2021 年 3 月）

html.zh:
WCA 软件团队正在招募新成员！WST 负责开发、扩展和维护各类软件，帮助 WCA 应对社区的持续增长，是组织的重要组成部分。

这些软件包括：

  • 你可能经常访问的 WCA 网站。
  • TNoodle：所有代表在比赛中使用的打乱库及其前端。
  • WCA Live：比赛录入成绩及查看实时成绩的主要平台。

WST 的全部项目均为开源项目，托管在 WCA 的 GitHub 上。

我们欢迎所有人申请，同时也在寻找以下特定岗位的人选。如果你符合条件，请在申请中说明：

  • 项目经理：管理 GitHub 上的任务、问题及优先级，协调 WCA 各团队和委员会的软件需求，并及时向他们通报进展。
  • 前端开发：开发 WCA 网站面向用户的部分，包括正在进行的部分页面 React 迁移工作，改善用户体验与满意度。
  • 开发运维：负责部署方案，处理相关问题并改进现有系统。我们的平台运行于 AWS。

WST 的大多数项目以 Web 为主，所用技术如下：

  • 网站基于 Ruby on Rails 框架，使用 SQL 数据库，部分前端组件用 React 编写。我们希望将更多常用部分迁移到 React，推进网站改版。
    • 这是目前最缺人手的项目。随着 WCA 各团队和委员会不断发展，我们持续收到新的功能需求。
    • 网站相关项目的概况可在此处查看。
  • WCA Live 前端使用 React，后端 GraphQL API 使用 Elixir，参见项目概览文档。
  • TNoodle 分为 Java 编写的打乱库 tnoodle-lib，以及包含 Kotlin 后端和 React 前端的服务器 tnoodle。

你可以查看标有“good first issue”的问题，了解我们对首次参与贡献者的期望。请注意，你不需要已经掌握上述某项或全部技术。申请这一岗位，只需具备软件基础知识，并愿意认真学习。

申请从即日起开放，请于 2021 年 3 月 31 日前将材料发送至 WCA 董事会（board@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，包含：

  • 姓名。
  • 简短的个人介绍。
  • 参与 WCA 事务的经历。
  • 技术背景和经验概述。
  • 作为 WCA 软件团队成员的工作目标。

感谢大家的申请与支持！
html.en:
The WCA Software Team is seeking new members! The WST plays a central role in the WCA by developing, scaling, and maintaining the software solutions that help the organization handle the continuous community growth.

Some examples of such software solutions are:

  • The WCA website, that you are probably browsing on a regular basis.
  • TNoodle, the scrambles library and its frontend, used by all Delegates during competitions.
  • WCA Live, which is the main platform for score taking and getting live results during competitions.

All WST projects are open source and hosted on the organization's GitHub.

While anyone is encouraged to apply, we are also looking for some specific roles - and if you fit these requirements, please let us know in your application:

  • Project Manager: Manage tasks and issues along with priorities on Github as well as managing any software needs from WCA teams/committees and keep them up to date.
  • Client Side Developer: Work on the user-facing parts of the WCA Website including working on the ongoing project of porting parts of the site to React. Enhance user experience and satisfaction.
  • Developer Operations: Work on deployment strategies (our platform runs on AWS) and address any issues/improvements to be made.

Most of the WST projects are web-oriented, which is reflected by the technologies used:

  • The website is written on top of the Ruby on Rails framework (using an SQL database), with some front-end components written in React. We're looking to move forward with its redesign process by migrating more heavily used parts to React.
    • This is by far the most understaffed project, as we constantly receive new feature requests by the various growing WCA teams and committees.
    • You can have a relatively high level idea of website-related projects by taking a look here.
  • WCA Live is written in React for the front-end and Elixir for the backend GraphQL API (checkout its high level documentation).
  • TNoodle is split into a scrambling library written in java (tnoodle-lib), and a server (tnoodle) that contains a Kotlin back-end+React front-end.

All our projects labelled with "good first issue" are those that you could take a look at to get an idea of what we expect from first time contributors. Please note that you do not need to be experienced in any or all aspects of the technologies mentioned here. A fundamental understanding of software as well as willingness and dedication to learn are the only requirements for this position.

The application period is open for candidates to submit their candidacy document from now until March 31st, 2021 to the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).

The candidacy documents must be submitted in PDF format, and should include the following:

  • Your Name
  • A brief personal summary
  • A summary of involvement in the WCA
  • An summary of your technical background and experience
  • Aspirations as a member of the WCA Software Team

Thank you for your applications and support!

title.zh: 2023 WCA 世锦赛及 2022 WCA 大洋洲锦标赛申办通知（2021 年 3 月）
title.en: Applications for WCA World Championship 2023 and WCA Oceania Championship 2022 (March 2021)

html.zh:
WCA 董事会现征集 2023 WCA 世锦赛和 2022 WCA 大洋洲锦标赛的申办方案。

请与你所在国家的代表讨论，确认是否有意愿、有能力申办。请注意，举办这一规模的比赛，在赛前和比赛期间都需要投入大量时间与精力。

WCA 世锦赛仅接受 WCA 认可的地区组织申办。有意申办者，请于 2021 年 5 月 31 日 23:59 UTC 前，私下将申请材料发送至 cgoodyear@worldcubeassociation.org。**材料须以 PDF 格式提交两个版本：**一份包含所有申办细节的完整版，以及一份删去敏感内容（如有）、可供公开的版本。

申请材料至少应包含以下信息：

希望何时举办比赛？

1a. 可选日期。 1b. 比赛天数。 1c. 与世界各地学校假期的重合情况。

希望在本国哪个地方举办比赛？

2a. 城市对外国游客的吸引力，以及可供游览的景点。 2b. 国际、国内及本地交通的便利程度。 2c. 不同价位的酒店或公寓供应情况。 2d. 场馆、面积及布置，包括舞台、观众席、练习桌和附属房间。 2e. 可用技术设施，包括网络、视频直播、灯光和音响。 2f. 可容纳的选手与观众人数。

主办团队和工作人员如何组成？

3a. 核心团队成员。 3b. 核心团队的经验。 3c. 其他参与方。 3d. 本地志愿者的人数和能力；建议约 20% 的选手担任工作人员。 3e. 需要外国代表提供哪些支持。

比赛总预算是多少？

4a. 支出：场租、场馆服务、舞台、设备、装饰、网站、胸牌、挂绳、礼包和奖品等。 4b. 收入：报名费、赞助和地方政府支持等。

这份示例表格列出了大型比赛需要安排和编入预算的部分事项，但并非完整清单。

申请期结束后，WCA 董事会将与申办方面谈，征询其他 WCA 工作人员的意见，并通过投票决定举办地点。如有董事参与某个申办团队，该董事在选拔流程中的职责将由其他人代替，例如高级代表或委员会、团队负责人。

我们希望这些比赛能够体现 WCA 对大型赛事的理念，进一步提高协会的专业水平，为选手提供尽可能好的参赛体验，也为全世界呈现精彩的比赛。

感谢大家的配合，期待收到你们的申办材料！
html.en:
The Board of Directors would like to receive applications for WCA World Championship 2023 and WCA Oceania Championship 2022.

Please discuss with the Delegates in your country whether this is something you are willing and able to pursue. Bear in mind that organizing a competition of this size takes a significant amount of time and effort before and during the competition.

For the WCA World Championship, only a WCA recognized Regional Organization can apply. If you are interested, send your application documents privately to cgoodyear@worldcubeassociation.org before May 31, 2021, 23:59 UTC. Documents must be sent in PDF format in two versions: one full version with all the details for the application, and another version with sensitive details - if any - removed to make public.

Please include in your application documents at least the following information:

When would you like to hold the Championship? 1a. Possible dates 1b. Number of days of the competition. 1c. Overlap with international holiday periods of schools.

Where would you like to hold the Championship in your country? 2a. City should be interesting to visit for foreigners with opportunities for sightseeing. 2b. Ease of international, national, and local travel. 2c. Availability of hotels/apartments with different price categories. 2d. Venue, venue size, and venue setup (stage, audience, tables to practice, side rooms). 2e. Technology available like internet, video streaming, lighting, sound equipment. 2f. Number of competitors and spectators that can be hosted.

What would the organization team and staff look like? 3a. Core team members. 3b. Experience of the core team. 3c. Involvement of other parties. 3d. Quantity and quality of local volunteers (guideline is 20% of competitors should staff). 3e. Required support by foreign Delegates.

What would be the overall budget for the competition? 4a. Cost (venue, venue services, stage, equipment, decorations, website, badges/lanyards/giftpacks, prizes). 4b. Income (registration fees, sponsoring, local government).

Here is an example document with a non-exhaustive list of topics that need to be arranged and budgeted for a large competition.

Once the application period is over, the WCA Board of Directors will interview applicants, consult other WCA Staff members, and vote in order to decide where the Championships will take place. If any Director is involved in a team that sends in an application, they will be replaced in the selection process by another person (for example a Senior Delegate or a Committee/Team Leader).

We are looking for competitions that can reinforce our concept of large WCA competitions, boosting the professionalization of our organization and able to offer the competitors the best possible experience and the world the best possible show.

Thank you in advance for your cooperation and we look forward to viewing your applications!
