title.zh: 2020 年年终寄语

html.zh:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

2020 年即将结束。尽管这一年困难重重，我们仍想与大家分享协会和魔方社区取得的进展。全年比赛数量降至 2010 年以来的最低点；虽然 WCA 比赛公告团队（WCAT）公布了超过 480 场比赛，但受新冠疫情影响，超过 240 场被取消。尽管世界许多地区没有比赛，我们仍要感谢魔方社区一年来的支持。协会的许多工作仍有进展，这些成果离不开工作人员和社区成员在比赛之外为魔方活动投入时间。

今年，我们完成了一些项目，让在线与我们交流的魔友有了更好的体验。WCA 咨询委员会（WAC）于 4 月推出了 WCA 论坛，为社区成员提供了讨论规则、当地社区、官方公告等话题的地方。仅今年就已有约 6,000 条帖子！9 月，WCA 网站首页重新设计，让所有访客都能更方便地找到有用信息，页面也更加友好。

各委员会和团队还开展了其他大型项目，其中许多都花费了大量精力。行为准则正式公开，这是 WEC、WAC、WDC 和 WRC 成员共同完成的成果。虽然提交的比赛成绩较少，WRT 仍努力完成了一项工作，确保数据库中的成绩数据与项目、轮次数据完全一致。WST 在改进网站和其他 WCA 软件之外，还发布了 TNoodle 1.0.1。WMT 推出了首款 WCA 周边商品，为今后推出商品测试供需情况。WQAC 则建立了网站的教学资源页面，并计划继续补充内容。

随着来年情况逐渐改善，WCA 已主动将安全确立为愿景和战略的支柱，始终把选手的健康与安全放在重要位置。2020 年，有 38 场比赛依据比赛安全政策成功举办，证明了这项政策和 2020 年 8 月规则改动的有效性。我们希望，在当地政府解除限制后，通过这些调整和周密筹备，让比赛逐步恢复。我们也在为已公布的 2021 年和 2022 年世界及洲际锦标赛作准备，确保这些赛事优先保障所有到场人员的安全。

与此同时，我们今年推广了超过 200 场线上比赛，让选手可以通过非正式比赛保持手感。我们也很高兴继续与红牛合作，支持其线上世界杯系列赛。今年，WCA 的工作人员队伍也有所壮大：选出了两名新董事和四名委员会、团队负责人，迎来了 22 名新实习代表和 15 名新初级代表，并将 15 名代表晋升为正式代表。

再次感谢所有在 WCA 内外自愿投入时间、帮助魔方运动发展的社区成员。希望我们能在当地赛事及荷兰阿尔梅勒的 2021 年世锦赛上，一同庆祝正式比赛回归。在那之前，请大家注意安全，祝新年快乐！
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

With the close of 2020 drawing near, we would like to share the success of our organization and cubing over the past year, despite the obstacles of the year. The annual number of competitions reached its lowest since 2010 and although the WCAT announced over 480 competitions, over 240 competitions were cancelled due to the COVID-19 pandemic. Despite this, we would like to thank the cubing community for their support over the year, even without the presence of competitions in many parts of the world. There were still many organizational advances for us that would not have been accomplished without dedicated Staff and community members who dedicate their time to cubing beyond competitions.

This year, we were able to accomplish projects that helped us provide a better experience for cubers who interact with us online. The WCA Forum was launched in April by the WAC and has provided a place for community members to discuss topics ranging from Regulations, local communities, official announcements, and much more. There have been around 6,000 posts this year alone! In September, the WCA website homepage was redesigned, making the landing page more inviting and useful for all who use it.

Our Committees and Teams were also hard at work on other large projects over the year, many of which have taken a significant effort to complete. The Code of Conduct was made public, which was a collaborative effort from members of the WEC, WAC, WDC, and WRC. Although there were not as many results coming in from competitions, the WRT still worked hard to complete the project of establishing full consistency among the results data and the events/rounds data in our database. In addition to the many improvements to the website and other WCA software, the WST also released TNoodle 1.0.1. The WMT launched the first piece of WCA merchandise as a test of supply and demand for future launches. Finally, the WQAC created the Education resources page of the website, which they plan to add more to in the future.

As conditions improve over the next year, the WCA has proactively established Safety as a pillar of our Vision and Strategy so that we keep the health and safety of our competitors as a main priority. The Competition Safety Policy was used to hold 38 competitions in 2020 successfully, proving the effectiveness of the Policy and the August 2020 Regulation changes. We are hopeful that these changes will allow us to bring competitions back with careful planning once local government restrictions are lifted. We are also looking ahead to the World and Continental Championships that were announced for 2021 and 2022 to ensure that these events can be held with the prioritization of safety for all who are able to attend.

In the meantime, we have been happy to promote over 200 online competitions this year to allow competitors to keep their cubing skills fresh in an unofficial format. We were also excited to continue our partnership with Red Bull in their online World Cup competition series. We also grew our WCA Staff this year, electing two new Board members, selecting four new Committee/Team Leaders, welcoming 22 new Trainee Delegates and 15 new Junior Delegates, and promoting 15 Delegates to Full status.

Once again, we are thankful for those in our community who volunteer their time to improve cubing through the WCA and elsewhere. Hopefully, we will be able to celebrate the return of official competitions together at local events and World Championship 2021 in Almere, Netherlands. Until then, stay safe and have a happy New Year!

title.zh: 2021 WCA 世锦赛延期通知（2020 年 12 月）

html.zh:
由于全球新冠疫情仍在持续，WCA 董事会与核心主办团队决定，将 WCA 世锦赛推迟至 2021 年 12 月 28–31 日。

我们认为，7 月如期举办世锦赛的可能性正在降低。届时，全球很可能仍有部分防疫限制尚未解除。改到 2021 年 12 月意味着延期 5 个月，这几个月对疫情发展可能至关重要，也能大幅提高我们完整举办一届世锦赛的可能性。

提醒大家，锦标赛日期只有在比赛网站建立、比赛在 WCA 官网公布并显示于比赛列表后，才算正式确认。主办团队的公告可在这里阅读。

感谢理解。希望 2021 年在阿尔梅勒与大家相见，请保重！
html.en:
Because of the ongoing global COVID-19 pandemic, the WCA Board and the core organization team have decided to postpone the WCA World Championship to December 28-31, 2021.

We believe that the chances of carrying out the World Championship in July are decreasing. There is a good chance that in July at least some global restrictions caused by the pandemic will still be in force. A Championship in December 2021 means a postponement of 5 months. These months could be very crucial as far as the pandemic is concerned, and would make it much more likely that we can have a Championship in its own right.

As a reminder, Championship dates are not officially confirmed until the competition website has been created and announced on the WCA website and is shown on the Competitions page. You can read the announcement from the organization team here.

Thanks for your understanding. We hope to see you in 2021 in Almere. Stay safe!

html.en:

The new Code of Conduct can be found here. This document acts as a standard of actions and behaviors of any member of the WCA, including Registered Speedcubers, Competitions Organizers, guests, WCA Officials, and users on the official WCA Forum.

The safety policy has been updated to clarify that the holding of competitions within a region must be able to be done safely and includes a reminder that the Board has the right to cancel a competition if it is no longer safe to hold. The new version of the WCA Competition Safety Policy can be found here.

title.zh: WCA 顾问理事会招募社区代表（2020 年 10 月）

html.zh:
**WCA 顾问理事会（WAC）**正在招募新成员。

本次申请面向所有 WCA 成员。

WAC 是什么，负责哪些工作？

WAC 最重要的职责是在社区与 WCA 工作人员之间沟通，让社区在重要议题的讨论中有发言机会。社区代表是这一过程的重要参与者。WAC 主要职能的更多说明见 WCA 议案 20.2019.01。

理事会下设社区代表和 WCA 代表两个小组。本次招募的是社区代表，他们占理事会多数席位，且不属于 WCA 工作人员。也就是说，除 WCA 工作人员外，任何人都可申请。如果你此前从未在 WCA 担任正式职务，这将是参与改进 WCA 的好机会！

目前，理事会的主要项目包括论坛审核和管理，以及建立收集社区反馈的渠道，为 WCA 提供参考。

我们希望申请人具备：

  • 沟通能力：内部交流使用英语，因此需要中等水平的英语能力。
  • 工作态度：成员须定期参与工作，不能连续多天不理会消息。预计每周需投入 2–4 小时。
  • 改进意识：我们会花较多时间讨论工作方式，收集值得关注的议题。如果你认为 WCA 已经完美无缺，这个岗位可能不适合你。
  • 兴趣：最好喜欢与社区成员讨论 WCA 事务。
  • 成熟的判断：线上讨论应能启发思考、取得实际进展。反馈社区意见时，你代表的是社区，而非个人观点。
  • 擅长的领域：团队希望覆盖社区中的不同群体，因此成员可以部分专注于自己了解、关心的领域，例如某个地区或某类魔友，如高水平／速度较慢的魔友、年轻／年长的魔友。

申请从即日起开放，请于 2020 年 11 月 25 日 23:59 UTC 前将材料发送至 WCA 董事会（board@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，包含：

  • 姓名。
  • 简短的个人介绍。
  • 参与 WCA 事务的经历。
  • 说明自己如何符合所需条件。
  • 作为 WCA 顾问理事会成员的工作目标。

感谢大家的申请与支持！
html.en:
The WCA Advisory Council (WAC) is seeking new members to assist the council.

The application is open to all WCA members.

What is the WAC and what do they do?

The biggest task of the WAC is to be an intermediary between the community and the WCA Staff - to give the community a voice when important topics are being discussed. The Community Representatives are a vital part of that process. More information about the main functions of the WAC can be found here: WCA Motion 20.2019.01

The council has 2 sub-teams - Community Representatives and WCA Representatives. This announcement is for Community Representatives, who make up the majority of the council and are not members of WCA Staff, meaning that anyone except WCA Staff can apply. If you have never held a formal position in the WCA before, this an exciting opportunity to contribute towards making the WCA even better!

Current key projects of the council involve moderation and management of the forum and developing channels to gather community feedback useful for the WCA.

The qualities expected of candidates are:

  • Communication: Internal communication is done in English, so an intermediate standard of English is required.
  • Work Ethic: Members will be expected to contribute regularly and not ignore messages for many days. The expected time commitment is 2-4 hours per week on tasks for the council.
  • Innovation: There will be significant time spent discussing our methods of working and doing a lot of idea gathering of topics to focus on. If you think that the WCA is currently perfect then you probably aren’t the person for this!
  • Interest: An enjoyment to discuss WCA matters among the community is ideal.
  • Maturity: Online discussions will need to be thought-provoking and productive. When providing community feedback you'll be representing the community and not your own views.
  • Specialisations: The goal of the team is to cover a wide spectrum of the community and therefore members can partly focus on certain areas that they are knowledgeable and passionate about. This could be a geographical area, or any sort of “category” of cuber e.g. elite/slower cubers, younger/older cubers.

The application period is open for candidates to submit their candidacy document from now until November 25, 2020, 23:59 UTC to the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).

The candidacy documents must be submitted in PDF format, and should include the following:

  • Your Name
  • A brief personal summary
  • A summary of involvement in the WCA
  • An explanation of how you fit the qualities required
  • Aspirations as a member of the WCA Advisory Council

Thank you in advance for your candidacies and support!

  • 熟练使用英语。

以下能力也会有所帮助：

谢谢大家，祝平安！
html.en:
The WCA Competition Announcement Team (WCAT) is seeking new members! Applications are open to everyone, and community members not currently holding a WCA position are encouraged to apply.

The daily tasks of a WCAT member include:

  • Reviewing and announcing competition submissions with accuracy and correctness.
  • Handling change requests to competitions.
  • Debating and voting with the rest of the Team.

The official rights and duties of the WCAT are documented in WCA Motion 10.2020.2. Please note that the expected workload is around 1 to 1.5 hours per day.

The main qualities of members we are seeking include:

  • A sense of detail.
  • Commitment and solution-oriented to help Delegates in all the requests they can have.
  • Proactiveness in daily communication with the rest of the Team and the Delegates.
  • Good familiarity with the WCA Competition Requirements Policy (WCRP).
  • Sufficient familiarity with the WCA Regulations and WCA Policies.
  • High level of proficiency in English.

Other qualities which are good to have:

  • Having experience with competition organization and with group work.
  • Speaking more than one language.
  • Coding Experience.

Candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

  • A brief personal introduction.
  • Summary of activities done for the WCA.
  • Goals as a member and why you are seeking to join.

The application period is open for applicants to submit their application document from now until November 8th 2020 23:59 UTC to Wilson Alvis (walvis@worldcubeassociation.org).

Thank you and take care!

title.zh: 议案修订获通过（2020 年 9 月）

html.zh:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

经过近期 WCA 工作人员投票，拟议的议案修订以明显多数获得通过。本次修订依照议案 13.2019.1 进行，该议案现称《议案 13.2020.1：章程及议案修订》。修改内容概述如下：

  • 议案 04.2020.1——董事会：将“WCA 工作人员”改为“有表决权的会员”。
  • 议案 07.2020.1——注册速拧选手：调整内容，使其与章程中退出会员资格的规定及现行匿名化做法一致。
  • 议案 08.2020.1——代表：增加了解 WCA 政策的要求。
  • 议案 08.2020.2——实习代表：增加了解 WCA 政策的要求，并重新表述不得独立执行的任务。
  • 议案 09.2020.1——高级代表：为部分事项增加董事会批准要求，与现行做法一致；并明确没有高级代表的地区如何处理。
  • 议案 10.2020.0——委员会与团队：明确没有负责人的团队如何处理，并作小幅语法修正。
  • 议案 10.2020.4——规则委员会：将通常由 WQAC 处理的任务移入《质量保证委员会议案》。
  • 议案 10.2020.5——财务委员会：将收取会费加入 WFC 的职责。
  • 议案 10.2020.6——数据保护委员会：小幅语法修正。
  • 议案 10.2020.7——道德委员会：将注册速拧选手列入必须配合 WEC 调查的人员范围。
  • 议案 13.2020.1——议案修订：删除对章程的提及，以免与章程已规定的程序相冲突。
  • 议案 14.2020.1——规则修订：取消规则从公告到生效必须间隔 2 周的固定要求。
  • 议案 16.2020.1——争议：将部分“必须”改为“应当”，与现行做法一致。
  • 议案 20.2020.0——理事会：将“提交消息”改为“提交辞呈”，并明确没有负责人的理事会如何处理。
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

After recent voting by WCA Staff Members, the proposed amendments to the Motions have been approved by a good majority. The amendment of the Motions followed Motion 13.2019.1 now called Motion 13.2020.1: Amendments of Bylaws and Motions and a summary of the included changes has been compiled below:

Motion 04.2020.1 - Board of Directors - Change WCA Staff to Voting Members. Motion 07.2020.1 - Registered Speedcubers - Changes to match Bylaws regarding resignation of membership and current practices regarding anonymization. Motion 08.2020.1 - Delegates - Add requirement for knowledge of WCA Policies Motion 08.2020.2 - Trainee Delegates - Add requirement for knowledge of WCA Policies and reword tasks which they cannot do alone. Motion 09.2020.1 - Senior Delegates - Add required approval from the Board to certain points to match current practices and clarification of regions without seniors. Motion 10.2020.0 - Committees and Teams - Clarification regarding teams without leaders. Minor grammatical fix Motion 10.2020.4 - Regulation Committee - Transfer of tasks which are normally handled by WQAC to the Quality Assurance Motion Motion 10.2020.5 - Financial Committee - Add collection of dues as a responsibility of the WFC Motion 10.2020.6 - Data Protection Committee - Minor grammatical fix Motion 10.2020.7 - Ethics Committee - Add Registered Speedcubers as persons who must cooperate with investigations by the WEC Motion 13.2020.1 - Amendments of Motions - Remove mention of the Bylaws to avoid contradiction with the process already outlined in the Bylaws Motion 14.2020.1 - Amendment of Regulations - Remove arbitrary 2 week period from announcement that Regulations come into effect Motion 16.2020.1 - Disputes - Change some “must” to “should” to match current practices Motion 20.2020.0 - Councils - Change of submitting a message to submitting a resignation and clarification of councils without a leader

  • Ambitions as Leader of the WEC.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their application which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WEC can be found in WCA Motion 10.2019.3.

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of WCA Motion 10.2020.0.

Thank you for your candidacies and support.

title.zh: WCA 软件团队招募贡献者（2020 年 9 月）
title.en: Call for Contributors - WCA Software Team (September 2020)

html.zh:
WCA 软件团队（WST）正在招募新的贡献者！

WST 通过开发、扩展和维护软件，帮助协会应对社区的持续增长，在 WCA 中承担着重要职责。 这些软件包括：

  • 你可能经常访问的 WCA 网站。
  • TNoodle：所有代表在比赛中使用的打乱库及其前端。
  • WCA Live：比赛中录入成绩及查看实时成绩的主要平台。

WST 的所有项目均为开源项目，托管于 WCA 的 GitHub：https://github.com/thewca/。 因此，任何有意帮忙的人都可以参与，不需要先在 WCA 担任职务。

WST 的大多数项目面向 Web，所用技术也以此为主：

  • 网站基于 Ruby on Rails 框架构建，使用 SQL 数据库，部分前端组件使用 React。我们希望把使用频率较高的部分进一步迁移到 React，推进网站改版。
    • 这是人手最紧缺的项目，因为随着 WCA 各团队和委员会发展，我们不断收到新的功能需求。
    • 你可以在此处了解网站相关项目的大致情况。
  • WCA Live 的前端使用 React，概况可参阅项目文档。该项目目前正在进行较大调整，完成后将欢迎新的贡献者。
  • TNoodle 分为使用 Java 编写的打乱库（tnoodle-lib），以及包含 Kotlin 后端和 React 前端的服务端程序（tnoodle）。

可以先看看标有“good first issue”的问题，了解我们对首次贡献的预期。这些问题也适合经验不多的开发者：所需编程工作通常很简单，目的是帮助你熟悉我们的工具和基础设施。了解项目结构时，有不懂的地方请放心提问！

WST 的入组方式与 WCA 其他团队和委员会略有不同：我们希望贡献者先做一些实际工作，证明自己会持续参与完成 WST 项目。等大家确认你可靠后，就会邀请你正式加入团队！

感谢大家的贡献与支持！
html.en:
The WCA Software Team (WST) is looking for new contributors!

The WST plays a central role in the WCA by developing, scaling, and maintaining the software solutions that help the organization handle the continuous community growth. Some examples of such software solutions are:

  • The WCA website, that you are probably browsing on a regular basis.
  • TNoodle, the scrambles library and its frontend, used by all Delegates during competitions.
  • WCA Live, which is the main platform for score taking and getting live results during competitions.

All WST projects are open source and hosted on the organization's GitHub: https://github.com/thewca/. As such, anyone willing to help can do so: it is not a requirement to hold a current position in the WCA to be contributing.

Most of the WST projects are web-oriented, which is reflected by the technologies used:

  • The website is written on top of the Ruby on Rails framework (using an SQL database), with some front-end components written in React. We're looking to move forward with its redesign process by migrating more heavily used parts to React.
  • This is by far the most understaffed project, as we constantly receive new feature requests by the various growing WCA teams and committees.
  • You can have a relatively high level idea of website-related projects by taking a look here.
  • WCA Live is written in React for the front-end (checkout its high level documentation). Currently the project undergoes significant changes, but it will happily accept contributors once that's finished.
  • TNoodle is split into a scrambling library written in java (tnoodle-lib), and a server (tnoodle) that contains a Kotlin back-end+React front-end.

All our projects labelled with "good first issue" are those that you could take a look at to get an idea of what we expect from first time contributors. These are good even for inexperienced developers: the programming involved with these issues should be almost trivial, as they are meant to be a way to learn our tools and infrastructure. Do not be afraid to ask for help when figuring out the project layout!

The WST membership is slightly different from the other WCA teams and committees: we expect contributors to first do some work and prove that they are not going to disappear from completing WST projects. Once trust in your reliability has been established, you should expect an invitation to join the team!

Thank you for your contributions and support!

title.zh: WCA 董事会成员变动（2020 年 9 月）
title.en: Changes in the WCA Board of Directors (September 2020)

html.zh:
Chris Wright 的董事任期即将结束，因此 WCA 于 2020 年 9 月 1 日举行了不记名选举。选举依照《WCA 决议：董事选举》进行。

html.en:

  • Callum Goodyear

title.zh: 关于场馆合同的说明

html.zh:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

WCA 道德委员会近期完成了对以 WCA 名义签订合同情况的调查。我们发现，一些场馆合同的表述并不符合 WCA 的性质和职责。对于组织比赛、与代表一同租用比赛场地的成员，我们想借此提醒大家注意道德准则第 5.4 条：

“未经 WCA 董事会事先批准，WCA 工作人员不得代表 WCA 签订合同。”

我们将对这一条作小幅修改，明确规定：未经 WCA 董事会书面许可，不得在合同中提及 WCA。这是因为 WCA 并不组织比赛，合同不应让人误以为 WCA 是主办方。

感谢大家理解。

WCA 道德委员会
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

The WCA Ethics Committee has recently concluded an investigation into contracts being signed on behalf of the WCA. We found that sometimes venue contracts are written in a way that does not represent what the WCA is or does. For those of you who organize competitions and acquire competition venues with a Delegate, we would like to take this opportunity to show you 5.4 of the Code of Ethics.

“WCA Staff must not sign contracts on behalf of the WCA without prior approval of the WCA Board.”

We will be making a minor update to this point to specify that mention of the WCA in a contract should never be made without written permission from the WCA Board of Directors. This is because the WCA does not organize competitions, and therefore contracts should not make the WCA seem like an organizing body.

Thank you for your understanding, The WCA Ethics Committee

title.zh: TNoodle 1.0.1 正式发布

html.zh:
TNoodle-WCA-1.0.1 现已在打乱页面提供下载。与上一版本相比，本次更新包括：

  • 新界面：“旧版界面”和“使用 WCA 登录”两项功能已合并为一个单页应用。
  • **WCIF：**TNoodle 增加了更多便捷功能，并改善了与工作流程中其他软件的集成。
  • **Square-1 现在采用专用求解器，**感谢 Chen Shuang 的贡献。如果比赛包含 Square-1 项目，生成打乱的总耗时应会大幅减少。

即将举行的比赛应尽可能使用 TNoodle-WCA-1.0.1 生成新打乱。考虑到目前的比赛限制，过渡期有所延长，TNoodle-WCA-0.15.1 将继续作为官方版本保留三周，直至 2020 年 9 月 7 日。此前已用 TNoodle-WCA-0.15.1 生成的打乱，在该日期前仍可使用。

请记住，官方比赛必须使用当前有效版本的官方打乱程序。最新版本始终可从以下页面获取： https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/
html.en:
TNoodle-WCA-1.0.1 is now available on the Scrambles page The following changes have been made since the previous version:

  • New UI: The “Legacy UI” and “Log in with WCA” features have been merged into one single-page application.
  • WCIF: TNoodle now has more convenience features and better integration with other software in the toolchain.
  • Square-1 now uses a specialised solver courtesy of Chen Shuang. This means that overall scramble generation time should decrease by a significant margin if your competition includes the Square-1 event.

Upcoming competitions should use TNoodle-WCA-1.0.1 to generate new scrambles whenever possible. Due to the current situation with competition restrictions, there will be an extended transition period meaning that TNoodle-WCA-0.15.1 will stay an official version for three weeks until September 7, 2020. Scrambles that have already been generated using TNoodle-WCA-0.15.1 can still be used until that date.

Please remember that official competitions must use a current version of the official scramble program. This is always available from: https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/

title.zh: WCA 咨询理事会负责人招募（2020 年 8 月）

html.zh:
Daniel Sheppard 将卸任 WCA 咨询理事会（WAC）负责人，WCA 将任命新的负责人。感谢 Daniel 在任期间带领理事会所做的工作。

申请人应能够完成 24 个月的任期，平均每周至少投入 5 小时处理理事会工作，并具备以下条件：

  • 较强的领导能力
  • 出色的沟通能力
  • 熟悉 WCA 的组织结构
  • 与 WCA 社区有密切联系

申请时间为即日起至 2020 年 9 月 26 日 23:59 UTC。有意申请者请将材料私下发送至 WCA 董事会（board@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：

  • 简短的个人介绍
  • 为 WCA 所做工作的概述
  • 担任 WAC 负责人的工作设想

申请人还须提交一份可在申请截止后公开的申请材料副本。

WAC 的权利与职责见 WCA 动议 20.2019.1。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将依照 WCA 动议 20.2019.0第 4.1 节投票选出并公布新任负责人。

感谢各位申请和支持。
html.en:
There will be an appointment of a new WCA Advisory Council (WAC) Leader, as Daniel Sheppard is stepping down from this position. We would like to thank Daniel for the work he has done leading the Council.

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 5 hours per week on average to work for the Council. The qualities expected of candidates are:

  • Strong leadership skills
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Good knowledge of the WCA structure
  • A strong connection to the WCA Community

The application period for candidates to submit their candidacy documents is from now until September 26th, 2020, 23:59 UTC. Interested candidates can send the application privately to the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).

The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

  • Brief personal introduction.
  • Summary of activities done for the WCA.
  • Ambitions as the WAC Leader of the WCA.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WAC can be found in WCA Motion 20.2019.1.

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, as described in Section 4.1 of WCA Motion 20.2019.0.

Thanks for your candidacies and support.

title.zh: 2020 年 8 月版 WCA 规则

html.zh:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

WCA 规则委员会在此通知大家，新版 WCA 规则与指南将于 2020 年 8 月 1 日生效。

WRC 与 WCA 董事会共同制定了本次规则和指南修订，旨在配合《WCA 比赛安全政策》，在新冠疫情期间为 WCA 比赛提供更安全的条件。

全部修改可在 GitHub 版本对比中查看。点击“Files changed”可查看完整的规则和指南文件；修改及新增内容标为绿色，删除内容标为红色。

以下为新版规则与指南的修改概述（提交记录 | 讨论）：

  • 规则新增 Y 章，作为《比赛安全政策》的补充。预计在安全条件允许时撤销这些修改。
  • 必要时，WCA 代表可以要求到场人员遵守额外要求，例如佩戴口罩或没有新冠症状，但必须在赛前明确公告（规则 Y3、Y3a 至 Y3d）。
  • 由选手而非裁判重置计时器，裁判负责提醒选手（规则 Y7d1）。
  • 对行为不安全的选手，WCA 代表可以取消其参赛资格（规则 2k3），并要求其离开场地（规则 11h）。
  • 另有一些补充，使规则与《比赛安全政策》更加一致：
    • 选手应自带笔（规则 Y4），裁判可以自带秒表（规则 Y5）。
    • 选手必须用自己的笔为裁判记录的成绩签名确认，且不得触碰成绩单（规则 Y7e1）。
    • 应设置固定座位；没有必要时，不应设置选手等候区（规则 Y6a、Y7a）。
    • 每次尝试结束后，由选手将魔方放回遮盖物内（规则 Y7f）。
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

The WCA Regulations Committee would like to inform you about a new version of the WCA Regulations and Guidelines, which are going into effect August 1, 2020.

The WRC has been working on a new WCA Regulations and Guidelines amendment in conjunction with the WCA Board of Directors. This amendment is meant to complement the WCA Competition Safety Policy and to guarantee safer conditions in WCA Competitions in light of the COVID-19 pandemic.

You can review all changes in this comparison on GitHub. You can click on “Files changed” to see the complete files of the Regulation and Guidelines, where all changes and additions are marked green and removals are red.

Here is a summary of the changes in the new version of the Regulations and the Guidelines (commit | discussion):

  • A new article Y is added to the Regulations which complements the Safety Policy. It is expected that the changes will be reverted once it is safe to do so.
  • WCA Delegates can impose additional requirements on attendees like wearing masks or not having COVID symptoms, if it is necessary and if it is clearly announced before the competition (Regulations Y3 and Y3a through Y3d).
  • The competitor resets the timer instead of the judge. The judge reminds the competitor to do so (Regulation Y7d1).
  • Competitors who behave unsafely might be disqualified by the WCA Delegate (Regulation 2k3) and requested to leave the venue (Regulation 11h).
  • Some additions that make the Regulations more inline with the Safety Policy:
    • Competitors should bring their own pens (Regulation Y4), judges may bring their own stopwatches (Regulation Y5).
    • Competitors, without touching the scoresheet, must sign the result recorded by their judge using their own pen (Regulation Y7e1).
    • There should be fixed seats and there should not be a Competitor Area if unnecessary (Regulations Y6a, Y7a).
    • The competitor places the puzzle inside the cover after the attempt (Regulation Y7f).

title.zh: 2022 年洲际锦标赛承办申请（2020 年 7 月）

html.zh:
董事会现征集以下地区 2022 年 WCA 洲际锦标赛的承办申请：

  1. 非洲
  2. 大洋洲
  3. 南美洲

请与本国代表商量，确认是否有意愿和能力承办。请记住，组织如此规模的比赛，在赛前及比赛期间都需要投入大量时间和精力。

有意申请者请在 2020 年 7 月 1 日 00:00 UTC 至 2020 年 9 月 30 日 23:59 UTC 期间，将材料私下发送至 board@worldcubeassociation.org。**材料须以 PDF 格式提供两个版本：**包含所有申请细节的完整版，以及删去敏感内容（如有）、可供公开的版本。

申请材料至少须包括以下信息：

计划何时举办 2022 年洲际锦标赛？

1a. 可选日期。 1b. 比赛天数。 1c. 与各国学校假期的重合情况。

计划在本国何处举办 2022 年洲际锦标赛？

2a. 城市应对外国游客有吸引力，并有观光选择。 2b. 国际、国内及当地交通的便利程度。 2c. 不同价位酒店及公寓的供应情况。 2d. 场馆、场馆面积及布置方案（舞台、观众区、练习桌、附属房间）。 2e. 可用技术条件，如网络、视频直播、灯光及音响设备。 2f. 可接待的选手和观众人数。

组织团队和工作人员将如何安排？

3a. 核心团队成员。 3b. 核心团队的经验。 3c. 其他参与方。 3d. 当地志愿者的数量与能力（建议由 20% 的选手参与工作人员工作）。 3e. 需要外国代表提供哪些支持。

比赛总预算如何？

4a. 支出（场租、场馆服务、舞台、器材、装饰、网站、证件／挂绳／礼包、奖品）。 4b. 收入（报名费、赞助、当地政府支持）。

这里提供了一份参考文件，列出大型比赛需要安排和编制预算的部分事项，清单并非详尽无遗。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将面试申请者、征询其他 WCA 工作人员的意见，并投票确定各项 2022 年洲际锦标赛的举办地。如有董事参与某个申请团队，其在遴选过程中的位置将由其他人替代，例如高级代表或委员会／团队负责人。

我们希望这场比赛能够进一步体现 WCA 对大型赛事的构想，推动协会更加专业地运作，为选手提供尽可能好的参赛体验，也向世界呈现尽可能精彩的比赛。

提前感谢大家的配合，期待收到你们的申请！
html.en:
The Board of Directors would like to receive applications for WCA Continental Championships 2022 for the following regions:

  1. Africa
  2. Oceania
  3. South America

Please discuss with the Delegates in your country whether this is something you are willing and able to pursue. Bear in mind that organizing a competition of this size takes a significant amount of time and effort before and during the competition.

If you are interested, send your application documents privately to board@worldcubeassociation.org between July 1st, 2020, 00:00 UTC and September 30th, 2020, 23:59 UTC. Documents must be sent in PDF format in two versions: one full version with all the details for the application, and another version with sensitive details - if any - removed to make public.

Within your application documents, please include at least the following information:

When would you like to hold your Continental Championship 2022? 1a. Possible dates 1b. Number of days of the competition. 1c. Overlap with international holiday periods of schools.

Where would you like to hold your Continental Championship 2022 in your country? 2a. City should be interesting to visit for foreigners with opportunities for sightseeing. 2b. Ease of international, national, and local travel. 2c. Availability of hotels/apartments with different price categories. 2d. Venue, venue size, and venue setup (stage, audience, tables to practice, side rooms). 2e. Technology available like internet, video streaming, lighting, sound equipment. 2f. Number of competitors and spectators that can be hosted.

What would the organization team and staff look like? 3a. Core team members. 3b. Experience of the core team. 3c. Involvement of other parties. 3d. Quantity and quality of local volunteers (guideline is 20% of competitors should staff). 3e. Required support by foreign Delegates.

What would be the overall budget for the competition? 4a. Cost (venue, venue services, stage, equipment, decorations, website, badges/lanyards/giftpacks, prizes). 4b. Income (registration fees, sponsoring, local government).

Here is an example document with a non-exhaustive list of topics that need to be arranged and budgeted for a large competition.

Once the application period is over, the WCA Board of Directors will interview applicants, consult other WCA Staff members, and vote in order to decide where each 2022 Continental Championship will take place. If any Director will be involved in a team that sends in an application, they will be replaced in the selection process by another person (for example a Senior Delegate or a Committee/Team Leader).

We are looking for a competition that can reinforce our concept of large WCA competitions, boosting the professionalization of our organization and able to offer the competitors the best possible experience and the world the best possible show.

Thank you in advance for your cooperation and we look forward to viewing your applications!

title.zh: 《比赛安全政策》

html.zh:
董事会一直在讨论当前的新冠疫情情况，并听取各负责人和高级代表的意见。感谢大家耐心等待。

WCA 现公布新的《比赛安全政策》。随着各地逐步恢复比赛，我们请所有工作人员和选手熟悉这份政策。在 WCA 董事会撤销该政策之前，所有比赛都必须遵守。

选手和工作人员的安全至关重要，也是今后比赛能顺利开展的前提。虽然比赛的形式可能与以往有所不同，但我们仍希望尽可能与大家一起享受魔方的乐趣。如对安全政策有任何疑问，请联系我们。
html.en:
We thank you for your patience as the Board has been discussing and receiving input from Leaders and Seniors regarding the current COVID-19 situation.

The WCA is proud to present our new Competition Safety Policy with which we are asking all Staff members and competitors to familiarize themselves as competitions are reintroduced to their local communities. All competitions must adhere to this policy until it is revoked by the WCA Board.

The safety of our competitors and Staff are paramount to ensure that competitions will be successful into the future. Although competitions may look different, we still hope to celebrate the joy of cubing together as we can. Please reach out to us if you have any questions about the safety policies.

title.zh: 2020 WCA 亚洲锦标赛取消

html.zh:
很遗憾，由于新冠疫情，我们不得不宣布取消 2020 WCA 亚洲锦标赛。虽然此前已宣布延期，但现在不再计划另择日期举办本届比赛。

感谢社区在这段困难时期的理解。
html.en:
With great sadness, we have to announce the cancellation of WCA Asian Championship 2020 due to the COVID-19 outbreak. Although this competition was previously announced to be postponed, there are no longer plans to reschedule this competition for a later date.

We appreciate the community's kind understanding during these unfortunate times.

title.zh: WCA 财务委员会负责人及财务主管任命公告（2020 年 4 月）
title.en: Announcement of a new WFC Leader & WCA Treasurer (April 2020)

html.zh:
我们很高兴地宣布，James Molloy 将成为 WCA 财务委员会（WFC）的新负责人，并担任 WCA 财务主管。James 此前已担任 WFC 高级成员。

按照 WCA 委员会与团队动议第 4 节的规定，WCA 董事会选定 James，并由现任委员会负责人和高级代表投票通过。

感谢 Chris Wright 担任 WFC 负责人及 WCA 财务主管期间所做的工作，祝 James Molloy 在新的岗位上工作顺利。

新负责人已正式就任。James 是这一职位的唯一申请者。有兴趣了解的成员可在此处查看他的申请材料。
html.en:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Committee Leader and WCA Treasurer. James Molloy will become the new Leader of the WCA Finance Committee (WFC) and the WCA Treasurer. James was already working as a Senior Member of the WFC.

James was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote among the current Committee Leaders and Senior Delegates, following Section 4 of our Motion about WCA Committees and Teams.

We thank Chris Wright for the work he has done for the WFC as the Leader and WCA Treasurer, and wish James Molloy best of luck in fulfilling his new duties.

The new Leader is already promoted. James was the only applicant we had and the candidacy document can be found here if you are interested in viewing it.

title.zh: 招募 WCA 市场团队成员（2020 年 4 月）

html.zh:
WCA 市场团队（WMT）正在招募成员，协助以下工作：

  • WCA 器材小组（仅限美国居民）。
  • WCA 周边商品及其他项目的平面设计（面向所有平面设计师）。
  • 争取赞助及开展周边商品业务。

所有 WCA 会员都可以申请，不要求申请者目前已在 WCA 任职。

WMT 负责什么？

  • 与 Speed Stacks 协调，管理和分发 WCA 比赛器材。
  • 在世界各地推出 WCA 周边商品。
  • 为主办方和代表制作可免费下载的模板，加强比赛中的 WCA 品牌展示。
  • 为 WCA 争取赞助。
  • 协助各地主办方开展赞助工作，并维护当地的 WCA 品牌形象。

WMT 的正式权利与职责载于 WCA 议案 10.2018.1。

我们希望申请者具备的素质：

  • 沟通能力与邮件礼仪： 能写出专业、简洁的邮件，回答代表或客户的问题。
  • 耐心： 在邮件往来和内部交流中保持友好。

WMT 成员的一般要求：

  • 因工作或个人兴趣而熟悉市场营销。
  • 熟悉周边商品、赞助或供应商管理。
  • 每周可投入 5–10 小时。
  • 平面设计申请者：必须熟悉 Adobe Illustrator 或同类软件。

我们使用的沟通平台：

  • 正式沟通使用电子邮件。
  • 内部讨论使用 Slack。
  • 会议使用 Zoom/Hangouts。
  • 器材小组订单管理使用 Trello。

WMT 器材小组成员的补充说明：

  • 仅限美国居民申请。
  • 分发比赛器材是最重要的任务之一，因为我们要确保世界各地代表都有足够的器材用于比赛。 由于国际运输的限制，美国成员需要愿意代 WMT 器材小组收取包裹并转寄。
  • 主要工作包括处理器材订单、重新打包以便国际运输，以及定期前往邮局。

请于即日起至 2020 年 4 月 27 日 23:59 UTC，将申请发送给 Somya Srivastava（ssrivastava@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请材料必须为 PDF 格式，并应包含：

  • 简短的个人介绍。
  • 以往参与 WCA 的经历。
  • 申请加入 WMT 的原因。
  • 希望在 WMT 内具体从事哪一组工作。

如对职位或申请有疑问，可联系 Somya Srivastava（ssrivastava@worldcubeassociation.org）。

感谢大家的关注与支持！
html.en:
The WCA Marketing Team (WMT) is seeking members to help in the following areas:

  • WCA Gear Team (US residents only)
  • Graphic design for WCA merchandise and other projects (open for all graphic designers)
  • Acquiring sponsorship and merchandising

The application is open to all WCA members. Potential applicants do not have to hold a current position to be considered.

What does the WMT do?

  • Coordinates with Speed Stacks to manage and distribute WCA competition gear.
  • Launches WCA merchandise in regions all over the world.
  • Works on free downloadable templates for organisers and delegates that increase WCA's branding at competitions.
  • Works on acquiring sponsorship for the WCA.
  • Works and assists organisers around the world with sponsorships and maintaining the WCA brand in their region.

The official rights and duties of the WMT are documented in WCA Motion 10.2018.1.

Characteristics we are looking for:

  • Communication skills and email ethics: You should be able to write a professional, concise email to answer delegate/client questions.
  • Patience: You should keep friendly communications within our email and internal interactions.

Requirements for WMT members in general:

  • Familiarity with marketing professionally or out of interest.
  • Familiarity in dealing with merchandising/sponsorships/vendor management.
  • Time commitment per week of 5-10 hours.
  • FOR GRAPHICS APPLICANTS: Must be familiar with Adobe Illustrator or equivalent programs

Platforms we communicate on:

  • Email for all official communication
  • Slack for internal discussions
  • Zoom/Hangouts for meetings
  • Trello for managing gear team orders

Additional information for WMT Gear Team members:

  • Open for US residents only
  • Distribution of competition equipment is one of the most important tasks since we have to ensure that delegates around the world are well equipped with equipment for their competition. Due to restrictions on international shipping, US members need to be willing to receive the package and repost it on behalf of the WMT Gear Team.
  • Primary tasks involve receiving equipment orders, re-pack the equipment for international shipping, and make routine trips to the post office.

Applications should be sent to Somya Srivastava (ssrivastava@worldcubeassociation.org) from now until April 27, 2020, 23:59 UTC to be considered.

The application must be in PDF format, and should include the following:

  • A brief personal introduction
  • A description of any previous involvement with the WCA
  • Motivation for applying to the WMT
  • The specific team they would like to work in within the WMT

Anyone with questions about the positions or applying can contact Somya Srivastava (ssrivastava@worldcubeassociation.org).

Thank you for your interest and support!

title.zh: 2020 年 WCA 欧洲锦标赛取消

html.zh:
我们很遗憾地宣布，受新冠疫情影响，2020 年 WCA 欧洲锦标赛取消。由于情况仍不明朗，比赛不会改期至今年晚些时候举行。已报名选手将在接下来几周收到退款。

更多信息请见 2020 年 WCA 欧洲锦标赛官网。

感谢社区在这段充满不确定性的时期给予理解。
html.en:
With great regret, we have to announce the cancellation of WCA European Championship 2020 due to the COVID-19 outbreak. Due to the uncertain circumstance, the competition will not be rescheduled for a later date in this year. Competitors who are registered for this competition will be issued refunds over the next couple of weeks.

You will find more information on the WCA European Championship 2020 Website.

We appreciate the community's kind understanding during this unsure time.

title.zh: WDC 简报：2020 年初

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

以下为纪律委员会在 2020 年前三个月的重要动态。

主要调查案件对土耳其社群影响重大。İzmir Open 2020 发生不幸事件：激烈争论后，一名 WCA 工作人员对选手实施身体攻击。因此，WCA 代表 İskender Aznavur 被 WEC 降职，并被 WDC 禁止参加 WCA 比赛 5 年。禁赛自 2 月 6 日开始；不久后其向理事会申诉。理事会最终认定 WDC 与 WEC 的调查过程和结论适当。

涉事选手 Ahmet Güzel 因不尊重 İskender 对规则问题的正式裁定，以及对 WCA 官员使用的言语，被禁赛 3 个月。处分于 2 月 9 日正式通知本人，其接受裁定。

鉴于 WEC 和 WDC 所作决定的重要性，我们决定公布调查报告。

最后提醒大家充分理解规则及流程，有疑问时询问代表。若认为成绩受到损害或发现可疑行为，请立即找最近的代表报告。

也提醒大家，代表在正式比赛中代表 WCA 和规则，选手应接受决定、遵从指示，不应现场抗议。若认为代表未按 WCA 使命、精神或规则行事，应向伦理委员会（WEC）报告；在比赛中闹事并非适当处理方式。

感谢支持 WCA 精神与使命。

Lorenzo Vigani Poli WDC 负责人，代表纪律委员会
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

Here you can find some noteworthy updates about the activity of the Disciplinary Committee over the first three months of 2020.

The main case we investigated greatly affects the Turkish Community. An unfortunate situation occurred during İzmir Open 2020, where a WCA Staff Member physically assaulted a competitor as a consequence of a heated discussion. Because of this, WCA Delegate İskender Aznavur has been demoted by the WEC and banned from WCA Competitions for 5 years by the WDC. İskender’s ban began on the 6th of February and he decided to appeal the ruling shortly after, contacting the WCA Board. In the end, the Board concluded that the investigation by the WDC and WEC was appropriately conducted and concluded.

The competitor involved in this incident, Ahmet Güzel, has been banned for 3 months for failing to respect İskender’s official ruling on a Regulations issue and for the language he used towards a WCA Official. Ahmet’s ban was made official and communicated to him on the 9th of February and he accepted the ruling.

Given the importance of the decisions taken by the WEC and WDC, we have decided to publish the report of the investigation. The document can be found here.

To conclude this Digest, we would like to remind everyone to make sure they fully understand the WCA Regulations and competition procedures. If you have any questions or are unsure about how to do something, please do not hesitate to ask the Delegate(s) of the competition. In addition, if you think the competition results are being compromised in any way or if you see suspicious behavior, find the nearest Delegate immediately and report the incident.

We would also like to remember that Delegates represent the WCA and the Regulations during official competitions, and every competitor should accept their decisions and follow their instructions without protesting. If you believe a Delegate is not acting in accordance with the Mission, Spirit, and Regulations of the WCA you should report them to the Ethics Committee (WEC). Creating a scene at the competition is not an appropriate way to handle the situation.

Thank you all for your help in supporting the WCA Spirit and Mission.

Lorenzo Vigani Poli
WDC Leader
On behalf of the Disciplinary Committee

title.zh: WCA 论坛上线

html.zh:
WCA 论坛正式上线！这是 WCA 咨询理事会为社区精心筹备的项目。

WAC 希望通过论坛加强 WCA 工作人员与社区的联系。所有 WCA 成员都可以在这里讨论比赛、纪录、规则等话题，也可以结识自己所在地区的魔友。更重要的是，当 WCA 为未来发展作出调整时，每个人都可以在这里表达意见。

欢迎登录论坛，四处看看，加入讨论。感谢大家一直以来对协会的支持！
html.en:
We are excited to announce the launch of the WCA Forum, a project that the WCA Advisory Council has worked hard to create for the community!

The WAC hopes to use this tool to improve the connection between WCA Staff and the Community. It is a space for all WCA members to join together to discuss topics such as competitions, records, regulations, and more. This is also a great place to connect with others in your regional community. Most importantly for the WCA, this is a place where everyone gets to have their say as we make changes to our organization for the future.

We invite you to log in, explore the site, and get involved in some conversations. Thank you for your continued support of our organization!

title.zh: 新冠疫情情况更新（2020 年 3 月 30 日）

html.zh:
鉴于过去几周新冠疫情进一步加剧，为支持全球减缓病毒传播的努力，董事会一致同意延长比赛限制。

**所有已公布且首个比赛日在 2020 年 5 月 31 日或之前的比赛，即刻取消。**此外，新比赛只有在首个比赛日为 2020 年 6 月 1 日或之后时，才会获批。

社区开展的线上比赛、远程聚会和直播等活动让我们备受鼓舞。我们全力支持这些尝试，也呼吁更多 WCA 工作人员参与，支持社区。请继续关注官网，了解这些活动的后续公告。

希望所有社区成员都遵循当地政府和世界卫生组织的指引，保护自身安全。感谢大家在这段前所未有的时期给予理解。
html.en:
Given recent escalations of the COVID-19 situation over the past couple weeks and to support the global effort to slow the spread of the virus, the Board has unanimously agreed to extend competition restrictions.

All competitions already announced where the first day of the competition is May 31, 2020 or earlier will be cancelled with immediate effect. In addition, new competitions will only be approved if the first date of the competition is June 1, 2020 or later.

We are encouraged by the initiatives being seen within the community such as online competitions, virtual meets and live streams. We wholeheartedly support and encourage these and are urging more WCA Staff to get involved with these events to support the community. Please keep checking our website for more announcements about these events.

We hope everyone in the community is staying safe by following the directives of their local governments and the World Health Organization. Thank you for your understanding during these unprecedented times.

title.zh: 2020 年 WCA 北美锦标赛取消
title.en: Cancellation of WCA North American Championship 2020

html.zh:
我们很遗憾地宣布，受新冠疫情影响，2020 年 WCA 北美锦标赛取消。鉴于局势仍不稳定、充满不确定性，比赛不会延期至今年晚些时候举行。已报名选手将获得退款，预计在接下来几周处理。主办方的正式取消公告见此处。

感谢社区在这段充满不确定性的时期给予理解。
html.en:
It is with great sadness that we announce the cancellation of WCA North American Championship 2020 due to the COVID-19 outbreak. Given the instability and uncertainty of the situation, the competition will not be postponed to a later point of the year. If you registered for this competition, you will be issued a refund that is due to be processed in the next couple of weeks. Please see the post here for the official cancellation from the competition organizers.

We appreciate the community's kind understanding during this uncertain time.

title.zh: 非官方线上比赛

html.zh:
受当前新冠疫情影响，多国政府采取居家限制措施。一些 WCA 社区成员发起了线上项目，让大家继续享受魔方竞赛！请注意，这些比赛未经 WCA 认可或监督，也不必遵守 WCA 竞赛规则。成绩不会计入你的 WCA 个人页面。

即将举行的非官方比赛信息已移至 WCA 论坛。如果你想发布活动信息，请在论坛新建帖子！

请留在家中，注意安全。
html.en:
Due to the current situation regarding COVID-19 and the measures taken by many governments to confine people to their homes, several members of the WCA community have started projects to keep the competitive spirit alive in cubing! Please note that these competitions are not sanctioned or monitored by the WCA and do not have to abide by WCA regulations. The results will not count towards your WCA profile.

The information about upcoming unofficial competitions has been moved to the WCA Forum. If you would like to submit your upcoming event, please create a topic on the Forum!

Stay home and safe.

title.zh: 新冠疫情情况更新（2020 年 3 月 19 日）

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

针对全球不断变化的新冠疫情，董事会现作出以下通知。

鉴于疫情变化迅速，各地政府也正采取防控措施，董事会决定取消即日起至 4 月 19 日之间的所有比赛。此外，考虑到后续比赛极有可能面临取消，我们决定不接受开始日期在即日起至 5 月 15 日之间的比赛申请。

董事会认为，上述截止日期很可能还会延长，并需要取消更多比赛。

我们鼓励大家保持社交距离，尽力保护自己和所在社区的安全。

感谢理解。

WCA 董事会
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

The Board of Directors would like to make a few announcements regarding the ever changing situation which is unfolding around the world with COVID-19.

Given the rapid pace of change and action from local governments being taken to combat COVID-19 the Board has decided to cancel all competitions between now and April 19th. Additionally we have decided to not allow any submissions of competitions with a starting date between now and May 15th given the high likelihood that these competitions would be faced with cancellation.

It is worth noting that the Board sees a very high likelihood that these deadlines will be extended and further cancellations will be required.

We encourage you to practice social distancing and stay as safe as you can within your communities.

Thank you for your understanding, The Board of Directors

title.zh: 新冠疫情相关通知

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

世界卫生组织（WHO）已将新冠肺炎（COVID-19）认定为全球大流行。WCA 董事会现告知大家，我们正在制定有关举办 WCA 比赛的政策和建议。

在此期间，我们敦促所有社区成员阅读并遵循世卫组织的建议，尤其是在决定是否参加比赛时。

  • 世卫组织新冠疫情专题页面
  • 如何保护自己
  • 旅行建议

请留意社交媒体上的大量不实信息，以世卫组织的指引，以及当地政府或卫生机构推荐的信息为准。

也请注意，各国及政府采取的限制措施各不相同，并会不断调整。请及时了解并遵守你所在国家及旅行目的地的限制和建议。

我们重视工作人员、社区成员和公众的健康与安全。每个人都有责任尽可能减少病毒传播。
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

Following the classification of the Coronavirus (COVID-19) as a pandemic by the World Health Organization (WHO), the WCA Board of Directors wants to communicate that we are in the process of drafting a policy and recommendations for the holding of WCA Competitions.

In the meantime we urge all community members to read and follow the advice of the WHO, especially in relation to attendance at Competitions.

WHO COVID-19 Site Protecting yourself Travel advice

Be mindful of the amount of misinformation on social media and please refer to the guidance by WHO and information recommended by your local governments or health organisations.

Please also be aware that different countries and governments have different and ever changing restrictions in place. Keep yourself up to date and abide by any restrictions and recommendations for your country and any country you are travelling to.

We are committed to the health and safety of our Staff, Community, and the general public. We all have a responsibility to minimize, where possible, the spread of the virus.

title.zh: WCA 财务委员会招募负责人（2020 年 2 月）

html.zh:
Chris Wright 将卸任 WCA 财务委员会（WFC）负责人，委员会将任命新负责人。感谢 Chris Wright 在带领委员会期间所做的工作。

申请者应能完成 24 个月的任期，并平均每周投入至少 7 小时参与委员会工作。我们希望申请者具备：

  • 基本了解 WCA 的组织架构和内部工作流程。
  • 有财务工作经验，尤其是记账和报税经验。
  • 英语熟练。
  • 每天能安排适当时间履行职责。
  • 具备团队管理能力。

申请材料提交时间为即日起至 2020 年 3 月 15 日 23:59 UTC。有意申请者可私下将材料发送至 WCA 董事会（board@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：

  • 简短的自我介绍。
  • 为 WCA 所做工作的概述。
  • 担任 WFC 负责人的工作设想。

此外，请提供一份可在申请截止后公开的申请材料副本。

WFC 的权利与职责见 WCA 动议 10.2017.3。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将投票选定人选，并依据 WCA 动议 10.2020.0 第 4 节，由高级代表及现任委员会、团队负责人投票确认后，公布新负责人。

感谢大家的申请和支持。
html.en:
There will be an appointment of a new WCA Financial Committee (WFC) Leader, as Chris Wright is stepping down from this position. We would like to thank Chris Wright for the work he has done leading the Committee.

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 7 hours per week on average to work for the Committee. The qualities expected of candidates are:

  • Basic knowledge of the structure and workflow inside the WCA
  • Experience on financial matters, especially bookkeeping and tax filing
  • Proficiency in English
  • A reasonable daily availability to deploy the duties
  • Team management capabilities

The application period for candidates to submit their candidacy documents is from now until March 15th, 2020, 23:59 UTC. Interested candidates can send the application privately to the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).

The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

  • Brief personal introduction.
  • Summary of activities done for the WCA.
  • Ambitions as the WFC Leader of the WCA.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WFC can be found in WCA Motion 10.2017.3.

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of WCA Motion 10.2020.0.

Thank you for your candidacies and support.

title.zh: 2020 年 WCA 亚洲锦标赛延期
title.en: Postponement of the WCA Asian Championship 2020

html.zh:
很遗憾，由于当地目前的新冠疫情，2020 年 WCA 亚洲锦标赛将延期举行。组委会与 WCA 董事会正在共同寻找今年晚些时候的合适日期。

请留意后续消息，感谢大家理解。
html.en:
Unfortunately, we are here to announce that the date for the WCA Asian Championship 2020 has been postponed due to the current COVID-19 outbreak within the region. The organization team and the WCA Board are currently working together on finding a suitable date for this championship later in the year.

Please stay tuned for future updates, thank you for your kind understanding.

title.zh: 2022 年洲际锦标赛申办公告（2020 年 2 月）

html.zh:
WCA 董事会现接受以下地区的 2022 年 WCA 洲际锦标赛申办：

  1. 亚洲
  2. 欧洲
  3. 北美洲

其他洲的申请将在今年晚些时候开放。

请与本国的代表讨论，确认是否有意愿和能力申办。请记住，举办如此规模的比赛，无论赛前还是比赛期间，都需要投入大量时间和精力。

有意者请于 2020 年 3 月 1 日 00:00 UTC 至 2020 年 6 月 30 日 23:59 UTC 期间，私下将材料发送至 board@worldcubeassociation.org。材料须为 PDF 格式，并提交两个版本：包含完整申请信息的版本，以及删除敏感信息（如有）、可供公开的版本。

申请至少须说明：

计划何时举办 2022 年洲际锦标赛？

1a. 可选日期。

1b. 比赛天数。

1c. 与各国学校假期的重合情况。

计划在本国的哪个地点举办？

2a. 城市应对海外访客有吸引力，并有观光游览的选择。

2b. 国际、国内及当地交通是否便利。

2c. 是否有不同价位的酒店或公寓。

2d. 场馆、面积及布局，包括舞台、观众区、练习桌和附属房间。

2e. 网络、视频直播、灯光、音响等技术条件。

2f. 可容纳的选手和观众人数。

组委会和工作人员如何安排？

3a. 核心成员。

3b. 核心团队的经验。

3c. 其他参与方。

3d. 当地志愿者的数量和能力，建议工作人员人数约为选手人数的 20%。

3e. 需要多少海外代表提供支持。

比赛总预算是多少？

4a. 支出：场馆及配套服务、舞台、设备、装饰、网站、证件／挂绳／礼包、奖品。

4b. 收入：报名费、赞助、当地政府支持。

这份示例表列出了大型比赛需要安排并纳入预算的部分事项，但并非完整清单。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将面试申请团队、征询其他 WCA 工作人员意见，并通过投票决定各项 2022 年洲际锦标赛的举办地点。若某位董事参与了申办团队，将由另一人代替其参与遴选，例如高级代表或委员会／团队负责人。

我们希望这场比赛能进一步完善大型 WCA 比赛的办赛方式，提高组织的专业水平，为选手提供尽可能好的体验，也向世界呈现尽可能精彩的赛事。

感谢大家配合，期待收到申办材料！
html.en:
The Board of Directors would like to receive applications for WCA Continental Championships 2022 for the following regions:

  1. Asia
  2. Europe
  3. North America

(Note that the application period for other continents will open later this year.)

Please discuss with the Delegates in your country whether this is something you are willing and able to pursue. Bear in mind that organizing a competition of this size takes a significant amount of time and effort before and during the competition.

If you are interested, send your application documents privately to board@worldcubeassociation.org between March 1st, 2020, 00:00 UTC and June 30th, 2020, 23:59 UTC. Documents must be sent in PDF format in two versions: one full version with all the details for the application, and another version with sensitive details - if any - removed to make public.

Within your application documents, please include at least the following information:

When would you like to hold your Continental Championship 2022? 1a. Possible dates 1b. Number of days of the competition. 1c. Overlap with international holiday periods of schools.

Where would you like to hold your Continental Championship 2022 in your country? 2a. City should be interesting to visit for foreigners with opportunities for sightseeing. 2b. Ease of international, national, and local travel. 2c. Availability of hotels/apartments with different price categories. 2d. Venue, venue size, and venue setup (stage, audience, tables to practice, side rooms). 2e. Technology available like internet, video streaming, lighting, sound equipment. 2f. Number of competitors and spectators that can be hosted.

What would the organization team and staff look like? 3a. Core team members. 3b. Experience of the core team. 3c. Involvement of other parties. 3d. Quantity and quality of local volunteers (guideline is 20% of competitors should staff). 3e. Required support by foreign Delegates.

What would be the overall budget for the competition? 4a. Cost (venue, venue services, stage, equipment, decorations, website, badges/lanyards/giftpacks, prizes). 4b. Income (registration fees, sponsoring, local government).

Here is an example document with a non-exhaustive list of topics that need to be arranged and budgeted for a large competition.

Once the application period is over, the WCA Board of Directors will interview applicants, consult other WCA Staff members, and vote in order to decide where each 2022 Continental Championship will take place. If any Director will be involved in a team that sends in an application, they will be replaced in the selection process by another person (for example a Senior Delegate or a Committee/Team Leader).

We are looking for a competition that can reinforce our concept of large WCA competitions, boosting the professionalization of our organization and able to offer the competitors the best possible experience and the world the best possible show.

Thank you in advance for your cooperation and we look forward to viewing your applications!

title.zh: 印度及东南亚周边商品合作公告
title.en: India & Southeast Asia Merchandise Collaboration Announcement

html.zh:
我们很高兴与 Cubelelo 合作，推出 WCA 官方周边商品！Cubelelo 将成为我们在东南亚及印度地区的周边合作伙伴。首款商品是一件 T 恤，目前已可在 Cubelelo 网站购买。

今后我们将在更多地区推出周边商品，请留意后续公告！

为让更多地区可以买到我们的周边，我们正在寻找有意成为 WCA 周边合作伙伴的组织或个人。如你或你的组织有兴趣，请联系 WCA 市场推广团队。

title.zh: WCA 决议修订获通过（2020 年 1 月）

html.zh:
经 WCA 工作人员近期投票，决议修订提案以明显多数通过。这些决议自 2020 年 1 月 31 日起生效，主要改动如下：

  • 决议 02.2020.1——定义 - 将定义按字母顺序排列，增加“实习代表”，将“候选代表”更名为“初级代表”。
  • 决议 06.2020.1——地区组织 - 增加要求：地区组织必须是依法注册的实体。（董事会同意给予截至 2020 年 12 月 31 日的宽限期，自 2021 年 1 月 1 日起执行。）
  • 决议 08.2020.1——代表 - 将“候选代表”更名为“初级代表”。明确比赛现由 WCAT 公布，初级代表已属于 WCA 工作人员。代表有责任为实习代表提供支持。
  • 决议 09.2020.1——高级代表 - 明确高级代表负责任命和支持实习代表。
  • 决议 09.2020.2——区域代表 - 明确区域代表为实习代表提供支持。
  • 决议 10.2020.0——委员会与团队 - 明确 WEAT 由 WCA 董事会领导。
  • 决议 10.2020.2——WCA 比赛公告团队 - 扩大权限，允许 WCAT 负责人取消 WCA 比赛。
  • 决议 10.2020.3——质量保证委员会 - 明确 WQAC 在代表晋升、降级及考察期安排方面提供建议的职责。
  • 决议 15.2020.1——暂停资格及其他处分 - 扩大权限，允许 WEC 根据调查结果采取部分措施。

除上述修订外，还新增了以下决议：

  • 决议 08.2020.2——实习代表 - 设立实习代表岗位。
  • 决议 10.2020.1——行政助理团队 - 正式设立 WCA 行政助理团队。
html.en:
After recent voting by WCA staff members, the proposed amendments to the Motions have been approved by a good majority. The Motions are effective as of January 31, 2020, and a summary of the included changes has been compiled below:

  • Motion 02.2020.1 - Definitions - Fixed the order of the definitions to be alphabetical, add Trainee Delegate, rename Candidate Delegate to Junior Delegate.
  • Motion 06.2020.1 - Regional Organizations - Added a requirement for Regional Organizations to be legally registered entities (The Board agreed to allow a grace period until December 31, 2020 and begin enforcement of this beginning January 1, 2021).
  • Motion 08.2020.1 - Delegates - Renamed Candidate Delegate to Junior Delegate. Clarified that competitions are now announced by the WCAT and that Junior Delegates are already Staff. Delegates have the responsibility to support Trainee Delegates.
  • Motion 09.2020.1 - Senior Delegates - Clarified that Senior Delegates appoint and support Trainee Delegates.
  • Motion 09.2020.2 - Regional Delegates - Clarified that Regional Delegates support Trainee Delegates.
  • Motion 10.2020.0 - Committees and Teams - Clarified that the WEAT will be led by the WCA Board.
  • Motion 10.2020.2 - WCA Competition Announcement Team - Expanded to allow WCAT Leader permission to cancel WCA Competitions.
  • Motion 10.2020.3 - Quality Assurance Committee - Clarified the role of the WQAC in advising on the promotion, demotion, and probation of Delegates.
  • Motion 15.2020.1 - Suspensions and other Sanctions - Expanded to provide WEC with rights to take some actions as a result of investigations.

In addition to the above amendments, the following motions have been created:

  • Motion 08.2020.2 - Trainee Delegates - Creates the role of Trainee Delegate
  • Motion 10.2020.1 - Executive Assistants Team - Formally establishes the WCA Executive Assistants Team

title.zh: WDC 月度简报：2019 年 12 月

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

2019 年最后一期简报，回顾一个月前结束的这一年 WDC 的工作。

工作数据：

  • 立案 55 件；
  • 结案 53 件；
  • 19 件已结案件对一人或多人发出正式警告；
  • 14 件已结案件导致禁赛；
  • 2 项调查仍在进行。

委员会动态：

  • Anuj Menta、JP Bulman 两名成员卸任；
  • 新增 6 名成员：Arthur Garcin、Chris Tabar、Christopher Morris、Jules Desjardin、Martin Vædele Egdal、Sebastiano Tronto；
  • 理事会将我的负责人任期续延一年，现定于 2020 年 12 月结束。

最后提醒大家充分理解规则和流程，有疑问时询问代表。若认为成绩受到损害或看到可疑行为，请立即找最近的代表报告。

感谢支持 WCA 精神与使命。

Lorenzo Vigani Poli WDC 负责人，代表纪律委员会
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

For this last Digest of 2019, we want to summarize everything achieved by the WCA Disciplinary Committee over the year that ended a month ago.

First, some numbers about the activity of the WDC.

  • 55 cases were opened;
  • 53 cases were closed;
  • 19 of the resolved cases ended with an official warning to one or more people;
  • 14 of the resolved cases ended with a ban;
  • 2 investigations are still ongoing.

Then a few numbers and facts about the WDC.

  • 2 members stepped down: Anuj Menta and JP Bulman;
  • 6 new members were added: Arthur Garcin, Chris Tabar, Christopher Morris, Jules Desjardin, Martin Vædele Egdal, Sebastiano Tronto;
  • My term as WDC Leader was renewed by the Board for one year and is now scheduled to end in December 2020.

To conclude this short Digest, we would like to remind everyone to make sure they fully understand the WCA Regulations and competition procedures. If you have any questions or are unsure about how to do something, please do not hesitate to ask the Delegate(s) of the competition. In addition, if you think the competition results are being compromised in any way or if you see suspicious behavior, find the nearest delegate immediately and report the incident.

Thank you all for your help in supporting the WCA Spirit and Mission.

Lorenzo Vigani Poli
WDC Leader
On behalf of the Disciplinary Committee

title.zh: WCA 比赛公告团队新负责人（2020 年 1 月）

html.zh:
我们很高兴地宣布，Wilson Alvis 将担任 **WCA 比赛公告团队（WCAT）**的新负责人。

按照关于 WCA 委员会和团队的 10.2019.0 号议案第 4 节，WCA 董事会选定 Wilson，并经现任委员会负责人和高级代表投票批准。

感谢 Henrik 在担任 WCAT 负责人期间所做的工作，祝 Wilson Alvis 履新顺利。

html.en:

Wilson was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote among the current Committee Leaders and Senior Delegates, following Section 4 of our Motion 10.2019.0 about WCA Committees and Teams.

We thank Henrik for the work he has done as the leader for the WCAT, and wish Wilson Alvis best of luck in fulfilling his new duties.

The new Leader has already been already promoted. Wilson Alvis was among the two applicants who applied and the candidacy documents can be found here if you are interested in viewing them.

title.zh: WCA 成绩团队成员招募（2020 年 1 月）

html.zh:
WCA 成绩团队（WRT）正在招募认真投入、值得信赖的新成员！

你喜欢数字吗？你是否总能很快发现餐厅菜单上别人没注意到的错字或前后不一致之处？别人处理数据不够准确会不会让你难以忍受？如果是，你可能很适合 WRT！

WRT 成员应具备以下条件：

  • 回应及时，愿意经常处理 WRT 工作。
  • 注重细节，能够准确、审慎地处理数据。
  • WRT 的工作涉及 WCA 成绩数据库，因此你必须是 WCA 社区中值得信赖、做事可靠的成员。已在 WCA 任职或有 WCA 工作人员推荐者更佳。
  • 基本了解什么是关系型数据库。
  • 有 SQL（MySQL）及编程经验更佳，但并非硬性要求。

WRT 成员的日常工作包括：

  • 核验、上传和公布比赛成绩。
  • 处理成绩或个人资料的修改请求。
  • 协助 WCA 代表及其他委员会处理数据相关问题和需求。
  • 调查 WCA 数据库中不一致的数据。
  • 分析 WCA 数据，为其他团队和委员会提供参考。
  • 与 WCA 软件团队合作，改进与 WRT 工作有关的软件。

WRT 成员平均每周需投入约 4–5 小时。在此过程中，你可以更深入地了解 WCA 的组织结构和数据库，并直接参与维护 WCA 比赛成绩的准确可信。WCA 动议中规定的 WRT 正式权利与职责见此处。

有意加入 WCA 成绩团队者，请将申请发送给 WRT 负责人 Sébastien Auroux（sauroux@worldcubeassociation.org）。申请至少应包括详细的个人介绍，说明自己为什么适合 WRT，以及加入团队的动机和目标。

申请截止时间为 2020 年 1 月 30 日 23:59 UTC。此后，现任 WRT 成员会审阅和讨论申请，并在约 2–3 周后作出决定。

期待收到你的申请！
html.en:
The WCA Results Team (WRT) is looking for new devoted and trustworthy team members!

Do you like numbers? Are you the type of person quickly spotting typos or inconsistencies in restaurant menus that others miss? Does it drive you crazy when people lack precision with data? If yes, then you might be a very good fit for the WRT!

The qualities that you should bring to become a WRT member include:

  • You must be very responsive and be willing to work on WRT tasks regularly.
  • You should have a good sense of detail and you must be able to handle data precisely and consciously.
  • Since the WRT operates on the WCA results database, you have to be a very trustworthy and reliable member of the WCA community. Ideally, you are already a WCA staff member or you have a recommendation from one.
  • You should have a basic understanding of what a (relational) database is.
  • Existing experience with SQL (MySQL) and programming are beneficial, but not strictly mandatory.

As a WRT member you will work on the following regular tasks:

  • Verifying, uploading and publishing competition results.
  • Handling change requests to results or personal data.
  • Supporting WCA Delegates and other WCA committees with data-related problems and requests.
  • Investigating inconsistencies in the WCA database.
  • Analyzing the WCA’s data to provide insights for other teams/committees.
  • Cooperating with the WCA Software Team to improve WCA’s software solutions related to WRT’s work.

On average, the membership in the WRT requires approximately 4-5 hours per week. In return, you gain a deeper insight into the structure of the WCA and the WCA database, and you will actively contribute to ensuring the integrity of the WCA's competition results. The official rights and duties of the WRT as described in the Motions of the WCA can be found here.

If you are interested in joining the WCA Results Team, please send an application to WRT leader Sébastien Auroux (sauroux@worldcubeassociation.org). The application should at least include a comprehensive description of yourself, showing why you would be a good addition to the WRT, and your motivation and goals for becoming a WRT member.

The application deadline is January 30th 2020 23:59 UTC. Following that date, the applications will be reviewed and discussed among the current WRT members and a decision will be made about 2-3 weeks after.

We are looking forward to your application!

title.zh: 2019 年年终寄语

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

2019 年，无论是魔方比赛还是 WCA 的组织发展，都又取得了一年的好成绩！我们想借此机会，与大家分享在你们帮助下取得的一些成果。

WCA 比赛首次进入了八个国家，超过 27,750 人首次参加官方比赛。今年，选手们不断突破，创造了 61 项世界纪录、205 项洲际纪录和 3,760 项国家纪录。

在组织层面，WCA 持续改进，为工作人员和选手提供更好的支持。我们成立了 WCA 数据保护委员会，处理《通用数据保护条例》（GDPR）带来的相关事务；也成立了 WCA 执行助理团队，协助董事会处理行政工作。我们设置了地区代表职位，帮助高级代表更好地管理幅员较大的地区。《WCA 比赛要求政策》开始实施，以统一比赛标准；《WCA 器材资助政策》也已推出，为因经济或其他困难而无法自行购置器材的社区代表和地区组织提供器材。

各委员会和团队同样完成了大量工作：WCA 道德委员会开展了 21 次调查；WCA 比赛公告团队公布了超过 1,300 场比赛，从确认到公布平均用时 21 小时；WCA 成绩团队发布了这些比赛的成绩，从提交到上传平均仅需 10 小时；WCA 沟通团队在 Facebook 发布了 153 条内容，在 Instagram 发布了 115 条内容。今年我们还任命了 43 名新代表！

今年是 WCA 首次与 Red Bull Mind Gamers 合作，在西班牙、中国和墨西哥联合办赛，并让多位 WCA 选手参加了在俄罗斯举行的 2019 红牛魔方世界杯。WCA 也开始与吉尼斯世界纪录合作，让 WCA 世界纪录在吉尼斯官网和书籍中得到正式认可。Rubik’s 的支持让 2019 WCA 世锦赛得以举行，我们感谢他们持续以来的帮助。期待 2020 年继续深化与这些组织及其他伙伴的合作！

2019 WCA 世锦赛在墨尔本成功举办后，我们期待在马来西亚吉隆坡、荷兰阿尔梅勒和加拿大多伦多，分别与大家相聚于亚洲、欧洲和北美锦标赛。无论是在 WCA 任职，还是在自己的社区组织和参加比赛，每一位持续投入时间的人都支持着我们的目标与发展。感谢大家共同成就了这一年，祝你新年愉快！
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

We had another successful year of cubing and developing the WCA as an organization in 2019! We would like to take this moment to share the highlights of what we have accomplished this year with all of your help.

WCA competitions were introduced to eight new countries and there were over 27,750 new people who competed officially for the first time. This year, our competitors broke barriers and achieved 61 world records, 205 continental records, and 3,760 national records.

On the organizational side, the WCA continued to evolve and make changes to benefit our staff and competitors. The WCA Data Protection Committee and WCA Executive Assistant Team were created to address the implications of the GDPR and to assist the WCA Board with their administrative tasks. Regional Delegate positions were developed to help senior delegates better manage large areas. The WCA Competition Requirements Policy was implemented to standardize our competitions and the WCA Equipment Funding Policy was put in place to offer equipment to Delegates and Regional Organizations in communities where their own investment is hindered by financial or other hardship.

Within our Committees and Teams, there have been 21 investigations taken by the WCA Ethics Committee, more than 1,300 competitions announced by the WCA Competition Announcement Team (with an average announcement time of 21 hours from confirmation) and results for those competitions posted by the WCA Results Team (with an average delay of only 10 hours between submission and upload), and 153 posts made on Facebook and 115 posts on Instagram by the WCA Communication Team. We also appointed 43 new delegates this year!

This was the first year that the WCA collaborated with Red Bull Mind Gamers to have joint events in Spain, China, and Mexico and bring many WCA competitors to the Red Bull Rubik’s Cube World Cup 2019 in Russia. The WCA has also began collaborating with Guinness World Records to formally recognize WCA World Records on their website and in their books. Rubik’s made WCA World Championship 2019 possible and we are thankful for their continued support. We look forward to furthering our relationships with these organizations and others into 2020!

After the success of WCA World Championship 2019 in Melbourne, we are looking forward to coming together for the Asian, European, and North American Championships in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia; Almere, Netherlands; and Toronto, Canada respectively. We could not achieve any of our goals or developments without the continued support of all who give their time to the WCA in a staff position or by organizing and competing in their communities. Thank you again for another year of success and may you have a wonderful new year!

title.zh: 2021 年 WCA 世界锦标赛承办申请
title.en: Applications for the WCA World Championship 2021

html.zh:
WCA 董事会现征集 2021 年 WCA 世界锦标赛的承办申请。

请与所在国家的代表讨论是否有意愿和能力承办。举办这一规模的比赛，需要在赛前和比赛期间投入大量时间与精力。

如有意承办，请在 2020 年 1 月 1 日 00:00 UTC 至 2020 年 6 月 30 日 23:59 UTC 期间，将申请材料私下发送至 board@worldcubeassociation.org。材料须以 PDF 格式提交两个版本：一份包含所有申请细节的完整版；另一份为公开版，如有敏感信息，应将其删除。

申请材料至少须包含以下信息：

计划何时举办 2021 年世锦赛？

  • 1a. 可选日期
  • 1b. 比赛天数
  • 1c. 与各国学校假期的重合情况

计划在本国何处举办 2021 年世锦赛？

  • 2a. 城市应对外国游客有吸引力，有观光机会
  • 2b. 国际、国内及市内交通的便利程度
  • 2c. 不同价位酒店、公寓的供应情况
  • 2d. 场馆、面积及布置，包括舞台、观众区、练习桌和附属房间
  • 2e. 网络、视频直播、灯光及音响等技术条件
  • 2f. 可容纳的选手和观众人数

主办团队和工作人员如何组成？

  • 3a. 核心团队成员
  • 3b. 核心团队的经验
  • 3c. 其他参与方
  • 3d. 当地志愿者的数量和能力，建议约 20% 的选手参与工作人员工作
  • 3e. 需要外国代表提供哪些支持

比赛的总体预算是多少？

  • 4a. 支出：场馆、场馆服务、舞台、器材、装饰、网站、证件及挂绳和礼品包、奖品
  • 4b. 收入：报名费、赞助、地方政府支持

此处有一份示例文档，列出大型比赛需要安排并纳入预算的部分事项，清单并非详尽无遗。作为成功申办的例子，此处还提供了澳大利亚墨尔本 2019 年世锦赛的获选申办材料。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将与申请方面谈，并投票决定 2021 年世锦赛的举办地。如有董事参与某个申办团队，将由其他人员（例如高级代表或委员会、团队负责人）代替其参与遴选。

我们希望这场比赛能够进一步实践 WCA 大型赛事的理念，让协会的工作更加专业，为选手提供尽可能好的参赛体验，也向世界呈现尽可能精彩的比赛。

提前感谢大家的配合，期待收到各位的申请！
html.en:
The Board of Directors would like to receive applications for WCA World Championship 2021.

Please discuss with the Delegates in your country whether this is something you are willing and able to pursue. Bear in mind that organizing a competition of this size takes a significant amount of time and effort before and during the competition.

If you are interested, send your application documents privately to board@worldcubeassociation.org between 00:00 UTC of January 1st, 2020 and 23:59 UTC of June 30th, 2020. Documents must be sent in PDF format in two versions: one full version with all the details for the application, and another version with sensitive details - if any - removed to make public.

Within your application documents, please include at least the following information:

When would you like to hold the World Championship 2021? 1a. Possible dates 1b. Number of days of the competition. 1c. Overlap with international holiday periods of schools.

Where would you like to hold the World Championship 2021 in your country? 2a. City should be interesting to visit for foreigners with opportunities for sightseeing. 2b. Ease of international, national, and local travel. 2c. Availability of hotels/apartments with different price categories. 2d. Venue, venue size, and venue setup (stage, audience, tables to practice, side rooms). 2e. Technology available like internet, video streaming, lighting, sound equipment. 2f. Number of competitors and spectators that can be hosted.

What would the organization team and staff look like? 3a. Core team members. 3b. Experience of the core team. 3c. Involvement of other parties. 3d. Quantity and quality of local volunteers (guideline is 20% of competitors should staff). 3e. Required support by foreign Delegates.

What would be the overall budget for the competition? 4a. Cost (venue, venue services, stage, equipment, decorations, website, badges/lanyards/giftpacks, prizes). 4b. Income (registration fees, sponsoring, local government).

Here is an example document with a non-exhaustive list of topics that need to be arranged and budgeted for a large competition. As an example of a successful application, here is the winning bid for World Championship 2019 held in Melbourne, Australia.

Once the application period is over, the WCA Board of Directors will interview applicants and vote in order to decide where the 2021 World Championship will take place. If any Director will be involved in a team that sends in an application, he will be replaced in the selection process by another person (for example a Senior Delegate or a Committee/Team Leader).

We are looking for a competition that can reinforce our concept of large WCA competitions, boosting the professionalization of our organization and able to offer the competitors the best possible experience and the world the best possible show.

Thank you in advance for your cooperation and we look forward to viewing your applications!

title.zh: WCA 规则更新：2020 年 1 月

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

WCA 规则委员会（WRC）在此向大家介绍将于 2020 年 1 月 1 日生效的新版 WCA 规则与指南。

全部改动可在此 GitHub 对比页面查看。点击“Files changed”可以查看规则与指南的完整文件，修改或新增的内容标为绿色，删除的内容标为红色。

简化规则

  • 允许魔表的按针彼此可区分。（提交 | 讨论）
  • 最少步：解法只允许使用 18 种基本转动、x、y、z 整体转动以及宽层转动，不允许使用方括号整体转动记号。（提交 | 讨论）
  • “组合轮次”（combined round）更名为“设及格线的轮次”（cutoff round）。（提交 | 讨论）

责任确认

  • 必须进行打乱签名：每次还原前，打乱员或打乱检查员须确认魔方已正确打乱。虽然比赛必须尽力确保每次还原都有打乱签名，但不能仅因缺少打乱签名而取消成绩。（提交 | 提交 | 讨论）
  • 强烈建议 WCA 代表记录每次批准额外还原的原因，例如写在成绩单背面。（提交）
  • 强烈建议主办方在所有计时器按钮上安装 O 形圈或类似装置，防止意外复位。（提交 | 讨论）

其他改动

  • 三阶脚拧不再是官方项目。（公告 | 提交 | 讨论）
  • 最少步解法视为公开资料。（提交 | 讨论）
  • 多盲：如果在还原过程中发现重复的魔方，可使用备打重新打乱该魔方。（提交 | 讨论）
  • 允许在一次还原开始时使用魔表支架，将魔表竖直放置在比赛台上。（提交 | 讨论）
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

The WRC would like to inform you about the versions of the WCA Regulations and Guidelines, which are going into effect January 1, 2020.

You can review all changes in this comparison on GitHub. You can click on “Files changed” to see the complete files of the Regulation and Guidelines, where all changes and additions are marked green and removals are red.

Simplifications

  • Clock pins are allowed to be distinguishable. (commit | discussion)
  • Fewest Moves: only the 18 basic moves, <x, y, z> rotations, and wide moves are allowed in solutions (no bracket rotations). (commit | discussion)
  • The name for "combined round" has changed to "cutoff round". (commit | discussion)

Accountability

  • Required: scramble signatures. Either the scrambler or a scramble checker must certify that the puzzle is scrambled correctly for each attempt. Although competitions must make a full effort to use scramble signatures for all attempts, results cannot be disqualified solely for a missing scramble signature. (commit | commit | discussion)
  • Strongly recommended: the WCA Delegate should record a reason for each granted extra (e.g. on the back of the score sheet). (commit)
  • Strongly recommended: organizers should attach O-rings (or equivalent) to all timer buttons to prevent accidental resets. (commit | discussion)

Miscellaneous

  • 3x3x3 With Feet will no longer be an official event. (announcement | commit | discussion)
  • Fewest Moves solutions are considered public. (commit | discussion)
  • Multi-Blind: if a duplicate cube is found and during an attempt, the cube may be re-scrambled using an extra scramble. (commit | discussion)
  • Clock stands may be used to place the Clock vertically at the solving station at the beginning of the attempt. (commit | discussion)

title.zh: WCA 比赛公示团队成员招募（2019 年 12 月）

我们希望新成员具备以下条件：

  • 有服务意识，愿意协助代表处理各类请求。
  • 在与团队其他成员及代表的日常沟通中及时回应。
  • 熟悉 WCA 比赛要求政策（WCRP）。
  • 熟悉竞赛规则及 WCA 政策。

  • 掌握不止一种语言。
  • 有编程经验。

预计每周需投入约 8 小时。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包括：

  • 简短的个人介绍。
  • 为 WCA 所做工作的概述。
  • 成为成员后的目标，以及申请加入的原因。

申请自即日起开放，截止时间为 2020 年 1 月 5 日 23:59 UTC。请将材料发送给 Henrik Buus Aagaard（haagaard@worldcubeassociation.org）。

谢谢！
html.en:
The WCA Competition Announcement Team (WCAT) is seeking new members to help them with their mission! Applications are open to everyone and community members not currently holding a WCA position are encouraged to apply.

The daily tasks of a WCAT member include:

  • Reviewing and announcing competition submissions with accuracy and correctness.

  • Handling change requests to competitions.

  • Debating and voting with the rest of the Team.

The official rights and duties of the WCAT are documented in WCA Motion 10.2019.1.

The qualities of members we are seeking include:

  • A sense of detail.

  • Service mindedness to help delegates in all the requests they can have.

  • Responsiveness in day to day communication with the rest of the Team and the Delegates.

  • Good familiarity with the WCA Competition Requirements Policy (WCRP).

  • Familiarity with the Regulations and WCA Policies.

  • Good level of English.

Other qualities which are good to have:

  • Having experience with competition organization and with group work.

  • Speaking more than one language.

  • Coding Experience

The expected workload is around 8 hours per week.

Candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

  • A brief personal introduction.

  • Summary of activities done for the WCA.

  • Goals as a member and why you are seeking to join.

The application period is open for applicants to submit their application document from now until January 5th 2020 23:59 UTC to Henrik Buus Aagaard (haagaard@worldcubeassociation.org).

Please pass this information on to anyone in your community that you believe would be a good fit for this new team. You do not need to have any current position inside the WCA to be considered.

Thank you!
