title.zh: 取消三阶脚拧的正式项目资格
title.en: Removing official status for 3x3x3 With Feet

html.zh:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

经过一整年的意见收集和评估，WRC 与 WCA 董事会决定，按照此前的计划，于 2020 年 1 月 1 日将三阶脚拧从 WCA 正式项目列表中移除。我们清楚这一决定会给部分人带来很大影响，但在整个 2019 年，该项目的参与情况并未明显改变。三阶脚拧仍是参与人数最少的速拧项目，且与其他项目相差很大；主办方对卫生和现场组织安排的担忧也依然存在。

我们知道，这一结果会让许多社区成员失望，也理解大家的挫败感：取消正式资格，会明显影响一个项目的普及程度。不过，各场比赛仍可将脚拧设为非正式项目；对于有医疗方面特殊情况的选手，主办方也可以允许其在三阶速拧项目中用脚还原。（参见指南 5b+ 和规则 2s。）

我们也欢迎大家提出缩小非正式项目与正式项目之间差距的建议，例如：

  • 在正式报名时，也能方便地报名非正式项目。
  • 为 WCA 比赛中的非正式成绩设立统一的发布位置。

同时，我们为此次决策流程中的不足表示歉意。社区的反馈让我们学到了很多；今后涉及项目变更时，我们会优先确保流程清晰、透明。

Lucas Garron WRC 负责人 代表规则委员会
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

After a full year of feedback and review, the WRC and the WCA Board have come to the conclusion that 3x3x3 with Feet should be removed from the list of official WCA events as previously planned, on January 1, 2020. Although it is clear that some people will be significantly impacted, there has not been a significant change in participation in the event throughout 2019. 3x3x3 with Feet remains the least popular speedsolving event by a significant margin, and concerns from organizers about hygiene and logistics remain.

We know that this outcome is disappointing for many community members, and understand the frustration that removing an event from the official list will have a significant impact on its popularity. However, any competition is still welcome to hold it as an unofficial event, and organizers may allow competitors with medical considerations to compete using feet during 3x3x3 Speed Solving. (See Guideline 5b+ and Regulation 2s.)

We also welcome suggestions to bridge the gap between unofficial and official events. For example:

  • Making it easy to sign up for unofficial events during official registration.
  • Having a standard place for unofficial results from WCA competitions.

We would also like to take this time to apologize for the flaws in the process used for this decision. We have learned greatly from the community's feedback, and will prioritize a clear and transparent process for event changes in the future.

Lucas Garron WRC leader On behalf of the Regulations Committee

title.zh: WDC 月度简报：2019 年 10 月

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

以下为纪律委员会 2019 年 10 月的重要动态。

10 月新开四项正式调查。一件很直接，数日内完成；另三件中的两件在 10 月底或 11 月初结案。

主要工作是遴选新成员，流程耗时，分以下阶段：

  1. 初评：分析申请文件；16 人全部进入下一阶段。
  2. 中期评估：填写 Google 表单，回答问题并模拟 WDC 常见情景，起草正式沟通并解释推理；16 人中 9 人晋级。
  3. 终评：与负责人面试，平均 30 分钟，讨论各类 WCA/WDC 话题；9 人中 6 人入选。

新成员为 Arthur Garcin（2014GARC27）、Christopher Morris（2013MORR03）、Chris Tabar（2017TABA02）、Jules Desjardin（2010DESJ01）、Martin Vædele Egdal（2013EGDA02）、Sebastiano Tronto（2011TRON02）。欢迎他们，也感谢所有申请人。遴选很有启发，最终抉择困难，说明整体水平很高。

同时还准备新成员入职：编写一些文件，确定内部沟通事项。我们考虑公开其中一份，以介绍委员会运作。

遴选期间，Anuj Menta 因个人原因决定卸任。公开感谢他过去两年的工作和贡献，祝未来顺利！

最后提醒充分理解规则及流程，有疑问时询问代表。若认为成绩受到损害或看到可疑行为，请立即找最近的代表报告。

感谢支持 WCA 精神与使命。

Lorenzo Vigani Poli WDC 负责人，代表纪律委员会
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

Here you can find some noteworthy updates about the activity of the Disciplinary Committee over the month of October 2019.

During October, four new official investigations were opened. One was very straightforward and took only a few days to be completed and two out of the other three were closed at the end of October/beginning of November.

The bulk of the activity during October was the selection process for the new WDC members. This took a while to complete, as the process followed the below steps.

1. Initial evaluation
- Conducted on the analysis of the candidacy documents;
- 16 out of 16 candidates proceeded to the next step;

2. Intermediate evaluation
- Candidates were asked to complete a Google form with questions and simulations of scenarios regularly faced by the WDC. Candidates were asked to draft official communication and to explain their reasoning;
- 9 out of 16 candidates proceeded to the next step;

3. Final evaluation
- The last step of the process was an interview with the WDC Leader. Calls lasted for 30 minutes on average, focusing on various WCA/WDC topics;
- 6 out of 9 candidates were selected to become WDC members.

The new WDC members are: Arthur Garcin (2014GARC27), Christopher Morris (2013MORR03), Chris Tabar (2017TABA02), Jules Desjardin (2010DESJ01), Martin Vædele Egdal (2013EGDA02) and Sebastiano Tronto (2011TRON02).
I would like to welcome them to the Committee and thank everyone who submitted a candidacy: the selection process was very stimulating and I had a hard time making the final choices, meaning that the overall quality of candidates was very high.

At the same time, some procedural work was carried out behind the scenes to prepare the onboarding of the new members: a few documents were prepared and some decisions were made about internal communication. We are considering sharing one of these documents, since it could give an interesting insight on how the Committee operates.

During the selection process, Anuj Menta decided to step down from his role in the WDC for personal reasons. I would like to publicly thank him for his work and contribution in the Committee over the past two years, as well as wishing him all the best for his future endeavors!

To conclude, we would like to remind everyone to make sure they fully understand the WCA Regulations and competition procedures. If you have any questions or are unsure about how to do something, please do not hesitate to ask the Delegate(s) of the competition. In addition, if you think the competition results are being compromised in any way or if you see suspicious behavior, find the nearest delegate immediately and report the incident.

Thank you all for your help in supporting the WCA Spirit and Mission.

Lorenzo Vigani Poli
WDC Leader
On behalf of the Disciplinary Committee

title.zh: WCA 质量保证委员会招募成员（2019 年 11 月）

html.zh:
WCA 质量保证委员会（WQAC）正在招募新成员，一起完成委员会的工作！申请面向所有人开放，也欢迎目前未在 WCA 任职的社区成员申请。

WQAC 负责什么？

WQAC 负责制定并落实 WCA 内部的质量标准，包括为 WCA 社区编写教学材料，以及确保组织各岗位的工作人员保持履职所需的能力。WQAC 将深入参与与 WCA 代表工作有关的事务，并调查各地社区反映的质量问题。

WQAC 的正式权利与职责见 WCA 动议 10.2019.4。

我们希望申请者具备：

  • 细心、务实的思考方式。
  • 熟悉比赛的组织和运行。
  • 良好的协作能力，并能及时回应。
  • 能够讨论想法及其依据。

申请者可于即日起至 2019 年 12 月 31 日 23:59 UTC，将申请材料发送给 Daniel Vædele Egdal（degdal@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，应包含：

  • 简短的自我介绍。
  • 参与 WCA 工作的经历。
  • 申请加入 WQAC 的原因。

申请者会收到确认收件的回复，之后可能收到面试邀请。如有申请方面的问题，可联系 Daniel Vædele Egdal（degdal@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请期结束后，WQAC 负责人将进行选拔，待获选者接受职位后公布新成员。

感谢你愿意为 WQAC 和 WCA 出力！
html.en:
The WCA Quality Assurance Committee (WQAC) is seeking new members to help them with their mission! Applications are open to everyone and community members not currently holding a WCA position are encouraged to apply.

What does the WQAC do? The WQAC is responsible for developing and ensuring quality standards within the WCA. This includes producing educational material for the WCA Community and ensuring that Staff Members throughout the organization maintain the required skills for their positions. The WQAC will be highly involved in the work that WCA Delegates perform and will look into quality concerns in various communities.

The official rights and duties of the WQAC are documented in WCA Motion 10.2019.4.

Applicants are expected to have:

  • Strong attention to detail and practical thinking
  • Good knowledge of how competitions are organized and run.
  • Collaboration skills and responsiveness
  • Ability to discuss reasoning and ideas

The application period is open for applicants to submit their application document from now until December 31st, 2019, 23:59 UTC to Daniel Vædele Egdal (degdal@worldcubeassociation.org).

The application document must be in PDF format, and should include the following:

  • A brief personal introduction
  • Summary of activities done within the WCA
  • Motivation for applying to join the WQAC

Applicants can expect a reply to confirm the receipt of the application, and may later receive a request to be interviewed. Anyone with questions about applying can contact Daniel Vædele Egdal (degdal@worldcubeassociation.org).

After the application period, the WQAC Leader will make a selection and the new members will be announced once applicants have accepted the positions.

Thank you for your interest in assisting the WQAC and the WCA!

title.zh: 招募 WCA 比赛公告团队负责人（2019 年 11 月）

html.zh:
Henrik Buus Aagaard 已辞去 WCA 比赛公告团队（WCAT）负责人职务，WCA 将任命新负责人。感谢 Henrik 在带领团队期间所做的工作。WCAT 是 WCA 的咨询委员会之一，负责审批和公告 WCA 比赛。

候选人应完成整个任期（24 个月），平均每周至少投入 8 小时处理团队工作。我们希望候选人具备以下条件：

  • 较强的领导能力。
  • 注重细节。
  • 非常熟悉《WCA 比赛要求政策》（WCRP）。
  • 出色的沟通能力。

申请期从即日起至 2019 年 11 月 30 日 23:59 UTC。有意申请者可将材料私下发送至 WCA 董事会（board@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：

  • 简短的个人介绍。
  • 曾为 WCA 开展的工作概述。
  • 担任 WCA 比赛公告团队负责人后的工作设想。

此外，请提交一份可在申请期结束后公开的申请材料副本。

WCAT 的权利与职责见 WCA 议案 10.2019.1。

申请期结束后，WCA 董事会将投票选出人选，再由高级代表及现任委员会、团队负责人投票确认，随后公布新负责人。流程详见 WCA 议案 10.2019.0第 4 节。

感谢大家的申请与支持。
html.en:
There will be an appointment of a new WCA Competitions Announcements Team (WCAT) Leader, as Henrik Buus Aagaard has resigned. We would like to thank Henrik for the work he has done leading the team. The WCAT is an Advisory Committee of the WCA which is responsible for approving and announcing WCA competitions.

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 8 hours per week on average to work for the Team. The qualities expected of candidates are:

  • Strong leadership skills
  • Attention to detail
  • Very good knowledge of the WCRP
  • Excellent communication skills

The application period for candidates to submit their candidacy documents is from now until November 30th, 2019, 23:59 UTC. Interested candidates can send the application privately to the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).

The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

  • Brief personal introduction.
  • Summary of activities done for the WCA.
  • Ambitions as the WCAT Leader of the WCA.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WCAT can be found in WCA Motion 10.2019.1.

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of WCA Motion 10.2019.0.

Thanks for your candidacies and support.

title.zh: WCA 董事会成员变动（2019 年 11 月）
title.en: Changes in the Board of Directors (November 2019)

html.zh:
Alberto Pérez de Rada Fiol 和 Bob Burton 的董事任期即将结束，WCA 于 2019 年 11 月 9 日举行了不记名选举。此次选举依据《WCA 董事选举动议》进行。

董事会收到以下两人的申请：

  • Bob Burton
  • Henrik Buus Aagaard

我们很高兴地宣布，选举顺利完成，Bob Burton 成功连任，Henrik Buus Aagaard 新当选为 WCA 董事会成员。

感谢 Alberto 为 WCA 所做的一切，祝他今后一切顺利！

上述变动已立即生效。

Henrik 和 Bob 的申请材料可在这里查看。
html.en:
With the terms of Board Members Alberto Pérez de Rada Fiol and Bob Burton coming to an end, an anonymous election took place on November 9th, 2019. The election was done according to the WCA Motion: Election of Directors.

The Board received the applications of:

  • Bob Burton
  • Henrik Buus Aagaard

We are happy to announce that the election was successful and that both Bob Burton and Henrik Buus Aagaard were respectively re-elected and elected members of the WCA Board of Directors.

We want to thank Alberto for all the things he has done for the WCA. We wish him all the best in his future activities!

These changes have become effective immediately.

Henrik’s and Bob’s applications can be viewed here.

title.zh: 大洋洲高级代表任命公告
title.en: Announcement of a new Senior Delegate - Oceania

html.zh:
我们很高兴地宣布，Edward Hollingdale 将出任大洋洲地区的新任高级代表。感谢 Tim McMahon 担任该地区高级代表期间所做的工作。

WCA 董事会依照《关于高级代表的议案》第 4 节，经董事投票选出 Edward。

祝 Edward Hollingdale 在新的岗位上一切顺利。他的高级代表任期从今天（2019 年 11 月 1 日）开始。

如有兴趣，Edward 的申请材料可在这里查看。
html.en:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Senior Delegate for Oceania - Edward Hollingdale. We would like to thank Tim McMahon for his service as Senior Delegate for the region.

Edward was selected by the WCA Board by voting among them, following Section 4 of our Motion about Senior Delegates.

We wish Edward Hollingdale the best of luck in fulfilling his new duties. His term as Senior Delegate begins today (Nov 1, 2019).

The application document of Edward can be found here if you are interested in viewing it.

title.zh: WCA 与吉尼斯世界纪录达成合作
title.en: Collaboration between the WCA and Guinness World Records

html.zh:
亲爱的社区成员：

WCA 近期与吉尼斯世界纪录（GWR）建立合作，WCA 世界纪录将获得吉尼斯世界纪录的认可！你可以在这里查看吉尼斯官网的魔方纪录页面，也可以在这里查看双方合作介绍。

出现新的世界纪录时，WCA 沟通团队将联系破纪录者，协助其取得官方证书，吉尼斯官网也会相应更新。

我们很高兴达成这项合作，期待未来更多纪录被打破！
html.en:
Dear Community,

The WCA has recently partnered with Guinness World Records (GWR) in order to acknowledge WCA World Records as Guinness World Records! You can see the page for cubing records on the GWR website here and the page of the partnership with the WCA here.

When a new WR happens, the WCA Communication Team will contact the record breaker for them to obtain an official certificate and the GWR website will be updated.

We are really happy about this collaboration and look forward to the many records that will be broken in the future!

title.zh: 招募 WCA 传播团队平面设计成员（2019 年 10 月）
title.en: Call for Applicants - WCT Graphics Members (October 2019)

html.zh:
WCA 传播团队（WCT）正在招募新成员，协助设计社交媒体帖子及其他项目的图片！

所有 WCA 会员都可以申请，不要求申请者目前已在 WCA 任职。这一职位面向有平面设计经验的人，加入团队后的职责也将以此类工作为主。

WCT 负责什么？

  • 通过邮件及 WCA 网站联系页面，回复日常咨询。
  • 管理 WCA 官方社交媒体平台，定期发布有吸引力的内容。
  • 与 WCA 其他负责人合作，改善网站及面向社区的沟通。

章程中 WCT 的权利与职责可在这里查看。

工作流程概况

  • 社交媒体帖子至少提前 1 周规划，在成员有空时发布。
  • 涉及 WCT 其他项目的内部邮件须在 48 小时内回复；这些项目也可能带来其他工作，所需时间各不相同。
  • 每周需投入 4–10 小时。
  • 必须熟悉 Adobe Illustrator、GIMP 或同类软件。

我们希望申请者具备的素质

  • 创意：我们一直需要新的社交媒体系列内容构思，以及拓展其他平台的独特方式。你需要思考这些问题，并在有想法时提出建议。你的平面设计经验将帮助我们制作视觉上有吸引力的帖子。
  • 社交媒体知识：你应熟悉多个社交媒体平台及其基本功能。即使自己没有使用过，也需要代表 WCA 在这些平台发帖，并了解各平台适合什么内容。
  • 流利的英语：我们在大多数社交媒体平台上使用英语发帖，也用英语回复大多数邮件。同时欢迎除英语外还熟练掌握其他语言的人加入。
  • 沟通能力：你将负责设计内容得体、能够传达 WCA 使命的社交媒体帖子。
  • 耐心：在邮件和社交媒体交流中保持友好。

申请材料请包含：

  • 简短的个人介绍。
  • 参与 WCA 的经历。
  • 申请加入 WCT 的原因。
  • 对社交媒体平台的熟悉程度，以及一条可供 WCA 发布的帖子构思。
  • 2–3 件自己创作的设计作品，展示个人设计风格。

请于即日起至 2019 年 12 月 10 日 23:59 UTC，将 PDF 格式的申请发送至 lclement@worldcubeassociation.org。

提交申请后，候选人可能还需与负责人面试。申请期结束后的下一周，团队将选出人选，并在候选人接受职位后公布新成员名单。如对申请流程有疑问，请联系 Lauren Clement（lclement@worldcubeassociation.org）。

感谢大家的申请与支持！
html.en:
The WCT is seeking new members to help with graphics design for social media posts and other projects!

The application is open to all WCA members. You do not have to hold a current position to be considered. This position is directed to those with graphic design experience and duties once on the team will mainly focus on that type of work.

What does the WCT do?

  • Answers daily inquires to the WCA through emails and the contact page on the WCA website.
  • Manages official WCA social media platforms through frequent & engaging posts
  • Works with other WCA leaders to improve the WCA website and communications to the community

The rights and duties of WCT from our By-laws can be found here.

Workflow Outline

  • Social media posts are planned at least 1 week in advance and are posted when members are available.
  • Internal emails regarding other WCT projects are answered within 48 hours and other work may come from those projects that take various amounts of time.
  • Time commitment per week is between 4-10 hours.
  • Must be familiar with Adobe Illustrator, GIMP, or equivalent programs

Characteristics we are looking for

  • Creativity: We always need ideas of new social media series or unique ways to expand to other platforms. You will be required to think about this and suggest ideas when you can. With your graphic design experience, you will help us with designing visually compelling posts.
  • Social media knowledge: You should be familiar with many social media platforms and their basic functions. While you may not have used them personally, you will have to post to them as the WCA and should know what type of content goes on each.
  • Fluent English: Our posts on most social media platforms are in English and we answer most emails in English. We do welcome those that are fluent in other languages alongside English.
  • Communication skills: You will be responsible for designing social media posts that are appropriate and convey the mission of the WCA.
  • Patience: You should keep friendly communications within our email and social media interactions.

To apply, please include:

  • A brief personal introduction
  • Your involvement with the WCA
  • Your motivation for applying to the WCT
  • Your familiarity with social media platforms & an idea of a potential WCA post
  • 2-3 designs that you have created to highlight your design style

Please send the application in PDF format to lclement@worldcubeassociation.org from now until December 10, 2019, 23:59 UTC to be considered.

There may be an additional interview requested of candidates with the leader following application submission. The week after the application period, the team will make a selection and the new member(s) will be announced once candidates have accepted the positions. If you have any questions regarding the application process, do not hesitate to reach out to Lauren Clement (lclement@worldcubeassociation.org).

Thank you for your candidacies and support!

title.zh: WCA 质量保障委员会招募负责人（2019 年 10 月）

html.zh:
Gregor Billing 已辞职，WCA 将任命新的 WCA 质量保障委员会（WQAC）负责人。感谢 Gregor Billing 在带领委员会期间所做的工作。WQAC 负责支持和推动 WCA 持续改进工作质量，在全球实施质量标准，使 WCA 工作人员、地区组织、比赛组织者及比赛工作人员的工作流程保持稳定的高质量。

申请人应能完成 24 个月任期，并平均每周至少投入 6 小时处理委员会事务。我们希望申请人具备：

  • 注重细节。
  • 工作准确。
  • 十分熟悉竞赛规则。
  • 思考务实。
  • 良好的协作能力。

申请从即日起开放，截止时间为 2019 年 11 月 15 日 23:59 UTC。有意者请私下将材料发送至 WCA 董事会（board@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，包含：

  • 简短的个人介绍。
  • 为 WCA 所做工作的概述。
  • 担任 WCA 质量保障委员会负责人的工作设想。

另请提供一份可在申请截止后公开的申请材料副本。

WQAC 的权利与职责见 WCA 议案 10.2019.4。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将通过投票选出新负责人，并按照 WCA 议案 10.2019.0 第 4 节，经高级代表及现任委员会、团队负责人投票确认后公布。

感谢大家的申请与支持。
html.en:
There will be an appointment of a new WCA Quality Assurance Committee (WQAC) Leader, as Gregor Billing has resigned. We would like to thank Gregor Billing for the work he has done leading the committee. The WQAC has the role of supporting and promoting continuous quality improvement within the WCA. They apply quality standards worldwide to ensure consistent high quality of processes for WCA Staff, Regional Organizations, Competition Organizers, and Competition Staff.

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 6 hours per week on average to work for the Committee. The qualities expected of candidates are:

  • Attention to detail
  • Accuracy
  • Very good knowledge of the Regulations
  • Practical thinking
  • Collaboration skills

The application period for candidates to submit their candidacy documents is from now until November 15th, 2019, 23:59 UTC. Interested candidates can send the application privately to the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).

The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

  • Brief personal introduction.
  • Summary of activities done for the WCA.
  • Ambitions as the WQAC Leader of the WCA.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WQAC can be found in WCA Motion 10.2019.4.

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of WCA Motion 10.2019.0.

Thanks for your candidacies and support.

title.zh: WDC 月度简报：2019 年 8 月和 9 月

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

以下为纪律委员会 2019 年 8、9 月的重要动态。

目前积极处理 5 件案件；8 月下半月结案 4 件，9 月结案 5 件。2019 年调查及案件总数现为 45。

主要调查涉及 2017SHIR03 在 Udmurtia Open 2019 的三阶单手正式成绩。调查认定其在第一轮和决赛多次用还原手臂提前停表作弊，视频证实了证人举报。其被禁赛 2 年，该比赛全部三阶单手成绩被取消。

如上期预告，WDC 原定公布初夏影响乌克兰社群案件的报告。但近几个月，我们调查了比平常更多的利用裁判缺乏经验谋利案件：例如观察期间转动，以及故意不复位计时器，使成绩单记录更快时间。现场无人察觉，后来依视频解决；选手被禁赛，相关成绩取消。鉴于这一令人担忧的趋势，上述报告正在修订，改为说明哪些流程未正确执行，以及如何预防容易被利用的情况。

另一方面，我想公开感谢 JP Bulman 近两年来为 WDC 作出的出色贡献。JP 即将离任，我们正在寻找新成员。遴选进展良好，候选人水平很高，计划月底前确定“新”WDC。

最后提醒充分理解规则及流程，不清楚时询问代表。若认为成绩受到损害或发现可疑行为，请立即找最近的代表报告。

感谢大家支持 WCA 精神与使命。感谢 JP 的宝贵贡献，祝未来顺利！

Lorenzo Vigani Poli WDC 负责人，代表纪律委员会
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

Here you can find some noteworthy updates about the activity of the Disciplinary Committee over the months of August and September 2019.

The Committee is actively working on 5 cases. The WDC was also able to close 4 cases over the second half of August and 5 during September. The total number of investigations/cases in 2019 is now 45.

The main case the WDC was called to investigate during this time is the one concerning the official results in 3x3 One-Handed of 2017SHIR03 at Udmurtia Open 2019. The competitor has been found guilty of cheating in the event by prematurely stopping the timer with his solving arm during various attempts, both in the First and Final rounds. Video evidence was available and it confirmed what witnesses denounced. The competitor is banned from WCA Competitions for 2 years and all of the results achieved in 3x3 One-Handed at Udmurtia Open 2019 have been disqualified.

As anticipated in the last Monthly Digest, the WDC decided to publish the report for the case that affected the Ukrainian Community at the beginning of the summer. Over the last couple of months, though, the WDC has conducted more investigations than usual where we saw competitors exploiting the lack of experience of judges to gain a personal advantage: for example, a competitor was caught applying moves during inspection, while another one was caught not resetting the timer intentionally, which resulted in a faster result getting registered on the scorecards. These cases were resolved using video evidence, when nobody noticed anything during the competition. As a consequence of their actions, these competitors were banned from WCA Competitions and the affected results were disqualified. Because of this worrisome trend, the aforementioned report is currently under revision and it will be reshaped to show which WCA processes were not properly followed and how it’s possible to prevent easily exploitable situations during competitions.

Now, on a more pleasant note, I would like to use this space to publicly thank JP Bulman for his outstanding work for the WDC over the last (almost) 2 years. JP will shortly leave the Committee and we are currently working on finding new members. The selection process is going pretty well and I’m very pleased to see such a high level of candidates; the plan is to have the “new” WDC defined by the end of the month.

To conclude, we would like to remind everyone to make sure they fully understand the WCA Regulations and competition procedures. If you have any questions or are unsure about how to do something, please do not hesitate to ask the Delegate(s) of the competition. In addition, if you think the competition results are being compromised in any way or see suspicious behavior, find the nearest delegate immediately and report the incident.

Thank you all for your help in supporting the WCA Spirit and Mission.

Thank you, JP, for your very valuable contribution and best of luck for your future!

Lorenzo Vigani Poli
WDC Leader
On behalf of the Disciplinary Committee

title.zh: WCA 软件团队新负责人（2019 年 10 月）

html.zh:
我们很高兴地宣布，Philippe Virouleau 将成为 WCA 软件团队（WST）的新负责人。Philippe 此前已是 WST 成员。

按照 WCA 委员会与团队动议 10.2019.0第 4 节的规定，WCA 董事会选定 Philippe，并由现任委员会负责人和高级代表投票通过。

感谢 Jeremy Fleischman 为 WST 所做的工作，祝 Philippe 在新的岗位上工作顺利。

新负责人将立即就任。Philippe 是唯一的申请者，他的申请材料可在此处查看。
html.en:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Team Leader. Philippe Virouleau will become the new Leader of the WCA Software Team (WST). Philippe was already working as a member of the WST.

Philippe was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote among the current Committee Leaders and Senior Delegates, following Section 4 of our Motion 10.2019.0 about WCA Committees and Teams.

We thank Jeremy Fleischman for the work he has done for the WST, and wish Philippe best of luck in fulfilling his new duties.

The new Leader will be promoted immediately. Philippe was the only applicant and his candidacy document can be found here.

title.zh: 新任高级代表公告（2019 年 10 月）

html.zh:
我们很高兴宣布，两位新高级代表已获任命：

  • Leow Yi Jun——东南亚
  • Serhii Koksharov——欧亚中部

WCA 董事会依照关于高级代表的决议 9.2019.1第 4 节，通过内部投票选定了他们。

两人的高级代表任期自 2019 年 10 月 1 日起生效。

申请材料可在此处查看。

Ilya Tsiareshka 也提交了欧亚中部高级代表的申请。感谢所有申请人愿意在现有工作的基础上，继续为 WCA 和速拧社区多出一份力。祝 Yi Jun 和 Serhii 在新岗位上一切顺利！
html.en:
We are happy to announce that we have two new Senior Delegates:

  • Leow Yi Jun - Asia Southeast
  • Serhii Koksharov - Central Eurasia

They were selected by the WCA Board by voting among them, following Section 4 of Motion 9.2019.1 about Senior Delegates.

Their terms as Senior Delegate are effective as of October 1, 2019.

The application documents can be found here if you are interested in viewing them.

An application was also received from Ilya Tsiareshka for the Central Eurasia Senior Delegate position. We want to thank all applicants for their willingness in helping the WCA and the Speedcubing Community even more than they currently do. Good luck to Yi Jun and Serhii in their new roles!

title.zh: 2019 年红牛与 WCA 合作赛事

html.zh:
如 WCA 董事会此前所通报，WCA 与 Red Bull Mind Gamers 决定在本赛季合作，在中国、墨西哥和西班牙举办联合赛事。具体比赛如下：

As informed earlier by the WCA Board, the WCA and Red Bull Mind Gamers have decided to partner together to host joint events in China, Mexico, and Spain this season. The competitions will take place as follows:

You can learn more about the Red Bull Rubik’s Cube World Cup and their qualifiers here.

title.zh: 招募 WDC 成员（2019 年 9 月）

html.zh:
**WCA 纪律委员会（WDC）**正在招募新成员协助履行使命！人人可申请，鼓励目前未在 WCA 任职的社群成员申请。

WDC 做什么？

  • 就特殊个案向理事会提供意见，例如涉嫌违反 WCA 规则；
  • WCA 成员遇到有关比赛的重要个人事务时可联系 WDC。

更多工作信息见纪律日志。暂停资格及其他处分见动议 15.2019.1，正式权利和职责见动议 10.2019.2。

**期望素质与要求：**清白的背景、个人时间管理能力、讨论推理和想法的能力、熟悉 WCA 活动。

申请期为即日起至 2019 年 9 月 23 日 23:59 UTC，请发送至 Lorenzo Vigani Poli（lpoli@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请文件必须为 PDF，应包含简短自我介绍、在魔方社群中所做活动、加入 WDC 的动机。非 PDF 文件将自动弃置。

申请人会收到收件确认，之后可能获邀面试。有疑问可联系 Lorenzo Vigani Poli。申请期后由 WDC 负责人遴选，在申请人接受职位后公布新成员。

感谢愿意协助 WDC 和 WCA！
html.en:
The WCA Disciplinary Committee (WDC) is seeking new members to help them with their mission! Applications are open to everyone and community members not currently holding a WCA position are encouraged to apply.

What does the WDC do?
- Advises the WCA Board in special cases, like alleged violations of WCA Regulations
- May be contacted by WCA members in case of important personal matters regarding WCA competitions.

If you want to get more insight about the work of the Committee, you can check the Disciplinary Log on the WCA website. Suspensions and other Sanctions are defined in Motion 15.2019.1. The official rights and duties of the WDC are documented in WCA Motion 10.2019.2.

The qualities and requirements expected of candidates are:
- Clear background
- Personal time management skills
- Ability to discuss reasoning and ideas
- Familiarity with WCA activities

The application period is open for applicants to submit their application documents from now until September 23rd, 2019, 23:59 UTC to Lorenzo Vigani Poli (lpoli@worldcubeassociation.org).

The application document must be in PDF format, and should include the following:
- A brief personal introduction
- Summary of activities done within the cubing community
- Motivation for applying to join the WDC

Application documents not in PDF format will be automatically discarded.

Applicants can expect a reply to confirm the receipt of the application, and may later receive a request to be interviewed. Anyone with questions about applying can contact Lorenzo Vigani Poli (lpoli@worldcubeassociation.org).

After the application period, the WDC Leader will make a selection and the new members will be announced once applicants have accepted the positions.

Thank you for your interest in assisting the WDC, and the WCA!

title.zh: 新增比赛收藏功能

html.zh:
WCA 网站新增了比赛收藏功能！

比赛公告后，你可以点击比赛名称旁的“收藏”图标：

比赛收藏按钮

Once a competition is announced, you can click the "bookmark" icon next to its name:

https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbmtCIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--fcf4a3bfe0a23fa4c37720846dcddfc0fdd35860/bookmark_button.png

title.zh: 洲际锦标赛举办地及今后锦标赛申办安排

html.zh:
我们很高兴公布 2020 年洲际锦标赛的获选举办地：

2020 年 WCA 亚洲锦标赛将于 2020 年 8 月 27–30 日在马来西亚吉隆坡举行。

2020 年 WCA 欧洲锦标赛将于 2020 年 7 月 16–19 日在荷兰阿尔梅勒举行。

2020 年 WCA 北美锦标赛将于 2020 年 6 月 25–28 日在加拿大多伦多举行。

在比赛正式公布于 WCA 网站之前，以上日期和地点均为暂定。

2020 年 WCA 大洋洲锦标赛举办地的决定已推迟。

非洲和南美洲没有收到申办申请，因此这两个洲在 2020 年不会举办洲际锦标赛。

申办材料的公开版本见此处。大洋洲锦标赛申办材料的公开版本将在决定作出后公布。

此外，我们也将调整今后锦标赛的申办时间安排及要求。

The public versions of the applications are available here. The public version of the Oceanian Championship application will be published after a decision is made.

title.zh: WCA 道德委员会成员招募（2019 年 8 月）

html.zh:
**WCA 道德委员会（WEC）**正在招募新成员，帮助委员会完成工作！申请向所有人开放，申请者不必目前在 WCA 担任职务。

WEC 的工作是什么？

  • 维护和更新道德准则。
  • 确保 WCA 工作人员遵循的各项程序符合道德准则。
  • 如有 WCA 工作人员不遵守道德准则，开展独立调查。
  • 为提出调查请求的已注册速拧选手提供保密沟通渠道。
  • 如相关当事方不认同 WCA 纪律委员会的决定，担任申诉审理机构。

WEC 的正式权利与职责载于 WCA 动议 10.2019.3。

我们希望候选人具备以下条件：

  • 无不良记录。
  • 良好的个人时间管理能力。
  • 能讨论观点并说明理由。
  • 熟悉 WCA 的各项活动。

申请自即日起开放，截止时间为 2019 年 9 月 11 日 23:59 UTC。请将材料发送给 Callum Goodyear（cgoodyear@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包括：

  • 简短的个人介绍。
  • 在魔方社区所做工作的概述。
  • 申请加入 WEC 的原因。

我们会及时回复确认收到申请，之后可能邀请申请者面试。有关申请的任何疑问，可联系 Callum Goodyear（cgoodyear@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请截止后，WEC 负责人将选定人选，待申请者接受职务后公布新成员。

感谢大家的申请与支持！
html.en:
The WCA Ethics Committee (WEC) is seeking new members to help them with their mission! The applications are open to everyone; it’s not a requirement to hold a current position in the WCA to be considered.

What does the WEC do?

  • Maintaining and updating the Code of Ethics.
  • Ensures that all procedures followed by WCA Staff abide by the Code of Ethics.
  • Performs independent investigations if any WCA Staff member is not compliant with said Code of Ethics.
  • Confidant for Registered Speedcubers that request investigations.
  • Functions as the board of appeal if any involved party disagrees with a decision made by the WCA Disciplinary Committee.

The official rights and duties of the WEC are documented in WCA Motion 10.2019.3.

The qualities and requirements expected of candidates are:

  • Clear background
  • Personal time management skills
  • Ability to discuss reasoning and ideas
  • Familiarity with WCA activities

The application period is open for applicants to submit their application documents from now until September 11th, 2019, 23:59 UTC to Callum Goodyear (cgoodyear@worldcubeassociation.org).

Candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

  • A brief personal introduction
  • Summary of activities done within the cubing community
  • Motivation for applying to join the WEC

Applicants can expect an immediate reply to confirm the receipt of the application, and may later receive a request to be interviewed. Anyone with questions about applying can contact Callum Goodyear (cgoodyear@worldcubeassociation.org).

After the application period, the WEC Leader will make a selection and the new members will be announced once applicants have accepted the positions.

Thank you for your candidacies and support!

title.zh: WDC 月度简报：2019 年 7 月

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

以下为纪律委员会 2019 年 7 月的重要动态。

目前积极处理 9 件案件。7 月底至 8 月初也完成了一些案件，包括六月初 Ukrainian Open 2019 期间对乌克兰及国际社群影响重大的案件。调查报告将随下期简报公布；结果已可在官网看到，因此先作简述。

WDC 最终决定，因无法确认成绩合法性，取消 2017LENY01 在 WCA 比赛取得的全部正式成绩，并给予附条件禁赛：在其开始配合 WDC、澄清作弊情况前，不得参加任何 WCA 正式活动。WDC 给了两个月说明事件、回答问题，但其未作答。

视频是启动调查的关键，调查也高度依赖乌克兰社群成员及当地 WCA 官员证词。这些因素使 WDC 认定：视频中用前臂动作在还原中提前停表的情况并非偶发，而是其练习形成的习惯。感谢参与调查、支持 WCA 精神与使命的所有人。

另一个值得公开讨论的案件涉及前理事会成员 Olivér Perge。他近期主动联系 WDC，承认 2007 年、正式参与 WCA 工作前的一次作弊。WDC 请他直接向社群说明，以下为来信：

亲爱的 WCA 社群：

我想承认，在 Swedish Cube Day 2007 的多盲中作弊。我从眼罩下偷看，每还原一个就检查一个。这是一次性事件，我立即后悔，至今仍非常难受。当时刚开始竞技速拧，太害怕坦白，后来又不想让这一错误损害自己的正式职位。但现在我认为应站出来，尽管已过去近十年。我深感抱歉，希望能够挽回，却无法做到。诚实与诚信是 WCA 的核心价值，希望我的教训至少能作为一个例子。

谨致问候， Olivér Perge

WDC 感谢其诚实坦白。相关尝试当然已被取消，匈牙利多盲国家纪录历史也因此改变。虽时隔很久，坦白仍重要，因为终于纠正了事情。人会犯错，重要的是承认并学习。

约在内部讨论此案的同时，另一名选手在 Facebook 公开类似坦白：2017HEIS02 承认一年多前的金字塔正式单次成绩来自重复打乱。WDC 联系并感谢其诚实，如许多人已公开表达的那样，并告知无需进一步措施。

最后提醒充分理解规则及流程，有疑问时询问代表。若认为成绩受到损害或看到可疑行为，请立即找最近的代表报告。

感谢支持 WCA 精神与使命。

Lorenzo Vigani Poli WDC 团队负责人，代表纪律委员会
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

Here you can find some noteworthy updates about the activity of the Disciplinary Committee over the month of July 2019.

The Committee is actively working on 9 cases. The WDC was also able to close a few cases between the end of July and the beginning of August. One of these cases is the one that greatly affected the Ukrainian and international community at the beginning of June, during Ukrainian Open 2019. The report of this investigation will be published with the next WDC Monthly Digest. In the meantime, since the result of the investigation can be seen on the WCA website, a quick overview of the case is necessary.

The final decision of the WDC was to disqualify all of the official results obtained by 2017LENY01 in WCA competitions because of the impossibility to determine the legitimacy of these results. The WDC also administered a conditional ban to the competitor, which means that 2017LENY01 will not be allowed to participate in any WCA official event until he starts cooperating with the WDC to clarify the circumstances of his cheating. 2017LENY01 was given two months to offer his version of the events and to reply to the question of the WDC, but he has failed to do so.
Video evidence was key in opening the investigation, which greatly relied on the testimony of different members of the Ukrainian community and local WCA officials. These factors helped the WDC reach the conclusion about the circumstances that can be seen in the video evidence, specifically 2017LENY01 stopping the timer early with a movement of his forearms during the solve, were not isolated instances but a practiced habit for the competitor.

The WDC would like to thank all the people involved in the investigation for their help and efforts in supporting the WCA Spirit and Mission.

Another case that deserves public discussion involves former WCA Board member Olivér Perge. Olivér recently contacted the WDC to confess an episode of cheating that happened in 2007, before Olivér’s official involvement with the WCA. The WDC asked Olivér to directly address the Community and explain his actions. This is the letter he wrote:

Dear WCA Community,

I would like to admit that I cheated at multi blind during the Swedish Cube Day 2007 competition. I peeked under the blindfold and checked the cubes after I solved them one by one. This was a one time incident, I regretted it immediately and I still feel horrible about it to this day. I was just starting competitive speedcubing and was too scared to come clean back then, and later on I didn't want my official positions to be damaged by this mistake, but I felt important now to come forward, even though it was almost a decade ago. I am deeply sorry and wish I could undo it somehow, but I cannot. Honesty and integrity are key values within the WCA, and I just hope that my lesson can serve as an example at least.

Kind Regards,
Olivér Perge

The WDC would like to thank Olivér for his honesty in confessing. The affected attempt was of course disqualified, changing the history of Hungarian multi-blind National Records.

Even though a lot of time has passed, Olivér’s confession is important, since it finally makes things right. Mistakes can happen, but it’s important to recognize and learn from them.
Around the same time when the WDC was discussing Olivér’s case internally, a similar confession was published on Facebook by another competitor. 2017HEIS02 confessed that his official single in Pyraminx was achieved on a duplicate scramble, more than a year ago. The WDC contacted the competitor and thanked him for his honesty, as many others had already done publicly, communicating that no further action by the Committee was deemed necessary.

To conclude, we would like to remind everyone to make sure they fully understand the WCA Regulations and competition procedures. If you have any questions or are unsure about how to do something, please do not hesitate to ask the Delegate(s) of the competition. In addition, if you think the competition results are being compromised in any way or see suspicious behavior, find the nearest delegate immediately and report the incident.

Thank you all for your help in supporting the WCA Spirit and Mission.

Lorenzo Vigani Poli
WDC Team Leader
On behalf of the Disciplinary Committee

title.zh: WCA 软件团队负责人招募（2019 年 8 月）

html.zh:
Jeremy Fleischman 的任期将于 2019 年 10 月 1 日结束，WCA 将任命一位新的软件团队（WST）负责人。感谢 Jeremy 在带领团队期间所做的工作。WST 负责管理 WCA 的软件，包括网站、打乱程序、成绩工作簿和管理工具。

申请人应能完成 24 个月的任期，并平均每周为团队工作至少 10 小时。我们希望申请人具备以下条件：

  • 扎实的专业技术能力。
  • 良好的沟通能力。
  • 解决问题的能力。
  • 能围绕目标开展工作。
  • 项目管理经验。

申请材料提交截止时间为 2019 年 9 月 6 日 23:59 UTC，请私下发送给 Bob Burton（rburton@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，包含：

  • 简短的自我介绍。
  • 为 WCA 所做工作的总结。
  • 担任 WST 负责人的工作设想。

此外，请提供一份可在申请期结束后公开的申请材料。

WST 的权利和职责见 WCA 决议 10.2017.4。

申请期结束后，WCA 董事会将投票选定人选，经高级代表和现任委员会/团队负责人投票确认后公布。流程见 WCA 决议 10.2019.0第 4 节。

感谢大家的申请与支持！
html.en:
There will be an appointment of a new WCA Software Team Leader (WST), as Jeremy Fleischman’s term expires on October 1, 2019. We would like to thank Jeremy for the work he has done leading the Team. The WST is responsible for managing the WCA's software which includes the website, scramblers, workbooks, and admin tools.

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 10 hours per week on average to work for the Committee. The qualities expected of candidates are:

  • Strong technical expertise
  • Good communication
  • Problem solving skills
  • Goal-oriented
  • Project management experience

The application period is open for candidates to submit their candidacy documents until September 6th, 2019, 23:59 UTC privately to the Bob Burton (rburton@worldcubeassociation.org).

The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

  • Brief personal introduction.
  • Summary of activities done for the WCA.
  • Ambitions as the WST Leader.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WST can be found in WCA Motion 10.2017.4.

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of WCA Motion 10.2019.0.

Thank you in advance for your candidacies and support!

title.zh: WCA 软件团队招募成员（2019 年 7 月）

html.zh:
WCA 软件团队（WST）正在招募新成员！所有人都可以申请，不要求目前在 WCA 任职。WST 通过开发、扩展和维护各类软件，帮助 WCA 应对社区的持续增长，是协会运作的重要一环。这些软件包括：

  • WCA 网站。
  • TNoodle。
  • Workbook Assistant。

以上项目均已开源，可在 WCA 的 GitHub 上找到。项目采用的技术多种多样，包括 Ruby on Rails、JavaScript、CSS、MySQL、Chef、React、Java 等，欢迎不同技术背景的开发者申请！

有意申请者，请通过 afiol@worldcubeassociation.org 联系 WST 项目经理 Alberto Pérez de Rada Fiol，作自我介绍并说明开发经验。如果还能介绍自己为 WCA 所做的工作，以及加入团队后的目标，将更有助于申请。

目前，团队优先推进的项目有：

  1. 网站改版：
    • 将旧 PHP 网站的剩余部分迁移至 Ruby on Rails。
    • 实现已经准备好的新版设计。
  2. WCA Live：
    • 建立现代化的实时成绩平台，并能与其他软件通信。
  3. WCA 论坛：
    • 搭建 Discourse 论坛，并接入多项集成功能。

申请者须先为项目作出贡献，之后才会收到正式入队邀请。为方便入门，网站项目的一些问题已标记为 good first issues 和 good second issues。

符合要求的申请者将陆续加入团队。WST 长期欢迎新成员，感兴趣的开发者随时都可以联系我们！

感谢大家的申请和支持！
html.en:
The WCA Software Team (WST) is looking for new members! The applications are open to everyone; it’s not a requirement to hold a current position in the WCA to be considered. The WST plays a central role on the WCA developing, scaling, and maintaining the software solutions that help the organization handle the continuous community growth. Some examples of such software solutions are:

  • A website
  • TNoodle
  • Workbook Assistant

All of the above are open-sourced and can be found on the WCA’s GitHub. The technologies used on these projects is very varied: Ruby on Rails, JavaScript, CSS, MySQL, Chef, React, Java, etc, so developers of all backgrounds are encouraged to apply!

Interested applicants should reach out to Alberto Pérez de Rada Fiol (WST’s Project Manager) at afiol@worldcubeassociation.org with an introduction of themselves that includes their experience as developers. Adding activities done for the WCA and goals as a team member is a plus.

Among the projects the team has, the ones we are trying to deliver first are:

  1. Website redesign:

    • To port the remaining parts of the old PHP website to RoR
    • To implement an already prepared redesign

  2. WCA Live

    • To build a modern platform for live results able to communicate with the other softwares

  3. WCA Forum

    • Provide a Discourse forum with several integrations

Applicants will be asked to contribute to the projects before being formally invited to the team. For this purpose, and specifically for the website, we have labeled some issues as good first issues and good second issues.

Successful applicants will be added to the team on a rolling basis. It’s worth noting that the WST is always looking for new members, so we encourage interested developers to reach out to us at any time!

Thank you for your applications and support!

title.zh: 停止使用 TNoodle 0.14.0

html.zh:
TNoodle-WCA-0.15.0 发布时，我们曾宣布，TNoodle-WCA-0.14.0 将在短期内继续作为正式允许使用的版本。现在已过去近 2 周，TNoodle-WCA-0.14.0 正式停用，TNoodle-WCA-0.15.0 成为唯一的官方打乱程序版本。

详情请参阅上周的 TNoodle-WCA-0.15.0 公告。

请记住，正式比赛必须使用现行版本的官方打乱程序。下载地址始终为： https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/
html.en:
When TNoodle-WCA-0.15.0 was released, we announced that TNoodle-WCA-0.14.0 would briefly remain an officially permitted version. Since almost 2 weeks has passed, TNoodle-WCA-0.14.0 is now officially retired, leaving TNoodle-WCA-0.15.0 as the only official scramble program.

Please see last week's TNoodle-WCA-0.15.0 announcement for details.

Please remember that official competitions must use a current version of the official scramble program. This is always available from: https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/

title.zh: WDC 月度简报：2019 年 5 月和 6 月

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

以下为纪律委员会 2019 年 5、6 月的重要动态。

2019 年前六个月立案数量已超过 2018 年全年。目前积极处理 11 件，其中少数简单，多数复杂，需更多时间精力才能妥善结案。例如，正在调查一宗对乌克兰社群影响重大的案件，需要更多时间覆盖各方面。

数量增长部分因为，当被指控者不是 WCA 工作人员时，WDC 也须调查违反伦理准则的行为。另一个原因显然是工作人员和注册选手观察更仔细，发现异常及时联系。感谢所有提供准确资料与背景的人；报告越准确，调查越快。

最后提醒充分理解规则及流程，有疑问时询问代表。若认为成绩受到损害或看到可疑行为，请立即找最近的代表报告。

感谢支持 WCA 精神与使命。

Lorenzo Vigani Poli WDC 团队负责人，代表纪律委员会
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

Here you can find some noteworthy updates about the activity of the Disciplinary Committee over the months of May and June 2019.

In the first six months of 2019, the WDC has opened more investigations than in 2018 as a whole.

The Committee is currently actively working on 11 cases. Some of these cases are straightforward but the majority are more complex and require more time and effort to reach a proper conclusion. For example, the WDC is currently investigating a case that greatly affects the Ukrainian community and some more time is needed to properly cover all of the different aspects of this particular case.

The aforementioned increment in the number of investigations is partially due to the fact that the WDC has to investigate violations of the Code of Ethics if the accused individual is not WCA Staff. Another reason is surely represented by a more careful eye from WCA Staff and Registered Speedcubers who promptly contact the WDC if they witness something odd. We would like to thank everyone who contacts us providing precise information and context. The more accurate a reporting is, the quicker the investigation will be.

To conclude, we would like to remind everyone to make sure they fully understand the WCA Regulations and competition procedures. If you have any questions or are unsure about how to do something, please do not hesitate to ask the Delegate(s) of the competition. In addition, if you think the competition results are being compromised in any way or see suspicious behavior, find the nearest delegate immediately and report the incident.

Thank you all for your help in supporting the WCA Spirit and Mission.

Lorenzo Vigani Poli
WDC Team Leader
On behalf of the Disciplinary Committee

title.zh: TNoodle 0.15.0

html.zh:
TNoodle-WCA-0.15.0 现已在打乱页面提供下载。 与上一版本相比，作出了以下调整：

与普通选手有关的调整：

  • 改善最少步打乱裁切页的排版间距。
  • 选手可在最少步答题纸上填写比赛名称。

与工作人员有关的调整：

  • 由于比赛名称可由选手填写，剩余的最少步答题纸可以留到其他比赛使用。
  • 禁止将多盲数量设为 1 个，以防输入错误。
  • 为比赛生成打乱时，显示各项目的轮次和分组表。
  • 可选择按赛程顺序打印打乱。

即将举行的比赛应尽可能使用 TNoodle-WCA-0.15.0 生成新的打乱。不过，由于本次直接影响选手的改动很少，TNoodle-WCA-0.14.0 将暂时继续作为官方允许的版本；未来一周比赛中已经使用 TNoodle-WCA-0.14.0 生成的打乱仍可使用。

请记住，正式比赛必须使用官方打乱程序当前获准使用的版本，可随时从以下页面下载： https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/
html.en:
TNoodle-WCA-0.15.0 is now available on the Scrambles page The following changes have been made, since the previous version:

Changes visible to the regular competitor:

  • Better spacing on FMC cutout sheets.
  • Competitor can fill competition's name on FMC filling sheet.

Changes visible to staff members:

  • Since competitors can fill competition's name on the FMC filling sheet, you can reuse sheets across competitions (in case you got some left).
  • Prevent Multi-Blind from being set to 1 cube (prevent input mistakes).
  • Show a table with rounds and groups for each event when generating scrambles for a competition.
  • Option to print ordered scrambles matching the schedule.

Upcoming competitions should use TNoodle-WCA-0.15.0 to generate new scrambles, when possible. However, since we have just a few changes that directly affect competitors, TNoodle-WCA-0.14.0 will briefly remain an officially permitted version (competition scrambles for the coming week that have already been generated using TNoodle-WCA-0.14.0 can still be used).

Please remember that official competitions must use a current version of the official scramble program. This is always available from: https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/

title.zh: Philipp Weyer 夺得澳大利亚墨尔本 2019 年 WCA 世锦赛冠军
title.en: Philipp Weyer wins WCA World Championship 2019, in Melbourne, Victoria, Australia

html.zh:
Philipp Weyer 以 6.74 秒的平均成绩赢得了 2019 年 WCA 世锦赛冠军。Sean Patrick Villanueva 以 6.78 秒获得亚军，Sebastian Weyer 以 6.81 秒获得季军。

世界纪录：Andrew Huang，斜转单次 0.93；Max Park，七阶单次 1:44.02、平均 1:50.10；Stanley Chapel，四阶盲拧单次 1:08.07、平均 1:21.81，五阶盲拧单次 2:38.77。

非洲纪录：Timothy Lawrance，三阶最少步单次 25 步、平均 28.00 步。

亚洲纪录：Lim Hung，三阶脚拧单次 17.10、平均 23.29；Makoto Takaoka（高岡誠），Square-1 平均 7.50；Seung Hyuk Nahm（남승혁），四阶单次 19.87、平均 23.57，五阶平均 45.75、单次 40.66、平均 44.78，六阶单次 1:24.61。

大洋洲纪录：David Epstein，Square-1 平均 8.68；Tom Nelson，三阶多盲单次 29/31，57:09。

欧洲纪录：Amos Nordman，五魔方平均 34.50；Ciarán Beahan，五阶单次 38.96、六阶平均 1:27.23；Martin Vædele Egdal，三阶盲拧平均 21.52、平均 19.94。

北美洲纪录：Max Hilliard，三阶盲拧单次 16.23。

南美洲纪录：Manuel Gutman，三阶盲拧平均 20.81、五阶盲拧单次 6:13.53。
html.en:
Philipp Weyer won WCA World Championship 2019 with an average of 6.74 seconds. Sean Patrick Villanueva finished second (6.78) and Sebastian Weyer finished third (6.81).

World records: Andrew Huang‎ Skewb 0.93 (single), Max Park‎ 7x7x7 Cube 1:44.02 (single), 7x7x7 Cube 1:50.10 (average), Stanley Chapel‎ 4x4x4 Blindfolded 1:08.07 (single), 4x4x4 Blindfolded 1:21.81 (average), 5x5x5 Blindfolded 2:38.77 (single).

Oceanian records: David Epstein‎ Square-1 8.68 (average), Tom Nelson‎ 3x3x3 Multi-Blind 29/31 57:09 (single).
European records: Amos Nordman‎ Megaminx 34.50 (average), Ciarán Beahan‎ 5x5x5 Cube 38.96 (single), 6x6x6 Cube 1:27.23 (average), Martin Vædele Egdal‎ 3x3x3 Blindfolded 21.52 (average), 3x3x3 Blindfolded 19.94 (average).
North American records: Max Hilliard‎ 3x3x3 Blindfolded 16.23 (single).
South American records: Manuel Gutman‎ 3x3x3 Blindfolded 20.81 (average), 5x5x5 Blindfolded 6:13.53 (single).

title.zh: WCA 财务委员会成员招募（2019 年 7 月）

html.zh:
WCA 财务委员会（WFC）希望招募两至三名新成员。申请向所有人开放，申请者不必目前在 WCA 担任职务。

WFC 的工作是什么？

  • 制定 WCA 年度预算，包括分析和预测参赛人数。
  • 管理会费制度，包括开具账单及跟进欠款。
  • 代表 WCA 填报税务及其他监管合规文件。
  • 管理 WCA 的财务和现金流。
  • 按照器材资助及差旅报销政策审核资助申请。
  • 完成 WCA 董事会要求或各项动议规定的其他财务工作。

WFC 的正式权利与职责载于 WCA 动议 10.2017.3。

请于 2019 年 7 月 28 日（星期日）23:59 UTC 前，将申请发送给 WCA 财务主管兼财务委员会负责人 Chris Wright（cwright@worldcubeassociation.org）。申请将由 WFC 管理团队审阅。

我们希望候选人具备以下条件：

  • 有财务、税务或会计经验。
  • 良好的数学或数据分析能力。
  • 良好的英语书面表达能力。
  • 每周能投入 2 至 5 小时。
  • 能及时查看和回复委员会邮件。

以下并非必需条件，但如有相关经验，将对工作有所帮助：

  • 有使用电子表格的经验。
  • 熟悉 Google G-Suite。
  • 了解非营利组织或企业财务，并有相关经验。
  • 了解美国税务及美国国税局（IRS）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包括：

  • 简短的个人介绍。
  • 列明参与魔方社区经历的 WCA 履历。
  • 职业履历，尤其是与数学、会计或财务有关的经历。
  • 申请加入 WFC 的原因。
  • 计划以委员会成员身份为 WFC 作出哪些贡献，帮助 WCA 发展。

我们会及时回复，确认申请材料是否齐全；你也可能获邀参加 WFC 负责人的面试。

如有疑问，请随时联系 Chris Wright（cwright@worldcubeassociation.org）或 WFC 副负责人 James Molloy（jmolloy@worldcubeassociation.org）。

感谢大家的申请与支持！
html.en:
The WCA Financial Committee (WFC) is looking for two or three new members to add to its team. The applications are open to everyone; it’s not a requirement to hold a current position in the WCA to be considered.

What does the WFC do?

  • Determine the annual budget for the WCA including analysis and projections of competitor counts.
  • Manage the dues system including invoicing and credit control.
  • Complete tax and other regulatory compliance forms on behalf of the WCA.
  • Manage the finances and cash flow of the WCA.
  • Review applications for funding in accordance with the Equipment Funding and Travel Reimbursement policies.
  • Other financial tasks requested by the WCA Board or in accordance with our Motions.

The official rights and duties of the WFC are documented in WCA Motion 10.2017.3.

Please submit your application by Sunday, July 28th, 2019 at 23:59 UTC to the WCA Treasurer and Leader of the WCA Financial Committee, Chris Wright (cwright@worldcubeassociation.org). Applications will be reviewed by the WFC leadership team.

The qualities and requirements expected of candidates are:

  • Experience in finance, tax or accounting.
  • Good math or data analytics skills.
  • Good written English.
  • Time commitment of 2-5 hours per week.
  • Prompt review and response to committee emails.

The following are not required, but it would be useful for new WFC members to have additional experience with any of the following:

  • Experience using spreadsheets.
  • Familiarity with Google G-Suite.
  • Knowledge and experience in non-profit or corporate finances.
  • US tax and IRS knowledge.

Candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

  • A brief personal introduction.
  • Your WCA resume listing your involvement with the cubing community.
  • Your professional resume (especially if math/accounting/finance related).
  • Your motivation for applying to the WFC.
  • Your ambitions for what you plan to contribute to the WFC as a committee member to further the WCA.

You can expect an immediate reply to confirm whether your application is complete, and may receive a request for an interview with the WFC Leader.

If you have any questions please do not hesitate in reaching out to Chris Wright (cwright@worldcubeassociation.org) or the WFC Deputy Leader, James Molloy (jmolloy@worldcubeassociation.org).

Thank you for your candidacies and support!

title.zh: WCA 董事会成员变动（2019 年 7 月）
title.en: Changes in the Board of Directors (July 2019)

html.zh:
Olivér Perge 担任 WCA 董事的任期已于 7 月 1 日结束。感谢 Olivér 所做的出色工作、达成的重要目标，以及为 WCA 未来发展打下的基础。祝愿他今后一切顺利！

与此同时，依照动议 05.2019.1，WCA 代表、团队／委员会负责人及高级成员进行了不记名投票。

WCA 收到了 Jacob Ambrose 和 Ethan Pride 的申请。

我们很高兴地宣布，根据选举结果，Ethan Pride 当选 WCA 新任董事！

上述变动立即生效。

Jacob 和 Ethan 的申请材料可在此处查看。
html.en:
Olivér Perge’s term as a member of the Board of Directors of the WCA has come to an end on July 1st. We want to thank Olivér for the amazing things he has done, the milestones he achieved and the steps he paved for the future of the WCA. We wish him all the best in his future activities!

In the meantime, an anonymous election took place among the WCA Delegates, Team/Committee Leaders and Senior Members in accordance with Motion 05.2019.1.

The WCA received the applications of Jacob Ambrose and Ethan Pride.

We are happy to announce that the results of the election promoted Ethan Pride as a new member of the WCA Board of Directors!

These changes have become effective immediately.

Jacob’s and Ethan’s applications can be viewed here.

title.zh: WCA 道德委员会新负责人招募（2019 年 7 月）
title.en: Appointment of a new WCA Ethics Committee Leader (July 2019)

html.zh:
Walker Welch 近期卸任 WCA 道德委员会负责人，WCA 将任命新的负责人。感谢 Walker 在带领委员会期间所做的工作。过渡期间，委员会将由 WCA 董事会领导。

申请人应能完成 24 个月任期，并平均每周至少投入 6 小时处理委员会事务。我们希望申请人具备：

  • 背景清白。
  • 值得信任。
  • 能独立判断。
  • 有责任心。

申请现已开放，请于 2019 年 7 月 23 日 23:59 UTC 前，私下将材料发送至 WCA 董事会（board@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，包含：

  • 简短的个人介绍。
  • 为 WCA 所做工作的概述。
  • 担任 WCA 道德委员会负责人的工作设想。

另请提供一份可在申请截止后公开的申请材料副本。

WEC 的权利与职责摘自 WCA 议案 10.2019.3，见下方附录。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将通过投票选出新负责人，并按照 WCA 议案 10.2019.0 第 4 节，经高级代表及现任委员会、团队负责人投票确认后公布。
html.en:
There will be an appointment of a new WCA Ethics Committee Leader, as Walker Welch recently stepped down as the Leader of the WCA Ethics Committee. We would like to thank Walker the work he has done leading the Committee. In the interim period, the WCA Board will lead the Committee.

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 6 hours per week on average to work for the Committee. The qualities expected of candidates are:

  • Clear background
  • Trustworthiness
  • Independence
  • Accountability

The application period is opened for candidates to submit their candidacy documents until July 23rd, 2019, 23:59 UTC privately to the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).

The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

  • Brief personal introduction.
  • Summary of activities done for the WCA.
  • Ambitions as the WEC Leader of the WCA.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WEC are copied from WCA Motion 10.2019.3 in the appendix below.

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of WCA Motion 10.2019.0.

title.zh: WCA 规则委员会成员招募（2019 年 7 月）

html.zh:
WCA 规则委员会（WRC）计划招募约 5 名新成员。欢迎各种背景的社区成员申请。申请面向所有人开放，无须已在 WCA 任职。

WRC 的工作是什么？

  • 更新和完善《WCA 规则》。（参见我们的公开 Issue 列表。）
  • 阅读比赛报告，处理意外事件。
  • 与 WCA 社区交流，收集对规则的意见。
  • 处理与规则有关的问题和咨询。

优先申请期为即日起至 2019 年 7 月 21 日 23:59 UTC，请将材料私下发送给 Lucas Garron（lgarron@worldcubeassociation.org）。在优先申请期内收到的申请将得到同等考虑，并于 8 月 5 日前作出决定。

此后仍会滚动接受申请，直至 2019 年 9 月 30 日 23:59 UTC。

WRC 的正式权利和职责见 WCA 决议 10.2017.2。

我们希望申请人满足以下条件：

  • 经常查阅并回复邮件（每天约 5–10 封）。
  • 客观地依照 WCA 规则的条文及精神作出判断。
  • 讨论事件处理办法时，能体谅他人，并提出建设性的意见。
  • 每周能投入 5–10 小时。

以下不是硬性要求，但具备其中任一方面的经验，将有助于开展 WRC 的工作：

  • 在跨语言沟通中使用流畅、清楚的书面英语。
  • 参与线上或线下魔方社区讨论。
  • 了解美国和欧洲以外的魔方社区。
  • 了解 WCA 规则的历史。
  • 使用 GitHub 及/或编程（尤其是 Python、Java、Ruby on Rails）。
  • 项目管理、领导工作、处理组织激励问题、倡议推广及/或法律工作。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，包含：

  • 简短的自我介绍。
  • 能证明自己满足要求的经历或成果总结。
  • 申请加入 WRC 的原因。
  • 是否有特别希望协助 WRC 改善的议题或问题。
  • （可选）其他与 WRC 工作相关的经验。

我们会及时回复确认材料是否完整，也可能邀请你与 WRC 负责人面试。

如有疑问，欢迎联系 Lucas Garron（lgarron@worldcubeassociation.org）。

感谢大家的申请与支持！
html.en:
The WCA Regulations Committee (WRC) is looking for about 5 new members. Interested community members of all backgrounds are encouraged to apply. The applications are open to everyone; it’s not a requirement to hold a current position in the WCA to be considered.

What does the WRC do?

  • Update and improve the WCA Regulations. (See our public issue tracker.)
  • Read competition reports and respond to incidents.
  • Engage with the WCA community for feedback about the Regulations.
  • Address any issues and inquiries related to the Regulations.

The priority application period is open for candidates to submit their candidacy document from now until July 21st, 2019, 23:59 UTC privately to Lucas Garron (lgarron@worldcubeassociation.org). All applications received during the priority application period will receive equal consideration, with a decision by August 5.

Additional applications will be accepted on a rolling basis until September 30, 2019 (23:59 UTC).

The official rights and duties of the WRC are documented in WCA Motion 10.2017.2.

The qualities and requirements expected of candidates are:

  • Regularly check and respond to email (5-10 emails/day).
  • Objectively apply the letter and spirit of the WCA Regulations.
  • Compassionately and constructively discuss how to address incidents.
  • Time commitment of 5-10 hours per week.

The following are not required, but it would be useful for new WRC members to have additional experience with any of the following:

  • Writing fluent, clear English while communicating across language differences.
  • Cubing community discussions, online or offline.
  • Cubing communities outside USA/Europe.
  • The history of the WCA Regulations.
  • Using GitHub and/or writing code (especially Python, Java, Ruby on Rails).
  • Project management, leadership, addressing organizational incentives, advocacy, and/or legal work.

Candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

  • A brief personal introduction.
  • A summary of experiences/accomplishments to demonstrate that you can meet the requirements.
  • What motivates you to join the WRC?
  • Do you have any topics/issues that you are passionate to help the WRC improve?
  • (Optional) Any additional experience that is relevant to WRC work.

You can expect an immediate reply to confirm whether your application is complete, and may receive a request for an interview with the WRC Leader.

If you have any questions please do not hesitate in reaching out to Lucas Garron (lgarron@worldcubeassociation.org).

Thank you for your candidacies and support!

title.zh: 2020 年 WCA 洲际锦标赛申办通知

html.zh:
WCA 董事会现征集以下地区 2020 年 WCA 洲际锦标赛的申办方案：

  • 非洲
  • 亚洲
  • 欧洲
  • 北美洲
  • 大洋洲
  • 南美洲

请与你所在国家的代表讨论，确认是否有意愿、有能力申办。请注意，举办这一规模的比赛，在赛前和比赛期间都需要投入大量时间与精力。

有意申办者，请于 2019 年 7 月 31 日 23:59 UTC 前，私下将申请材料发送至 board@worldcubeassociation.org。材料须以 PDF 格式提交两个版本：一份包含所有申办细节的完整版，以及一份删去敏感内容（如有）、可供公开的版本。

申请材料至少应包含以下信息：

希望何时举办 2020 年洲际锦标赛？

  • 可选日期。
  • 比赛天数。
  • 与世界各地学校假期的重合情况。

希望在本国哪个地方举办 2020 年洲际锦标赛？

  • 城市对外国游客的吸引力，以及可供游览的景点。
  • 国际、国内及本地交通的便利程度。
  • 不同价位的酒店或公寓供应情况。
  • 场馆、面积及布置，包括舞台、观众席、练习桌和附属房间。
  • 可用技术设施，包括网络、视频直播、灯光和音响。
  • 可容纳的选手与观众人数。

主办团队和工作人员如何组成？

  • 核心团队成员。
  • 核心团队的经验。
  • 其他参与方。
  • 本地志愿者的人数和能力；建议约 20% 的选手担任工作人员。
  • 需要外国代表提供哪些支持。

比赛总预算是多少？

  • 支出：场租、场馆服务、舞台、设备、装饰、网站、胸牌、挂绳、礼包和奖品等。
  • 收入：报名费、赞助和地方政府支持等。

这里有一份示例表格，列出了大型比赛需要安排和编入预算的部分事项，但并非完整清单。

申请期结束后，WCA 董事会将与申办方面谈，征询其他 WCA 工作人员的意见，并通过投票决定各项 2020 年洲际锦标赛的举办地点。如有董事参与某个申办团队，该董事在选拔流程中的职责将由其他人代替，例如高级代表或委员会、团队负责人。

我们希望这些比赛能够体现 WCA 对大型赛事的理念，进一步提高协会的专业水平，为选手提供尽可能好的参赛体验，也为全世界呈现精彩的比赛。

感谢大家的申请和支持。
html.en:
The Board of Directors would like to receive applications for WCA Continental Championships 2020 for the following regions:

  •  Africa

  •  Asia

  •  Europe

  •  North America

  •  Oceania

  •  South America

Please discuss with the Delegates in your country whether this is something you are willing and able to pursue. Bear in mind that organizing a competition of this size takes a significant amount of time and effort before and during the competition.

If you are interested, send your application documents privately to board@worldcubeassociation.org before 23:59 UTC of July 31st, 2019. Documents must be sent in PDF format in two versions: one full version with all the details for the application, and another version with sensitive details - if any - removed to make public.

Please include in your application documents at least the following information:

  1. When would you like to hold your Continental Championship 2020?
  2. Possible dates
  3. Number of days of the competition.
  4. Overlap with international holiday periods of schools.
  5. Where would you like to hold your Continental Championship 2020 in your country?
  6. City should be interesting to visit for foreigners with opportunities for sightseeing.
  7. Ease of international, national, and local travel.
  8. Availability of hotels/apartments with different price categories.
  9. Venue, venue size, and venue setup (stage, audience, tables to practice, side rooms).
  10. Technology available like internet, video streaming, lighting, sound equipment.
  11. Number of competitors and spectators that can be hosted.
  12. What would the organization team and staff look like?
  13. Core team members.
  14. Experience of the core team.
  15. Involvement of other parties.
  16. Quantity and quality of local volunteers (guideline is 20% of competitors should staff).
  17. Required support by foreign Delegates.
  18. What would be the overall budget for the competition?
  19. Cost (venue, venue services, stage, equipment, decorations, website, badges/lanyards/giftpacks, prizes).
  20. Income (registration fees, sponsoring, local government).

A sample document with a non-exhaustive list of topics that need to be arranged and budgeted for a large competition can be found here.

Once the application period is over, the WCA Board of Directors will interview applicants, consult other WCA Staff members, and vote in order to decide where each 2020 Continental Championship will take place. If any Director will be involved in a team that sends in an application, he will be replaced in the selection process by another person (for example a Senior Delegate or a Committee/Team Leader).

We are looking for a competition that can reinforce our concept of large WCA competitions, boosting the professionalization of our organization and able to offer the competitors the best possible experience and the world the best possible show.

Thank you in advance for your applications and support.

title.zh: WCA 决议修订获通过（2019 年 6 月）
title.en: Amendments to the Motions approved - June 2019

html.zh:
经 WCA 工作人员近期投票，决议修订提案以明显多数通过。这些决议自 2019 年 6 月 1 日起生效，主要改动如下：

  • 决议 02.2019.1——定义 - 增加“政策”和“区域代表”的定义。
  • 决议 04.2019.1——董事会 - 在 WCA 董事会的权限中增加任命和免除区域代表的权利。
  • 决议 06.2019.1——地区组织 - 增加申请成为地区组织的要求。
  • 决议 09.2019.1——高级代表 - 增加任命区域代表和将其降级的权利。
  • 决议 10.2019.0——委员会与团队 - 明确任命新委员会/团队负责人时，确认投票的通过条件。
  • 决议 10.2019.1——WCA 比赛公告团队 - 明确链接至《WCA 比赛要求政策》，并明确比赛数据及元数据可以编辑。
  • 决议 10.2019.2——WCA 纪律委员会 - 明确注册速拧选手必须配合调查。
  • 决议 10.2019.3——WCA 道德委员会 - 明确 WCA 工作人员必须遵守《道德准则》。
  • 决议 10.2019.4——WCA 质量保证委员会 - 调整部分定义和流程，更清楚地界定 WQAC 的职责范围。
  • 决议 11.2019.1——WCA 财务 - 修改财务审计相关细节，并补充报税申报的具体规定。

除上述改动外，还新增了两份决议：

  • 决议 09.2019.2——区域代表
  • 决议 10.2019.5——数据保护委员会
html.en:
After recent voting by WCA staff members, the proposed amendments to the Motions have been approved by a good majority. The Motions are effective as of June 1, 2019, and a summary of the included changes has been compiled below:

  • Motion 02.2019.1 - Definitions - Added the definition of Policy and Regional Delegate.
  • Motion 04.2019.1 - Board of Directors - The right to instate and remove Regional Delegates has been added to the rights of the WCA Board of Directors.
  • Motion 06.2019.1 - Regional Organizations - Added more requirements for the application of a Regional Organization.
  • Motion 09.2019.1 - Senior Delegates - Added the right to appoint and demote Regional Delegates.
  • Motion 10.2019.0 - Committees and Teams - Clarified the conditions for the approval vote to pass when appointing a new Committee/Team Leader.
  • Motion 10.2019.1 - WCA Competition Announcement Team - Explicitly link to the “WCA Competition Requirements Policy” and clarify that competition data and metadata can be edited.
  • Motion 10.2019.2 - WCA Disciplinary Committee - Clarified that Registered Speedcubers must cooperate with investigations.
  • Motion 10.2019.3 - WCA Ethics Committee - Clarified that WCA Staff must abide by the Code of Ethics.
  • Motion 10.2019.4 - WCA Quality Assurance Committee - Changed some definitions and procedure to better define the scope of the WQAC.
  • Motion 11.2019.1 - Finances of the WCA - Modified the details regarding the auditing of the finances and added the details of filing the returns.

Along with the above changes, two new Motions have been added:

  • Motion 09.2019.2 - Regional Delegates
  • Motion 10.2019.5 - Data Protection Committee

title.zh: WDC 月度简报：2019 年 3 月和 4 月

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

以下为纪律委员会 2019 年 3、4 月的重要动态。

3 月处理 4 项调查，其中 2 件新立案、2 件延续。4 月处理 8 项，其中 2 件始于 3 月、6 件于 4 月立案。两件目前暂停，需等待后续发展。其他在办案件较复杂，并非简单违反比赛规则，预计仍需投入一段时间。

本期虽无公开个案通报，但 WDC 强调：潜在案件应直接报告委员会，不应在网上基于不充分信息推测。这只会传播错误信息，甚至引发网络欺凌，尤其当非常年轻的选手被指故意违规时。

WCA 强烈谴责任何形式的欺凌，倡导尊重与合作。这既适用于正式 WCA 比赛，也适用于线上社群。

最后提醒充分理解规则及流程，有疑问时询问代表。若认为成绩受到损害或看到可疑行为，请立即找最近的代表报告。

感谢支持 WCA 精神与使命。

Lorenzo Vigani Poli WDC 团队负责人，代表纪律委员会
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

Here you can find some noteworthy updates about the activity of the Disciplinary Committee over the months of March and April 2019.

In March, the WDC actively worked on 4 investigations: 2 were opened in March and 2 were already ongoing.
In April, the WDC has actively worked on 8 investigations: 2 were the ones that began in March and 6 were opened in April.
Two of these cases are currently on hold, because the Committee has to wait for future developments in order to proceed with its work. The other ongoing investigations are quite complex and are expected to require the attention of the Committee for some time, since the matters under investigation don’t involve simple violations of WCA Regulations.

Even though there are no public announcements in this digest, the WDC would like to stress out that potential cases should be communicated directly to the Disciplinary Committee, without indulging in misinformed speculation online. This attitude only leads to the spreading of false information and, potentially, to cases of online bullying, especially when very young competitors are involved in allegations of intentionally breaking the WCA Regulations.

The WCA strongly condemn every form of bullying and promotes an environment of respect and cooperation. This applies both to officially sanctioned WCA Competitions and to the community online.

To conclude, we would like to remind everyone to make sure they fully understand the WCA Regulations and competition procedures. If you have any questions or are unsure about how to do something, please do not hesitate to ask the Delegate(s) of the competition. In addition, if you think the competition results are being compromised in any way or see suspicious behavior, find the nearest delegate immediately and report the incident.

Thank you all for your help in supporting the WCA Spirit and Mission.

Lorenzo Vigani Poli
WDC Team Leader
On behalf of the Disciplinary Committee

title.zh: 2019 年 5 月版 WCA 规则已生效
title.en: WCA Regulations — May 2019: Now in Effect

html.zh: 新版 WCA 规则和指南已于 2019 年 5 月 1 日生效。详情请参阅此前的公告。
html.en: New WCA Regulations and Guidelines are in effect as of May 1, 2019. Please see the original announcement for details.

title.zh: 执行助理任命公告（2019 年 4 月）

html.zh:
我们很高兴地宣布，WCA 董事会已任命两位新执行助理：Daniel James 和 Thaynara Santana de Oliveira。

html.en:
We are happy to announce that the WCA Board has appointed two new Executive Assistants: Daniel James and Thaynara Santana de Oliveira.

They have been selected among the 7 applicants because of their proven skills and trustworthiness serving through the years in different Staff positions.

title.zh: 拉丁美洲高级代表任命公告（2019 年 4 月）
title.en: Appointment of a New Senior Delegate - Latin America (April 2019)

html.zh:
近期招募结束后，新一位高级代表已获任命。董事会收到 Natán Riggenbach 和 José Garrido 对拉丁美洲高级代表岗位的申请，经过讨论，决定任命 Natán Riggenbach。
