感谢两位申请人愿意在已有工作之外，为 WCA 和速拧社区承担更多责任。祝 Natán 履新顺利！
html.en:
As a result of our recent application period, a new Senior Delegate has been appointed. For the Latin America region, the Board received the applications of Natán Riggenbach and José Garrido. After deliberation, they decided to appoint Natán Riggenbach for the position.

The appointment is effective immediately. You may find both applications here.

We want to thank both applicants for their willingness in helping the WCA and the Speedcubing Community even more than they currently do now. Good luck to Natán in his new role!

title.zh: WCA 竞赛规则——2019 年 5 月版

html.zh:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

WRC 在此介绍将于 2019 年 5 月 1 日生效的新版 WCA 竞赛规则与指南。

你可以通过 GitHub 上的版本比较查看全部改动。如果不想逐个打开改动，可以点击“Files changed”，查看规则和指南的完整文件。改动及新增内容标为绿色，删除内容标为红色。

轮次赛制调整：

  • 四阶盲拧和五阶盲拧的“三次取最佳”轮次，现在也认可三次平均成绩。（提交 | 讨论）
  • 除盲拧项目和三阶最少步外，其他所有项目均取消“X 次取最佳”赛制。（提交 | 讨论，提交 | 讨论，提交 | 讨论）

比赛组织方面的调整：

  • 所有比赛都应采用打乱员签名制度。（提交 | 讨论 | 讨论 | 讨论）
    • 计划于 2020 年将打乱员签名设为强制要求。
  • 在某组比赛开始前，WCA 代表不得让打乱员或其他任何人接触该组的打乱序列。（提交）
    • TNoodle 0.14.0 为各套打乱 PDF 提供独立密码，有助于落实这一要求。
  • 明确还原时限的规定。（提交）
    • 时限必须在比赛开始前公布，而非只在相应轮次开始前公布。
    • 每一轮只能适用一个累积时限。
    • 累积时限包括 DNF 还原中已用的时间。
    • 裁判和 WCA 代表可以估算累计用时。（提交）
  • 应在视觉上将打乱员与选手隔开。（提交）
  • 许多比赛要求已从竞赛规则移至新的 WCA 比赛要求政策。（提交）

其他实质性调整及澄清：

  • 多盲中若有个别魔方不符合使用要求，代表可酌情将这些魔方计为未还原，而不将整次还原判为 DNF。（提交 | 讨论）
  • 明确盲拧项目由选手启动还原尝试，且“测试”计时器前必须先征得裁判同意。（提交 | 讨论）
  • 经代表酌情允许，选手可在特定时候使用暖手用品及进食。（提交 | 讨论）
  • 发生飞棱时，选手不得请求协助，裁判也应阻止他人帮忙。如果有人替选手捡起飞出的零件，裁判或选手可以请其将零件放到比赛位上，并停止进一步协助。（提交 | 讨论）
  • 选手可以触碰官方计时用的秒表，除非组织团队另行提供了非官方计时用的秒表供选手使用。（提交 | 讨论）
  • 启动计时器即意味着观察结束、还原开始。因此，观察开始后，选手不能再“测试”计时器。（提交 | 讨论）
  • 明确禁止故意造成魔方故障。（提交 | 讨论）
  • 如果与顶面相邻的面中有多个绿色面，打乱时将颜色最深的一面朝前。（提交）
  • 明确多盲成绩的用时一律四舍五入到秒，与成绩数据库保持一致。（提交）
  • 明确 N×N×N 魔方的记号。（提交）
    • 连同外层一起转动 n 层的外砖转动（如 nFw），须满足 1 < n < N，其中 N 为魔方阶数。
    • 定义执行转动度量制（ETM），并以此规定三阶最少步的步数上限。
  • 明确任意中心块均可带有标志，不限于最中央的中心块。（提交 | 讨论）
  • 最少步相关澄清。（提交）
    • 用于标识答卷的信息，是指姓名、WCA ID 或报名编号中的至少一项，也可附上比赛名称、轮次及尝试序号。
    • 选手可以在本次尝试开始前填写标识答卷的信息。
    • 提交解法时，选手可以在裁判面前填写标识答卷的信息，但提交后不得补写。
    • 选手应将不属于最终解法的转动涂黑或划掉。
    • 对经验不足的选手，裁判可以将 {r}、<r> 或 (r) 理解为 [r]。
    • 选手可根据需要自备最少步用笔。（提交）
    • 明确允许在最少步中使用铅笔及类似书写工具。
    • 如果不存在提前获知打乱的风险，选手可以迟到参加三阶最少步的一次尝试。（提交）
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

The WRC would like to inform you about the versions of the WCA Regulations and Guidelines, which are going into effect May 1, 2019.

You can review all changes in this comparison on GitHub. If you do not want to open all the individual changes, you can click on “Files changed” to see the complete files of the regulation and guidelines. All changes and additions are marked green and removals are red.

Round format changes:

  • Means are now recognized for 4x4x4 Blindfolded and 5x5x5 Blindfolded "Best of 3" rounds. (commit | discussion)
  • The "Best of X" format has been removed from all events except blindfolded events and 3x3x3 Fewest Moves. (commit | discussion, commit | discussion, commit | discussion)

Competition organization changes:

  • Scramble signatures should be used for all competitions (commit | discussion | discussion | discusssion)
    • Scramble signatures are planned to become mandatory in 2020.
  • The WCA Delegate must not give scramblers (or anyone else) access to scramble sequences for any group before it has begun. (commit)
    • Note that TNoodle 0.14.0 includes scramble set PDFs with individual passcodes to help with this.
  • Time limits have been clarified (commit)
    • Time limits must be announced before the competition, rather than just before the round.
    • Only one cumulative time limit can apply to a given round.
    • Cumulative time limits include time elapsed in DNF attempts.
    • The judge and WCA Delegate may estimate cumulative elapsed time (commit)
  • Scramblers should be visually isolated from competitors. (commit)
  • Many competition requirements have been moved from the Regulations to the new WCA Competition Requirements Policy (commit)

Other substantial changes and clarifications:

  • Individual non-permitted puzzles in multi BLD may count as unsolved instead of DNFing the whole attempt, at the discretion of the Delegate. (commit | discussion)
  • Clarified that competitors start the attempt for blindfolded events, and that they must ask the judge before "testing" a timer. (commit | discussion)
  • Competitors are allowed to have hand warmers and food at certain times, at the discretion of the Delegate. (commit | discussion)
  • The competitor must not ask for assistance during a pop, and the judge should prevent others from assisting. If someone picks up a popped part for the competitor, the judge or competitor may ask them to place it on the solving station and not to assist any further. (commit | discussion)
  • The competitor may touch the official stopwatch, unless the organization team provides an unofficial stopwatch for the competitor. (commit | discussion)
  • Starting the timer always ends inspection and begins the solve. This means that the competitor cannot "test" the timer once inspection has begun. (commit | discussion)
  • It is explicitly forbidden to cause puzzle defects intentionally. (commit | discussion)
  • If there are multiple green faces next to the top face, the darkest is placed in front for scrambling. (commit)
  • We've specified that Multi-Blind result times are always rounded to seconds, matching the results database. (commit)
  • Notation for NxNxN cubes has been clarified (commit)
    • Outer Block Moves that move n slices (e.g. nFw) must have 1 < n < N (where N is the number of layers in the puzzle).
    • Execution Turn Metric (ETM) is defined, and used to define the move limit for 3x3x3 Fewest Moves.
  • Clarified that any center piece may have a logo, not just the most central one. (commit | discussion)
  • Clarifications for Fewest Moves (commit)
    • Information to identify an attempt is defined as name, WCA ID, or registrant ID (at least one), and optionally competition name/round/attempt number.
    • The competitor may write information to identify the attempt before the attempt has begun.
    • The competitor may write information to identify the attempt in front of a judge while submitting a solution (but the information must not be added after).
    • Competitors should black out/scribble out moves that are not part of the solution.
    • Judges may interpret {r}, <r>, or (r) as [r] for inexperienced competitors.
    • Competitors may supply their own pens for Fewest Moves if they wish. (commit)
    • Pencils and similar writing implements are explicitly permitted for Fewest Moves.
    • Competitors may join a 3x3x3 Fewest Moves attempt late, if there is no risk they could have information about the scramble. (commit)

title.zh: 执行助理招募（2019 年 4 月）

html.zh:
WCA 董事会正在设立一个负责董事会行政事务的职位。为让董事职位对符合条件的工作人员更有吸引力、减少工作耗时，并使董事会能够长期稳定运作，董事会将任命 2 至 3 名执行助理，协助董事处理日常事务。

工作可能包括：

  • 管理 WCA 董事会的 Trello 看板。
  • 在 GitHub 上维护政策、章程和动议。
  • 管理 G-Suite 用户。
  • 管理 WCA 董事会的团队云端硬盘。
  • 代表董事会起草邮件。
  • 汇总和审阅表单回复中的信息。

执行助理须平均每周至少投入 5 小时协助董事会工作。申请向所有人开放，不必目前在 WCA 担任职务。我们希望候选人具备以下条件：

  • 出色的组织能力。
  • 出色的沟通能力。
  • 经常有时间处理工作。
  • 值得信赖。

申请现已开放，请于 2019 年 4 月 15 日 23:59 UTC 前，将材料私下发送至 WCA 董事会（board@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包括：

  • 简短的个人介绍。
  • 为 WCA 社区所做工作的概述。
  • 说明自己适合这一职位的原因。

申请截止后的下一周，WCA 董事会将投票选定并公布执行助理人选。

提前感谢大家的申请与支持！
html.en:
The WCA Board is creating a position to carry out the administrative tasks of the Board of Directors. To make the Board position more appealing to qualified Staff members, less time consuming, and sustainable in the long-term, they will appoint 2-3 Executive Assistants who will be responsible for assisting the Board members with day-to-day functions.

Some sample tasks include:

  • Managing the WCA Board’s Trello board
  • Maintaining Policies, Bylaws, and Motions on Github
  • Administration of users on G-Suite
  • Administration of WCA Board’s Team Drives
  • Drafting emails on behalf of the Board
  • Compiling and reviewing information from form responses

Executive Assistants are expected to spend at least 5 hours per week on average to work for the Board. The position is open to everyone; it is not necessary to hold a current position within the WCA to be considered. The qualities expected of candidates are:

  • Strong organizational skills
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Frequent availability
  • Trustworthiness

The application period is opened for candidates to submit their candidacy documents until April 15th, 2019, 23:59 UTC privately to the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).

The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

  • Brief personal introduction
  • Summary of activities done for the WCA Community
  • Reasons you are fit for the role

The week after the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the Executive Assistants.

Thank you in advance for your candidacies and support!

title.zh: WCA 与红牛联合赛事申办公告
title.en: Applications for WCA/Red Bull Joint Events

html.zh:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

WCA 已与 Red Bull Mind Gamers 达成协议，将与 2019 年 Red Bull Rubik’s Cube World Cup 系列赛事合作。WCA 将提供咨询支持，并共同安排 3–5 场联合赛事：红牛比赛将在 WCA 官方比赛之前或之后举行，但两者安排在不同日期。

为此，我们正在寻找欢迎红牛比赛、愿意承办联合赛事的社区。有意者请联系最近的代表、本地区高级代表，或当地地区组织（如有）。基本条件如下：

  • 有组织速拧活动的经验。
  • 组织者经验丰富，能够使用英语沟通。
  • 当地有较多速拧选手。
  • 能在 2019 年 5 月至 9 月之间组织比赛。
  • 红牛在该国开展业务。

如果符合条件，请联系当地代表，于 2019 年 4 月 15 日前提交申请，包含：

  • 组织者。
  • 举办国家和城市。
  • WCA 比赛的可选日期。
  • 预计选手人数。

Red Bull Mind Gamers 将与当地红牛团队协调，在 WCA 的建议下，从申请中选出 3–5 场合作赛事。
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

We are informing you that the WCA and Red Bull Mind Gamers have reached a deal in which the WCA will be collaborating with the Red Bull Rubik’s Cube World Cup 2019 series. Within this collaboration the WCA will offer its advisory assistance and will also have 3-5 joint competitions, in which the Red Bull competitions will be held before or after an official WCA competition, but on different days.

In light of this recent news, we are looking for communities that would welcome Red Bull competitions and would like to host these joint events. If you are interested, please reach out to your closest Delegate, your region’s Senior Delegate, or your region’s Regional Organization (if applicable). The basic criteria for such events are:

  • Experience in hosting Speedcubing Events
  • Experienced, English speaking organizers
  • Substantial amount of speedcubers in the area
  • Availability to organize between May and September of 2019
  • Red Bull availability in the country

If you fit these requirements, please contact your local Delegate to submit an application by April 15, 2019 with the following information:

  • Organizer(s)
  • Hosting country and city
  • Possible date of the WCA competition
  • Number of expected competitors

Red Bull Mind Gamers will choose 3-5 collaboration events out of the submitted applications in coordination with the local Red Bull Country under the advisory of the WCA.

title.zh: WCA 沟通团队成员招募（2019 年 3 月）

html.zh:
WCA 沟通团队（WCT）正在招募成员，协助管理和创作 WCA 社交媒体内容，或为社交媒体帖文及其他项目进行平面设计！

所有 WCA 成员均可申请，不必目前在 WCA 担任职务。

WCT 的工作是什么？

  • 回复通过电子邮件、WCA 网站联系页面及社交媒体私信收到的日常咨询。
  • 管理 WCA 官方社交媒体，定期发布有吸引力的内容。
  • 与 WCA 其他负责人合作，改进 WCA 网站及与社区的沟通。
  • 章程所列的 WCT 权利与职责可在此处查看。

工作安排概况

  • 社交媒体帖文至少提前一周规划，并在成员有空时发布。
  • 与 WCT 其他项目有关的内部邮件须在 48 小时内回复；这些项目还可能带来耗时不同的其他工作。
  • 每周需投入 4 至 10 小时。
  • 平面设计申请者须熟悉 Adobe Illustrator、GIMP 或同类软件。

我们希望你具备的能力

  • 创意：我们一直需要新的社交媒体系列创意，或拓展到其他平台的独特方法。你需要主动思考，并在有想法时提出建议。有平面设计经验的成员还须帮助我们设计有视觉吸引力的帖文。
  • 社交媒体知识：你应熟悉多种社交媒体平台及其基本功能。即使你个人没有用过，也需要代表 WCA 在这些平台发帖，并了解各平台适合什么类型的内容。
  • 流利的英语：我们在大多数社交媒体平台上使用英语，也用英语回复大部分邮件。同时欢迎既熟练掌握英语、又精通其他语言的申请者。
  • 沟通能力：你将负责撰写得体、能传达 WCA 使命的社交媒体帖文。你应能用专业、简洁的邮件回答选手的问题，并熟悉 WCA 为选手提供的各类资源。
  • 耐心：在邮件及社交媒体互动中，你应保持友善。反复回答同样的问题时仍保持专业并不容易，但这是日常沟通的必要要求。

申请材料请包括：

  • 简短的个人介绍。
  • 参与 WCA 的经历。
  • 申请加入 WCT 的原因。
  • 对社交媒体平台的熟悉程度，以及一个可供 WCA 发布的帖文创意。
  • 平面设计申请者：提供 2 至 3 件你创作的设计，展示个人风格。

申请自即日起开放，请于 2019 年 4 月 2 日 23:59 UTC 前，将 PDF 格式的材料发送至 lclement@worldcubeassociation.org。

收到后，我们会回复确认材料齐全，或说明需要补充的内容。提交申请后，候选人可能还须参加团队负责人的面试。申请截止后的两周内，团队将选定人选，待候选人接受职务后公布新成员。

提前感谢大家的申请与支持！
html.en:
The WCA Communication Team (WCT) is seeking members to help with managing and creating WCA social media posts or graphic design for social media posts and other projects!

The application is open to all WCA members. You do not have to hold a current position to be considered.

What does the WCT do?

  • Answers daily inquires to the WCA through emails, the contact page on the WCA website, and social media direct messages
  • Manages official WCA social media platforms through frequent & engaging posts
  • Works with other WCA leaders to improve the WCA website and communications to the community
  • The rights and duties of WCT from our By-laws can be found here

Workflow Outline

  • Social media posts are planned at least 1 week in advance and are posted when members are available.
  • Internal emails regarding other WCT projects are answered within 48 hours and other work may come from those projects that take various amounts of time.
  • Time commitment per week is between 4-10 hours.
  • FOR GRAPHICS APPLICANTS: Must be familiar with Adobe Illustrator, GIMP, or equivalent programs

Characteristics we are looking for

  • Creativity: We always need ideas of new social media series or unique ways to expand to other platforms. You will be required to think about this and suggest ideas when you can. For those with graphic design experience, you will be required to help us with designing visually compelling posts.
  • Social media knowledge: You should be familiar with many social media platforms and their basic functions. While you may not have used them personally, you will have to post to them as the WCA and should know what type of content goes on each.
  • Fluent English: Our posts on most social media platforms are in English and we answer most emails in English. We do welcome those that are fluent in other languages alongside English.
  • Communication skills: You will be responsible for writing social media posts that are appropriate and convey the mission of the WCA. You should be able to write a professional, concise email to answer competitor questions and to convey a thorough knowledge of the WCA resources for competitors.
  • Patience: You should keep friendly communications within our email and social media interactions. Always maintaining professionalism when answering the same question many times is hard, but necessary for our day-to-day communications.

To apply, please include:

  • A brief personal introduction
  • Your involvement with the WCA
  • Your motivation for applying to the WCT
  • Your familiarity with social media platforms & an idea of a potential WCA post
  • FOR GRAPHIC APPLICANTS: 2-3 designs that you have created to highlight your design style

Please send the application in PDF format to lclement@worldcubeassociation.org from now until April 2, 2019, 23:59 UTC to be considered.

A reply will be sent to confirm that the documents are in good order or to report on deficiencies otherwise once received. There may be an additional interview requested of candidates with the leader following application submission. The two weeks after the application period, the team will make a selection and the new member(s) will be announced once candidates have accepted the positions.

Thank you in advance for your candidacies and support!

title.zh: WCA 市场团队新负责人确定

html.zh:
我们很高兴地宣布，Somya Srivastava 已获任命，担任 WCA 市场团队（WMT）负责人。

按照关于 WCA 委员会和团队的 10.2019.0 号议案第 4 节，WCA 董事会选定 Somya，并经现任委员会、团队负责人及高级代表投票批准。

祝 Somya 履新顺利！

Somya Srivastava 是本岗位的唯一申请人。如有兴趣，可在此处查看她的申请材料。
html.en:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Committee Leader. Somya Srivastava has been appointed as the Leader of the WCA Marketing Team (WMT).

Somya was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a voting among the current Committee/Team Leaders and Senior Delegates, following Section 4 of our Motion 10.2019.0 about WCA Committees and Teams.

We wish Somya the best of luck in fulfilling her new duty!

Somya Srivastava was the only applicant for the position. Her candidacy document can be found here if you are interested in viewing it.

title.zh: WDC 月度简报：2019 年 2 月

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

以下为纪律委员会 2019 年 2 月的重要动态。

本月积极处理 8 项调查：4 件始于 2018 年 12 月，2 件始于 1 月，2 件始于 2 月。其中 7 件结案，2018 年立案的所有案件现已结案。

已结调查公开通报

  • 两项调查由现任或前任 WCA 工作人员行为引起。两案当事人均充分配合，迅速得出结论，结果积极，WDC 未采取纪律措施。
  • 三项调查涉及盲拧。第一案中，一名年轻、经验不足的选手被现场发现以明拧方法 CFOP 还原。代表询问后认定其不会盲拧。WDC 认可代表分析并发出正式警告。第二案中，一名有经验选手在五阶盲拧时试图从眼罩下偷看。裁判发现眼罩未正确佩戴、未完全遮挡面部，口琴架也放错位置；裁判和代表看到其还原时试图看魔方。正确放置纸板后，选手突然停止还原，随后 DNF。WDC 认可代表判断，给予 6 个月禁赛。第三案中，选手在两场比赛的三阶盲拧中作弊被发现。全面调查中，其承认作弊及目前不会盲拧，WDC 给予 9 个月禁赛。

最后提醒大家充分理解规则和流程，不清楚时询问代表。若认为成绩受到损害或发现可疑行为，请立即找最近的代表报告。

感谢支持 WCA 精神与使命。

Lorenzo Vigani Poli WDC 团队负责人，代表纪律委员会
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

Here you can find some noteworthy updates about the activity of the Disciplinary Committee over the month of February 2019.

In the second month of 2019, the WDC has actively worked on 8 investigations: 4 were opened in December 2018, 2 in January and 2 in February 2019. 7 of these cases were closed. The WDC has now closed all the cases that were opened in 2018.

Public announcements about closed investigations

  • Two investigations were opened as consequence of the actions of WCA Staff or former Staff. In both cases, the person under investigation fully cooperated with the WDC and a conclusion of the case was reached in short time, with positive outcome. No disciplinary action was taken by the WDC.

  • Blindsolving had been the topic of 3 investigations. In the first case, a young and inexperienced competitor was caught, during the competition, solving with a sighting method (CFOP). The competitor was confronted by the Delegate at the competition and it was determined that the competitor is not able to solve the cube blindfolded. The WDC confirmed the validity of the analysis of the Delegate and officially warned the competitor. In the second case, an experienced competitor was caught, during the competition, trying to peek under the blindfold in 5x5x5 blindfolded. The judge noticed that the competitor had donned the blindfold wrongly and it did not fully cover the competitor’s face. The competitor misplaced the harmonica holder as well and was caught by the judge and the Delegate trying to look at the cube whilst solving. When a paper was correctly placed, the competitor stopped his solution abruptly and then DNFed the attempt. The WDC confirmed the Delegate’s evaluation of this issue and decided to ban the competitor for 6 months from WCA competitions. In the third case, a competitor was caught cheating during 3x3 blindfolded at two different competitions. During the thorough investigation, the competitor confessed and admitted they are not able to solve the cube blindfolded at this time. The WDC decided to ban the competitor for 9 months from WCA competitions.

To conclude, we would like to remind everyone to make sure they fully understand the WCA Regulations and competition procedures. If you have any questions or are unsure about how to do something, please do not hesitate to ask the Delegate(s) of the competition. In addition, if you think the competition results are being compromised in any way or see suspicious behavior, find the nearest delegate immediately and report the incident.

Thank you all for your help in supporting the WCA Spirit and Mission.

Lorenzo Vigani Poli
WDC Team Leader
On behalf of the Disciplinary Committee

title.zh: WCA 市场团队器材组成员招募（2019 年）
title.en: Call for Applicants: Gear Team Members for WMT (2019)

html.zh:
WCA 市场团队现招募新成员，主要负责 WCA 比赛器材的发货。工作包括接收器材订单、为国际运输重新包装器材，以及定期前往邮局寄件。

由于岗位特殊，申请人必须居住在美国。除此之外，申请面向所有人，无须目前在 WCA 担任职务。

申请人应具备以下条件：

  • 能够在美国地址接收包裹
  • 能够定期前往当地邮局寄件，每月数次
  • 诚实可靠
  • 良好的沟通能力

现已开始接收申请，将持续招募，直至三个名额全部录满。请将材料私下发送给 Somya Srivastava（ssrivastava@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：

  • 简短的个人介绍
  • 为 WCA 所做工作的概述
  • 担任 WCA 市场团队成员的工作设想

收到申请后，我们会确认材料是否完整，或指出需要补充之处。

WMT 的权利与职责见 WCA 动议 10.2018.1。

申请期结束后，WMT 负责人将选出人选；待候选人接受职位后，将公布新成员。

提前感谢各位申请和支持！
html.en:
The WCA Marketing Team is asking for membership applications with the primary task of handling the distribution of WCA Competition Gear. The responsibilities of these team members will be to receive equipment orders, re-pack the equipment for international shipping, and make routine trips to the post office.

Applicants must be based within the United States for this unique position. Otherwise, the applications are open to everyone; it is not a requirement to hold a current position within the WCA to be considered.

The qualities expected of candidates are:

  • Ability to accept packages sent to a US address
  • Ability to make routine (several times per month) drop-offs to a local post office
  • Trustworthiness
  • Communication skills

The application period is opened for candidates to submit their candidacy documents, which will be accepted on a rolling basis until all three available positions are filled. Applications should be sent privately to the Somya Srivastava (ssrivastava@worldcubeassociation.org).

The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

  • Brief personal introduction
  • Summary of activities done for the WCA
  • Ambitions as a member of the WCA Marketing Team

Upon receipt, it will be confirmed if the documents are in good order or if there are deficiencies.

The rights and duties of the WMT can be found in WCA Motion 10.2018.1.

After the application period, the WMT leader will make a selection and the new members will be announced once candidates have accepted the positions.

Thank you in advance for your candidacies and support!

title.zh: WCA 数据保护委员会负责人任命公告

html.zh:
我们很高兴地宣布，Ronald Mansveld 已获任命为 WCA 数据保护委员会（WDPC）负责人。

依照 WCA 委员会与团队动议 10.2019.0第 4 节，WCA 董事会选定 Ronald，并经现任委员会、团队负责人和高级代表投票批准。

祝 Ronald 在新的岗位上工作顺利！

Ronald Mansveld 是本次职位的唯一申请人。有兴趣的成员可在此处查看他的申请材料。
html.en:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Committee Leader. Ronald Mansveld has been appointed as the Leader of the WCA Data Protection Committee (WDPC).

Ronald was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a voting among the current Committee/Team Leaders and Senior Delegates, following Section 4 of our Motion 10.2019.0 about WCA Committees and Teams.

We wish Ronald the best of luck in fulfilling his new duty!

Ronald Mansveld was the only applicant for the position. His candidacy document can be found here if you are interested in viewing it.

title.zh: WCA 市场团队负责人招募（2019 年 2 月）

html.zh:
WCA 将为**市场团队（WMT）**任命新的负责人。该团队自成立以来一直由 WCA 董事会领导。WMT 是 WCA 的咨询委员会，负责建立和管理 WCA 品牌、寻求赞助、协助发放 WCA 比赛器材，以及推广 WCA 周边商品。

申请人应能够完成 24 个月的任期，平均每周至少投入 7 小时处理团队工作，并具备以下条件：

  • 市场营销背景
  • 了解社交媒体
  • 英语流利
  • 出色的沟通能力

请在 2019 年 2 月 28 日 23:59 UTC 前，将申请材料私下发送至 WCA 董事会（board@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：

  • 简短的个人介绍
  • 为 WCA 所做工作的概述
  • 担任 WMT 负责人的工作设想

申请人还须提交一份可在申请截止后公开的申请材料副本。

WMT 的权利与职责见 WCA 动议 10.2018.1。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将依照 WCA 动议 10.2019.0第 4 节投票选出新负责人，经高级代表及现任委员会、团队负责人投票确认后公布。

提前感谢各位申请和支持！
html.en:
There will be an appointment of a new WCA Team Leader for the WCA Marketing Team (WMT), which has been led by the WCA Board since its creation. The WMT is an Advisory Committee of the WCA responsible for developing and managing the WCA Brand, seeking sponsorships, supporting the distribution of WCA Competition Gear, and marketing WCA Merchandise.

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 7 hours per week on average to work for the Committee. The qualities expected of candidates are:

  • Marketing background
  • Social media knowledge
  • Fluent English
  • Excellent communication skills

The application period is opened for candidates to submit their candidacy documents until February 28th, 2019, 23:59 UTC privately to the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).

The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

  • Brief personal introduction
  • Summary of activities done for the WCA
  • Ambitions as the WMT Leader

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WMT can be found in WCA Motion 10.2018.1.

Following the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of WCA Motion 10.2019.0.

Thank you in advance for your candidacies and support!

title.zh: 征求意见：2019 年 WCA 竞赛规则草案
title.en: Call for Feedback — WCA Regulations 2019 Draft

html.zh:
WRC 邀请 WCA 社区讨论 2019 年初的新版竞赛规则草案，并提交反馈。这还不是最终版本，欢迎就任何改动提出建议。

如果没有重大问题，我们计划在 3 月初将最终草案提交 WCA 董事会审批。具体流程见动议 14.2019.1。

本摘要所列改动已公开于 https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/call-for-feedback-wca-regulations-2019-draft 。你可以通过 GitHub 上的版本比较查看各项改动。如果不想逐个打开，可以点击“Files changed”，查看规则和指南的完整文字差异。改动及新增内容标为绿色，删除内容标为红色。

轮次赛制调整：

  • 四阶盲拧和五阶盲拧的“三次取最佳”轮次，现在也认可三次平均成绩。（提交 | 讨论）
  • 除盲拧项目和三阶最少步外，其他所有项目均取消“X 次取最佳”赛制。（提交 | 讨论，提交 | 讨论，提交 | 讨论）

比赛组织方面的调整：

  • 2019 年的所有比赛都应采用打乱员签名制度。（提交 | 讨论 | 讨论 | 讨论）
    • 计划于 2020 年将打乱员签名设为强制要求。
  • 在某组比赛开始前，WCA 代表不得让打乱员或其他任何人接触该组的打乱序列。（提交）
    • TNoodle 0.14.0 为各套打乱 PDF 提供独立密码，有助于落实这一要求。
  • 明确还原时限的规定。（提交）
    • 时限必须在比赛开始前公布，而非只在相应轮次开始前公布。
    • 每一轮只能适用一个累积时限。
    • 累积时限包括 DNF 还原中已用的时间。
    • 裁判和 WCA 代表可以估算累计用时。（提交）
  • 应在视觉上将打乱员与选手隔开。（提交）
  • 许多比赛要求已从竞赛规则移至新的 WCA 比赛要求政策。（提交）

其他实质性调整及澄清：

  • 多盲中若有个别魔方不符合使用要求，代表可酌情将这些魔方计为未还原，而不将整次还原判为 DNF。（提交 | 讨论）
  • 经代表酌情允许，选手可在特定时候使用暖手用品及进食。（提交 | 讨论）
  • 发生飞棱时，选手不得请求协助，裁判也应阻止他人帮忙。如果有人替选手捡起飞出的零件，裁判或选手可以请其将零件放到比赛位上，并停止进一步协助。（提交 | 讨论）
  • 选手可以触碰官方计时用的秒表，除非组织团队另行提供了非官方计时用的秒表供选手使用。（提交 | 讨论）
  • 启动计时器即意味着观察结束、还原开始。因此，观察开始后，选手不能再“测试”计时器。（提交 | 讨论）
  • 明确禁止故意造成魔方故障。（提交 | 讨论）
  • 如果与顶面相邻的面中有多个绿色面，打乱时将颜色最深的一面朝前。（提交）
  • 明确多盲成绩的用时一律四舍五入到秒，与成绩数据库保持一致。（提交）
  • 明确 N×N×N 魔方的记号。（提交）
    • 连同外层一起转动 n 层的外砖转动（如 nFw），须满足 1 < n < N，其中 N 为魔方阶数。
    • 定义执行转动度量制（ETM），并以此规定三阶最少步的步数上限。
  • 最少步相关澄清。（提交）
    • 用于标识答卷的信息，是指姓名、WCA ID 或报名编号中的至少一项，也可附上比赛名称、轮次及尝试序号。
    • 选手可以在本次尝试开始前填写标识答卷的信息。
    • 提交解法时，选手可以在裁判面前填写标识答卷的信息，但提交后不得补写。
    • 选手应将不属于最终解法的转动涂黑或划掉。
    • 对经验不足的选手，裁判可以将 {r}、<r> 或 (r) 理解为 [r]。
    • 选手可根据需要自备最少步用笔。（提交）
    • 明确允许在最少步中使用铅笔及类似书写工具。
    • 如果不存在提前获知打乱的风险，选手可以迟到参加三阶最少步的一次尝试。（提交）
html.en:
The WRC invites the WCA Community to discuss and send feedback on a new draft version of the WCA Regulations for early 2019. This version is not final, and we welcome suggestions on any aspect of the set of changes.

If there are no major issues, we plan to send a final draft to the WCA Board for approval at the beginning of March. (See Motion 14.2019.1 for details about the process.)

The changes listed in this summary are publicly available at https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/call-for-feedback-wca-regulations-2019-draft. You can review all individual changes in this comparison on GitHub. If you do not want to open all the individual changes, you can click on "Files changed" to see the full textual changes to the Regulations and Guidelines. All changes and additions are marked green and removals are red.

Round format changes:

  • Means are now recognized for 4x4x4 Blindfolded and 5x5x5 Blindfolded "Best of 3" rounds. (commit | discussion)
  • The "Best of X" format has been removed from all events except blindfolded events and 3x3x3 Fewest Moves. (commit | discussion, commit | discussion, commit | discussion)

Competition organization changes:

  • Scramble signatures should be used for all competitions in 2019 (commit | discussion | discussion | discusssion)

    • Scramble signatures are planned to become mandatory in 2020.

  • The WCA Delegate must not give scramblers (or anyone else) access to scramble sequences for any group before it has begun. (commit)

    • Note that TNoodle 0.14.0 includes scramble set PDFs with individual passcodes to help with this.

  • Time limits have been clarified (commit)

    • Time limits must be announced before the competition, rather than just before the round.
    • Only one cumulative time limit can apply to a given round.
    • Cumulative time limits include time elapsed in DNF attempts.
    • The judge and WCA Delegate may estimate cumulative elapsed time (commit)

  • Scramblers should be visually isolated from competitors. (commit)

  • Many competition requirements have been moved from the Regulations to the new WCA Competition Requirements Policy (commit)

Other substantial changes and clarifications:

  • Individual non-permitted puzzles in multi BLD may count as unsolved instead of DNFing the whole attempt, at the discretion of the Delegate. (commit | discussion)
  • Competitors are allowed to have hand warmers and food at certain times, at the discretion of the Delegate. (commit | discussion)
  • The competitor must not ask for assistance during a pop, and the judge should prevent others from assisting. If someone picks up a popped part for the competitor, the judge or competitor may ask them to place it on the solving station and not to assist any further. (commit | discussion)
  • The competitor may touch the official stopwatch, unless the organization team provides an unofficial stopwatch for the competitor. (commit | discussion)
  • Starting the timer always ends inspection and begins the solve. This means that the competitor cannot "test" the timer once inspection has begun. (commit | discussion)
  • It is explicitly forbidden to cause puzzle defects intentionally. (commit | discussion)
  • If there are multiple green faces next to the top face, the darkest is placed in front for scrambling. (commit)
  • We've specified that Multi-Blind result times are always rounded to seconds, matching the results database. (commit)
  • Notation for NxNxN cubes has been clarified (commit)
    • Outer Block Moves that move n slices (e.g. nFw) must have 1 < n < N (where N is the number of layers in the puzzle).
    • Execution Turn Metric (ETM) is defined, and used to define the move limit for 3x3x3 Fewest Moves.
  • Clarifications for Fewest Moves (commit)
    • Information to identify an attempt is defined as name, WCA ID, or registrant ID (at least one), and optionally competition name/round/attempt number.
    • The competitor may write information to identify the attempt before the attempt has begun.
    • The competitor may write information to identify the attempt in front of a judge while submitting a solution (but the information must not be added after).
    • Competitors should black out/scribble out moves that are not part of the solution.
    • Judges may interpret {r}, <r>, or (r) as [r] for inexperienced competitors.
    • Competitors may supply their own pens for Fewest Moves if they wish. (commit)
    • Pencils and similar writing implements are explicitly permitted for Fewest Moves.
    • Competitors may join a 3x3x3 Fewest Moves attempt late, if there is no risk they could have information about the scramble (commit)

title.zh: 招募 WCA 顾问理事会社区代表（2019 年 2 月）
title.en: Call for Applicants - WAC Community Representatives (February 2019)

html.zh:
新成立的 WCA 顾问理事会（WAC）正在招募成员，一起开展工作！

WAC 是什么，负责什么？

WAC 最重要的任务，是在社区和 WCA 工作人员之间搭起沟通桥梁，让重要议题的讨论能够听到社区的声音。社区代表将是这一过程的关键参与者。WAC 主要职能的更多信息见 WCA 议案 20.2019.01。

理事会分为两个小组：社区代表和 WCA 代表。本公告招募的是社区代表，他们将占理事会成员的大多数，且不得是 WCA 工作人员，也就是说，除 WCA 工作人员外，其他人都可以申请。如果你以前从未在 WCA 正式任职，这将是一个参与改善 WCA 的好机会！

我们希望候选人具备以下素质：

  • 沟通能力：内部交流使用英语，因此需要达到中等英语水平。
  • 工作态度：成员应持续参与工作，不能连续多天不理会消息。
  • 创新意识：我们会花不少时间讨论工作方法，并收集值得关注的议题。如果你觉得 WCA 现在已经完美无缺，这个职位可能并不适合你！
  • 兴趣：最好愿意与社区一起讨论 WCA 事务。
  • 成熟度：线上讨论需要有深度、有成果。反馈社区意见时，你代表的是社区，而非仅仅自己的看法。
  • 熟悉的领域：团队希望覆盖尽可能广泛的社区群体，因此成员可以将部分精力放在自己了解且有热情的领域。这可以是某个地理区域，也可以是某一类魔友，例如顶尖或较慢的选手、年轻或年长的选手。

申请期从即日起至 2019 年 3 月 1 日 23:59 UTC，请将材料发送给 Daniel Sheppard（dsheppard@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请材料须以邮件正文或 PDF 格式提交，并应包含：

  • 姓名和 WCA ID。
  • 说明自己如何符合上述要求。
  • （选填） 一位可信赖的社区成员作为推荐人，例如代表。

提前感谢大家的申请与支持！
html.en:
Our newly formed WCA Advisory Council (WAC) is looking for members to help with their mission!

What is the WAC and what do they do? The biggest task of the WAC is to be an intermediary between the community and the WCA Staff - to give the community a voice when important topics are being discussed. The Community Representatives will be a vital part of that process. More information about the main functions of the WAC can be found here: WCA Motion 20.2019.01

The council will have 2 sub-teams - Community Representatives and WCA Representatives. This announcement is for Community Representatives, who will make up the majority of the council and will not be members of WCA Staff, meaning that anyone except WCA Staff can apply. If you have never held a formal position in the WCA before, this an exciting opportunity to contribute towards making the WCA even better!

The qualities expected of candidates are:

  • Communication: Internal communication is done in English, so an intermediate standard of English is required.
  • Work Ethic: Members will be expected to contribute regularly and not ignore messages for many days.
  • Innovation: There will be significant time spent discussing our methods of working and doing a lot of idea gathering of topics to focus on. If you think that the WCA is currently perfect then you probably aren’t the person for this!
  • Interest: An enjoyment to discuss WCA matters among the community is ideal.
  • Maturity: Online discussions will need to be thought-provoking and productive. When providing community feedback you'll be representing the community and not your own views.
  • Specialisations: The goal of the team is to cover a wide spectrum of the community and therefore members can partly focus on certain areas that they are knowledgeable and passionate about. This could be a geographical area, or any sort of “category” of cuber e.g. elite/slower cubers, younger/older cubers.

The application period is open for candidates to submit their candidacy document from now until March 1, 2019, 23:59 UTC to Daniel Sheppard (dsheppard@worldcubeassociation.org).

The candidacy documents must be in written email or PDF format, and should include the following:

  • Your Name and WCA ID
  • An explanation of how you fit the qualities required
  • (Optional) A reference to a trusted member of the community (e.g. a Delegate)

Thank you in advance for your candidacies and support!

title.zh: WDC 月度简报：2019 年 1 月

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

自 2019 年 1 月起，WDC 将每月公开工作概览，帮助社群更了解委员会。我们的工作大多在幕后，基于保密，容易引发虚假传闻和混乱。因此，希望建立常规沟通，避免误解和不实信息，并介绍工作。

本月积极处理 11 项调查：3 件于 1 月立案，8 件由 2018 年延续；其中 5 件结案。

已结调查公开通报

  1. WDC 近期完成一名不具名未成年选手在不同盲拧项目中试图谋取优势的调查。视频显示，比赛中该选手使用依赖视力的方法还原，原因是裁判忘记在选手与魔方之间放置遮挡板。WDC 与其长时间讨论，尤其询问盲拧时所用方法。最终未获得证明其实际盲拧能力的证据，关于“创新”方法的问题仍无回答。因此给予六个月禁赛，将全部受影响成绩改为 DNF。
  2. 两名未成年选手因采取行动试图互相帮助取得更好成绩，各被禁赛六个月。一人担任另一人裁判，在显示屏关闭时记录不真实时间；另一人在前者执裁时观察中转动。两人互相掩护违规，分别在不同项目取得国家纪录。现场代表询问时，两人无法复盘并重现声称达到的时间，也无法可靠地回答 WDC 问题，以推翻代表及证人的证词。
  3. WDC 完成对 2016DERO04不同盲拧项目成绩的第二次调查，第二次认定其作弊，禁赛总期限增至 2 年。

调查细节见公开报告。

我们不计划经常公开报告，但 2018 年末首次调查结束后争议很大，因此认为这是展示委员会正式调查方式的机会，也希望防止 2018 年 12 月已出现过的不实信息传播。

最后提醒充分理解规则及流程，有疑问时询问代表。若认为成绩受到损害或看到可疑行为，请立即找最近的代表报告。

感谢支持 WCA 精神与使命。

Lorenzo Vigani Poli WDC 团队负责人，代表纪律委员会
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

Starting from January 2019, the WDC will issue a public overview of its activities every month, in order to give a better perception of the work of the Committee to the Community.
We realize that our work is mostly behind the scenes and that it’s based on confidentiality, which is something that can easily lead to the spreading of false rumors and confusion. The WDC would like to establish a routine in its communication towards the WCA Community, to avoid misunderstanding and disinformation and to provide some insight about its activities.

First, a bit of data. In the first month of 2019, the WDC has actively worked on 11 investigations: 3 were opened in January and 8 were still ongoing from 2018. 5 of these cases were closed.

Public announcements about closed investigations

  1. The WDC has recently concluded an investigation regarding an underage competitor, who shall remain nameless, because of their attempt to gain a personal advantage in different blindfolded events. A video provided to the WDC shows the competitor using a sight based method to solve their cubes during one of these events at a WCA Competition. This was possible because the judge of this attempt had forgot to administer a blocker between the competitor and their cube. The WDC discussed at length the case with the accused competitor, especially focusing on the method used to solve the cube whilst blindfolded by them. In the end, no proof has been provided to the WDC about the actual ability of the competitor with regards to solving the cube blindfolded. All the questions about their “innovative” method remain unanswered. The WDC has decided to administer a six month ban to the competitor and to DNF all of the affected results.

  2. The WDC has decided to administer a six month ban to two underage competitors because of their actions taken in an attempt to help each other get better results. One of the competitors was found to be judging the other and record illegitimate times while the display was off, while the other competitor was found performing moves during inspection, while the first competitor was judging him. Both of them went on to make National Records in two different events, because of their cooperation in cover each others violations of the WCA Regulations. They were both questioned by the Delegate at the competition and were unable to reconstruct their solves and obtaining on these reconstructions the same times as they just allegedly had. They were also not able to answer to the WDC’s questions in a way that could reliably contradict the testimonies of the Delegate of the competition and of the witnesses that contacted the Disciplinary Committee.

  3. The WDC has also concluded its second investigation about 2016DERO04 and his results in different Blindsolving events. The competitor has been found guilty of cheating for the second time by the Committee. Consequently, the length of the ban has been increased to a total of 2 years.

The details of this investigation, contained in this report, are shared with the Community.

We don’t plan on publicly sharing reports on a regular basis, but great controversy arose at the end of 2018, after the conclusion of the first investigation. Therefore, the WDC thinks that this can be the right chance of showing how the Committee operates and acts during official investigations. Obviously, we also want to prevent the spreading of false information, which is something that already happened during the month of December 2018.

Finally, we would like to remind everyone to make sure they fully understand the WCA Regulations and competition procedures. If you have any questions or are unsure about how to do something, please do not hesitate to ask the Delegate(s) of the competition. In addition, if you think the competition results are being compromised in any way or see suspicious behavior, find the nearest Delegate immediately and report the incident.

Thank you all for your help in supporting the WCA Spirit and Mission.

Lorenzo Vigani Poli
WDC Team Leader
On behalf of the Disciplinary Committee

title.zh: WCA 顾问理事会负责人任命公告

html.zh:
我们很高兴地宣布，Daniel Sheppard 已获任命，担任 WCA 顾问理事会（WAC）负责人。

WCA 董事会根据关于 WCA 理事会的 20.2019.0 号议案第 4.1 节，选定 Daniel。

祝 Daniel 履新顺利！

本次共有三位申请人，Daniel Sheppard 是其中之一。如有兴趣，可在此处查看他及其他申请人的材料。
html.en:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Council Leader. Daniel Sheppard has been appointed as the Leader of the WCA Advisory Council (WAC).

Daniel was selected by the WCA Board, in accordance with Section 4.1 of our Motion 20.2019.0 about WCA Councils.

We wish Daniel the best of luck in fulfilling his new role!

Daniel Sheppard was among the three applicants who applied and his candidacy document (and the others) can be found here if you are interested in viewing them.

title.zh: WCA 数据保护委员会招募负责人（2019 年 1 月）

html.zh:
随着 WCA 数据保护政策 v1.1 获得通过，**WCA 数据保护委员会（WDPC）**正式成立，现需招募一位负责人。WDPC 是 WCA 的顾问委员会，负责所有与数据保护有关的事务，包括但不限于欧盟《通用数据保护条例》（GDPR），以及世界各地其他数据保护和隐私法规。

所有人均可申请，无需目前在 WCA 任职。申请人应能完成 24 个月任期，并平均每周至少投入 7 小时处理委员会事务。我们希望申请人具备：

  • 出色的领导能力。
  • 熟悉数据保护及 GDPR。
  • 注重细节。
  • 出色的沟通能力。

申请现已开放，请于 2019 年 2 月 5 日 23:59 UTC 前，私下将材料发送至 WCA 董事会（board@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，包含：

  1. 简短的个人介绍。
  2. 为 WCA 所做工作的概述。
  3. 担任 WDPC 负责人的工作设想。

另请提供一份可在申请截止后公开的申请材料副本。

WDPC 的权利与职责见 WCA 数据保护政策 v1.1。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将通过投票选出新负责人，并按照 WCA 议案 10.2019.0 第 4 节，经高级代表及现任委员会、团队负责人投票确认后公布。

感谢大家的申请与支持！
html.en:
The successful passing of the WCA Data Protection Policy v1.1 established the WCA Data Protection Committee (WDPC) that is in need of a leader. The WCA Data Protection Committee is an Advisory Committee of the WCA which is responsible for all matters relating to Data Protection including, but not limited to the EU General Data Protection Regulations (GDPR) and other Data Protection and Privacy regulations worldwide.

The applications are open to everyone; it’s not a requirement to hold a current position in the WCA to be considered. Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 7 hours per week on average to work for the Committee. The qualities expected of candidates are:

  • Strong leadership skills
  • Good knowledge of Data Protection and GDPR
  • Attention to detail
  • Excellent communication skills

The application period is opened for candidates to submit their candidacy documents until February 5th, 2019, 23:59 UTC privately to the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).

The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

  1. Brief personal introduction.
  2. Summary of activities done for the WCA.
  3. Ambitions as the WDPC Leader.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WDPC are can be found in the WCA Data Protection Policy v1.1.

Following the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of WCA Motion 10.2019.0.

Thank you in advance for your candidacies and support!

title.zh: WCA 咨询理事会首任负责人招募（2019 年 1 月）
title.en: Appointment of a WCA Advisory Council Leader (January 2019)

html.zh:
我们将任命 WCA 首位理事会负责人。相关动议修订已获通过，WCA 动议 20.2019.1据此设立了 WCA 咨询理事会（WAC）。WAC 负责建立和维护 WCA 社区与工作人员之间的双向沟通。

申请者应能完成 24 个月的任期，并平均每周投入至少 8 小时参与理事会工作。我们希望申请者具备：

  • 较强的领导能力。
  • 出色的沟通能力。
  • 熟悉 WCA 的组织架构。
  • 与 WCA 社区保持紧密联系。

即日起接受申请，请于 2019 年 1 月 31 日 23:59 UTC 前，私下向 WCA 董事会提交材料（board@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：

  1. 简短的自我介绍。
  2. 为 WCA 社区所做工作的概述。
  3. 担任 WAC 负责人的工作设想。

收到的所有申请材料都将在申请截止后公开。

WAC 的权利与职责摘自 WAC 动议，附于下文。

申请截止后的下一周，WCA 董事会将依据 WCA 动议 20.2019.0 第 4.1 节投票选出新负责人，并公布结果。

感谢大家的申请和支持。

附录：WCA 咨询理事会的权利与职责

  1. WCA 咨询理事会拥有以下权利与职责：
    1. 建立 WCA 社区与 WCA 董事会之间的沟通渠道，提供已注册速拧选手对 WCA 运作的直接反馈。
      1. 确保 WCA 社区的需求和请求得到 WCA 工作人员的倾听与处理。
    2. 招募有能力且愿意帮助改进 WCA 运作的社区成员。
    3. 改善并进一步推动 WCA 的透明度。
    4. 改善 WCA 社区与工作人员之间的双向沟通。
html.en:
There will be an appointment of our first WCA Council Leader. The successful passing of the proposed amendments to the Motions established the WCA Advisory Council through WCA Motion 20.2019.1. The WAC is an Advisory Council of the WCA which is responsible for building and maintaining bilateral communication between the WCA Community and the WCA Staff.

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 8 hours per week on average to work for the Council. The qualities expected of candidates are:

  • Strong leadership skills
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Good knowledge of the WCA structure
  • A strong connection to the WCA Community

The application period is opened for candidates to submit their candidacy documents until January 31st, 2019, 23:59 UTC privately to the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).

The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

  1. Brief personal introduction.
  2. Summary of activities done for the WCA Community.
  3. Ambitions as the WAC Leader.

All received applications will be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WAC are copied from the WAC’s Motion in the appendix below.

The week after the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, as described in Section 4.1 of WCA Motion 20.2019.0.

Thanks for your candidacies and support.

APPENDIX - RIGHTS AND DUTIES OF THE WCA ADVISORY COUNCIL

  1. The WCA Advisory Council has the following rights and duties:
    1. Establishing communication channels between the WCA Community and the WCA Board, providing direct feedback from Registered Speedcubers about the WCA operations.
      1. The WCA Advisory Council shall ensure that the demands and requests of the WCA Community are heard and addressed by WCA Staff.
    2. Recruiting Community Members who are able and willing to help improve the WCA operations.
    3. Improving and further promoting transparency in the WCA.
    4. Improving bilateral communication between the WCA Community and WCA Staff.

title.zh: 2018 年年终寄语

html.zh:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

感谢大家共同度过又一个精彩的魔方年！2018 年对 WCA 来说成果丰硕，我们想与大家分享这一年的成绩。

10 个国家首次举办了 WCA 比赛，超过 25,000 名新选手加入了 WCA。全年共打破 85 项世界纪录、271 项洲际纪录和 4,039 项国家纪录。

今年 WCA 在组织层面最大的变化，是于 10 月获认可为非营利组织！我们还成立了两个新团队：WCA 市场推广团队和 WCA 比赛公示团队，他们的工作帮助 WCA 顺利运作。此外，53 位新代表在今年第一次履行比赛代表职责。

各委员会与团队也忙碌了一整年：WCA 成绩团队发布了 1,148 场比赛的成绩；WCA 董事会、WCA 质量保证委员会及后来成立的 WCA 比赛公示团队公示了 1,196 场比赛；WCA 纪律委员会启动了约 27 起调查；WCA 沟通团队发布了 130 条 Instagram 帖文和 166 条 Facebook 帖文；WCA 软件团队合并了 1,106 个拉取请求！一整年要跟进的工作实在不少！

在社区的帮助下，我们期待 2019 年有更多发展，并继续调整组织架构。也期待 7 月在 2019 年世界锦标赛上，与大家一同享受魔方的乐趣！感谢大家带来又一个精彩的年份，感谢所有让协会正常运作的志愿者。没有每个人的帮助和支持，我们无法做到这些。新年快乐！
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

Thank you all for another great year for cubing! It has been a successful year for the WCA and we would like to share our achievements of 2018 with you.

Ten new countries held WCA competitions and we welcomed over 25,000 new competitors to the WCA. Throughout the year, 85 world records, 271 continental records, and 4,039 national records were broken.

The greatest change for the WCA as an organization this year was becoming recognized as a non-profit organization in October! We also established two new Teams, the WCA Marketing Team and the WCA Competition Announcement Team whose work helps the WCA run smoothly. Additionally, 53 new Delegates delegated their first competition this year.

Within our Committees and Teams, there have been 1,148 competition results posted by the WCA Results Team, 1,196 competition announcements posted by the WCA Board, the WCA Quality Assurance Committee, and later the WCA Competition Announcement Team, about 27 investigations opened by the WCA Disciplinary Committee, 130 Instagram and 166 Facebook posts published by the WCA Communication Team, and 1,106 pull requests merged by the WCA Software Team! So much to keep up with throughout the year!

With the help of our community, we anticipate more growth and organizational adjustments into 2019. We also look forward to celebrating cubing together at World Championship 2019 in July! Thank you for another great year and for all the volunteers that keep our organization running. We could not do it without everyone’s help and support. Happy New Year!

title.zh: WCA 决议修订获通过（2019 年 1 月）

html.zh:
经近期投票，决议修订提案已获通过。新版完整章程与决议可在文件页面 查看，最终改动列表见此处. 自 2019 年 1 月 1 日起生效的决议整理如下：

  • 决议 10.2019.1: 通过决议正式设立 WCA 比赛公告团队，并规定其权利和职责。
  • 决议 20.2019.0: 界定 WCA 顾问委员会类机构的范围。
  • 决议 20.2019.1: 正式设立 WCA 顾问委员会，并规定其权利和职责。
  • 决议 2.2019.1: 补充缺失及新增的定义，并在必要之处作出澄清。
  • 决议 9.2019.1: 规定仅正式代表可以申请高级代表职位。
  • 决议 10.2019.0: 定义委员会/团队资深成员岗位，并说明改进后的委员会/团队负责人任命流程。
  • 决议 1.2019.1, 决议 3.2019.1, 决议 4.2019.1, 决议 5.2019.1, 决议 6.2019.1, 决议 8.2019.1, 决议 10.2019.2, 决议 10.2019.3, 决议 11.2019.1, 决议 13.2019.1, 决议 14.2019.1, 决议 15.2019.1, 决议 16.2019.1, 决议 17.2019.1, 决议 18.2019.1: 因删除“外部工作人员”一词而作相应调整；以上决议均受此改动影响。

*同时涉及其他修改的决议已单独列出。
html.en:
After the recent voting, the proposed amendments to the Motions have been approved. The new complete set of Bylaws and Motions can be found on our Documents page and a final set of the included changes can be found here. The Motions to be in force from January 1, 2019 have been compiled:

  • Motion 10.2019.1: formally establishes through a Motion the WCA Competition Announcement Team and outlines the team's rights and duties.
  • Motion 20.2019.0: gives a scope to WCA Councils.
  • Motion 20.2019.1: formally establishes the WCA Advisory Council, together with its rights and duties.
  • Motion 2.2019.1: adds missing definitions, new ones, and clarifications where necessary.
  • Motion 9.2019.1: restricts the possible applicants for Senior Delegate positions to Full Delegates only.
  • Motion 10.2019.0: defines the Committee/Team Senior Member position, and describes the improved Committee/Team Leader appointment process.
  • Motion 1.2019.1, Motion 3.2019.1, Motion 4.2019.1, Motion 5.2019.1, Motion 6.2019.1, Motion 8.2019.1, Motion 10.2019.2, Motion 10.2019.3, Motion 11.2019.1, Motion 13.2019.1, Motion 14.2019.1, Motion 15.2019.1, Motion 16.2019.1, Motion 17.2019.1, Motion 18.2019.1: address the removal of the “External Staff” term, the following Motions are affected.

*Motions affected by other changes too are listed separately.

title.zh: TNoodle 0.13.5 停止使用

html.zh:
上周发布 TNoodle-WCA-0.14.0 时，我们曾说明，TNoodle-WCA-0.13.5 会暂时继续列为官方允许使用的版本。一周已过，TNoodle-WCA-0.13.5 现正式停止使用，TNoodle-WCA-0.14.0 成为唯一的官方打乱程序。

详情请参阅上周的 TNoodle-WCA-0.14.0 发布公告。

请记住，官方比赛必须使用当前有效版本的官方打乱程序。最新版始终可以从以下页面获取： https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/
html.en:
When TNoodle-WCA-0.14.0 was released last week, we announced that TNoodle-WCA-0.13.5 would briefly remain an officially permitted version. Since a week has passed, TNoodle-WCA-0.13.5 is now officially retired, leaving TNoodle-WCA-0.14.0 as the only official scramble program.

Please see last week's TNoodle-WCA-0.14.0 announcement for details.

Please remember that official competitions must use a current version of the official scramble program. This is always available from: https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/

title.zh: TNoodle 0.14.0

html.zh:
TNoodle-WCA-0.14.0 现已可从 https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/ 下载。 与 TNoodle-WCA-0.13.5 相比，作出了以下调整：

  • 生成的 .zip 压缩包中新增了一个名为 ... Computer Display PDFs.zip 的嵌套压缩包，其中包含各套打乱的 PDF 文件。每个 PDF 都有独立密码，密码列在 ... Computer Display PDF Passcodes - SECRET.txt 中。代表请阅读 https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/#scramble-secrecy 上的说明。
  • 调整了压缩包内其他文件的组织方式，让用于电脑显示的 PDF 文件更醒目。

即将举行的比赛应尽可能使用 TNoodle-WCA-0.14.0 生成新的打乱。 不过，由于与上一版本相比没有直接影响选手的改动，TNoodle-WCA-0.13.5 将暂时继续作为官方允许的版本。（未来一周比赛中已经使用 TNoodle-WCA-0.13.5 生成的打乱仍可使用。）

请记住，正式比赛必须使用官方打乱程序当前获准使用的版本，可随时从以下页面下载： https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/
html.en:
TNoodle-WCA-0.14.0 is now available from https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/ The following changes have been made since TNoodle-WCA-0.13.5:

  • The generated .zip folder now contains a nested .zip file called ... Computer Display PDFs.zip. This contains the scramble set PDFs, each encrypted with a unique passcode that can be found in ... Computer Display PDF Passcodes - SECRET.txt. Please read the directions at https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/#scramble-secrecy if you are a Delegate.
  • The other files in the .zip folder have been rearranged to highlight the existence of the computer display PDFs.

Upcoming competitions should use TNoodle-WCA-0.14.0 to generate new scrambles, when possible. However, since there are no changes that directly affect competitors since the previous version, TNoodle-WCA-0.13.5 will briefly remain an officially permitted version. (Competition scrambles for the coming week that have already been generated using TNoodle-WCA-0.13.5 can still be used.)

Please remember that official competitions must use a current version of the official scramble program. This is always available from: https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/

title.zh: WCA 规则委员会新任负责人

html.zh:
我们很高兴地宣布，Lucas Garron 将接替 Laura Ohrndorf，担任 WCA 规则委员会（WRC）负责人。Lucas 此前已是 WRC 成员。

依照 WCA 委员会与团队动议 10.2017.0第 4 节，WCA 董事会选定 Lucas，并经现任委员会、团队负责人和高级代表投票批准。

祝 Lucas 在新的岗位上工作顺利！

新负责人将立即上任。Lucas Garron 是本次职位的唯一申请人，有兴趣的成员可在此处查看他的申请材料。
html.en:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Committee Leader. Lucas Garron will replace Laura Ohrndorf as the Leader of the WCA Regulations Committee (WRC). Lucas was already working as a member of the WRC.

Lucas was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a voting among the current Committee/Team Leaders and Senior Delegates, following Section 4 of our Motion 10.2017.0 about WCA Committees and Teams.

We wish Lucas the best of luck in fulfilling his new duty!

The new Leader will be promoted immediately. Lucas Garron was the only applicant and his candidacy document can be found here if you are interested in viewing it.
