title.zh: WDC 公告：盲拧事件

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社群：

WCA 纪律委员会面对越来越多调查，涉及选手在盲拧中通过作弊或试图作弊谋取个人优势。

我们对此担忧，尤其是选手常在比赛现场未被发现，不合规成绩被 WCA 接受后，WDC 才不得不开展困难的调查。

WDC 决定对一名保持匿名的选手禁赛六个月，因为其试图取得个人优势。调查发现，其在三阶盲拧中故意从眼罩下偷看，用明拧方法完成还原。这直接违反规则，也违背 WCA 使命和精神，比赛中不允许这种行为。若看到此类行为，请立即报告比赛代表。

WDC 还决定追溯将另一名选手的特定成绩改为 DNF，该人在不明情况下取得异常优异成绩。由于其不配合调查，表现极度防御且可疑，未提供任何证据或可接受解释，WDC 认为这些成绩不可能在遵守规则的情况下取得。因此禁止其参加任何 WCA 比赛一年。WDC 进行了全面调查，参考顶尖选手意见，并与多名证人合作。不过，该禁赛附有条件：如果选手愿意配合并提供所请求证据，我们愿意重启调查。

谢谢， WCA 纪律委员会
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

The WCA Disciplinary Committee (WDC) has been facing a rise in the number of investigations concerning competitors trying to achieve a personal advantage by cheating (or attempting to cheat) during blindfolded events.

We are concerned about this phenomenon, especially because competitors often have been able to get away with it during competitions. The WDC had to step in and conduct difficult investigations after illegal results had been accepted by the WCA.

The WDC has decided to administer a six month ban to a competitor, who shall remain anonymous, because of their actions taken in an attempt to gain a personal advantage. The competitor was found to be intentionally cheating while competing in 3x3x3 Blindfolded by looking under their blindfold and using a sight-solving method to finish the cube. We would like to remind everyone that this kind of behavior is not allowed at WCA Competitions because it is in direct violation of the Regulations and contravenes both the Mission and Spirit of the WCA. If you or anyone else sees this kind of activity happening, please report it to the WCA Delegate of the competition immediately.

The WDC has also decided to retroactively DNF specific results of another competitor, who obtained exceptionally good results under unclear circumstances. Since the competitor in question failed to cooperate with the WCA Disciplinary Committee during the investigation, acted in an extremely defensive and suspicious way, and failed to present any sort of evidence or acceptable explanation, the WDC deemed impossible for these results to have been achieved in compliance with the WCA Regulations. The competitor has consequently been banned from any WCA Competition for one year. The WDC conducted a thorough investigation in this case, considering the opinion of top level speedcubers and cooperating with multiple witnesses. The ban is conditional, though, since we are willing to reopen the investigation if the competitor decides to cooperate and provides the evidence that we requested.

Thank you,
WCA Disciplinary Committee

title.zh: WCA 获得 501(c)(3) 非营利组织资格
title.en: Recognition of WCA as a 501(c)(3) Non-Profit Organization

html.zh:
我们终于可以高兴地宣布，世界魔方协会已获认定为非营利组织！我们刚刚收到美国国税局的认定函，确认 WCA 根据《国内税收法》第 501(c)(3) 条享有联邦所得税豁免资格。

借此机会，感谢大家多年来对协会及其使命的投入。一路走来并不容易，而更好的未来还在前方！
html.en:
It is with great pleasure that we can finally announce that the World Cube Association has been recognized as a Non-Profit Organization! We have just received the Determination Letter from the Internal Revenue Service of the United States that confirms we are exempt from federal income tax under Internal Revenue Code Section 501(c)(3).

We would like to seize this moment to thank every one of you for your dedication towards our organization and our Mission through the years. It has been a long way since this journey began, but the best is yet to come!

title.zh: WCA 比赛公告团队成员招募（2018 年 10 月）

html.zh:
WCA 比赛公告团队（WCAT）正在招募新成员，一起完成比赛公告工作！

我们希望成员具备以下条件：

  • 注重细节。
  • 乐于服务他人。
  • 遵守工作流程，能够帮助代表在合理时间内公布比赛。
  • 熟悉 WCA 规则和比赛政策。

预计每周需投入 4–6 小时。关于 WCAT 的政策，详情见《WCA 比赛公告政策 2.0 版》。

WCAT 成员的工作包括：

  • 准确审核并公布提交的比赛申请。
  • 处理比赛信息的修改申请。
  • 培训代表正确使用 WCA 提供的工具。
  • 经常就需要批准的比赛事项参与投票。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，包含：

  • 简短的自我介绍。
  • 为 WCA 所做工作的总结。
  • 对 WCAT 工作的设想，以及申请加入的原因。

申请面向所有有兴趣的人开放，截止时间为 2018 年 11 月 5 日 23:59 UTC。请将材料发送给 Henrik Aagaard（henrikthedane@gmail.com）。

如果你认为社区中有人适合加入这个新团队，请把消息转告他们。申请人无须目前已在 WCA 任职。

谢谢大家！
html.en:
The WCA Competition Announcement Team (WCAT) is seeking members to help them with our mission of announcing competitions!

The qualities of members we are seeking include:

  • A sense of detail.
  • Service mindedness.
  • Sticking to protocol, and can help your fellow Delegates announce their competition in a reasonable time.
  • Familiarity with the regulations and WCA Competition Policies.

The expected workload is 4-6 hours per week. More info of the policy of WCAT can be found here: WCA Competition Announcement Policy Version 2.0

As a WCAT member you would work on the following tasks:

  • Reviewing and announcing competition submissions with accuracy and correctness.
  • Handling change requests to competitions.
  • Training Delegates to properly utilize the tools that WCA has for them.
  • Partake in frequent votes for competition items that need approval.

Candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

  • A brief personal introduction.
  • Summary of activities done for the WCA.
  • Ambitions for the WCAT and why you are seeking to join.

Applications are open now until November 5th 2018 23:59 UTC to anyone interested in applying! The candidacy document must be sent to Henrik Aagaard (henrikthedane@gmail.com)

Please pass this information on to anyone in your community that you believe would be a good fit for this new team. You do not need to have any current position inside the WCA to be considered.

Thank you!

title.zh: 非洲高级代表任命公告（2018 年 10 月）
title.en: Appointment of a New Senior Delegate - Africa (October 2018)

html.zh:
近期招募结束后，新一位高级代表已获任命。董事会收到了 Philippe Virouleau 对非洲高级代表岗位的申请，并已任命他担任此职。

任命即日起生效。他的申请材料可在此处查看。

感谢 Philippe 愿意在已有工作之外，为 WCA 和速拧社区承担更多责任。祝新高级代表履新顺利！
html.en:
As a result of our recent application period, a new Senior Delegate has been appointed. For the Africa region, the Board received the application of Philippe Virouleau and he has been appointed to the position.

The appointment is effective immediately. You may find his application here.

We want to thank Philippe for his willingness to help the WCA and the Speedcubing Community even more than he currently does now. Good luck to the new Senior Delegate in his role!

title.zh: WCA 比赛公告团队新任负责人

html.zh:
我们很高兴地宣布，Henrik Buus Aagaard 将担任 WCA 比赛公告团队（WCAT）负责人。

依照 WCA 委员会与团队动议 10.2017.0第 4 节，WCA 董事会选定 Henrik，并经现任委员会、团队负责人和高级代表投票批准。

祝 Henrik 在新的岗位上工作顺利！

新负责人将立即上任。本次共有五位申请人，包括 Henrik Buus Aagaard。有兴趣的成员可在此处查看他及其他申请人的材料。

其他申请人为：

  • Jacob Ambrose
  • Clément Cherblanc
  • Abhijeet Ghodgaonkar
  • Sam Spendla
html.en:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Committee Leader. Henrik Buus Aagaard will become the Leader of the WCA Competition Announcement Team (WCAT).

Henrik was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a voting among the current Committee/Team Leaders and Senior Delegates, following Section 4 of our Motion 10.2017.0 about WCA Committees and Teams.

We wish Henrik the best of luck in fulfilling his new duty!

The new Leader will be promoted immediately. Henrik Buus Aagaard was among the five applicants we had and his candidacy document (and the others) can be found here if you are interested in viewing it.

List of the other candidates who applied:

  • Jacob Ambrose
  • Clément Cherblanc
  • Abhijeet Ghodgaonkar
  • Sam Spendla

title.zh: 招募 WCA 规则委员会新负责人（2018 年 10 月）
title.en: Appointment of a New WRC Leader (October 2018)

html.zh:
Laura Ohrndorf 近日卸任 WCA 规则委员会负责人，我们将任命新负责人。感谢 Laura 过去几年带领委员会付出的努力！

候选人应完成整个任期（24 个月），平均每周至少投入 10 小时处理委员会工作。我们希望候选人具备以下条件：

  • 较强的领导能力。
  • 注重细节。
  • 精通规则。
  • 善于分析。
  • 出色的沟通能力。

申请截止时间为 2018 年 10 月 23 日 23:59 UTC。请将申请材料私下发送至 WCA 董事会（board@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：

  1. 简短的个人介绍。
  2. 曾为 WCA 开展的工作概述。
  3. 担任 WCA 规则委员会负责人后的工作设想。

此外，请提交一份可在申请期结束后公开的申请材料副本。

WRC 的权利与职责摘自 WCA 议案 10.2017.2，列于下方附录。

申请期结束后，WCA 董事会将投票选出人选，再由现任高级代表及委员会、团队负责人投票确认，随后公布新负责人。流程详见 WCA 议案 10.2017.0第 4 节。

感谢大家的申请与支持。

附录 3：WCA 规则委员会的权利与职责

WCA 规则委员会是 WCA 的咨询委员会，拥有以下权利与职责：

  1. 管理和维护 WCA 规则，其中包含 WCA 比赛期间及相关活动中必须遵守的所有规定。
    1. 规则应包含清晰、简洁、具有规范性的全部条文，作为 WCA 比赛的适当标准。
  2. 根据 WCA 工作人员与注册速拧选手的反馈、委员会自身的认识，以及 WCA 比赛中发生的事件，定期制定并发布新版规则。行使此项权利时，必须遵守《WCA 议案：规则修订》。
  3. 如遇紧急修改或文字错误，发布规则的临时更新。
  4. 根据社区反馈和 WCA 比赛报告，解决规则方面的问题。
  5. 根据社区、WCA 工作人员、注册速拧选手的反馈或 WCA 比赛报告，对比赛中发生的事件作出决定。
  6. 当 WCA 比赛中出现未预见、未涵盖或尚未解决的事件时，对规则的解释作出决定。
  7. 指导 WCA 社区正确应用规则。
  8. 定期向所有 WCA 代表编写并发布报告，介绍重要信息，以改善代表的整体工作水平、比赛质量和规则执行情况。
  9. 就 WCA 代表和社区所需的培训，向董事会提出建议。
  10. 鼓励 WCA 社区成员翻译和维护规则译本，并指导这些译本的发布流程。
html.en:
There will be an appointment of a new WCA Regulations Committee Leader, since Laura Ohrndorf recently stepped down as the Leader of the WCA Regulations Committee. We thank Laura for all her hard work leading this Committee for the past years!

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 10 hours per week on average to work for the Committee. The qualities expected of candidates are:

  • Strong leadership skills
  • Attention to detail
  • Expert knowledge of Regulations
  • Analytical thinking
  • Excellent communication skills

The application period is opened for candidates to submit their candidacy documents until October 23rd, 2018, 23:59 UTC privately to the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).

The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

  1. Brief personal introduction.
  2. Summary of activities done for the WCA.
  3. Ambitions as the WRC Leader of the WCA.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WRC are copied from WCA Motion 10.2017.2 in the appendix below.

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among sitting Senior Delegates and Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of WCA Motion 10.2017.0.

Thanks for your candidacies and support.

APPENDIX 3 - RIGHTS AND DUTIES OF WCA REGULATIONS COMMITTEE

The WCA Regulations Committee is an Advisory Committee of the WCA with the following rights and duties:

  1. Managing the maintenance of the Regulations of the WCA, containing all regulations that must be followed in and around WCA Competitions.
    1. The Regulations should contain all clear, concise, normative rules as a proper standard for WCA Competitions.
  2. Producing and publishing new versions of the Regulations on a periodic basis, based on feedback from WCA Staff and Registered Speedcubers, their own insights, and incidents that happened during WCA Competitions. Such rights must be exercised in accordance with WCA Motion : Amendments of Regulations.
  3. Delivering interim updates of the Regulations in case of urgent changes or clerical errors.
  4. Resolving issues with the Regulations, based on feedback from the Community and from reports of WCA Competitions.
  5. Decision making on incidents that happened during WCA Competitions, based on feedback from the Community, WCA Staff, Registered Speedcubers, or reports of WCA Competitions.
  6. Decision making on the interpretation of the Regulations, if any unforeseen, uncovered, or unresolved incident happens during WCA Competitions.
  7. Advising the WCA Community on the correct application of the Regulations.
  8. Producing and publishing regular reports to all WCA Delegates, that include notable information in order to improve the overall quality of WCA Delegates, WCA Competitions, and the application of the Regulations.
  9. Advising the WCA Board of Directors on the required education of WCA Delegates and the Community.
  10. Encouraging members of the WCA Community to create and maintain translations of the Regulations, and steering the process of publishing those translations.

title.zh: TNoodle 0.13.5 发布

html.zh:
TNoodle-WCA-0.13.5 现已可从 https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/ 下载。

与 TNoodle-WCA-0.13.4 相比，本次作出了以下修改：

  • 修复了 Skewb 打乱可能短于预期 11 步的问题。

根据 WCA 规则，官方 Skewb 打乱必须从至少需要 7 步才能还原的状态中（4b3c），生成随机状态（4b3）。

为避免从打乱纸上轻易辨认出解法较短的打乱，TNoodle 的设计确保生成的所有 Skewb 打乱序列至少有 11 步，即使该状态存在更短的解法。然而，0.13.5 之前版本的 TNoodle 存在线程安全问题，可能导致打乱序列被截断，具体表现为：

  • 如果截断后的打乱仍需要至少 7 步才能还原，该序列就会被采用，仍满足规则 4b3c；但
  • 截断操作破坏了打乱的随机分布，违反规则 4b3。

更多细节可在 GitHub 上的 TNoodle 项目中查看。

对历史打乱解法长度的分析表明，过去绝大多数比赛的状态分布并未受影响。然而，至少有一场大型比赛（CubingUSA Nationals 2018）的状态明显偏向最优解较短的情况，这也促成了问题的发现。感谢 Sébastien Auroux 向我们反映此事，也感谢 Tim Reynolds 在刚过去的周末与 Jeremy Fleischman 一起定位问题，并为 TNoodle 准备了修复。

我们不认为有人故意利用这一问题获取优势。不过，分析工作仍未完成；完成后，我们会在 WRC 意外事件日志中记录此事。

请记住，官方比赛必须使用当前有效版本的官方打乱程序。最新版本始终可从以下页面获取： https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/
html.en:
TNoodle-WCA-0.13.5 is now available from https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/ The following change has been made since TNoodle-WCA-0.13.4:

  • Fix a bug where Skewb scrambles could be shorter than the 11 moves they should be.

Per the WCA Regulations, an official scramble sequence for Skewb must produce a random state (4b3) from those that require at least 7 moves (4b3c) to solve.

In order to make it hard to distinguish scrambles with short solutions on a scramble sheet, TNoodle was designed to ensure that all generated Skewb scramble sequences are at least 11 moves (even if there is an optional solution with fewer moves). However, a thread safety bug in TNoodle before version 0.13.5 made it possible for scramble sequences to be truncated, such that:

  • a truncated scramble sequence would be used if it required at least 7 moves to solve (still satisfying Regulation 4b3c), but
  • the truncation did not preserve the random scramble distribution (violating Regulation 4b3).

More details are available at the TNoodle project on GitHub.

An analysis of solution lengths for historical scrambles suggests that this did not affect the distribution of states for the vast majority of past competitions. However, it did result in a significant bias of states towards shorter optimal solutions for at least one major competition (CubingUSA Nationals 2018), which led to the discovery of this bug. We would like to thank Sébastien Auroux for bringing it to our attention, and Tim Reynolds for working with Jeremy Fleischman to identify and prepare a fix for TNoodle over the past weekend.

We do not believe that this bug was purposely used by anyone to gain an advantage. However, we are still working to complete the analysis before posting an entry to the WRC incidents log.

Please remember that official competitions must use a current version of the official scramble program. This is always available from: https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/

title.zh: 关于红牛比赛的公告

html.zh:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

相信大多数人已经知道，红牛于 2018 年推出了自己的速拧系列赛，WCA 并未参与。

该系列赛今年已在波士顿举行总决赛，之后也会继续举办新的赛季。关于 2019 赛季，我们正在与红牛沟通，探讨双方合作的可能性。目前尚未作出任何决定，正式谈判也还没有开始，但我们希望先告知大家，双方已经建立联系。

2018 赛季开始时，这一赛事在速拧社区引起了争议，尤其是它使用了“世界锦标赛”的名称。为消除混淆，避免同一年由两个不同组织举办两场“世界锦标赛”，红牛已提前决定将赛事更名为“世界杯”。

谈判结束后，我们会向大家通报进展并公布结果。

WCA 董事会
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

As most of you know Red Bull has created their own series of speedcubing competitions in 2018 without the involvement of the WCA.

Their series has finished for this year with their finals in Boston, but they will surely continue for future seasons too. Regarding the 2019 season, we are in talks with them about a possible cooperation between the two parties. So far nothing has been decided, the negotiations have not yet started, but we wanted to inform you that we are in communication with Red Bull right now.

The start of their 2018 season was controversial among the speedcubing community, especially because they called their series “World Championship”. To fix this confusion, Red Bull already decided to change their name to “World Cup” in advance to avoid misunderstandings and to not have 2 World Championships in the same year, by two different organizations.

We will update everyone once the negotiations are finished and will announce the outcome.

WCA Board of Directors

title.zh: 新任高级代表任命公告（2018 年 10 月）

html.zh:
近期申请结束后，两位高级代表的人选已确定。亚洲日本地区方面，董事会收到了 Yohei Suzuki 的申请，并决定续任。西欧地区方面，董事会收到了 Laura Ohrndorf 和 Lorenzo Vigani Poli 的申请，经讨论后决定任命 Laura Ohrndorf。

南美洲与中美洲地区、非洲地区均未收到申请，因此在找到合适接任者之前，由 WCA 董事会代行这些职责。

北美洲地区正在实施新制度，以加强该地区高级代表的工作。制度文件及说明见此处。

这些任命将于 2018 年 10 月 1 日生效。所有申请材料可在此处查看。

感谢 Daniel Sheppard、Donovan Hale、Tim Reynolds 和 Rafael Werneck de Andrade Cinoto 此前担任高级代表期间的辛勤工作与付出。同时，感谢所有申请者愿意在现有工作之外，进一步帮助 WCA 和速拧社区。祝新任高级代表工作顺利！
html.en:
As a result of our recent application period, two new Senior Delegates have been appointed. For the Asia Japan region, the Board received the application of Yohei Suzuki and he has been re-appointed for the position. For the Europe West region, the Board received the applications of Laura Ohrndorf and Lorenzo Vigani Poli. After deliberation, they decided to appoint Laura Ohrndorf for the position.

No applications were received for the regions of South America & Middle America and Africa, so the WCA Board will assume these roles until suitable replacements are found.

In North America, a new system is being implemented to enhance the senior delegate role for the region. The documentation and explanation of this system is here.

The appointments will be effective on October 1, 2018. You may find all the applications here.

We would like to thank Daniel Sheppard, Donovan Hale, Tim Reynolds, and Rafael Werneck de Andrade Cinoto for the hard work and dedication that they gave in the Senior Delegate positions previously. Additionally, we want to thank all the applicants for their willingness to help the WCA and the Speedcubing community even more than they currently do now. Good luck to the new Senior Delegates in their roles!

title.zh: WCA 比赛公示团队负责人招募（2018 年 9 月）

html.zh:
WCA 比赛公示政策 2.0 版获通过后，WCA 比赛公示团队正式成立，目前需要一位负责人。**WCA 比赛公示团队（WCAT）**是 WCA 的咨询委员会，负责批准和公示 WCA 比赛。

申请向所有人开放，不必目前在 WCA 担任职务。候选人须能完成 24 个月的任期，并平均每周至少投入 8 小时处理团队工作。我们希望候选人具备以下条件：

  1. 出色的领导能力。
  2. 注重细节。
  3. 熟悉竞赛规则及政策。
  4. 出色的沟通能力。

由于这项工作有较强的时效要求，负责人须及时回复邮件，通常应在 24 小时内回复。WCAT 每周约需处理 40 项申请，相关邮件约为 150 至 200 封。

申请现已开放，请于 2018 年 9 月 24 日 23:59 UTC 前，将材料私下发送至 WCA 董事会（board@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包括：

  • 简短的个人介绍。
  • 为 WCA 所做工作的概述。
  • 担任 WCAT 负责人后的工作设想。

申请者还须提供一份可在申请截止后公开的申请材料副本。

WCAT 的权利与职责见 WCA 比赛公示政策。

申请截止后的下一周，WCA 董事会将按照 WCA 动议 10.2017.0第 4 节的规定投票选定人选，经高级代表及现任委员会／团队负责人投票确认后，公布新负责人。

提前感谢大家的申请与支持！
html.en:
The successful passing of the WCA Competition Announcement Policy Version 2.0 established the WCA Competition Announcement Team that is in need of a leader. The WCA Competition Announcement Team (WCAT) is an Advisory Committee of the WCA which is responsible for approving and announcing WCA Competitions.

The applications are open to everyone; it’s not a requirement to hold a current position in the WCA to be considered. Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 8 hours per week on average to work for the Team. The qualities expected of candidates are: 1. Strong leadership skills 2. Attention to detail 3. Good knowledge of Regulations and policies 4. Excellent communication skills

Due to the time-sensitive nature of this work, the Leader of this committee must be very responsive to email, mostly within 24 hours. The WCAT will need to process approximately 40 requests per week, which generates 150-200 emails.

The application period is opened for candidates to submit their candidacy documents until September 24th, 2018, 23:59 UTC privately to the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).

The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include: - Brief personal introduction. - Summary of activities done for the WCA. - Ambitions as the WCAT Leader.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WCAT can be found in the WCA Competition Announcement Policy.

The week after the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of WCA Motion 10.2017.0.

Thank you in advance for your candidacies and support!

title.zh: WCA 董事会成员变动（2018 年 9 月）
title.en: Changes in the Board of Directors - September 2018

html.zh:
我们很高兴地宣布，Chris Wright 成为 WCA 董事会的新成员！

依照动议 5.2018.1，WCA 各负责人及代表进行了不记名投票，通过了 Chris 的申请。欢迎 Chris 加入 WCA 董事会，祝他在新的岗位上工作顺利。

这一变动立即生效。

有兴趣了解的成员可在此处查看 Chris 的申请材料。
html.en:
We are happy to announce that the WCA Board of Directors has a new member: Chris Wright!

An anonymous election took place among the WCA leaders and delegates in accordance with Motion 5.2018.1 who approved Chris’s application. We are glad to bring Chris onto the WCA Board and we wish him luck in his new position.

These changes have become effective immediately.

Chris’s application can be viewed to all interested in seeing it here.

title.zh: 2019 WCA 世锦赛将在澳大利亚墨尔本举行
title.en: WCA World Championship 2019 in Melbourne, Australia

html.zh:
我们现公布，澳大利亚墨尔本成功获得 2019 WCA 世锦赛的主办权！

我们认为，在四个申办方案中，墨尔本的方案最为出色，相信他们的团队将在明年成功举办本届世锦赛。

感谢白俄罗斯布列斯特，以及中国北京、广州的申办团队提交方案。全部申请材料可在这里查看。
html.en:
We are informing you that the winning candidate to host the WCA World Championship 2019 is Melbourne, Australia!

We believe that their plan was the strongest among the four candidates and that their team will lead to a successful championship next year.

Thank you to the applicants from Brest, Belarus and Beijing/Guangzhou, China for their submissions. You can view all of the application documents here.

title.zh: WCA 道德委员会招募成员（2018 年 8 月）

html.zh:
WCA 道德委员会（WEC）正在招募合适的成员，共同完成委员会的工作！

WEC 负责什么？

WEC 负责确保 WCA 工作人员及外部工作人员遵守道德准则；若有关人员的行为不符合准则，则开展独立调查。任何注册速拧选手均可请求调查，WEC 会为他们保密处理相关事项。此外，若相关方不服 WCA 纪律委员会的决定，WEC 也作为申诉机构处理。

我们希望申请人具备：

  • 背景清白。
  • 值得信任。
  • 能独立判断。
  • 有责任心。

申请从即日起开放，请于 2018 年 9 月 4 日 23:59 UTC 前将材料发送给 Walker Welch（walkerewelch@gmail.com）。所有人均可申请，无需目前在 WCA 任职。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，包含：

  • 简短的个人介绍。
  • 为 WCA 所做工作的概述。
  • 作为 WCA 道德委员会成员的工作设想。

提交后，我们会确认材料是否完整，或说明有哪些缺漏。

关于 WEC 和本岗位的更多信息见此文档。WEC 的权利与职责见 WCA 议案 10.2017.8。

申请截止后，WEC 负责人将作出选择，并在候选人接受岗位后公布新成员。

感谢你愿意帮助 WCA 发展！
html.en:
The WCA Ethics Committee (WEC) is seeking qualified members to help them with their mission!

What does the WEC do? The WEC's role is to ensure that all the procedures followed by the WCA Staff and External Staff abide by its Code of Ethics, and to perform independent investigations if the conduct of any of these members is not compliant with said Code of Ethics. Such investigations can be requested by any Registered Speedcubers, for whom the WEC is a confidant. This committee also functions as the board of appeal if anyone involved disagrees with a decision made by the WCA Disciplinary Committee.

The qualities expected of candidates are: - Clear background - Trustworthiness - Independence - Accountability

The application period is open for candidates to submit their candidacy document from now until September 4th, 2018, 23:59 UTC to Walker Welch (walkerewelch@gmail.com). The applications are open to everyone; it’s not a requirement to hold a current position in the WCA to be considered.

The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and should include the following: - Brief personal introduction - Summary of activities done for the WCA - Ambitions as a member of the WCA Ethics Committee.

Upon submission it will be confirmed if the document is in good order or if there are deficiencies.

More information on the WEC and the position can be found in this document. The rights and duties of the WEC can be seen in WCA Motion 10.2017.8.

After the application period, the WEC Leader will make a selection and the new members will be announced once candidates have accepted the positions.

Thank you for your interest in growing the WCA!

title.zh: WCA 市场推广团队成员招募（2018 年 8 月）
title.en: Call for Applicants - WMT Team Members (August 2018)

html.zh:
WCA 市场推广团队（WMT）正在招募成员，一起开展团队的工作。

申请面向所有人开放，无须目前已在 WCA 任职。由于 WMT 负责人遴选未能选出人选，此次成员遴选将由 WCA 董事会依照《WCA 章程》第 5.3 节进行。

WMT 的工作是什么？

WMT 是 WCA 的咨询性委员会，负责建设和管理 WCA 品牌、寻求赞助、支持 WCA 比赛器材的分发，以及推广 WCA 周边商品。

我们希望申请人具备以下条件：

  • 市场推广背景。
  • 可靠、值得信任。
  • 了解社交媒体。
  • 英语流利。
  • 良好的沟通能力。

WMT 的权利和职责见 WCA 决议 10.2018.1。

申请期为即日起至 2018 年 9 月 9 日 23:59 UTC。请将材料私下发送给 WCA 董事会（board@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，包含：

  • 简短的自我介绍。
  • 为 WCA 所做工作的总结。
  • 担任 WCA 市场推广团队成员的工作设想。

收到材料后，我们会确认材料是否齐全，或说明需要补充之处。

申请期结束后，WCA 董事会将选定人选，并在申请人接受任命后公布新成员。

感谢大家的申请与支持！
html.en:
The WCA Marketing Team (WMT) is seeking members in order to accomplish its mission.

The applications are open to everyone; it’s not a requirement to hold a current position in the WCA to be considered. As the selection process of a Leader for the WMT has not been successful, the selection process will be conducted by the WCA Board of Directors as allowed per Section 5.3 of the WCA Bylaws.

What does the WMT do? The WMT is an Advisory Committee of the WCA which is responsible for developing and managing the WCA Brand, seeking sponsorships, supporting the distribution of WCA Competition Gear, and marketing WCA Merchandise.

The qualities expected of candidates are: - Marketing background - Trustworthiness - Social media knowledge - Fluent English - Communication skills

The rights and duties of the WMT can be seen in WCA Motion 10.2018.1.

The application period is open for candidates to submit their candidacy document from now until September 9th, 2018, 23:59 UTC privately to the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).

Candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include: - A brief personal introduction - Summary of activities done for the WCA - Ambitions as a member of the WCA Marketing Team

Upon reception it will be confirmed if documents are in good order or if there are deficiencies.

After the application period, the WCA Board will make their selections and the new members will be announced once candidates have accepted the positions.

Thank you for your candidacies and support!

title.zh: Max Park 夺得台湾新北市 2018 年 WCA 亚洲锦标赛冠军
title.en: Max Park wins WCA Asian Championship 2018, in New Taipei City, Taiwan

html.zh:
Max Park 以 6.58 秒的平均成绩夺得 2018 年 WCA 亚洲锦标赛冠军。Seung Hyuk Nahm（남승혁） 以 6.65 秒获得亚军，Bill Wang 以 6.98 秒获得季军。

世界纪录：Max Park，五阶平均 42.36 秒、六阶单次 1:13.82、六阶平均 1:17.10。

亚洲纪录：Makoto Takaoka（高冈诚），Square-1 平均 7.90 秒；Seung Hyuk Nahm（남승혁），五阶单次 41.12 秒、五阶平均 45.77 秒；Wong Kin Lok（黄健乐），六阶平均 1:37.92；Yi-Fan Wu（吴亦凡），六阶单次 1:28.72。

大洋洲纪录：Feliks Zemdegs，七阶单次 1:54.54、七阶平均 2:02.31；Jack Cai，三阶盲拧单次 19.20 秒；Tomoya Firman，三阶多盲单次 25/27，用时 54:50。
html.en:
Max Park won the WCA Asian Championship 2018 with an average of 6.58 seconds. Seung Hyuk Nahm (남승혁) finished second (6.65) and Bill Wang finished third (6.98).

World records: Max Park‎ 5x5x5 Cube 42.36 (average), 6x6x6 Cube 1:13.82 (single), 6x6x6 Cube 1:17.10 (average).
Asian records: Makoto Takaoka (高岡誠)‎ Square-1 7.90 (average), Seung Hyuk Nahm (남승혁)‎ 5x5x5 Cube 41.12 (single), 5x5x5 Cube 45.77 (average), Wong Kin Lok (黃健樂)‎ 6x6x6 Cube 1:37.92 (average), Yi-Fan Wu (吳亦凡)‎ 6x6x6 Cube 1:28.72 (single).
Oceanian records: Feliks Zemdegs‎ 7x7x7 Cube 1:54.54 (single), 7x7x7 Cube 2:02.31 (average), Jack Cai‎ 3x3x3 Blindfolded 19.20 (single), Tomoya Firman‎ 3x3x3 Multi-Blind 25/27 54:50 (single).

title.zh: WCA 市场推广团队负责人招募结果
title.en: Result of the WMT Leader Application Period

html.zh:
很遗憾，本次未能任命 WCA 市场推广团队（WMT）负责人。

WCA 董事会、各负责人及高级代表未能就合适人选达成一致，因此该职位暂时空缺。

本次只有一位申请人：Justin Parera。

Justin 的申请材料可在此处查看。

由于 WMT 暂无负责人，WCA 董事会将在新负责人获任命前，尽力承担该岗位的职责。之后会重新启动遴选，具体时间尚未确定。
html.en:
We regret to announce that we could not appoint a Team Leader for the WCA Marketing Team (WMT).

The WCA Board, Leaders, and Senior Delegates could not agree on a suitable applicant for the position so it will not be filled for now.

There was only one applicant for the position: Justin Parera

Justin’s candidacy document can be found here for those interested in viewing it.

Since the WMT has no Leader, the WCA Board will attempt to assume the responsibilities of the WMT Leader until a leader is appointed. We will start a new selection process at an undetermined time in the future.

title.zh: WCA 道德委员会新负责人

html.zh:
我们很高兴地宣布，Walker Welch 将出任 WCA 道德委员会（WEC）的新任负责人。Walker 此前已是 WEC 成员。

WCA 董事会依照《议案 10.2017.0：委员会与团队》第 4 节选出 Walker，并经现任委员会、团队负责人及高级代表投票确认。

祝 Walker 在新的岗位上一切顺利！

新负责人将立即就任。Walker Welch 是五位申请人之一，所有申请材料均可在这里查看。

其他申请人名单：

  • Joseph Blas
  • Abhijeet Ghodgaonkar
  • Callum Goodyear
  • Chris Krueger
html.en:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Committee Leader. Walker Welch will become the new Leader of the WCA Ethics Committee (WEC). Walker was already working as a member of the WEC.

Walker was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a voting among the current Committee/Team Leaders and Senior Delegates, following Section 4 of our Motion 10.2017.0 about WCA Committees and Teams.

We wish Walker the best of luck in fulfilling his new duties!

The new Leader will be promoted immediately. Walker Welch was one among five applicants for the position and all candidacy documents can be found here for anyone interested in viewing them.

List of the other candidates who applied: - Joseph Blas - Abhijeet Ghodgaonkar - Callum Goodyear - Chris Krueger

title.zh: Mats Valk 在西班牙马德里夺得 2018 年 WCA 欧洲锦标赛冠军
title.en: Mats Valk wins WCA European Championship 2018, in Madrid, Spain

html.zh:
Mats Valk 以 7.24 秒的平均成绩赢得 2018 年 WCA 欧洲锦标赛冠军。Sebastian Weyer 以 7.36 秒获得亚军，Philipp Weyer 以 7.37 秒获得季军。

世界纪录：Daniel Rose-Levine，三阶脚拧平均 22.22 秒；Juan Pablo Huanqui，五魔方单次 29.49 秒。

欧洲纪录：Amos Nordman，五魔方平均 36.09 秒；Ciarán Beahan，六阶平均 1:32.71；Ádám Barta，三盲平均 24.06 秒。

南美洲纪录：Juan Pablo Huanqui，五魔方平均 34.25 秒、33.55 秒；Pedro Alejandro Condo Tellez，四阶平均 28.81 秒、28.69 秒，五阶单次 44.81 秒、42.40 秒，六阶单次 1:32.36、平均 1:40.81。
html.en:
Mats Valk won the WCA European Championship 2018 with an average of 7.24 seconds. Sebastian Weyer finished second (7.36) and Philipp Weyer finished third (7.37).

World records: Daniel Rose-Levine‎ 3x3x3 With Feet 22.22 (average), Juan Pablo Huanqui‎ Megaminx 29.49 (single).
European records: Amos Nordman‎ Megaminx 36.09 (average), Ciarán Beahan‎ 6x6x6 Cube 1:32.71 (average), Ádám Barta‎ 3x3x3 Blindfolded 24.06 (average).
South American records: Juan Pablo Huanqui‎ Megaminx 34.25 (average), Megaminx 33.55 (average), Pedro Alejandro Condo Tellez‎ 4x4x4 Cube 28.81 (average), 4x4x4 Cube 28.69 (average), 5x5x5 Cube 44.81 (single), 5x5x5 Cube 42.40 (single), 6x6x6 Cube 1:32.36 (single), 6x6x6 Cube 1:40.81 (average).

title.zh: 2019 年 WCA 世锦赛申办城市

html.zh:
2019 年 WCA 世锦赛申办期已结束。感谢所有提交申请材料的团队！以下城市提出了申请：

  • 中国北京或广州
  • 白俄罗斯布列斯特
  • 澳大利亚墨尔本

遴选小组由三位董事组成：Olivér Perge（流程负责人）、Alberto Pérez de Rada Fiol 和 Bob Burton。

遴选流程包括分别评估申请材料、与申请方进行面谈，最后由小组投票。我们希望就最终获选者达成共识，确信比赛能够顺利举办，并为所有参与者带来良好体验。

遴选结束后，我们将在 8 月底前另行发布公告。
html.en:
The application period for WCA World Championship 2019 has ended. Thank you to everyone who submitted their application documents! Here are the list of the cities that applied:

Beijing or Guangzhou, China Brest, Belarus Melbourne, Australia

The selection team will be the Board members: Olivér Perge (process leader), Alberto Pérez de Rada Fiol, and Bob Burton.

The selection process will consist of individual evaluations of the applications, interviews with the applicants, and finally a vote by the selection team. The goal is to come to an agreement about the winning applicant, so that we can proceed with confidence that the competition will be successful and a positive experience for all who attend.

Once the selection is finalized, another announcement will be made before the end of August.

title.zh: 招募 WCA 市场团队新负责人（2018 年 7 月）

html.zh:
近期议案修订获通过后，WCA 市场团队正式成立，目前需要一位负责人。**WCA 市场团队（WMT）**是 WCA 的咨询委员会之一，负责发展和管理 WCA 品牌、争取赞助、协助分发 WCA 比赛器材，以及推广 WCA 周边商品。

候选人应完成整个任期（24 个月），平均每周至少投入 6 小时处理团队工作。我们希望候选人具备以下条件：

  1. 市场营销背景。
  2. 了解社交媒体。
  3. 英语流利。
  4. 良好的沟通能力。

申请截止时间为 2018 年 7 月 31 日 23:59 UTC。请将申请材料私下发送至 WCA 董事会（board@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：

  • 简短的个人介绍。
  • 曾为 WCA 开展的工作概述。
  • 担任 WMT 负责人后的工作设想。

此外，请提交一份可在申请期结束后公开的申请材料副本。

WMT 的权利与职责依据 WCA 议案 10.2018.1。

申请期结束后的下一周，WCA 董事会将投票选出人选，再由高级代表及现任委员会、团队负责人投票确认，随后公布新负责人。流程详见 WCA 议案 10.2017.0第 4 节。

提前感谢大家的申请与支持！
html.en:
The successful passing of the recent amendments to the Motions has established the WCA Marketing Team that is in need of a leader. The WCA Marketing Team (WMT) is an Advisory Committee of the WCA which is responsible for developing and managing the WCA Brand, seeking sponsorships, supporting the distribution of WCA Competition Gear, and marketing WCA Merchandise.

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 6 hours per week on average to work for the Team. The qualities expected of candidates are: 1. Marketing background 2. Social media knowledge 3. Fluent English 4. Communication skills

The application period is open for candidates to submit their candidacy documents until July 31st, 2018, 23:59 UTC privately to the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).

The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include: - Brief personal introduction. - Summary of activities done for the WCA. - Ambitions as the WMT Leader.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WMT are copied from WCA Motion 10.2018.1.

The week after the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of WCA Motion 10.2017.0.

Thank you in advance for your candidacies and support!

title.zh: 停止使用 TNoodle 0.13.3

html.zh:
上周发布 TNoodle-WCA-0.13.4 时，我们曾宣布，TNoodle-WCA-0.13.3 将在短期内继续作为正式允许使用的版本。现在已过去一周，TNoodle-WCA-0.13.3 正式停用，TNoodle-WCA-0.13.4 成为唯一的官方打乱程序版本。

详情请参阅上周的 TNoodle-WCA-0.13.4 公告。

请记住，正式比赛必须使用现行版本的官方打乱程序。下载地址始终为： https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/
html.en:
When TNoodle-WCA-0.13.4 was released last week, we announced that TNoodle-WCA-0.13.3 would briefly remain an officially permitted version. Since a week has passed, TNoodle-WCA-0.13.3 is now officially retired, leaving TNoodle-WCA-0.13.4 as the only official scramble program.

Please see last week's TNoodle-WCA-0.13.4 announcement for details.

Please remember that official competitions must use a current version of the official scramble program. This is always available from: https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/

title.zh: TNoodle 0.13.4 发布

html.zh:
现在可从 https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/ 下载 TNoodle-WCA-0.13.4。

相较 TNoodle-WCA-0.13.3，本次更新包括：

  • 多盲轮次不再默认设置魔方数量。为比赛生成打乱时，需要根据预计参赛选手设置足够大的数量。
  • TNoodle 不再在打乱 JSON 数据中为最少步生成备用打乱。
  • 更新了最少步答题纸的韩语译文。
  • 旧版打乱界面的项目名称现与竞赛规则一致。
  • “scramble group”现改称“scramble set”，以免与选手分组混淆。
  • 修复了新版界面中失效的网站图标链接。

即将举行的比赛应尽可能使用 TNoodle-WCA-0.13.4 重新生成打乱。

不过，由于本次更新没有直接影响选手的改动，TNoodle-WCA-0.13.3 将在短期内继续作为官方允许使用的版本。未来一周比赛若已用 TNoodle-WCA-0.13.3 生成打乱，仍可使用。

请记住，官方比赛必须使用官方打乱程序的当前有效版本，下载地址始终为： https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/
html.en:
TNoodle-WCA-0.13.4 is now available from https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/ The following changes have been made since TNoodle-WCA-0.13.3:

  • Multiple Blindfolded rounds are no longer generated with a default number of puzzles. The person generating scrambles for a competition will have to pick a sufficiently high number based on expected competitors.
  • TNoodle no longer generates extra scrambles for Fewest Moves in the JSON data for the scrambles.
  • The Fewest Moves sheet translation for Korean has been updated.
  • Event names on the legacy scramble UI now match the Regulations.
  • A "scramble group" is now called a "scramble set", to avoid confusion with competitor groups.
  • A broken favicon link in the new UI has been fixed.

Upcoming competitions should use TNoodle-WCA-0.13.4 to generate new scrambles, when possible. However, since there are no changes that directly affect competitors since the previous version, TNoodle-WCA-0.13.3 will briefly remain an officially permitted version. (Competition scrambles for the coming week that have already been generated using TNoodle-WCA-0.13.3 can still be used.)

Please remember that official competitions must use a current version of the official scramble program. This is always available from: https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/

title.zh: WCA 道德委员会新负责人招募（2018 年 7 月）

html.zh:
Hippolyte Moreau 近日卸任 WCA 道德委员会（WEC）负责人，WCA 将任命新的负责人。感谢 Hippolyte 在过去几个月为建立 WEC 所做的工作。

申请人应能够完成 24 个月的任期，平均每周至少投入 6 小时处理委员会工作，并具备以下条件：

  1. 背景清白
  2. 诚实可靠
  3. 能够独立判断
  4. 勇于承担责任

请在 2018 年 7 月 16 日 23:59 UTC 前，将申请材料私下发送至 WCA 董事会（board@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：

  • 简短的个人介绍
  • 为 WCA 所做工作的概述
  • 担任 WEC 负责人的工作设想

申请人还须提交一份可在申请截止后公开的申请材料副本。

WEC 的权利与职责见 WCA 动议 10.2017.8。

申请截止后的下一周，WCA 董事会将依照 WCA 动议 10.2017.0 第 4 节投票选出新负责人，经高级代表及现任委员会、团队负责人投票确认后公布。

提前感谢各位申请和支持！
html.en:
There will be an appointment of a new WCA Ethics Committee Leader, as Hippolyte Moreau recently stepped down as the Leader of the WCA Ethics Committee. We thank Hippolyte for his work getting the WEC established in the past months.

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 6 hours per week on average to work for the Committee. The qualities expected of candidates are: 1. Clear background 2. Trustworthiness 3. Independence 4. Accountability

The application period is opened for candidates to submit their candidacy documents until July 16th, 2018, 23:59 UTC privately to the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).

The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include: - Brief personal introduction. - Summary of activities done for the WCA. - Ambitions as the WEC Leader of the WCA.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WEC can be found in WCA Motion 10.2017.8.

The week after the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of WCA Motion 10.2017.0.

Thank you in advance for your candidacies and support!

title.zh: WCA 董事会成员变动

html.zh:
现宣布，自 2018 年 6 月 30 日起，WCA 董事会减至三名成员。Luis J. Iáñez 的任期已正式结束，Pedro Santos Guimarães 和 Ron van Bruchem 也已辞去董事职务。

衷心感谢 Luis、Pedro 和 Ron 的付出，以及他们为 WCA 发展至今所做的出色工作。尤其要感谢 Ron：他参与创立了世界魔方协会，并用近 15 年时间向世界各地传播 WCA 的使命与精神。祝三位今后的各项工作一切顺利！
html.en:
We hereby announce that as of June 30, 2018, the WCA Board of Directors is reduced to three members. Luis J. Iáñez’s term has officially ended, and Pedro Santos Guimarães and Ron van Bruchem stepped down from their positions as Board members.

We deeply thank Luis, Pedro, and Ron for their efforts and for the great work they have done for the WCA to convert it to what it is now. A special mention goes to Ron, who co-founded the World Cube Association, and has dedicated almost 15 years of his life to spread the WCA Mission and Spirit around the world. We wish the three of them the best of luck on all of their future projects!

title.zh: WCA 财务委员会新负责人

html.zh:
我们很高兴地宣布，Chris Wright 将接替 Chris Hardwick，出任 WCA 财务委员会（WFC）负责人，并因此担任 WCA 财务主管。Chris Wright 此前已是 WFC 成员，同时将卸任 WCA 道德委员会成员。

WCA 董事会依照《议案 10.2017.0：委员会与团队》第 4 节选出 Chris Wright，并经现任委员会、团队负责人及高级代表投票确认。

感谢 Chris Hardwick 为 WCA 所做的出色工作，祝 Chris Wright 在新的岗位上一切顺利。

新负责人将立即就任。Chris Wright 是唯一申请人，如有兴趣，其申请材料可在这里查看。
html.en:
We are happy to announce that we have a new Committee Leader. Chris Wright will replace Chris Hardwick as the Leader of the WCA Financial Committee (WFC), and thus as the WCA Treasurer. Chris Wright was already working as a member of the WFC, and will step down as a member of the WCA Ethics Committee.

Chris Wright was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a voting among the current Committee/Team Leaders and Senior Delegates, following Section 4 of our Motion 10.2017.0 about WCA Committees and Teams.

We thank Chris Hardwick for the great work he has done for the WCA, and wish Chris Wright the best of luck in fulfilling his new duties.

The new Leader will be promoted immediately. Chris Wright was the only applicant, and his candidacy document can be found here if you are interested in viewing it.

title.zh: WCA 沟通团队平面设计师招募（2018 年 5 月）
title.en: Call for Applicants - WCT Graphic Designer (May 2018)

html.zh:
WCT 正在招募一名新成员，协助社交媒体帖文及其他项目的平面设计！

所有 WCA 成员均可申请，不必目前在 WCA 担任职务。这一职位面向有平面设计经验的人，加入团队后也将主要从事这类工作。

WCT 的工作是什么？

  • 回复通过电子邮件及 WCA 网站联系页面收到的日常咨询。
  • 管理 WCA 官方社交媒体，定期发布有吸引力的内容。
  • 与 WCA 其他负责人合作，改进 WCA 网站及与社区的沟通。
  • 章程所列的 WCT 权利与职责可在此处查看。

工作安排概况

  • 社交媒体帖文至少提前一周规划，并在成员有空时发布。
  • 与 WCT 其他项目有关的内部邮件须在 48 小时内回复；这些项目还可能带来耗时不同的其他工作。
  • 每周需投入 4 至 10 小时。
  • 须熟悉 Adobe Illustrator、GIMP 或同类软件。

我们希望你具备的能力

  • 创意：我们一直需要新的社交媒体系列创意，或拓展到其他平台的独特方法。你需要主动思考，并在有想法时提出建议。你也将运用平面设计经验，帮助我们设计有视觉吸引力的帖文。
  • 社交媒体知识：你应熟悉多种社交媒体平台及其基本功能。即使你个人没有用过，也需要代表 WCA 在这些平台发帖，并了解各平台适合什么类型的内容。
  • 流利的英语：我们在大多数社交媒体平台上使用英语，也用英语回复大部分邮件。同时欢迎既熟练掌握英语、又精通其他语言的申请者。
  • 沟通能力：你将负责设计得体、能传达 WCA 使命的社交媒体帖文。
  • 耐心：在邮件及社交媒体互动中，你应保持友善。

申请材料请包括：

  • 简短的个人介绍。
  • 参与 WCA 的经历。
  • 申请加入 WCT 的原因。
  • 2 至 3 件你创作的设计，展示个人风格。
  • 一份设计示例，主题为 WCA 宣布某个国家首次举办比赛。

申请自即日起开放，请于 2018 年 6 月 3 日 23:59 UTC 前，将 PDF 格式的材料发送至 lmclement55@gmail.com。

提交申请后，候选人可能还须参加团队负责人的面试。申请截止后的下一周，团队将选定人选，待候选人接受职务后公布新成员。

感谢大家的申请与支持！
html.en:
The WCT is seeking a new member to help with graphics design for social media posts and other projects!

The application is open to all WCA members. You do not have to hold a current position to be considered. This position is directed to those with graphic design experience and duties once on the team will mainly focus on that type of work.

What does the WCT do?

  • Answers daily inquires to the WCA through emails and the contact page on the WCA website.
  • Manages official WCA social media platforms through frequent & engaging posts
  • Works with other WCA leaders to improve the WCA website and communications to the community
  • The rights and duties of WCT from our By-laws can be found here.

Workflow Outline

  • Social media posts are planned at least 1 week in advance and are posted when members are available.
  • Internal emails regarding other WCT projects are answered within 48 hours and other work may come from those projects that take various amounts of time.
  • Time commitment per week is between 4-10 hours.
  • Must be familiar with Adobe Illustrator, GIMP, or equivalent programs

Characteristics we are looking for

  • Creativity: We always need ideas of new social media series or unique ways to expand to other platforms. You will be required to think about this and suggest ideas when you can. With your graphic design experience, you will help us with designing visually compelling posts.
  • Social media knowledge: You should be familiar with many social media platforms and their basic functions. While you may not have used them personally, you will have to post to them as the WCA and should know what type of content goes on each.
  • Fluent English: Our posts on most social media platforms are in English and we answer most emails in English. We do welcome those that are fluent in other languages alongside English.
  • Communication skills: You will be responsible for designing social media posts that are appropriate and convey the mission of the WCA.
  • Patience: You should keep friendly communications within our email and social media interactions.

To apply, please include:

  • A brief personal introduction
  • Your involvement with the WCA
  • Your motivation for applying to the WCT
  • 2-3 designs that you have created to highlight your design style
  • An example design for a WCA posting about the first competition in a new country

Please send the application in PDF format to lmclement55@gmail.com from now until June 3, 2018, 23:59 UTC to be considered.

There may be an additional interview requested of candidates with the leader following application submission. The week after the application period, the team will make a selection and the new member(s) will be announced once candidates have accepted the positions.

Thank you for your candidacies and support!

title.zh: 2019 年 WCA 世锦赛申办通知

html.zh:
WCA 董事会现接受 2019 年 WCA 世锦赛的申办申请。

请与你所在国家的代表讨论，确认是否有意愿、有能力申办。请注意，举办这一规模的比赛，在赛前和比赛期间都需要投入大量时间与精力。

有意申办者，请于 2018 年 7 月 15 日 23:59 UTC 前，私下将申请材料发送至 albertopdrf.wca@gmail.com。**材料须以 PDF 格式提交两个版本：**一份包含所有申办细节的完整版，以及一份删去敏感内容（如有）、可供公开的版本。

申请材料至少应包含以下信息：

希望何时举办 2019 年世锦赛？

1a. 可选日期。 1b. 比赛天数。 1c. 与世界各地学校假期的重合情况。

希望在本国哪个地方举办 2019 年世锦赛？

2a. 城市对外国游客的吸引力，以及可供游览的景点。 2b. 国际、国内及本地交通的便利程度。 2c. 不同价位的酒店或公寓供应情况。 2d. 场馆、面积及布置，包括舞台、观众席、练习桌和附属房间。 2e. 可用技术设施，包括网络、视频直播、灯光和音响。 2f. 可容纳的选手与观众人数。

主办团队和工作人员如何组成？

3a. 核心团队成员。 3b. 核心团队的经验。 3c. 其他参与方。 3d. 本地志愿者的人数和能力；建议约 20% 的选手担任工作人员。 3e. 需要外国代表提供哪些支持。

比赛总预算是多少？

4a. 支出：场租、场馆服务、舞台、设备、装饰、网站、胸牌、挂绳、礼包和奖品等。 4b. 收入：报名费、赞助和地方政府支持等。

下面这份示例表格列出了大型比赛需要安排和编入预算的部分事项，但并非完整清单：https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1w6uxOHrr40of1R4-NjU1vy7fVJXRHiRZBn53Hc-IOk8

申请期结束后，WCA 董事会将与申办方面谈，征询其他 WCA 工作人员的意见，并通过投票决定 2019 WCA 世锦赛的举办地点。如有董事参与某个申办团队，该董事在选拔流程中的职责将由其他人代替，例如高级代表或委员会、团队负责人。

我们希望这场比赛能够体现 WCA 对大型赛事的理念，进一步提高协会的专业水平，为选手提供尽可能好的参赛体验，也为全世界呈现精彩的比赛。
html.en:
The WCA Board of Directors are accepting applications for WCA World Championship 2019.

Please discuss with the Delegates in your country whether this is something you are willing and able to pursue. Bear in mind that organizing a competition of this size takes a significant amount of time and effort before and during the competition.

If you are interested, send your application documents privately to albertopdrf.wca@gmail.com before 23:59 UTC of July 15th, 2018. Documents must be sent in PDF format in two versions: one full version with all the details for the application, and another version with sensitive details - if any - removed to make public.

Please include in your application documents at least the following information:

When would you like to hold WC 2019? 1a. Possible dates 1b. Number of days of the competition. 1c. Overlap with international holiday periods of schools.

Where would you like to hold WC 2019 in your country? 2a. City should be interesting to visit for foreigners with opportunities for sightseeing. 2b. Ease of international, national, and local travel. 2c. Availability of hotels/apartments with different price categories. 2d. Venue, venue size, and venue setup (stage, audience, tables to practice, side rooms). 2e. Technology available like internet, video streaming, lighting, sound equipment. 2f. Number of competitors and spectators that can be hosted.

What would the organization team and staff look like? 3a. Core team members. 3b. Experience of the core team. 3c. Involvement of other parties. 3d. Quantity and quality of local volunteers (guideline is 20% of competitors should staff). 3e. Required support by foreign Delegates.

What would be the overall budget for the competition? 4a. Cost (venue, venue services, stage, equipment, decorations, website, badges/lanyards/giftpacks, prizes). 4b. Income (registration fees, sponsoring, local government).

Here is an example document with a non-exhaustive list of topics that need to be arranged and budgeted for a large competition: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1w6uxOHrr40of1R4-NjU1vy7fVJXRHiRZBn53Hc-IOk8

Once the application period is over, the WCA Board of Directors will interview applicants, consult other WCA Staff members, and vote in order to decide where the WCA World Championship 2019 will take place. If any Director will be involved in a team that sends in an application, he will be replaced in the selection process by another person (for example a Senior Delegate or a Committee/Team Leader).

We are looking for a competition that can reinforce our concept of large WCA competitions, boost the professionalization of our organization, and is able to give the competitors the best possible experience and the world the best possible show.

title.zh: WCA 财务委员会新负责人招募（2018 年 5 月）
title.en: Appointment of a New WCA Financial Committee Leader (May 2018)

html.zh:
WCA 将任命一位新的委员会负责人。Chris Hardwick 即将卸任 WCA 财务委员会负责人，同时卸任 WCA 财务主管。

Chris 在担任 WFC 负责人及 WCA 财务主管期间表现出色。感谢他一直以来的辛勤工作与投入，也祝愿他今后一切顺利。

候选人须能完成 24 个月的任期，并平均每周至少投入 6 小时处理委员会工作。 我们希望候选人具备以下条件：

  • 对 WCA 内部组织架构及工作流程有基本了解。
  • 有财务工作经验，尤其是记账和报税经验。
  • 熟练使用英语。
  • 每天能安排适当时间履行职责。
  • 具备团队管理能力。

申请现已开放，请于 2018 年 5 月 8 日 23:59 UTC 前，将材料私下发送至 WCA 董事会（board@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包括：

  • 简短的个人介绍。
  • 为 WCA 所做工作的概述。
  • 担任 WFC 负责人及 WCA 财务主管后的工作设想。

WFC 的权利与职责摘自 WCA 动议 10.2017.3，列于文末附录。

申请截止后的下一周，WCA 董事会将按照 WCA 动议 10.2017.0第 4 节的规定投票选定人选，经高级代表及现任委员会／团队负责人投票确认后，公布新负责人。

感谢大家的申请与支持。

附录——WCA 财务委员会的权利与职责

  1. WCA 财务委员会是 WCA 的咨询委员会，拥有以下权利与职责：
    1. 为 WCA 制定年度预算提案。
    2. 按照获批准的年度预算提案，管理 WCA 的财务与账目。
    3. 经 WCA 董事会授权后，支付 WCA 应付的账单及税款。
    4. 每季度向 WCA 董事会汇报财务情况，并提供建议。
    5. 按照所有适用的法律要求，定期向外部机构报告 WCA 的财务情况。
    6. 按照所有适用的法律要求，任命并协助财务审计人员。
  2. WCA 财务委员会负责人兼任 WCA 财务主管。
html.en:
There will be an appointment of a new WCA Committee Leader. Chris Hardwick is stepping down as the Leader of the WCA Financial Committee, and thus as the WCA Treasurer.

Chris has done a great work as the Leader of the WFC and as the Treasurer of the WCA, and we thank him for all his hard work and dedication all this time, as well as wish him the best in all his future endeavors.

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 6 hours per week on average to work for the Committee. The qualities expected of candidates are:

  • Basic knowledge of the structure and workflow inside the WCA.
  • Experience on financial matters, especially bookkeeping and tax filing.
  • Proficiency in English.
  • A reasonable daily availability to deploy the duties.
  • Team management capabilities.

The application period is opened for candidates to submit their candidacy documents until May 8th, 2018, 23:59 UTC privately to the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org)

The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

  • Brief personal introduction.
  • Summary of activities done for the WCA.
  • Ambitions as the WFC Leader and the Treasurer of the WCA.

The rights and duties of the WFC are copied from WCA Motion 10.2017.3 in an appendix below.

The week after the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of WCA Motion 10.2017.0.

Thank you for your candidacies and support.

APPENDIX - RIGHTS AND DUTIES OF WCA FINANCIAL COMMITTEE

  1. The WCA Financial Committee is an Advisory Committee of the WCA with the following rights and duties: 1. Creating an annual budget proposal for the WCA. 2. Managing the finances and accounts of the WCA in accordance with the approved annual budget proposal. 3. Paying invoices and taxes that are directed to the WCA, after procuration by the WCA Board of Directors. 4. Reporting and advising on a quarterly basis to the WCA Board of Directors on the finances of the WCA. 5. Reporting on a periodic basis to external organizations on the finances of the WCA, based on all applicable legal requirements. 6. Appointing and supporting financial auditors based on all applicable legal requirements.
  2. The Leader of the WCA Financial Committee is the Treasurer of the WCA.

title.zh: 南美锦标赛举办信息

html.zh:
我们很高兴地宣布，南美锦标赛将于 12 月 15–16 日在巴西圣保罗州波阿举行！

我们收到了波阿的申办方案，以及一份在南美多个城市共同举办锦标赛的方案。两份方案都各有特色，详细介绍了办赛安排，也都经过了充分思考。最终，圣保罗州波阿获选为举办城市。

两份申办材料可在这里查看。

感谢两个团队为申办和筹备这场比赛投入的时间与精力！看到大家愿意花时间申办大型比赛、认真规划，我们很高兴，也十分感谢这份热情。

期待 12 月又一届南美锦标赛，也希望你能一起参加！
html.en:
We are happy to announce that South American Championship will be held in the city of Poá-São Paulo, Brazil on December 15-16!

Applications were received from Poá-SP and for an idea to hold the championship across multiple cities in South America. Both described the details for hosting the competition in their own unique ways and had a lot of thought put into them. In the end, Poá-São Paulo was chosen as the host city.

Both applications can be found here.

Thank you to those who put together both applications for their time and effort in planning for this competition! It is exciting to see enthusiasm for our larger competitions from those who take the time to apply to host them and their planning is appreciated.

We look forward to another South American Championship in December and hope you can join us!

title.zh: TNoodle 0.13.3

html.zh:
TNoodle-WCA-0.13.3 现已可在 https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/ 下载。 相比 TNoodle 0.12.0，有以下修改：

  • TNoodle 现在支持连接 WCA 网站，获取比赛的项目和轮次。
  • 最少步成绩单现提供 22 种语言版本。完整列表见：https://github.com/thewca/tnoodle/tree/v0.13.2/webscrambles/src/i18n.

此次发布修复了 TNoodle 0.13.1 在部分浏览器中的一个严重问题：生成的 zip 文件会缺少扩展名。 同时也修复了 TNoodle 0.13.2 和 TNoodle 0.13.1 的另一个严重问题：打乱 JSON 文件中的轮次 ID 生成错误，导致文件无法用于 Workbook Assistant。

对于 TNoodle 连续发布多个版本给大家带来的不便，我们表示歉意。

请记住，正式比赛必须使用现行版本的官方打乱程序。下载地址始终为： https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/
html.en:
TNoodle-WCA-0.13.3 is now available from https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/ The following changes have been made since TNoodle 0.12.0:

  • TNoodle now supports connecting to the WCA website to retrieve the events and rounds of a competition.
  • FMC sheets are now available in 22 languages. The full list is available here: https://github.com/thewca/tnoodle/tree/v0.13.2/webscrambles/src/i18n.

This new release fixes a serious bug occurring in specific browsers with TNoodle 0.13.1, where the generated zip file would miss its extension. It fixes another serious bug in TNoodle 0.13.2 and TNoodle 0.13.1 where the rounds ids were wrongly generated in the scrambles json file, making it impossible to use in the Workbook Assistant.

Appologies for any inconvenience these multiple TNoodle releases may have caused.

title.zh: TNoodle 0.13.2 发布

title.zh: 2017 年年末寄语

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

2017 年即将结束，我们想借此机会向大家道谢，并送上新年的祝福！这一年有许多值得分享的进展。

13 个国家首次举办了 WCA 比赛，超过 23,000 名新选手参加了官方比赛。在这些比赛中，共有 76 项世界纪录和 301 项洲纪录被打破！

世界魔方协会的组织架构也有重要调整，最主要的是成立了四个新委员会/团队：4 月，WCA 沟通团队开始工作；6 月，WCA 财务委员会成立。最近，WCA 道德委员会和 WCA 质量保证委员会也已成立，将在新的一年开始工作。

内部工作方面，WCA 成绩团队公布了 920 场比赛的成绩；WCA 规则委员会在 GitHub 上处理了 129 次提交和约 50 个拉取请求，完成了最新一轮规则更新；WCA 纪律委员会调查了约 30 起案件；WCA 沟通团队在 Facebook 上发了 82 条帖子；WCA 软件团队从代码库中删除了近 100 万行代码，只新增了 85,000 行。这确实是忙碌的一年！

我们期待 2018 年取得更多成果，也正在完成注册为非营利组织的最后几项手续。世界魔方协会感谢所有参与组织发展，以及努力为整个社区创造良好体验的人！

（Lauren Clement 代表 WCA 沟通团队发布）
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

With 2017 coming to a close, we wanted to use this opportunity to say thank you and wish you the very best for the New Year! We have experienced great developments in 2017 that we would like to share with you.

WCA competitions took place in 13 new countries and over 23,000 new competitors competed officially. At these competitions, 76 world records and 301 continental records were broken!

Some major structural changes within the World Cube Association took place, most importantly the establishment of four new committees: in April the WCA Communication Team started their work which then was joined by the WCA Financial Committee in June. Just recently the WCA Ethics Committee and the WCA Quality Assurance Committee were formed and will begin their work in the new year.

Internally, there have been 920 competition results posted by the WCA Results Team, the WCA Regulation Committee worked through 129 single commits and about 50 pull requests on GitHub to give us the most recent regulation changes, the WCA Disciplinary Committee investigated around 30 cases, the WCA Communication Team posted 82 times on Facebook, and the WCA Software Team deleted nearly a million lines of code while only adding 85 thousand to our codebase. It’s been a busy year!

We are looking forward to an even more successful year 2018 and are completing the final steps to become a registered non-profit organization. The World Cube Association wants to thank everyone involved with its development and those who work to make it a great experience for the whole community!

(Posted by Lauren Clement on behalf of the WCA Communication Team)

title.zh: WCA 竞赛规则：2018 年 1 月更新

html.zh:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

WRC 现公布新版竞赛规则，将于 2018 年 1 月 1 日生效。

全部改动可在 GitHub 版本对比中查看。如果不想逐项打开修改，可点击“Files changed”查看完整的规则与指南文件。修改和新增内容标为绿色，删除内容标为红色。

与选手最相关的主要变化：

  • 盲拧项目不允许使用带标志的魔方。（提交｜无公开讨论）
  • 三阶脚拧赛制改为“五次去尾平均”。WRC 和 WCA 董事会将在内部确定的一段时间后，评估赛制变化对该项目受欢迎程度的影响，再决定该项目的未来。（提交｜讨论）
  • 调整成绩记录流程：裁判必须在记录成绩后立即签名；选手须在裁判记录并签名后核对成绩、签名。确保自己和裁判都已为该次还原签名，最终责任在选手。（提交｜讨论）
  • 一次尝试期间不得使用电子头戴式或入耳式耳机，即使已关闭或断开连接也不例外。（提交｜无公开讨论）
  • 三阶脚拧观察期间，选手现可用手接触魔方。（提交｜讨论）
  • 使用不合规魔方完成的成绩将被取消资格，记为 DNF。例外：若在轮次进行中发现魔方不合规，WCA 代表可酌情用补赛替代此前的成绩。（提交｜无公开讨论）

其他重要变化：

  • 所有项目均允许使用面包魔方。（提交｜讨论）
  • 三阶、二阶、四阶、五阶、三阶单手、三阶脚拧、魔表、五魔方、金字塔、斜转和 Square-1 的默认赛制为“五次去尾平均”，组合轮次则为“两次取最佳／五次去尾平均”。这些项目采用其他赛制须获董事会批准。（提交｜无公开讨论）
  • 三阶单手还原中，若选手意外用身体其他部位触碰魔方，裁判可酌情不判 DNF。（提交｜讨论）
  • 停表后魔方掉到选手大腿上，视为触碰魔方，因此加罚 2 秒。（提交｜讨论）
  • 选手在一次尝试期间，除裁判外，现在也可以与 WCA 代表交谈。（提交｜讨论）
  • 明确了 A6c 与 A6e 的关系：违反 A6c 不再同时触发 A6e。（提交｜讨论）
  • 取消组合轮次按排名设置的及格线，只保留按成绩设置的及格线。（提交｜讨论）
  • 晋级下一轮的条件必须在当前轮次开始前公布，之后不应更改。（提交｜讨论）
  • 所有尝试必须使用 Stackmat；例外是没有观察时间、且预计选手用时超过 10 分钟的项目，可选择不使用 Stackmat。（提交｜讨论）
  • 多盲的魔方应摆成尽量接近正方形的形状，例如 8 个魔方应分为三行，两行各 3 个、一行 2 个。（提交｜讨论）
  • 报名管理新增三项限制（提交｜讨论）：
    1. 达到人数上限后，不得再接受现场报名。
    2. 应公布人数上限，只有获董事会批准后才能更改。
    3. 额外开放报名时，必须至少提前 48 小时公告。
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

The WRC would like to inform you about the new version of the regulations, which is going into effect January 1, 2018.

You can review all changes in this comparison on GitHub. If you do not want to open all the individual changes, you can click on “Files changed” to see the complete files of the regulation and guidelines. All changes and additions are marked green and removals are red.

Most important changes for competitors:

  • Puzzles with logos are not allowed to be used in blindfolded events (commit | no public discussion)
  • The format of “3x3x3 With Feet” is changed to “Average of 5”. The WRC and WCA Board will review how the format change influences the popularity of the event and decide about the future of the event after an internally determined period of time. (commit | discussion)
  • The result recording procedure has been revised: Judges must sign right after recording the result. Competitors have to check the result and sign after the judge has recorded the result and signed. The competitor is ultimately responsible for ensuring that they and the judge have signed an attempt. (commit | discussion)
  • Electronic headphones and earbuds must not be used during an attempt, even if they are switched off or disconnected (commit | no public discussion)
  • Competitors are now allowed to use their hands during inspection in 3x3x3 With Feet (commit | discussion)
  • Attempts done with illegal puzzles will be disqualified (DNF). Exception: If a puzzle is found to be not permitted during a round, earlier results may be replaced with an extra attempt, at the discretion of the WCA Delegate (commit | no public discussion)

Other important changes:

  • All pillowed puzzles are allowed in all events (commit | discussions)
  • The default format for 3x3x3 Cube, 2x2x2 Cube, 4x4x4 Cube, 5x5x5 Cube, 3x3x3 One-Handed, 3x3x3 With Feet, Clock, Megaminx, Pyraminx, Skewb, and Square-1 is “Average of 5” or “Best of 2/Average of 5” for a combined round. All other formats for these events have to be approved by the Board (commit | no public discussion)
  • When competitors accidentally touch the puzzle with other body parts during 3x3x3 One-Handed Solving, it’s not considered DNF, at the discretion of the judge (commit | discussion)
  • If the puzzle falls into the lap of the competitor after stopping the timer, this is considered touching the puzzle (thus, +2 seconds penalty is awarded) (commit | discussion)
  • Competitors are now allowed to talk to WCA Delegates during their attempts, not only to their judges (commit | discussion)
  • The interaction between A6c and A6e has been clarified: A6c does not trigger A6e anymore (commit | discussion)
  • Ranking-based cutoffs for combined rounds are removed (only result-based remains) (commit | discussion)
  • Advancement conditions to the next round must be announced before the current round starts and should not be changed later (commit | discussion)
  • A Stackmat must be used for all attempts, exception: the usage of a Stackmat is optional for events without inspection where the competitor is expected to exceed 10 minutes (commit | discussion)
  • In Multiple Blindfolded Solving, puzzles should be arranged in shape as square as possible (e.g. 8 puzzles should be arranged in 2 rows with 3 puzzles and 1 row with 2 puzzles) (commit | discussion)
  • Three restrictions for registration management (commit | discussion):
    1. If the competitor limit was reached, on-site registrations are not allowed
    2. Competitor limits should be announced and may only be changed with Board approval
    3. Additional registration periods must be announced at least 48 hours before they start
