title.en: Incident at China Championship 2017 and Beijing Open 2017

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

多位社区成员向 WCA 规则委员会（WRC）反映，林恺俊创造目前四盲和五盲世界纪录时所用的魔方，都带有覆盖贴纸。根据规则 3l2，这类魔方不允许用于盲拧项目。

我们调查了此事。相关比赛的 WCA 代表确认，他们当时检查过魔方，并认定标志无法通过触感辨认。因此，他们没有安排额外还原，现在也就没有可用于替换受影响成绩的额外还原成绩。基于这些原因，我们决定保留成绩。

针对近期盲拧中使用覆盖贴纸的事件，以及关于哪些标志应被允许的持续讨论，我们决定禁止在盲拧项目中使用任何标志。此外，新增规则 3k2 将规定，使用不合规魔方完成的还原均取消成绩，记为 DNF。以下规则将于 2018 年 1 月 1 日生效：

3k1）如果在一轮中发现魔方不符合规定，选手必须提交替代魔方。

3k2）使用不符合规定的魔方进行还原，处罚为取消该次成绩（DNF）。例外：如果在一轮中发现魔方不符合规定，WCA 代表可酌情允许以额外还原替换此前的成绩。

我们知道这是一次较大的变化，但相信这样能够让世界各地的盲拧选手在公平、一致的条件下参赛。

另外，也提醒所有选手：你最终须对自己的魔方负责。如果不确定某个魔方是否允许使用，请在提交前询问 WCA 代表。

Laura Ohrndorf

代表 WRC
html.en:
Dear WCA community,

The WRC was informed by several community members that the puzzles Kaijun Lin used for both his current world records in 4x4x4 Blindfolded and 5x5x5 Blindfolded had an overlay sticker. According to Regulation 3l2, such puzzles are not allowed in blindfolded events.

We have investigated in this case and received a confirmation by the WCA Delegates of the competitions that they checked the puzzles and decided the logos are not distinguishable by feel. Accordingly, they did not grant extra attempts, which could be used to replace the affected results now. For these reasons, we have decided to keep the results.

As a reaction to the recent incidents concerning overlay stickers used in blindfolded attempts and ongoing discussions about the allowance of certain types of logos, we have decided to forbid all logos for blindfolded events. Furthermore, by the addition of 3k2, all results for attempts done with illegal puzzles will be disqualified (DNF). These regulations will become effective on January 1st, 2018:

3k1) If a puzzle is found to be not permitted during a round, the competitor must submit a replacement. 3k2) Penalty for attempts done with not permitted puzzles: disqualification of the attempt (DNF). Exception: If a puzzle is found to be not permitted during a round, earlier results may be replaced with an extra attempt, at the discretion of the WCA Delegate.

We know that this is a sharp change, but we believe it is the right way to assure fair and equal conditions for competitors in Blindfolded events around the world.

Additionally, we want to remind all competitors that they are ultimately responsible for their puzzles. If you are unsure if a puzzle is allowed, please ask your WCA Delegate before submitting it.

On behalf of the WRC, Laura Ohrndorf

title.zh: WRC 对 Longhorn Cube Day 2017 意外事件的裁定
title.en: WRC decision regarding an incident at Longhorn Cube Day 2017

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

在 Longhorn Cube Day 2017 的三阶盲拧第三轮中，一名未满 18 岁的选手使用了带有叠加贴纸、不符合规定的魔方。这一事件受到特别关注，因为它涉及一次 17.35 秒的单次成绩；该成绩原本将成为新的三阶盲拧世界纪录。

WCA 规则要求魔方必须经过 WCA 代表批准。遗憾的是，本轮比赛前未进行这项检查，因此赛事代表决定给予该选手本轮的暂定额外还原机会。WRC 现已决定，用这些暂定额外还原替代原来的还原。成绩将由 DNF、DNF、17.35 改为 29.40、21.78、DNF。

我们为这名选手感到非常遗憾。不过，我们也提醒大家，WCA 规则要求每位选手熟悉规则，并且只提供符合全部规定的魔方。原来的还原违反了规则，而现有有效的替代还原，因此我们认为这是正确的决定。这也与其他比赛中的多个先例一致；仅因为涉及一项可能破纪录的成绩，就对本次事件采取不同处理，并不公平。

此致

Laura Ohrndorf，代表 WCA 规则委员会（WRC）
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

At Longhorn Cube Day 2017 a competitor [under 18 years old] used an invalid puzzle with an overlay sticker during the third round of 3x3x3 Blindfolded. This incident has generated special attention as it affects a single result of 17.35 seconds, which would be the new 3x3x3 Blindfolded World Record.

The WCA Regulations require that puzzles must be approved by a WCA Delegate. Unfortunately, this was not done before the round, so the delegates of the competition decided to grant the competitor provisional extra attempts for this round. The WRC has now decided that the provisional extra attempts should replace the original attempts. The results will be changed from DNF, DNF, 17.35 to 29.40, 21.78, DNF.

We are very sorry for the competitor. However, we would like to remind that the WCA Regulations require every competitor to be familiar with the Regulations and to only provide puzzles that comply with all Regulations. As the Regulations were broken in the original attempts and there are valid replacement attempts, we believe this is the correct decision. This decision is also consistent with several precedents at other competitions and it would be unfair to treat this incident differently only because it involves a potential record-breaking result.

Kind regards, Laura Ohrndorf, on behalf of the WCA Regulations Committee (WRC)

title.zh: 三位新高级代表任命公告（2017 年 11 月）
title.en: Appointment of Three New Senior Delegates (November 2017)

html.zh:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

我们很高兴地宣布，世界魔方协会任命了三位新的高级代表！

东亚岗位收到了 Baiqiang Dong（董百强）的申请。经过讨论，董事会认为他符合任职条件，并选定他担任此职。**Baiqiang Dong（董百强）**已接受任命。

美国东部及加拿大岗位收到了 Dave Campbell 和 Tim Reynolds 的申请。经过讨论，董事会认为两人都符合任职条件。投票后，Tim Reynolds 当选，并已接受任命。

美国西部岗位收到了 Kit Clement、Shelley Chang 和 Shonathon Collins 的申请。经过讨论，董事会认为三人均符合任职条件。投票后，Kit Clement 当选，并已接受任命。

三位新高级代表的任命即刻生效。愿意公开申请材料的候选人，其材料可在此处查看。

感谢六位申请人愿意在已有工作之外，为 WCA 和速拧社区承担更多责任。祝各位新高级代表履新顺利！

（Lauren Clement 代表世界魔方协会发布）
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

We are proud to announce the appointment of three new Senior Delegates to the World Cube Association!

For Asia East we received an application by Baiqiang Dong (董百强). After deliberation, the Board decided that Baiqiang fits the requisites for the appointment and he was elected. Baiqiang Dong (董百强) has accepted the new position.

For USA East & Canada we received applications by Dave Campbell and Tim Reynolds. After deliberation, the Board decided that both fit the requisites for the appointment. After a vote, Tim Reynolds was elected and he has accepted the new position.

For USA West we received applications by Kit Clement, Shelley Chang, and Shonathon Collins. After deliberation, the Board considered that all three fit the requisites for the appointment. After a vote, Kit Clement was elected and he has accepted the new position.

The new Seniors will be promoted immediately. The candidacy documents of those applicants willing to make them public can be found here if you are interested in viewing them.

We greatly thank the six applicants for their willingness to help the WCA and the Speedcubing community even more than they currently do now. Good luck to the new Senior Delegates in their roles!

(Posted by Lauren Clement on behalf of the World Cube Association)

title.zh: 招募新一届委员会与团队负责人（2017 年 11 月）

html.zh:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

WCA 将任命四位新的委员会或团队负责人。Daniel Sheppard 和 Linus Frész 将分别卸任 WCA 纪律委员会及 WCA 传播团队负责人。两人在任内做了出色的工作，感谢他们一直以来的努力与投入。

世界魔方协会还将新增两个咨询委员会：WCA 道德委员会和 WCA 质量保证委员会。道德委员会将确保 WCA 工作人员及外部工作人员遵循的所有程序符合《道德准则》。随着协会快速发展，我们也需要设立质量保证委员会，支持并推动 WCA 持续改善工作质量，在全球应用质量标准，确保流程、WCA 工作人员、地区组织、比赛主办方及工作人员始终保持较高水准。

候选人应完成整个任期（24 个月），平均每周至少投入 6 小时处理所属团队或委员会的工作。各职位的要求如下：

WCA 纪律委员会（WDC）：

  • 能严守秘密。
  • 客观思考。
  • 公正。
  • 做事细致周全。

WCA 传播团队（WCT）：

  • 了解社交媒体。
  • 英语流利。
  • 良好的沟通能力。
  • 有耐心。

WCA 道德委员会（WEC）：

  • 无不良记录。
  • 值得信赖。
  • 能独立判断。
  • 有责任心。

WCA 质量保证委员会（WQAC）：

  • 做事准确。
  • 非常熟悉规则。
  • 注重实际。
  • 善于团队合作。

现开放提交申请材料。请于即日起至 2017 年 11 月 28 日 23:59 UTC，将材料私下发送给对应联系人：

  • WCA 纪律委员会：Ron van Bruchem（cubefool@gmail.com）。
  • WCA 传播团队：Luis J. Iáñez（luisjianez@gmail.com）。
  • WCA 道德委员会：Alberto Pérez de Rada Fiol（albertopdrf.wca@gmail.com）。
  • WCA 质量保证委员会：Olivér Perge（pergeoliver@gmail.com）。

收到材料后，联系人会确认材料是否齐全，如有缺漏会告知申请者。申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：

  • 申请的委员会或团队。
  • 简短的个人介绍。
  • 曾为 WCA 开展的工作概述。
  • 担任该委员会或团队负责人后的工作设想。

章程中 WDC、WCT、WEC 和 WQAC 的权利与职责可在这里查看。

申请期结束后的下一周，WCA 董事会将投票选出人选，并提交 WCA 高级代表批准。之后将公布新负责人名单。

感谢大家的申请与支持！

（Lauren Clement 代表世界魔方协会发布）
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

There will be four appointments of new WCA Committee/Team Leaders. Daniel Sheppard and Linus Frész are stepping down as Leaders of the WCA Disciplinary Committee and the WCA Communication Team, respectively. Daniel and Linus have deployed great work as Leaders, and we want to thank them for all their hard work and dedication all this time.

The World Cube Association will also be adding two brand new Advisory Committees: the WCA Ethics Committee and the WCA Quality Assurance Committee. The Ethics Committee will have the role to ensure that all the procedures followed by the WCA Staff and External Staff abide by its Code of Ethics. Also, our large growing rate makes a Quality Assurance Committee necessary, with the role to support and promote continuous quality improvement within the WCA, as well as worldwide application of quality standards to ensure consistent high quality of processes, WCA Staff, Regional Organizations, Competition Organizers, and Competition Staff.

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to dedicate at least 6 hours per week on average to work for their respective Team/Committee. The qualities requested to candidates are:

WCA Disciplinary Committee (WDC): Secrecy Objective thinking Fairness Thoroughness

WCA Communication Team (WCT): Social media knowledge Fluent English Communication skills Patience

WCA Ethics Committee (WEC): Clear background Trustworthiness Independence Accountability

WCA Quality Assurance Committee (WQAC): Accuracy Very good knowledge of the regulations Practical thinking Team work

The application period is open for candidates to submit their candidacy documents. Candidacy documents must be sent from now until November 28th, 2017, 23:59 UTC privately to: WCA Disciplinary Committee: Ron van Bruchem (cubefool@gmail.com) WCA Communication Team: Luis J. Iáñez (luisjianez@gmail.com) WCA Ethics Committee: Alberto Pérez de Rada Fiol (albertopdrf.wca@gmail.com) WCA Quality Assurance Committee: Olivér Perge (pergeoliver@gmail.com )

Recipients will confirm the documents are in good order or will report on deficiencies otherwise once received. The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and they must include: Application Committee/Team Brief personal introduction Summary of activities done for the WCA Ambitions as Leader of the Committee/Team

The rights and duties of WDC, WCT, WEC, and WQAC from our By-laws can be found here.

The week after the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting. Selected winners will be presented to the WCA Seniors for their approval. Finally, the new Leaders will be announced.

Thanks for your candidacies and support!

(Posted by Lauren Clement on behalf of the World Cube Association)

title.zh: WCA 董事会成员变动（2017 年 11 月）
title.en: Changes in the Board of Directors - November 2017

html.zh:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

WCA 有投票权的成员再次以无记名方式进行了董事选举，现公布结果及董事会的相应变动。

我们很高兴地宣布，Bob Burton 和 Alberto Pérez de Rada Fiol 加入 WCA 董事会；Chris Hardwick 则将卸任董事。感谢 Chris 为 WCA 和社区所做的工作。他自 2016 年 7 月起担任董事，为 WCA 发展投入了大量时间和精力。他将继续担任 WCA 财务委员会负责人及美国佐治亚州的 WCA 代表。

上述变动自 2017 年 11 月 9 日起生效。

三位候选人均同意公开申请材料，可在此查看： https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/199Gr_MmpepvFwx36vVtpb_fnTnB-rfDR?usp=sharing
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

Another anonymous election took place among the voting members of the WCA for director positions. We hereby inform you on the results and the corresponding changes in the WCA Board of Directors.

We are happy to announce that the WCA Board has two new members: Bob Burton and Alberto Pérez de Rada Fiol, and Chris Hardwick is stepping down from being in the Board of Directors. We thank Chris for his work for the WCA and our community. He has served on the WCA Board since July 2016 and has put in a lot of time and effort to develop the WCA. He will still remain leader of the WCA Financial Committee and a WCA Delegate for Georgia, USA.

These changes have become effective starting November 9th, 2017.

All three candidates gave permission to publish their application documents which can be viewed here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/199Gr_MmpepvFwx36vVtpb_fnTnB-rfDR?usp=sharing

title.zh: 开放申办 2018 年南美锦标赛

html.zh:
WCA 董事会正在寻找主办团队，承办 2018 年南美锦标赛！

请与本国代表讨论，你们是否有意愿和能力承办。举办这一规模的比赛，在赛前和比赛期间都需要投入大量时间和精力。

如有意申办，请将申请材料发送给 Pedro Santos Guimarães，邮箱为 pedrosino@gmail.com。申办截止日期为 2017 年 12 月 31 日。

申办材料至少应包含以下信息：

你们希望何时举办比赛？

1.1 比赛天数。 1.2 与学校假期的重合情况。 1.3 与本国法定假日的重合情况。

你们希望在本国的哪个地点举办 2018 年南美锦标赛？

2.1 城市应对海外访客有吸引力，并有观光游览的机会。 2.2 国际、国内及市内交通的便利程度。 2.3 是否有不同价位的酒店或公寓可供选择。 2.4 场地应能容纳赛台、观众、练习桌及附属房间。 2.5 可用的技术设施，如网络、视频直播、灯光及音响设备。 2.6 可容纳的选手和观众人数。

主办团队和工作人员如何安排？

3.1 核心团队成员。 3.2 核心团队的经验。 3.3 其他合作方的参与情况。 3.4 当地志愿者的数量与能力；建议配备 80–120 名工作人员。 3.5 需要海外代表提供哪些支持。

比赛总体预算是多少？

4.1 支出：场地、赛台、器材、装饰、网站、证件/挂绳/礼包、奖品等。 4.2 收入：报名费、赞助、地方政府支持等。

当地赞助商可以是 Rubik 的合作伙伴，或最好是益智玩具行业以外的企业。

以下示例表格列出了大型比赛需要安排和编列预算的部分事项，并非完整清单：https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1w6uxOHrr40of1R4-NjU1vy7fVJXRHiRZBn53Hc-IOk8

Pedro Santos Guimarães 将负责主持申办遴选流程。董事会将投票，并可能在投票前咨询社区其他成员。 如果其他董事参与了申办团队，将邀请其他成员参与投票，例如高级代表或委员会负责人。

我们希望比赛重点做到三件事：

  • 会员能否一起度过愉快的时光？
  • 能否在公平、实力最强者获胜的比赛中，为会员提供创造个人好成绩的机会？
  • 能否让赞助商满意，并为我们的社区做好宣传？

提前感谢大家的配合！

（Lauren Clement 代表世界魔方协会发布）
html.en:
The WCA Board of Directors are looking for an organization team to host South American Championship 2018!

Please discuss with the delegates in your country whether this is something you are willing and able to pursue. Organizing a competition of this size takes a significant amount of time and effort before and during the competition.

If you are interested, then send your application documents to Pedro Santos Guimarães at pedrosino@gmail.com. The application period ends on December 31st, 2017.

Please include in your application documents at least the following information:

When would you like to hold the competition? 1.1 Number of days of the competition 1.2 Overlap with holiday periods of schools 1.3 Overlap with national holidays in the country

Where would you like to hold South America 2018 in your country? 2.1 City should be interesting to visit for foreigners with opportunities for sightseeing 2.2 Ease of international, national and local travelling 2.3 Availability of hotels/apartments with different price ranges 2.4 Venue should be able to accommodate stage, audience, tables to practice, side rooms 2.5 Technology offering like internet, video streaming, lighting, sound equipment 2.6 Number of competitors and spectators that can be hosted

What would the organization team and staff look like? 3.1 Core team members 3.2 Experience of the core team 3.3 Involvement of other parties 3.4 Quantity and quality of local volunteers (guideline is 80-120 staff) 3.5 Required support by foreign delegates

What would be the overall budget for the competition? 4.1 Cost (venue, stage, equipment, decoration, website, badges/lanyards/gift-pack, prizes) 4.2 Income (registration fees, sponsoring, local government)

Local sponsors may be Rubik partners or preferably not in puzzle business.

Here is an example document with a non-exhaustive list of topics that need to be arranged and budgeted for a large competition: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1w6uxOHrr40of1R4-NjU1vy7fVJXRHiRZBn53Hc-IOk8

Pedro Santos Guimarães will lead the process of selecting the winning application. The Board of Directors will vote and may consult with other members of our community before voting. If other Directors will be involved in a team that sends in an application, other members (for example senior delegates or committee leaders) will be included in the voting.

We are looking at a competition that is focused on three things: Will our members have a great time together? Will our members have a good opportunity to set personal times, in a fair competition where the best will win? Will our sponsors be happy and will we do good promotion of our community?

Thank you for your cooperation in advance!

(Posted by Lauren Clement on behalf of the World Cube Association)

title.zh: WCA 董事会就红牛魔方世界锦标赛发表声明
title.en: Statement of the WCA Board on the Red Bull Rubik's Cube World Championship

html.zh:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

2017 年 10 月 25 日，红牛宣布举办红牛魔方世界锦标赛。该赛事将在若干国家举办资格赛，胜者获得前往美国波士顿参加决赛的资格。更多信息见：https://www.redbullmindgamers.com/rubiks

得知这一消息后，我们认为有必要向所有为 WCA 工作、曾参加 WCA 比赛，或关心并支持 WCA 及其理念的人作出说明。社区中已经出现了许多传言。作为 WCA 的领导者，我们有责任告诉大家我们对此事的看法，以及对未来的立场。

红牛与 Rubik’s Brand Ltd. 合作，在世界各地举办自己的速拧比赛。这些比赛在 WCA 不知情的情况下公布，采用的规则、项目和赛制也与 WCA 不同。因此，WCA 不会公示这些比赛，也不会认可其成绩。

WCA 成员及工作人员可以自由参加红牛比赛。WCA 不会处罚任何希望参赛的人。我们仍然欢迎所有人参加 WCA 比赛，并会平等、友善地对待每个人。我们也希望 WCA 成员友善对待参加红牛比赛的选手。

WCA 的所有工作人员都应忠于 WCA 的使命，维护并保护 WCA 的诚信。目前关于红牛比赛的信息不足以判断 WCA 能否、以及是否会支持这些赛事。得到更多信息后，我们会进一步通知工作人员。在此之前，如有疑问，欢迎在代表群组中提出，或直接询问董事会。

请大家放心，WCA 为每一位魔友而存在。无论年龄大小、速拧水平如何，我们都欢迎你加入。我们提供多种项目和玩法，也允许选手自由选择参赛魔方的品牌及型号。WCA 还在继续成长，预计 2018 年将在全球约 90 个国家举办超过 1,000 场比赛。我们是独立的组织，也会努力保持独立。

WCA 为十多年来取得的成绩感到自豪，并会继续把精力放在做好及改进工作上。我们认为，坚持目标与使命、守护自身价值观，是继续前进的根本。这是一段持续的历程，而非一个终点，因此，我们必须了解当前的问题，不断学习，并根据社区的需求作出调整。

作为一个不断发展的组织，我们始终努力提高专业程度和工作质量。目前，成为非营利组织的程序已进入最后阶段。我们也在寻求与企业和赞助商合作，让世界各地的人都能参加 WCA 比赛。此外，我们正在考虑借助外部力量，争取更好、更有吸引力的媒体报道，让社区之外的人认识魔方。只要合作条件符合 WCA 及其成员的利益，我们愿意与任何其他方面合作，实现自己的目标。

我们期待后续的发展。我们为所有给 WCA 作出贡献的人感到自豪，也将不懈努力，代表 WCA 及其成员发声。

此致 WCA 董事会
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

On the 25th of October, 2017 Red Bull announced the Red Bull Rubik’s Cube World Championship. It will be a series of qualifier competitions in specific countries, and the winners will qualify for a final competition in Boston, USA. More information can be found here: https://www.redbullmindgamers.com/rubiks

In light of this news we feel it is important to address everyone who works for the WCA, has competed at our competitions before, or is simply interested and supportive of the WCA and what it stands for. There are already a lot of rumors spreading around within our community, and as the leaders of the WCA, we feel obliged to inform you about our view on the matter and our position on the future.

Red Bull has teamed up with Rubik’s Brand Ltd. to create their own speedcubing competitions around the world. These competitions were announced without the knowledge of the WCA and they use different regulations, events and formats. Therefore the WCA will not announce these competitions, and will not recognize the results of these competitions.

Members and staff of the WCA are free to compete in these Red Bull competitions. The WCA will not sanction anyone who wishes to enter the competitions. We will still welcome anyone to our competitions, and will treat everyone equally and friendly. We also expect from our members to stay friendly towards any competitor in the Red Bull competitions.

All staff of the WCA are expected to be loyal to the WCA mission and to defend and protect the WCA’s integrity. There is currently insufficient information on the Red Bull competitions to determine whether this is something the WCA can and will support or not. We will inform our staff further once we have more information. For now feel free to ask questions on the delegate group or to the board.

We would like to comfort everyone by saying that the WCA is here for all of you, and we welcome anyone to join us, regardless of age or proficiency in speedcubing. We provide a spectrum of different events and different variants, with the freedom of choice in any brand or puzzle to compete with. We continue to grow, and are set to have more than 1,000 competitions in 2018 worldwide, in around 90 countries. We are also an independent organization, and will work to stay independent.

The WCA is very proud of what it has achieved in more than a decade, and we will focus on maintaining and improving our work. We believe that keeping our goals and missions, and protecting our values is a core necessity in moving forward. As we think that this is not a destination, but rather a journey, we do believe that it is crucial to keep ourselves updated on the current issues and to learn and adjust to the demands and needs of our community.

As a growing organization, we put continuous effort in becoming more professional and achieving a higher quality standard. We are in the final steps of becoming a non-profit organization. We are also looking for cooperations with companies and sponsors to give all people across the globe access to WCA competitions. Additionally, we are considering the help of external parties which could help us get better and more appealing media coverage and reach out to people outside our community. The WCA will be glad to work with any other party to achieve its goals, if the conditions are right for the WCA and its members.

We are looking forward to further developments. We are proud of the people who contribute to the WCA and we will work tirelessly to represent the WCA and its members.

Kind Regards, WCA Board of Directors

title.zh: TNoodle 0.12.0 发布

html.zh:
现在可从 https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/ 下载 TNoodle-WCA-0.12.0。

相较 TNoodle 0.11.5，本次更新包括：

  • TNoodle 现会额外生成可裁切的最少步打乱纸条，以及黑白答题纸，分别保存为独立文件。这样可以减少较贵的彩色打印。
  • 支持多组、多次尝试的三阶多盲。此前，WCA 代表需要生成多个组，才能得到多次尝试的打乱。
  • 修复了 TNoodle 用户界面的一个问题。

请记住，官方比赛必须使用官方打乱程序的当前有效版本，下载地址始终为： https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/
html.en:
TNoodle-WCA-0.12.0 is now available from https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/

The following changes have been made since TNoodle 0.11.5:

  • TNoodle now generates additional FMC scramble cutout sheets and a black and white solution sheet (in separate files). These can be used to reduce the number of expensive color prints.
  • Added support for 3x3x3 Multi-Blind with multiple groups and attempts. In the past, WCA Delegates had to generate multiple groups to generate scrambles for multiple attempts.
  • Fixed a TNoodle user interface bug.

Please remember that official competitions must use the current version of the official scramble program. This is always available from: https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/

title.zh: 2018 年亚洲锦标赛及欧洲锦标赛承办申请
title.en: Applications for Asian Championship 2018 / European Championship 2018

html.zh:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

WCA 董事会现接受 2018 年亚洲锦标赛和 2018 年欧洲锦标赛的承办申请。

请与所在国家的代表和主办团队讨论是否有意愿和能力承办。举办这一规模的比赛，需要在赛前和比赛期间投入大量时间与精力。

如有意承办亚洲锦标赛，请将申请材料发送给 Olivér Perge，pergeoliver@gmail.com；欧洲锦标赛则发送给 Ron van Bruchem，rbruchem@worldcubeassociation.org。

申请截止日期为 2017 年 8 月 31 日。

申请材料至少须包含以下信息：

  1. 计划何时举办比赛？
    • 1.1 比赛天数
    • 1.2 与学校假期的重合情况
    • 1.3 与举办国法定假日的重合情况
  2. 计划在本国何处举办比赛？
    • 2.1 城市应对游客有吸引力，有观光机会
    • 2.2 国际、国内及市内交通的便利程度
    • 2.3 不同价位酒店、公寓的供应情况
    • 2.4 场馆应能安排舞台、观众区、练习桌和附属房间
    • 2.5 应具备网络、视频直播、灯光及音响等技术条件
    • 2.6 可容纳的选手和观众人数
  3. 主办团队和工作人员如何组成？
    • 3.1 核心团队成员
    • 3.2 核心团队的经验
    • 3.3 其他参与方
    • 3.4 当地志愿者的数量和能力，建议安排 80–120 名工作人员
    • 3.5 需要外国代表提供哪些支持
  4. 比赛的总体预算是多少？
    • 4.1 支出：场馆、舞台、器材、装饰、网站、证件及挂绳和礼品包、奖品
    • 4.2 收入：报名费、赞助、地方政府支持

计算预算时，可暂按 WCA 统一联系的赞助商提供 20,000 欧元赞助估算（仅用于测算，尚未确认！）。当地赞助商可以是 Rubik 的合作伙伴，其他赞助商最好不从事益智玩具业务。

以下示例文档列出了大型比赛需要安排并纳入预算的部分事项，清单并非详尽无遗：

https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1w6uxOHrr40of1R4-NjU1vy7fVJXRHiRZBn53Hc-IOk8

Olivér Perge 和 Ron van Bruchem 两位董事将负责主持申办遴选。董事会将投票决定，并可能在投票前征询其他社区成员的意见。

我们关注比赛能否做到以下三点：

  1. 成员们能否一起拥有愉快的经历？
  2. 成员们能否在公平、优胜者获胜的比赛中，有良好的机会发挥并取得个人成绩？
  3. 赞助商能否满意，比赛能否很好地宣传我们的社区？

祝好，

Linus Fresz

代表世界魔方协会
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

The WCA Board of Directors are accepting applications for Asian Championship 2018 and European Championship 2018.

Please discuss whether this is something you are willing and able to pursue with the delegates and organization teams in your country. Organizing a competition of this size takes a significant amount of time and effort before and during the competition.

If you are interested, then send your application documents to Olivér Perge, pergeoliver@gmail.com (Asian Championship), or Ron van Bruchem, rbruchem@worldcubeassociation.org (European Championship). The application period ends on August 31, 2017

Please include in your application documents at least the following information:

  1. When would you like to hold the competition? 1.1 number of days of the competition 1.2 overlap with holiday periods of schools 1.3 overlap with national holidays in the country

  2. Where would you like to hold the competition in your country? 2.1 city should be interesting to visit for travellers with opportunities for sightseeing 2.2 ease of international, national, and local travelling 2.3 availability of hotels/apartments in varying price ranges 2.4 venue should be able to accommodate stage, audience, tables to practice, and side rooms 2.5 technology, like internet, video streaming, lighting, and sound equipment, should be available 2.6 number of competitors and spectators that can be hosted

  3. What would the organization team and staff look like? 3.1 core team members 3.2 experience of the core team 3.3 involvement of other parties 3.4 quantity and quality of local volunteers (guideline is 80-120 staff) 3.5 required support by foreign delegates

  4. What will be the overall budget for the competition? 4.1 cost (venue, stage, equipment, decoration, website, badges/lanyards/giftpack, prizes) 4.2 income (registration fees, sponsoring, local government) You can assume 20K EUR sponsoring from a central sponsor via WCA (for calculation purposes, this is not yet confirmed!). Local sponsors may be Rubik partners or preferably not in puzzle business.

Here is an example document with a non-exhaustive list of topics that need to be arranged and budgeted for a large competition: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1w6uxOHrr40of1R4-NjU1vy7fVJXRHiRZBn53Hc-IOk8

The two Directors Olivér Perge and Ron van Bruchem will lead the process of selecting the winning application. The Board of Directors will vote and may consult with other members of our community before voting.

We are looking at a competition that is focused on three things:

  1. Will our members have a great experience together?
  2. Will our members have a good opportunity to set personal times, in a fair competition where the best will win?
  3. Will our sponsors be happy and will this promote our community well?

Kind Regards, Linus Fresz on behalf of the World Cube Association

title.zh: Max Park 在法国巴黎夺得 2017 年魔方世锦赛冠军
title.en: Max Park wins World Rubik's Cube Championship 2017, in Paris, France

html.zh:

**非洲纪录：**Moez Boussarsar：金字塔平均 4.78。

Oceanian records: Jack Cai 3x3x3 Blindfolded 23.44 (single), Jayden McNeill Pyraminx 2.10 (single), Square-1 10.36 (average), Square-1 7.47 (single), Square-1 10.07 (average), Tom Nelson 5x5x5 Blindfolded 5:43.86 (single).
European records: Charlie Stark Square-1 9.07 (average), Ciarán Beahan 6x6x6 Cube 1:45.57 (average), Jules Desjardin Pyraminx 2.32 (average), Oscar Roth Andersen Megaminx 45.07 (average), Sebastian Weyer 5x5x5 Cube 50.88 (average).

title.zh: WCA 董事会成员变动
title.en: Changes in the Board of Directors (WCA Board)

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

WCA 有投票权的会员通过不记名投票选举了 WCA 董事。现将选举结果及董事会相应变动告知大家。

我们很高兴地宣布，Olivér Perge成为 WCA 董事会新成员。Pedro Santos Guimarães成功连任董事，Ilkyoo Choi则将结束其董事任期。上述变动已于 2017 年 7 月 1 日生效。

感谢 Ilkyoo 为 WCA 和社区所做的工作。他自 2013 年起担任 WCA 董事，为协会发展投入了大量时间和精力，作出了重要贡献，帮助 WCA 在世界各地成长。他将继续担任韩国的 WCA 代表。
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

An anonymous election took place among the voting members of the WCA for the position of directors of the WCA. We hereby inform you on the results and the corresponding changes in the Board of Directors.

We are happy to announce that the WCA Board has a new member: Olivér Perge. Pedro Santos Guimarães was reelected as Director and Ilkyoo Choi will end his term in the Board of Directors. These changes have become effective starting July 1st, 2017.

We thank Ilkyoo for his work for the WCA and our community. He served in the WCA Board since 2013 and put up a lot of time and effort to develop the WCA. Ilkyoo made great contributions to the WCA and helped the WCA grow all around the world. He will still remain the WCA Delegate for Republic of Korea.

title.zh: WCA 财务委员会成立
title.en: Start up of the WCA Financial Committee

html.zh:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

世界魔方协会向成为非营利组织又迈出了一步，成立了新的委员会——WCA 财务委员会（WFC）。 WFC 由以下成员组成：

  • 财务主管：Chris Hardwick（美国）。
  • 委员会成员：Chris Wright（英国）及 James Molloy（英国）。

团队目前正在组建，并开展履行职责所需的调研。WCA 软件团队已作出一些软件调整，以满足新委员会的需要。新邮箱为 finance@worldcubeassociation.org，这是 WCA 财务委员会默认使用、面向公众的官方邮箱。

WFC 负责 WCA 内部的一切财务事务，包括提出年度预算、管理财务等。完整职责载于章程：

1. WCA 财务委员会是 WCA 的咨询委员会，拥有以下权利与职责：

1.1. 为 WCA 制定年度预算提案。

1.2. 按照获批准的年度预算提案，管理 WCA 的财务与账目。

1.3. 经 WCA 董事会授权后，支付 WCA 应付的账单及税款。

1.4. 每季度向 WCA 董事会汇报财务情况，并提供建议。

1.5. 按照所有适用的法律要求，定期向外部机构报告 WCA 的财务情况。

1.6. 按照所有适用的法律要求，任命并协助财务审计人员。

2. WCA 财务委员会负责人兼任 WCA 财务主管。

此致 Linus Fresz，代表世界魔方协会
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

The World Cube Association made the next step towards becoming a non-profit organization and formed a new committee: the WCA Financial Committee (WFC). The WFC consist of the following members: Treasurer: Chris Hardwick (US) Committee members: Chris Wright (United Kingdom) and James Molloy (United Kingdom).

The team is currently building up and doing the necessary research to handle their designated tasks. Some software adjustments were made by the WCA Software Team to accommodate the needs of the new committee. The new email address is finance@worldcubeassociation.org, which is the default, public and official email address of the WCA Financial Committee.

The WFC is responsible for everything regarding finances within the WCA. This includes an annual budget proposal, managing finances and much more. To read about the WFC’s full description of responsibilities, please take a look at our By-Laws:

1. The WCA Financial Committee is an Advisory Committee of the WCA with the following rights and duties: 1.1. Creating an annual budget proposal for the WCA. 1.2 Managing the finances and accounts of the WCA in accordance with the approved annual budget proposal. 1.3 Paying invoices and taxes that are directed to the WCA, after procuration by the WCA Board of Directors. 1.4 Reporting and advising on a quarterly basis to the WCA Board of Directors on the finances of the WCA. 1.5 Reporting on a periodic basis to external organizations on the finances of the WCA, based on all applicable legal requirements. 1.6 Appointing and supporting financial auditors based on all applicable legal requirements. 2. The Leader of the WCA Financial Committee is the Treasurer of the WCA.

Best regards, Linus Fresz, on behalf of the World Cube Association

title.zh: WCA 认可国家名单调整
title.en: Changes of countries recognized by the WCA

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

我们在此通知大家，WCA 认可的国家名单将作调整。部分目前登记为代表相关国家的选手可能受到影响。

此前，WCA 使用的是一个由维基百科公开页面维护、另加入部分主权地区的名单。该名单存在不少不一致之处：一些列出的“国家”实际是另一国家的州或省，而一些地区虽是国家，却因当地地缘政治原因一直未被作为国家接纳。

调整后，WCA 将使用《WCA 认可国家名单》。新名单依据《联合国宪章》制定，列明选手在 WCA 比赛中可以代表的全部国家。相关规则也将一并更新，以消除规则与认可国家名单之间的不一致。

旧名单中有相当多项目并非正式获认可的国家，一些地位相同的地区也受到不同对待。因此，部分社区成员的登记将有变化。此次调整涉及阿鲁巴（现归入荷兰）和波多黎各（现归入美国）的选手。遗憾的是，此前阿鲁巴和波多黎各的所有国家纪录都将不再获认可。

部分名称也作了调整：

  • “Korea”改为“Republic of Korea”（大韩民国）。
  • “North Korea”改为“Democratic People’s Republic of Korea”（朝鲜民主主义人民共和国）。
  • “Macao”改为“Macau”（澳门）。
  • “Palestinian Territories”改为“Palestine”（巴勒斯坦）。

如果你受到影响，想了解更多情况，请通过 communication@worldcubeassociation.org 联系 WCA 沟通团队，我们会进一步说明这些调整的背景。
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

With this message, we inform you on a change regarding the countries that the WCA recognizes. This change may affect some of you who are currently registered for these countries.

In the current situation, the WCA uses a list that is maintained on a public Wikipedia page, extended with some sovereign areas. There are many inconsistencies on this list: some countries are just states or provinces of another country, some areas are countries but were never accepted as countries because of local geopolitical reasons. In the new situation, the WCA uses a list called the “WCA List of Recognized Countries”. This new list is based on the UN charter and defines all countries that are eligible to be represented by a competitor in WCA competitions. This change also involves an update of the relevant regulations, so that inconsistencies between the Regulations and the recognized countries will be resolved.

A significant number of countries on the previous list were not officially recognized countries and some territories were equivalent but treated differently. This leads to changes for some of our community members. These changes affect competitors from Aruba (now part of the Netherlands) and Puerto Rico (now part of the United States). Unfortunately, all former National Records of Aruba and Puerto Rico will not be recognized anymore.

Some countries were renamed:

  • "Korea" was changed to "Republic of Korea",
  • "North Korea" was changed to "Democratic People’s Republic of Korea",
  • "Macao" was changed to "Macau" and
  • "Palestinian Territories" was changed to "Palestine".

If you are affected by this and would like to get more information, please contact the WCA Communication Team via communication@worldcubeassociation.org and we will give you a bit more detail behind the changes.

title.zh: 征求社区对 WCA 章程的意见

html.zh:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

WCA 正在争取注册为非营利公益法人，相关法律设立程序已进入最后阶段。我们希望听取比赛组织者、经常参与 WCA 比赛的工作人员，以及其他深度参与社区的成员的意见。作为非营利组织，WCA 需要制定自己的章程。章程是在上级主管规则允许或规定的范围内，由组织或社区制定、用于规范自身运作的规则。换句话说，它就是 WCA 的运作手册。

请在评论或反馈前，仔细阅读全部公司设立章程。发表评论或建议前，请先登录并表明身份。无法确认身份的评论将不予考虑并被删除。这对 WCA 作为非营利组织的未来至关重要。章程一旦获批，将成为我们最初的组织章程文件。

此致

Linus Fresz，代表世界魔方协会
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

We hereby inform you about the WCA’s endeavor to become a Nonprofit Public Benefit Corporation! Our association is on its last stages to become legally constituted and we would like to have feedback from Organizers and regular Staff of WCA Competitions, as well as other highly involved members of the WCA Community. As necessary for a Nonprofit Organization, the WCA has developed its own Bylaws. Bylaws are defined as a rule or law established by an organization or community to regulate itself, as allowed or provided for by some higher authority. In other words, the Bylaws are the WCA’s operating manual.

You are kindly requested to read thoroughly all the Articles of Incorporation before proceeding to comment and give feedback. Please login and authenticate yourself before commenting or suggesting. Non identificated comments will be disregarded and removed. This is a matter of the highest importance for our future as a Nonprofit Organization. When the Bylaws get approved, they will become our initial constitution documents.

Best regards, Linus Fresz, on behalf of the World Cube Association

title.zh: WCA 沟通团队正式成立
title.en: Start up of the WCA Communication Team

html.zh:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

我们很高兴宣布，一个全新的团队——WCA 沟通团队（WCT）现已成立。

WCT 成员如下：

  • Linus Fresz（德国，团队负责人）
  • Lauren Klemz（美国）
  • Matthew McMillan（美国）
  • Thaynara Santana de Oliveira（巴西）

为满足新的沟通需求，WCA 软件团队已作出一些内部调整。特别说明，任何人都可以通过 communication@worldcubeassociation.org 联系我们。这是新团队默认、公开的官方邮箱。

我们的目标是与 WCA 各委员会合作，在近期改善 WCA 网站，加强 WCA 的对外沟通。另一个重要目标是更好地联系社区，我们希望通过社交媒体账号来实现。我们知道，不同国家常用的社交平台不同，因此会在近期尽量开设更多平台账号，联系各国社区。这些渠道将向社区和公众提供有关 WCA 的知识和内容。

欢迎关注我们的官方 Facebook 页面：https://www.facebook.com/WorldCubeAssociation/

此致

Linus Fresz，代表 WCA 沟通团队
html.en:
Dear WCA Community,

We are excited to announce a brand new committee: the WCA Communication Team (WCT). The WCT consists of the following members:

  • Linus Fresz (Germany, Team Leader)
  • Lauren Klemz (US)
  • Matthew McMillan (US)
  • Thaynara Santana de Oliveira (Brazil)

Some internal changes have been made by the WCA Software Team in order to accommodate our new necessities in communications. Important to mention is that anyone can reach us via the email address communication@worldcubeassociation.org. This is the default, public, and official email address of our new team.

Our goal is to work with all WCA Committees to improve the WCA website and increase the communication of the WCA in the near future. Another important step is to gain better connections to the community, which we want to accomplish via social media accounts. We are aware that different countries use different social media networks, so we will try to add more social media accounts to reach communities in all countries in the near future. These channels will be used to create knowledge and content about the WCA for our community and the general public. Please take a look at our official Facebook page: https://www.facebook.com/WorldCubeAssociation/

Best regards, Linus Fresz, on behalf of the WCA Communication Team

title.zh: TNoodle 0.11.5

html.zh:
TNoodle-WCA-0.11.5 现已可从https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles下载。

与 TNoodle 0.11.3 相比，作出了以下调整：

  • 新增为每一轮输出多份打乱纸的功能。
  • 修复删除一轮后再添加一轮，可能导致两个不同轮次生成相同打乱的问题。

请记住，正式比赛必须使用官方打乱程序当前的版本，可随时从https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles下载。
html.en:
TNoodle-WCA-0.11.5 is now available from https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles

The following changes have been made since TNoodle 0.11.3:

  • Added the possibility to get multiple copies of scrambles sheets for each rounds.
  • Fixed a bug where removing a round then adding a round would generate the same scrambles for two different rounds.

Please remember that official competitions must use the current version of the official scramble program. This is always available from: https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles

title.zh: TNoodle 0.11.3

html.zh:
TNoodle-WCA-0.11.3 现已可在 https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles 下载。

相比 TNoodle 0.11.1，有以下修改：

  • 修复了可能生成错误最少步打乱的问题。
  • 生成的 PDF 现在会嵌入字体，以便在不同平台上保持更一致的显示效果。
  • 修复了在 Chrome 中保存 PDF 时出现报错的问题。

请记住，正式比赛必须使用现行版本的官方打乱程序。下载地址始终为：https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles
html.en:
TNoodle-WCA-0.11.3 is now available from https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles

The following changes have been made since TNoodle 0.11.1:

  • Fixed a bug that could result in the generation of incorrect FMC scrambles.
  • Fonts are now embedded into the generated PDFs to ensure a more consistent look across platforms.
  • Fixed a bug that resulted in an error messages when saving a PDF in Chrome.

Please remember that official competitions must use the current version of the official scramble program. This is always available from: https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles

title.zh: Seung Hyuk Nahm 在中国北京夺得 2016 年亚洲锦标赛冠军

**世界纪录：**林恺俊（Kaijun Lin）：三盲平均 24.65；Kevin Hays：六阶单次 1:32.77、平均 1:42.36。

**亚洲纪录：**Arifumi Fushimi（伏見有史）：三阶单手平均 11.55；陈霖（Lin Chen）：六阶单次 1:46.21、平均 1:53.51，七阶单次 2:24.46、平均 2:28.78；Seung Hyuk Nahm（남승혁）：四阶平均 27.52、五阶单次 47.08；王鹰豪（Yinghao Wang）：二阶平均 1.68；陈裕铖（Yucheng Chen）：多盲单次 32/33，用时 57:04。

**北美洲纪录：**Kevin Hays：七阶单次 2:25.62。

**南美洲纪录：**Gianfranco Huanqui：四盲单次 3:36.41。
html.en:
Seung Hyuk Nahm (남승혁) won the Asian Championship 2016 with an average of 7.41 seconds. Mats Valk finished second (8.05) and Arifumi Fushimi (伏見有史) finished third (8.18).

World records: Kaijun Lin (林恺俊) 3x3 blindfolded 24.65 (average), Kevin Hays 6x6 Cube 1:32.77 (single), 6x6 Cube 1:42.36 (average).
Asian records: Arifumi Fushimi (伏見有史) 3x3 one-handed 11.55 (average), Lin Chen (陈霖) 6x6 Cube 1:46.21 (single), 6x6 Cube 1:53.51 (average), 7x7 Cube 2:24.46 (single), 7x7 Cube 2:28.78 (average), Seung Hyuk Nahm (남승혁) 4x4 Cube 27.52 (average), 5x5 Cube 47.08 (single), Yinghao Wang (王鹰豪) 2x2 Cube 1.68 (average), Yucheng Chen (陈裕铖) 3x3 multi blind 32/33 57:04 (single).
North American records: Kevin Hays 7x7 Cube 2:25.62 (single).
South American records: Gianfranco Huanqui 4x4 blindfolded 3:36.41 (single).

title.zh: 悼念 François Courtès

html.zh:
我们的朋友、魔友 François Courtès 于 2016 年 9 月 7 日晚因脑血管意外去世，年仅 45 岁。这是一个令人悲痛的消息。

在《悼念 François Courtès》主题中，魔友们表达哀思，回忆与 François 相处的往事。我们中的许多人都会怀念他。
html.en:
Our friend and fellow cuber François Courtès died in the evening of September 7, 2016, from a cerebrovascular accident. He was 45 years old. It is very sad news.

In our In Memoriam: François Courtès fellow cubers express their feelings and bring back memories about François. He will be missed by many of us.

title.zh: WCA 规则更新：2016 年 4 月

html.zh:
新版规则与指南将于 2016 年 4 月 18 日生效。

现行规则始终可从 https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/ 获取。

2015 年版至 2016 年版的完整改动，请在 GitHub 上查看差异。

主要改动如下：

  • 明确观察结束后、启动计时器前将魔方放在垫子之外的处罚为加 2 秒。（#343 | 347）
  • 同一打乱序列应在最长 2 小时的时间范围内使用。（#295 | 342）
  • 明确可以为多个项目合并设置累计时限。（#296 | 334）
  • 允许使用第四代 Pro 计时器计时。（无对应 issue | 333）
  • 魔表同一侧的各按针必须不可区分；还原后按针帽缺失不影响魔表是否已还原的判定。（#189 | 329）
  • 明确最少步项目的裁判也可以参赛。（#165 | 329）
  • 明确还原时可以使用身体的任何部位，脚拧和单手项目除外。（#300 | 324）
  • 垫子的最小尺寸规定为左右 30 厘米、前后 25 厘米。（#304 | 335）
  • 建议额外还原紧接在被替换的那次还原之后进行。（无对应 issue | 341）
  • 一个项目可安排的最大轮数，现在根据每一轮的选手人数确定，而不再根据整个项目的选手人数确定。（#314 | 346）
  • 最少步项目允许所有类型的贴纸，删除了“有色”这一限制。（#68 | 329）
  • 如果选手观察时忘记取下 Square-1 用于对齐层的卡片，可以在还原过程中将其取下。（#315 | 323）
  • 明确可以为整场比赛设置人数上限，而不只是为单个项目设置。（#311 和 #325 | #327）
  • 补充说明如何处理与打乱逆序相似的最少步解法。（#344 | 348）
  • 采用累计时限时，选手一旦达到时限，该轮剩余各次还原均记为 DNS。（#303 | 353）
html.en:
A new version of the Regulations and Guidelines is going into effect April 18th, 2016.

The current Regulations are always available from https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/

For an exact list of all changes from 2015 to 2016, view the differences on GitHub.

Summary of changes:

  • The penalty for putting the puzzle outside the mat after the inspection phase and before starting the timer was defined as +2. (#343 | 347)

  • Scramble sequences should be used in a maximum time frame of 2 hours. (#295 | 342)

  • It has been clarified that cumulative time limits can be defined for a combination of events. (#296 | 334)

  • Generation 4 Pro Timers may be used for time measurement. (no issue | 333)

  • Clock pins must not be identifiable from any other pin on the same side and the solved state of Clock is not affected by pin caps missing after the solve. (#189 | 329)

  • It was explicitly clarified that judges in Fewest Moves are allowed to compete. (#165 | 329)

  • It was clarified that every part of the body may be used during solves (except in Feet and One-Handed Solving). (#300 | 324)

  • The minimum size of a mat was defined as 30 cm (left to right) by 25 cm (front to back). (#304 | 335)

  • It is now recommended that extra attempts should be done right after the attempt they replace. (no issue | 341)

  • The maximum number of rounds in an event is now defined by the number of competitors in every round (instead of the number of competitors in the event). (#314 | 346)

  • All types of stickers are allowed in Fewest Moves (the word "coloured" was removed). (#68 | 329)

  • The tab used for alignment of the layers in Square-1 may be removed during the attempt if the competitor forgot to remove it in the inspection phase. (#315 | 323)

  • It has been clarified that the number of competitors may be limited per competition and not only per event. (#311 and #325 | #327)

  • A clarification for Fewest Moves solutions that are similar to the inverse of the scramble sequence has been added. (#344 | 348)

  • In case of a cumulative time limit, the result of each remaining attempt in the round is recorded as DNS after a competitor reaches the time limit. (#303 | 353)

title.zh: TNoodle 0.11.1 发布

html.zh:
TNoodle-WCA-0.11.1 现已发布，可在 https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles 获取。

相较于 TNoodle 0.10.0，本次改动如下：

  • 五魔方和 Square-1 的配色改为目前广泛使用的配色。
  • 修改最少步打乱的生成流程。最少步打乱现在更长，打乱序列不再与其生成的魔方状态直接相关。具体来说，所有最少步打乱序列的开头和结尾均补上 R' U' F。

请注意，正式比赛必须使用当前版本的官方打乱程序。最新版始终可在 https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles 获取。
html.en:
TNoodle-WCA-0.11.1 is now available from https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles

The following change has been made since TNoodle 0.10.0:

  • The colour scheme of Megaminx and Square-1 has been changed to the ones widely used today.
  • The scramble generation process for Fewest Moves has been changed. Fewest Moves scrambles are now longer and the scramble sequence is no longer directly related to the puzzle state they produce. In particular, all scramble sequences for Fewest Moves are padded with the moves "R' U' F" at the beginning and the end.

Please remember that official competitions must use the current version of the official scramble program. This is always available from: https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles

title.zh: 悼念 Anders Larsson

html.zh:
我们亲爱的朋友 Anders Larsson 于 2015 年 8 月 6 日在韩国意外坠落身亡，年仅 51 岁。

在《悼念 Anders Larsson》中，我们回顾了 Anders 在 WCA 发展过程中发挥的重要作用。

我们中的许多人都会怀念 Anders。与他共度的美好时光，永远不会被遗忘。
html.en:
Our dear friend Anders Larsson died in a tragic accident, falling from height in South Korea on August 6, 2015. He was only 51 years old.

In our In Memoriam: Anders Larsson we summarise the important role of Anders in the development of WCA.

Anders will be missed by many of us. All the great moments we had with Anders will never be forgotten.

title.zh: Feliks Zemdegs 夺得 2015 年魔方世锦赛冠军
title.en: Feliks Zemdegs wins World Rubik's Cube Championship 2015

html.zh:
Feliks Zemdegs以 7.56 秒的平均成绩夺得 2015 年魔方世锦赛冠军。Mats Valk以 8.56 秒获得亚军，Jakub Kipa以 8.63 秒获得季军。

**世界纪录：**Feliks Zemdegs：七阶单次 2:23.55、平均 2:33.73；Jan Bentlage：斜转单次 1.68；Kevin Hays：六阶平均 1:46.41、平均 1:45.98。

**大洋洲纪录：**Feliks Zemdegs：三阶单次 5.60、单次 5.39，五魔平均 50.75；Jayden McNeill：三阶脚拧单次 1:20.35、平均 1:32.15。

**欧洲纪录：**Michał Pleskowicz：三阶单手单次 8.48。

**北美洲纪录：**Kevin Hays：五阶单次 51.26、平均 55.66，七阶单次 2:30.35。

**南美洲纪录：**Felipe Rueda Hernández：五魔平均 51.24；Gianfranco Huanqui：三盲单次 21.83、五盲单次 13:53.00；João Pedro Batista Ribeiro Costa：最少步平均 25.67；Pedro Alejandro Condo Tellez：六阶平均 2:07.81，七阶单次 3:11.59、平均 3:28.92、平均 3:33.26；Pedro Henrique da Silva Roque：四阶单次 27.73、平均 32.15，五阶平均 1:03.32。
html.en:
Feliks Zemdegs won the World Rubik's Cube Championship 2015 with an average of 7.56 seconds. Mats Valk finished second (8.56) and Jakub Kipa finished third (8.63).

World records: Feliks Zemdegs 7x7 Cube 2:23.55 (single), 7x7 Cube 2:33.73 (average), Jan Bentlage Skewb 1.68 (single), Kevin Hays 6x6 Cube 1:46.41 (average), 6x6 Cube 1:45.98 (average).

Oceanian records: Feliks Zemdegs Rubik's Cube 5.60 (single), Rubik's Cube 5.39 (single), Megaminx 50.75 (average), Jayden McNeill 3x3 with feet 1:20.35 (single), 3x3 with feet 1:32.15 (average).

European records: Michał Pleskowicz 3x3 one-handed 8.48 (single).

North American records: Kevin Hays 5x5 Cube 51.26 (single), 5x5 Cube 55.66 (average), 7x7 Cube 2:30.35 (single).

South American records: Felipe Rueda Hernández Megaminx 51.24 (average), Gianfranco Huanqui 3x3 blindfolded 21.83 (single), 5x5 blindfolded 13:53.00 (single), João Pedro Batista Ribeiro Costa 3x3 fewest moves 25.67 (average), Pedro Alejandro Condo Tellez 6x6 Cube 2:07.81 (average), 7x7 Cube 3:11.59 (single), 7x7 Cube 3:28.92 (average), 7x7 Cube 3:33.26 (average), Pedro Henrique da Silva Roque 4x4 Cube 27.73 (single), 4x4 Cube 32.15 (average), 5x5 Cube 1:03.32 (average).

title.zh: TNoodle 0.10.0 发布

html.zh:
为配合明天生效的 WCA 规则更新，TNoodle-WCA-0.10.0 现已可从 https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles 下载。

与 TNoodle 0.9.0 相比，本次作出了以下修改：

  • 金字塔打乱所要求的最短还原步数由 7 步降为 6 步。

请记住，官方比赛必须始终使用当前版本的官方打乱程序。最新版本可从以下页面获取：https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/
html.en:
TNoodle-WCA-0.10.0 is now available from https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles, in anticipation of tomorrow's update to the WCA Regulations.

The following change has been made since TNoodle 0.9.0:

  • The Pyraminx scrambling limit has been lowered from 7 moves to 6 moves.

Please remember that official competitions must always use the current version of the official scramble program. This is always available from: https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/

title.zh: WCA 规则更新：2015 年 7 月

html.zh:
新版规则与指南将于 2015 年 7 月 1 日生效。打乱程序也将于近期更新，以配合这些改动。

现行规则始终可从 https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/ 获取。

2014 年版至 2015 年版的完整改动，请在 GitHub 上查看差异。

主要改动如下：

  • 允许使用无贴纸魔方。（#177 | 580ea35、a4e289c）
  • 当事件的处理结果尚不明确时，可以暂时安排选手进行额外还原，待后续决定是否采用。（#245 | dd7527e）
  • 增加了安排额外还原的建议标准流程。（#228 | 45cf5a5）
  • 对于单独排定时间的某次还原，选手可以记为 DNS，且仍有资格参加之后的还原。（#263 | 3711345）
  • 选手不得以故意取得较差成绩或 DNF 为目的参赛。（#203、#225 | ba0308c）
  • 对于因比赛经验不足而出现问题的新人，可以安排额外还原。但只能重新进行完整的一次还原，不能免除单项处罚。（#251 | 65c3e7e）
  • 主办方可以要求使用物件固定 Square-1，防止送往计时台的途中状态改变。如使用这类卡片，选手须在观察期间将其取下，主办团队也须明确告知选手。（#192 | 3dc5d83、1946e9a）
  • 明确在未遵守 WCA 规则的情况下，董事会有权修改成绩。（#262 | 5b002e0）
  • 强烈建议为计时器安装 O 形圈，并在电池仓内加装缓冲垫。（#235、#243 | 67ab825）
  • 一次还原流程结束前，选手不得将计时器复位；同时明确裁判不得凭记忆填写成绩。（#206、#218、#222、#230 | e5a4879、fb14ded）
  • 允许选手在最少步比赛中使用时钟掌握时间。（#217 | afea552）
  • 明确选手不必使用指定的最少步答题纸提交解法。（#215 | a0382d7）
  • 主办团队可以要求采取更严格的措施，确保打乱正确。（#214 | 9d7c310）
  • 金字塔打乱须至少需要 6 步才能还原，由原来的 7 步下调，与当时金字塔世界纪录解法的步数一致。（#213 | 49c8503）
  • 明确允许使用相机，但选手不得与其交互。（#178 | c24c70d、04cdc58、8699359）
  • 明确还原开始前未将计时器复位属于裁判失误，应给予选手额外还原。（#260 | 52a4a03）
  • 魔表打乱的起始朝向不要求以特定一面朝前。（#269 | 3cd54d8）
  • 不允许通过视频证据恢复被选手复位清除的计时成绩。（#270 | 718f5a0）
  • 进一步说明为视力障碍选手提供的例外安排。（#271 | a9693fb）
  • 明确耗时较长项目中 Stackmat 垫子的使用要求。（#273 | 4529c5b）
html.en:
A new version of the Regulations and Guidelines is going into effect July 1, 2015. The scramble program will be updated soon to accommodate these changes.

The current Regulations are always available from https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/

For an exact list of changes from 2014 to 2015, view differences on GitHub.

Summary of changes:

  • Stickerless puzzles are permitted. ( #177 | 580ea35, a4e289c)
  • Competitors may be given tentative extra attempts during incidents with an unclear outcome. ( #245 | dd7527e)
  • A recommended standard procedure for giving extra attempts is described. ( #228 | 45cf5a5)
  • Competitors may DNS an individually scheduled attempt and still be eligible for future attempts. ( #263 | 3711345)
  • Competitors must not compete with the intent of intentionally poor results or a DNF. ( #203, #225 | ba0308c)
  • Newer competitors may be given an extra attempt for their inexperience in a competition. This only allows a full extra attempt, and does not allow ignoring individual penalties. ( #251 | 65c3e7e)
  • Organizers may enforce the use of an object to prevent a Square-1 from being altered in transport to the timing station. If used, competitors must remove this object during inspection, and the organization team must make it clear that such a tab is being used. ( #192 | 3dc5d83, 1946e9a)
  • It has been explicitly clarified that the Board has the ability to modify results when the WCA Regulations have not been observed. ( #262 | 5b002e0)
  • O-rings and padded battery compartments for timers are strongly recommended. ( #235, #243 | 67ab825)
  • Competitors must not reset the timer until the end of the attempt, and it has been explicitly clarified that judges must not write down times from memory. ( #206, #218, #222, #230 | e5a4879, fb14ded)
  • Competitors are allowed to use a clock during FMC to keep track of time. ( #217 | afea552)
  • It has been explicitly clarified that competitors don’t need to turn in their solution on an FMC sheet ( #215 | a0382d7).
  • The organization team may require stronger measures to ensure correct scrambles. ( #214 | 9d7c310)
  • Pyraminx must require at least 6 moves to solve (rather than 7), matching the number of moves in the current Pyraminx world record solution. ( #213 | 49c8503)
  • Cameras are explicitly permitted as long as the competitor is not interacting with them ( #178 | c24c70d, 04cdc58, 8699359).
  • It has been explicitly clarified that not resetting the timer before an attempt is the judge’s fault, and results in an extra attempt. ( #260 | 52a4a03)
  • The starting orientation of the clock does not specify a certain side of the clock for scrambling. ( #269 | 3cd54d8)
  • Using video evidence to recover a time that a competitor reset is not allowed. ( #270 | 718f5a0)
  • Exceptions given to competitors with visual disabilites have been further described. ( #271 | a9693fb)
  • The use of the Stackmat mat in long events has been explicitly clarified. ( #273 | 4529c5b)

Sei Sugama (洲鎌星) won the Asian Championship 2014 with an average of 9.47 seconds. Seung Hyuk Nahm (남승혁) finished second (9.57) and Mitsuki Gunji (郡司光貴) finished third (9.64).

title.zh: 打乱程序更新：TNoodle 0.8.2

html.zh:
TNoodle 0.8.2 现已可从 https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles 下载。

与 TNoodle 0.8.0 相比，本次修复包括：

  • 重新生成打乱时保持轮次顺序不变。
  • 修复了合并连续转动时的错误。该问题不影响随机性，但多余的转动可能让比赛中的打乱员感到困惑。

请记住，官方比赛必须始终使用当前版本的官方打乱程序。最新版本可从以下页面获取：https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/
html.en:
TNoodle 0.8.2 is now available from https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles

This addresses the following compared to TNoodle 0.8.0:

  • 2x2x2 scrambles only use <R, U, F> moves again.
  • Regenerating scrambles preserves the order of rounds.
  • A bug for merging consecutive moves has been fixed. (This does not affect randomness, but redundant turns may look confusing to scramblers at a competition.)

Please remember that official competitions must always use the current version of the official scramble program. This is always available from: https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/

title.zh: 打乱程序更新：TNoodle 0.8.0

html.zh:

html.en:
The final release of TNoodle 0.8.0 is now available from https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles

Please remember that official competitions must always use the current version of the official scramble program. This is always available from: https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/

title.zh: 2014 年 WCA 竞赛规则与指南

html.zh:
新版《竞赛规则与指南》将于 2014 年 1 月 1 日生效。打乱程序将很快更新，以适应这些改动；成绩数据也将按赛制变更作相应更新。

现行规则始终可在 https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/ 查看。

2013 年至 2014 年版本的详细改动，请查看 GitHub 版本差异。

改动概要请见完整公告。

主要改动

  • 斜转成为正式项目。（#102 / 66d6da9）
    • 斜转有趣，也适合开展比赛，社区对此有较大兴趣。
  • 明确允许使用的魔方：不再允许用厚贴片或涂漆、印刷的颜色替代薄贴片、贴纸。盲拧用魔方的贴纸或贴片必须无法通过触感区分，并明确了允许使用的标识。（#13、#33 / cd138cd）
    • 这有助于选手和代表对魔方是否合规作出一致判断。
  • 三阶多盲只成功还原一个魔方时，成绩记为 DNF。已有成绩仍获认可并参与排名。（#105 / 73276cd）
    • 这要求选手遵循项目的本意，尤其是防止选手报名尝试两个魔方，却只打算还原其中一个。
  • 三阶最少步现在可采用“三次平均”轮次赛制。（#81 / dc182c8）
    • 对于能够安排三次尝试的大型比赛，这可以减少最少步成绩中的运气因素。
  • 三阶盲拧“三次取最佳”轮次将认可平均成绩的排名和纪录，也适用于已有的“三次取最佳”成绩。（#111 / 5660ed5）
    • 社区对认可这些成绩有较大兴趣。由于轮次赛制未变，选手无须为争取比赛名次而改变比赛策略。
  • 对于设有“三次平均”赛制的项目，移除“三次取最佳”这一赛制选项。（#109 / 2685170）
    • 两种赛制所需资源大致相同，因此应采用更合适的赛制。2012 年和 2013 年几乎所有比赛都已这样做。
  • 选手为尚未进行的还原提前签名，将被记为 DNS。（#63 / 692fec6）
    • 这要求选手逐次确认每次还原，符合规则 A7c 的本意。
  • 取消资格赛轮次。（#49 / 49fa8c1）
    • 自 2010 年以来，只有两场比赛经代表酌情决定采用过资格赛轮次。
  • 五魔方被列入打乱错误后打乱员无须纠正的项目名单。（#61 / fcba232）
    • 重新打乱耗时较长，错误较难察觉，且不会显著影响打乱难度。
  • 主办方或代表必须将比赛纸质记录保留至少一个月。（#78 / e12b7c7）
    • 这为核查成绩录入错误规定了统一的保存期限。

详细改动

  • 多处小幅简化和修正。
  • 明确打乱序列和打乱筛选限制。（#48 / 9f2d078）
  • 明确一次尝试从选手确认准备就绪时开始，见规则 A3b2。这区分了“尝试开始”与“还原开始”，后者发生在规则 A4b 所述时刻。（#93、#104、#110 / 7ccdff4）
  • 将项目的“比赛赛制”改称“轮次赛制”。（#55 / 68264a9）
  • 明确打乱程序必须在比赛举行时仍为官方认可版本。（#85 / b307a84）
  • 明确单手还原允许借助桌面。（#10 / 9ca578f）
  • 明确记录不完整或字迹不清的成绩如何处理。（#101 / 8956f30）
  • 规定无观察时间的项目（即盲拧项目）的打乱序列必须生成随机朝向。（#74 / 913c5ca）
  • 将“Multiple Outer Slice Moves”改称“Outer Block Moves”（外层块转动），与“Outer Block Turn Metric”（外层块转动度量制）统一用语。（#9 / a1cfbd5）
  • 明确选手申报计划尝试的魔方数量时的权利和责任。（#94 / 8246735）
  • 明确 Square-1 未对齐的判定。（#130 / 8060032）

未作改动的事项

  • 魔表的官方记号仍沿用 2013 年的“新”记号。我们正在考虑更新打乱程序，同时显示“新”记号与 2013 年之前的“旧”记号。
  • 还原结束时未对齐的加罚 2 秒规定不变。
html.en:
A new version of the Regulations and Guidelines is going into effect January 1, 2014. The scramble program will be updated soon to accommodate these changes, and the results will be updated with format changes.

The current Regulations are always available from https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/

For an exact list of changes from 2013 to 2014, view differences on GitHub.

For a summarized list of changes, please visit the full announcement.

Main Changes

  • Skewb has been added as an official event. ( #102 / 66d6da9)
    • Skewb is interesting and practical, and there is significant community interest.
  • Regulations about permitted puzzles have been clarified: Thick tiles or painted/printed colors are no longer allowed instead of (thin) tiles/stickers. Stickers/tiles must be indistinguishable by feel for BLD. Permissible logos have been clarified. ( #13, #33 / cd138cd)
    • This allows competitors and Delegates to come to consistent decisions about what puzzles are allowed.
  • For Rubik's Cube: Multiple Blindfolded, a single solved cube will be considered DNF. Existing results are still recognized/ranked. ( #105 / 73276cd)
    • This requires competitors to satisfy the intent of the event. In particular, it prevents competitors from attempting 2 with the intention of solving only 1.
  • Rubik's Cube: Fewest Moves may now be held using a "Mean of 3" round format. ( #81 / dc182c8)
    • This reduces the role of luck in FMC for large competitions that can hold 3 attempts.
  • For Rubik's Cube: Blindfolded "Best of 3" rounds, rankings and records of the mean will be recognized. This also applies to existing "Best of 3" results. ( #111 / 5660ed5)
    • There is significant interest in recognizing these results. Since it does not change the round format, it does not require competitors to change their competition strategy for placing in competition.
  • The "Best of 3" round format has been removed as an option for events that have a "Mean of 3" format. ( #109 / 2685170)
    • Both formats take roughly the same resources, so the preferred format should be used. Almost all competitions followed this in 2012 and 2013.
  • Competitors who "pre-sign" for future attempts will now receive DNS results. ( #63 / 692fec6)
    • This requires competitors to acknowledge every attempt, in the spirit of Regulation A7c.
  • Qualification rounds have been removed. ( #49 / 49fa8c1)
    • Only two competitions have used qualification rounds since 2010. (at the discretion of the Delegate).
  • Megaminx has been added to the list of puzzles that scramblers do not need to correct if they are scrambled incorrectly ( #61 / fcba232)
    • Rescrambling takes significant time, errors are more subtle and do not have a large effect on difficulty of the scramble.
  • Organizers/Delegates must keep physical competition records at least one month. ( #78 / e12b7c7)
    • This sets a standard time frame for being able to check transcription mistakes.

Detailed Changes

  • Various small simplifications and corrections.
  • Specify scramble sequences and scramble filtering limits. ( #48 / 9f2d078)
  • Clarify that an attempt begins when the competitor acknowledges readiness Regulation A3b2. This distinguishes the beginning of the attempt from the beginning of the solve (which takes place in Regulation A4b). ( #93, #104, #110 / 7ccdff4)
  • Change event "competition format" to "round format". ( #55 / 68264a9)
  • Clarify that the scramble program must be official at the time of the competition. ( #85 / b307a84)
  • Clarify that use of the surface is allowed for OH. ( #10 / 9ca578f)
  • Clarify what to do with incomplete/illegible results. ( #101 / 8956f30)
  • Specify that scramble sequences must generate a random orientation for non-inspection (i.e. BLD) events. ( #74 / 913c5ca)
  • Rename "Multiple Outer Slice Moves" to "Outer Block Moves" for consistency with "Outer Block Turn Metric". ( #9 / a1cfbd5)
  • Clarify competitor rights and responsibilities for submitting the number of cubes they wish to attempt. ( #94 / 8246735)
  • Clarify Square-1 misalignments ( #130 / 8060032)

Non-Changes

  • Official clock notation will remain the same "new" notation from 2013. We are considering updating the scramble program to display both the "new" notation along with the "old" (pre-2013) one.
  • No changes regarding the +2 time penalty for misalignments at the end of the attempt.

  • 在 README 中说明打乱筛选方式。

请记住，官方比赛必须始终使用当前版本的官方打乱程序。最新版本可从以下页面获取：https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/
html.en:
The WRC is changing the official scrambling program from TNoodle 0.7.8 to TNoodle 0.7.12. This addresses two minor issues:

  • Remove the reference to slice moves in the FMC sheet. (Slice moves have never been allowed since TNoodle has been official.)
  • Document scramble filtering in the readme.

Please remember that official competitions must always use the current version of the official scramble program. This is always available from: https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/

title.zh: WRC 规则公告栏目上线

html.zh:
从 5 月 21 日的更新开始，WCA 规则与指南的所有重要更新，都将由 WCA 规则委员会（WRC）在 www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/announcements 发布公告。

这些公告也会在 WCA 首页置顶一段时间，方便大家看到。

WRC 会尽量只在一周的前半段（星期一至星期三）公布并实施这些改动，让代表和选手有时间了解变化，也能及时反馈紧急问题。

不过，我们仍建议代表和选手在比赛中使用保存或打印的规则前，先核对现行英文规则所标注的日期。

WRC 公告列表可在 https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/announcements/ 查看。

也可通过 RSS 订阅 WRC 公告：https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/announcements/rss.xml
html.en:
Starting with the May 21 update, all significant updates to the WCA Regulations and/or Guidelines will be announced by the WRC in a post at www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/announcements Such posts will also be made “sticky” on the main WCA homepage for a while, so that they are always at the top of the page.

The WRC will try to make sure such changes are only announced and put into effect at the beginning of the week (Monday-Wednesday), so that Delegates and competitors have time to learn of the changes (and respond with any urgent feedback).

Nevertheless, delegates and competitors are always encouraged to check the date listed on the current English Regulations before using a saved/printed version as reference for a competition.

It is possible to view a feed of WRC announcements at https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/announcements/

A RSS feed of WRC announcements is also available at https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/announcements/rss.xml

title.zh: 规则与指南更新：5 月 21 日

html.zh:
根据 5 月 11 日规则更新后收到的反馈，WRC 对规则和指南作出以下修改。这些修改涉及一次尝试结束时的魔方故障：

  • 修正 5b5d 和 5b5++ 的措辞。
  • 简化 5b5+ 和 5b5++ 中的示例。

这些修改适用于从 2013 年 5 月 21 日起举行的所有正式比赛。

这些修改不应改变规则的原意，而是希望帮助代表和选手更准确地理解规则。

新版规则见 https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/。

具体修改记录可在 GitHub 查看。
html.en:
In response to feedback after the May 11 update to the Regulations, the WRC is updating the Regulations and Guidelines with the following changes. These changes are about puzzle defects at the end of an attempt:

  • Phrasing corrections for 5b5d and 5b5++.
  • Simplifications of the examples in 5b5+ and 5b5++.

This change is effective for all official competitions starting May 21, 2013.

These changes should not affect the meaning of the Regulations, but will hopefully help delegates and competitors interpret them better.

The new Regulations are available at https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/

A history of exact changes is available on GitHub.

title.zh: 悼念 Raj Gala

html.zh:
亲爱的社区成员：

2013 年 1 月 29 日，来自印度的 WCA 社区成员 Raj Gala 因登革热去世，年仅 18 岁。

Raj 参加过 3 场 WCA 比赛，五魔方单次和平均均排名印度第 5。

在 WCA 论坛上，WCA 代表 Gaurav Taneja 以及 Raj 的朋友 Yogesh 和 Bhargav 写下了对他的回忆：他是印度魔方社区中一位友善、乐于助人的成员。

我们向 Raj 的家人和朋友致以深切慰问。

Ron van Bruchem

WCA 董事会
html.en:
Dear community,

On January 29, 2013 our fellow WCA member Raj Gala from India passed away due to Dengue fever. He was 18 years old.

Raj competed in 3 WCA competitions and was ranked #5 in India for Megaminx (single and average).

On the WCA Forum WCA delegate Gaurav Taneja and Raj's friends Yogesh and Bhargav write about Raj as a helpful and kind member of the Indian community.

Our thoughts and sympathy go out to Raj's family and friends.

Ron van Bruchem WCA Board

title.zh: WCA 文件更新：2013 年 1 月 1 日生效

html.zh:
大家好：

世界魔方协会已发布新版文件，自 2013 年 1 月 1 日起生效。全部文件可通过 https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/ 查看。

WCA 竞赛规则即日起生效，适用于所有经世界魔方协会认可的官方比赛。WCA 指南作为规则的补充。规则本身应视为完整文件，而指南提供额外的澄清和解释。

WCA 也新增了一款可用于官方比赛的打乱程序 TNoodle，同样可从上述链接下载。

特别感谢：

  • WCA 董事会（Tyson Mao、Ron van Bruchem、Tim Reynolds、Sébastien Auroux）、独立顾问委员会（Anders Larsson）、众多 WCA 代表以及社区成员提供的建设性反馈和审阅意见。
  • TNoodle 官方 WCA 打乱程序项目的主要负责人和首席架构师 Jeremy Fleischman。
  • 最后，感谢整个 WRC 委员会（Clément Gallet、Lucas Garron、Sébastien Auroux、Shelley Chang 和我本人）的持续努力。每位 WRC 成员都花了大量时间收集资料、审阅代表和社区反馈，并讨论规则的利弊。

新年快乐！
html.en:
Hello all,

The World Cube Association has released a new set of documents, effective January 1, 2013. All documents can be accessed via https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/.

The WCA Regulations go into effect immediately, and govern all official competitions sanctioned by the World Cube Association. The WCA Regulations are also supplemented by the WCA Guidelines. The Regulations should be considered a complete document, but the Guidelines contain additional clarifications and explanations.

The WCA has also added another scramble program to be used for official competitions; TNoodle can also be found at the link above.

Special thanks to:

  • The WCA Board (Tyson Mao, Ron van Bruchem, Tim Reynolds, and Sébastien Auroux), Independent Advisory Committee (Anders Larsson), the WCA Delegates (too many to list) and members of the community for constructive feedback and review;
  • Jeremy Fleischman, the point man and lead architect of the TNoodle Official WCA Scrambler project; and lastly,
  • The entire WRC committee (Clément Gallet, Lucas Garron, Sébastien Auroux, Shelley Chang, and myself) for their their tireless efforts. Each of the members of the WRC spent an inordinate amount of time collecting data, reviewing Delegate and community feedback, and debating the merits of the WCA Regulations.

Happy New Year!

title.zh: Tim Reynolds 和 Sébastien Auroux 加入 WCA 董事会
title.en: Tim Reynolds and Sébastien Auroux in WCA Board

html.zh:
各位社区成员：

WCA 董事会已任命 Tim Reynolds 和 Sébastien Auroux 为董事会成员。

Tim Reynolds 来自美国波士顿，自 2005 年起加入 WCA，一直积极组织比赛并担任 WCA 代表。他在成绩团队任职期间，为 WCA 作出了重要贡献。

Sébastien Auroux 来自德国亚琛，自 2008 年起加入 WCA，同样积极组织比赛并担任代表。他通过参与 WCA 规则委员会的工作，以及推动 WCA 在德国的发展，为组织作出了贡献。

在董事会中，Tim 将负责网站和成绩团队的日常运作；Sébastien 将负责 WCA 竞赛规则，以及跟进涉嫌违反规则的事件。

WCA 董事会也在评估来自亚洲的董事候选人。

祝 Tim 和 Sébastien 履新顺利，代表社区继续推动 WCA 发展。

祝大家玩魔方愉快！

Tyson Mao 和 Ron van Bruchem

WCA 联合主席
html.en:
Dear members of our community,

The WCA Board has appointed Tim Reynolds and Sébastien Auroux as members of the WCA Board.

Tim Reynolds, from Boston (USA) has been a member of WCA since 2005 and is an active competition organiser and WCA delegate. Tim made important contributions to WCA as a member of the Results team. Sébastien Auroux, from Aachen (Germany) has been a member of WCA since 2008 and is an active competition organiser and WCA delegate. Sébastien contributed to WCA as part of the WCA Regulations Committee and by developing WCA in Germany.

In the WCA Board Tim will be responsible for the daily operations of the website and the Results team. Sébastien will be responsible for the WCA Regulations and the follow-up on alleged violations of the regulations.

WCA Board is also evaluating candidates from Asia for a position in the board.

We wish Tim and Sébastien good luck in their new positions to represent our community and further develop WCA.

Cube regards,

Tyson Mao and Ron van Bruchem Co-chairmen of WCA

title.zh: 2010 年 WCA 竞赛规则定稿

html.zh:
2010 年 WCA 竞赛规则现已定稿。

新版规则：https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations

全部修改：https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/regulations\_history2010.html

标注所有改动的 2010 年规则：https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/regulations2010new.html

2010 年规则 PDF：https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/WCARegulations2010.pdf

从今天（2010 年 4 月 14 日）起开始的所有比赛，必须使用新版规则。

最重要的变化：

  • 五魔方的推荐赛制现改为“五次去尾平均”。

其他与选手有关的变化：

  • 计时器故障的处理更严格：计时器显示 0.01–0.05 秒时给予补赛，除非是选手故意造成；显示 0.06 秒或以上时判 DNF，除非故障可以复现。
  • 现在允许使用带纹理或涂色的魔方。
  • 盲拧：选手必须自备眼罩。
  • 最少步：解法最多包含 80 次转动和／或整体转动。
  • 八板：不得在计时器上进行练习还原。

其他与比赛组织者有关的变化：

  • WCA 代表现负责提供打乱。
  • 打乱程序有所改进。
  • 至少 25% 的选手不得晋级下一轮。

感谢大家的反馈和贡献。我们已尽力考虑所有意见，但不可能让每个人都满意。欢迎继续在 WCA 论坛反馈。

祝大家玩魔方愉快！

Ron van Bruchem

世界魔方协会
html.en:
The WCA Regulations 2010 are now final.

See https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations for the new version. See https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/regulations\_history2010.html for all changes. See https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/regulations2010new.html for the 2010 version with all changes marked. See https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/WCARegulations2010.pdf for the 2010 version in PDF.

All competitions starting today (April 14, 2010) must use this new version of the regulations.

Most important changes are: = Preferred format for Megaminx is now 'Average of 5'.

Other changes for competitors: = Stricter rules for timer malfunctions. Timer shows 0.01 - 0.05: extra attempt (unless intentional by competitor). Timer shows 0.06 or higher: DNF (unless reproducible malfunctioning). = Puzzles with textures or painted colours are now accepted. = Blindfolded: Competitors must bring their own blindfold. = Fewest moves: Solutions maximum 80 moves and/or rotations. = Magic: No practice solves on timer.

Other changes for competition organisers: = WCA delegate is now responsible for providing the scrambles. = Improved scramble programs. = At least 25% of competitors must not proceed to round.

Thank you all for your feedback and contributions. We did our best to cover all your feedback, but it is never possible to make everyone happy. Feedback is always welcome in the WCA Forum.

Happy cubing,

Ron van Bruchem World Cube Association

  • 可以限制某些项目组合的兼报。

与比赛主办方有关的其他修改：

  • 如果 WCA 代表同时担任主裁判，主裁判可以参加该项目。
  • 二阶必须使用新打乱程序生成的随机状态打乱。
  • 金字塔必须使用新打乱程序生成的随机状态打乱。
  • 缩小了封闭比赛的可选范围。
  • 最少步项目增加剩余时间提醒。

感谢大家的反馈和贡献。 我们尽力考虑了所有反馈，但不可能让每个人都满意。 欢迎继续在 WCA 论坛提出意见。

祝大家玩魔方愉快！

Ron van Bruchem 世界魔方协会
html.en:
The WCA Regulations 2009 are now final.

See https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations for the new version. See https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/regulations\_history2009.html for all changes. See https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/regulations2009new.html for the 2009 version with all changes marked. See https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/WCARegulations2009v1.pdf for the 2009 version in PDF.

All competitions starting today (February 6, 2009) must use this new version of the regulations.

Most important changes are: = Added 6x6x6 Cube and 7x7x7 Cube as official events. = Preferred format for Rubik's Clock and Square-1 to 'Average of 5'. = Maximum Time limit for Multiple Blindfolded to 1 hour.

Other changes for competitors: = Surface may be used for one-handed solving. = Restriction of specific combinations of events is possible.

Other changes for competition organisers: = A main judge may compete in an event if the WCA delegate is also the main judge. = Random positions for 2x2x2 required, based on new scramble program. = Random positions for Pyraminx required, based on new scramble program. = Reduced options for closed competitions. = More remaining time announcements for Fewest Moves event.

Thank you all for your feedback and contributions. We did our best to cover all your feedback, but it is never possible to make everyone happy. Feedback is always welcome in the WCA Forum.

Happy cubing,

Ron van Bruchem World Cube Association

title.zh: Gilles Roux 卸任 WCA 董事
title.en: Gilles Roux retires as member of WCA Board

html.zh:
来自法国的 Gilles Roux 决定自 2008 年 11 月 1 日起卸任 WCA 董事。

感谢 Gilles 为 WCA 和社区所做的贡献。他于 2004 年 10 月加入董事会，参与组织了多场 WCA 比赛并担任代表。他也为 WCA 竞赛规则作出了重要贡献，帮助 WCA 在世界各地发展。Gilles 将继续以技术顾问身份协助 WCA。

WCA 董事会正在制定未来几年的计划，主要涉及：

  • 完成 WCA 的组织设立工作，包括章程。
  • 调整和扩充 WCA 董事会。
  • 明确长期目标。
  • 组建专门团队，扩充组织以实现目标。
  • 明确 WCA 会员资格，并讨论可能收取的年费。

计划提案准备就绪后，我们会通过 WCA 网站通知大家。在此之前，董事会将由余下三位成员继续开展工作，并得到网站团队 Clément Gallet、Stefan Pochmann 和 Bob Burton 的支持。

祝大家玩魔方愉快！

WCA 董事会

Tyson Mao、Masayuki Akimoto、Ron van Bruchem
html.en:
Gilles Roux of France has decided to retire as a member of the WCA Board, starting November 1, 2008.

We thank Gilles for his contributions to WCA and our community. Gilles started as a WCA Board member in October 2004. He was involved in organising and being WCA delegate in several WCA competitions. He also made great contributions to the WCA regulations and helped WCA grow all around the world. Gilles will stay available to assist as a technical adviser of WCA.

WCA Board is working on plans for the upcoming years. These plans will include the following subjects:

  • finalising the establishment of the WCA organisation, including statutes
  • restructuring and extending the WCA Board
  • defining the longterm goals
  • extending the WCA organisation with dedicated teams to achieve our goals
  • defining membership of WCA and a possible annual fee

Once the proposal for the plan is ready, we will inform you via the WCA website. Until then the WCA Board will keep on working with the remaining three members, supported by the WCA website team (Clément Gallet, Stefan Pochmann and Bob Burton).

Happy cubing,

WCA Board Tyson Mao, Masayuki Akimoto, Ron van Bruchem

title.zh: 关于盲拧的重要公告

html.zh: WCA 已在 WCA 论坛发布一项关于盲拧的重要公告。
html.en: WCA made an important announcement about blindfolded solving on the WCA forum.

title.zh: 关于盲拧的重要公告

html.zh:
各位社群成员：

WCA 董事会经过广泛调查，并与该选手进行了多次交谈后，得出结论：已有毫无疑问的证据表明，2007 年盲拧世界纪录保持者在多场 WCA 比赛的盲拧项目中作弊。该选手并未承认作弊。

证据

证据显示，该选手通过从眼罩下方偷看来作弊。

这些证据来自对 WCA 比赛中多次盲拧还原录像的分析。许多录像都强烈表明存在作弊，因为该选手使用了复杂的方法，且还原成功率达到 100%（77 次还原全部正确）。使用这种方法还原魔方角块时，许多棱块和角块的位置和／或朝向会发生改变。

2007 年世界锦标赛多盲项目的一段录像提供了毫无疑问的证据。录像显示，该选手在执行某一步骤时犯了错误（错误地撤销预设步骤），却没有纠正该错误，而是重新开始还原魔方。只有该选手看到了自己犯错，才可能这样做。否则，他要么会撤销错误的转动，要么就无法再将魔方还原。

裁定

WCA 作出以下裁定：

  • 自今日起，禁止该选手参加所有 WCA 比赛，为期三年。如果该选手充分配合 WCA，可在两年后申诉请求恢复参赛资格。
  • WCA 已将该选手的全部盲拧还原成绩改为 DNF（未完成）。
  • WCA 已要求该选手将盲拧项目所得奖金退还给比赛组织者，以便组织者重新分配奖金。

其他措施

为防止今后在盲拧项目中作弊，WCA 决定采取以下措施：

所有依照《WCA 比赛规则 2007》举办的比赛都必须执行一项临时规则。在预计于 2008 年 3 月发布的《WCA 比赛规则 2008》中，这项新增规则将与其他一些预防措施一并正式纳入。

该规则要求在还原阶段，将一张纸（或类似物品）置于选手面部与魔方之间。WCA 正在寻找一种容易获得、兼顾坐姿和站姿还原、且不需要裁判一直手持纸张的装置。

WCA 希望向以下人员致敬：

  • 新的世界纪录保持者：Danyang Chen、Chris Hardwick（两次）及 Dennis Strehlau。
  • 2007 年世界锦标赛新的世界冠军：Rafal Guzewicz（两次）及 Chris Hardwick。
  • 2007 年世界锦标赛新的银牌得主：Shotaro Makisumi、Dror Vomberg、Bernett Orlando。
  • 2007 年世界锦标赛新的铜牌得主：Tyson Mao、Yumu Tabuchi、Sinpei Araki。
  • 所有其他因该选手作弊而受到损害的人。

沟通

由于该选手当时尚未满 18 岁，WCA 不会在对外沟通中使用其姓名。出于同样原因，WCA 仅向少数相关方提供了此事的详细报告。我们恳请社群共同保护该选手的隐私。

如果社群成员怀疑其他成员作弊，WCA 鼓励他们联系 WCA 董事会，而不是公开发表声明和／或助长不友善的公开讨论。

这项裁定是 WCA 作出的一个非常艰难的决定，但一项有组织的运动如果不执行规则，便失去了意义。WCA 感谢所有协助此次调查的人。

欢迎所有社群成员在 WCA 论坛回应这份公告。所有涉及个人指涉或敌意表达的消息都会受到版主管理。

WCA 的使命

WCA 的使命是：在公平的条件下，让更多国家举办更多比赛，让更多人参与并获得更多乐趣。

致以诚挚的问候，

WCA 董事会

  • Gilles Roux（法国）
  • Masayuki Akimoto（日本）
  • Ron van Bruchem（荷兰）
  • Tyson Mao（美国）
html.en:
Fellow members of our community,

WCA board has come to the conclusion that there is proof beyond any doubt that the 2007 world record holder for blindfolded solving has cheated in the blindfolded events of several WCA competitions. The conclusion of WCA board has come after extensive investigations and a number of conversations with the competitor. The competitor has not confessed.

Proof Proof shows that the competitor cheated by peeking underneath the blindfold. The proof consists of the analysis of videos of several blindfolded solves in WCA competitions. Many videos gave a strong indication of cheating, because of the applied complex method combined with a flawless accuracy (77 correct solves out of 77 solves). The method had the effect that many edge and corner pieces changed positions and/or orientation while solving the corners of the cube. One video of the multiple blindfolded event in World Championship 2007 brought proof beyond any doubt. The video shows that the competitor made an error (incorrect undo of set-up moves) during the execution of a step, and that instead of correcting the error, the competitor started solving the cube again. This is only possible if the competitor would have seen that he had made a mistake. Otherwise he would either have undone his incorrect moves, or he would not have been able to solve the cube anymore.

Verdict WCA has come to the following verdict.

  • WCA has banned the competitor for three years for all WCA competitions, starting today. The competitor may appeal for reinstatement after two years, if he fully cooperates with WCA.
  • WCA has changed all blindfolded solves of the competitor to the result DNF (did not finish).
  • WCA has requested the competitor to return his prize money in blindfolded events to the competition organisers. The organisers can then redistribute the prize money.

Other measurements WCA has come to the following measurement to prevent future cheating in the blindfolded event: A temporary regulation must be applied for all competitions under WCA Regulations 2007. For WCA Regulations 2008 (expected March 2008) the additional regulation will be fully integrated, including some other preventive measurements. The regulation consists of placing a sheet of paper (or a similar object) between the face of a competitor and the cube during the solving phase. WCA is looking for a widely available multi-purpose (solving while sitting and while standing) device that would not require the judge to constantly hold the paper.

WCA wants to honour:

  • the new world record holders: Danyang Chen, Chris Hardwick (twice) and Dennis Strehlau.
  • the new world champions of World Championship 2007: Rafal Guzewicz (twice) and Chris Hardwick.
  • the new silver medal winners of World Championship 2007: Shotaro Makisumi, Dror Vomberg, Bernett Orlando
  • the new bronze medal winners of World Championship 2007: Tyson Mao, Yumu Tabuchi, Sinpei Araki
  • all others who were damaged by the cheating of the competitor.

Communication WCA will not use the competitor’s name in communication because the competitor is still under 18 years of age. For the same reason WCA distributed a detailed report on this matter only to a small number of involved parties. We kindly request our community to support the privacy of the competitor.

WCA encourages members of our community who have suspicions of cheating by other members to contact the WCA board, instead of making public announcements and/or feeding unfriendly public discussions. The verdict is a very difficult decision by the WCA, but an organised sport is meaningless if its rules are not enforced. WCA would like to extend gratitude to everyone who assisted in this investigation.

All members of our community are welcome to respond to this announcement on the WCA forum. All messages with personal references or hostile expressions will be moderated.

Mission of WCA The mission of WCA is: more competitions in more countries with more people and more fun, under fair conditions.

Kind regards,

WCA Board Gilles Roux (France) Masayuki Akimoto (Japan) Ron van Bruchem (Netherlands) Tyson Mao (USA)

title.zh: Yu Nakajima 夺得 2007 年世界魔方锦标赛冠军

html.zh:

title.zh: Masayuki Akimoto 成为 WCA 新任董事
title.en: Masayuki Akimoto new WCA board member

html.zh:
我们很高兴地宣布，来自日本的 Masayuki Akimoto 先生加入 WCA 董事会。

Masayuki 是现任二阶世界冠军，也是 2003 年四阶和五阶世界冠军。他曾负责京都、东京和大阪三场亚洲比赛，并计划今后举办更多比赛。他的网站提供了丰富的信息，也一直通过自己的想法和行动，让这项爱好变得更有趣。

目前 WCA 董事会由四名成员组成：

  • Tyson Mao（联合创始人），美洲
  • Ron van Bruchem（联合创始人），欧洲
  • Gilles Roux，欧洲
  • Masayuki Akimoto，亚洲

我们期待 2006 年在更多地方举办更多比赛，迎来更多选手。2006 年的另一项目标是完成 WCA 的正式设立。之后，我们就可以准备选举新一届董事会。
html.en:
It is with great pleasure that we announce that we have a new WCA board member: Mr. Masayuki Akimoto from Japan.

Masayuki is the reigning world champion for 2x2x2, and 2003 world champion for 4x4x4 and 5x5x5. He was responsible for three Asian competitions (Kyoto, Tokyo and Osaka) and has plans for more in the future. He has a very informative website and is always working hard to make our hobby more fun with his ideas and initiatives.

Currently the WCA board consists of 4 members: Tyson Mao (co-founder), Americas Ron van Bruchem (co-founder), Europe Gilles Roux, Europe Masayuki Akimoto, Asia

We are looking forward to 2006, with more competitions in more places and with more competitors. One of our other goals for 2006 is to finalise the establishment of WCA. After that we are ready for elections for a new board.
